EN_TEXT: The cult that liberates the spiritual aspirant by helping him in expanding his mind and spirit is Tantra. And when a sádhaka, a spiritual aspirant, tries to enlarge his mind, naturally debasing forces become very active. The depraving forces, debasing forces, become very active, and the sádhaka is to enlarge his mind and spirit by fighting at each and every step, each and every stage of life.
ZH_TEXT: 幫助靈性修持者擴展心靈，以達到解脫的法門鍛鍊就稱為「密宗」。 當修行者努力擴展其心靈時，自然許多阻礙會迎面而來。這些墮落、粗鈍的力量是如此張牙舞爪，為了對抗它們以擴展心靈和靈性，修行者在生命的每一步都必須不停地奮鬥。
CITATION_EN: Shrii Shrii Ánandamúrti | Date not known | 04 Fighting at Each and Every Step | Ánanda Vacanámrtam Part 34
CITATION_ZH: Shrii Shrii Ánandamúrti | 日期未知 | 04 每一步都必須奮鬥 | 喜悅甘露集 卷11，P.23

EN_TEXT: Now, a Tantric is called, a sádhaka is called, a soldier. [Sádhanásamara] [“the battle of sádhaná”]. Samara means “war”, “battle”, “fight”. The sádhaka is engaged in fight. It is for the brave, it is for courageous people. Sádhanásamara. And this cult is the cult of Tantra. He who wants to keep himself away from fight is unknowingly committing suicide, mental and spiritual suicide. Each and every man should be ready for fight – fight in the mental stratum, fight in the family stratum, fight in each and every stratum of life. This is Tantra.
ZH_TEXT: 靈性的修持者被稱為「戰士」。靈性修持的戰場稱為Sádhanásamara。Samara是指「戰爭」、「交戰」、「奮鬥」。修行者必須奮戰，靈性的修持是為勇者而備的。而此戰鬥的法門就是「Tantra」。一個意欲躲避戰鬥的人，在不知不覺間犯了自我毀滅的罪行，他毀滅了自己的心靈和靈性。所以每個人都必須隨時備戰，在生命的每個層面都要有戰鬥的準備，這就是「Tantra」。
CITATION_EN: Shrii Shrii Ánandamúrti | Date not known | 04 Fighting at Each and Every Step | Ánanda Vacanámrtam Part 34
CITATION_ZH: Shrii Shrii Ánandamúrti | 日期未知 | 04 每一步都必須奮鬥 | 喜悅甘露集 卷11，P.24

EN_TEXT: You are in the midst of so many minute expressions of Náráyańa. Each and every expression is Náráyańa in a particular form, Náráyańa in a particular shape, Náráyańa in a particular style. You are to serve them, and this serving of Náráyańa in human form is your objective adjustment, and your movement towards the Non-Attributional Supreme Puruśa is your subjective approach.
ZH_TEXT: 你們處在上主森羅萬象的微小展現中，你們必須為眾生服務，你們的客體調適就是以人的形相為祂服務，而你們朝向主體的前進就是往無屬性至上本體的行動。

CITATION_ZH: Shrii Shrii Ánandamúrti | 每一步都必須奮鬥 | 喜悅甘露集卷11，P.33

EN_TEXT: Life is to fight. Now when one starts fight, then he becomes a man in human structure. He is no longer a brute in human structure, he is a man in human structure. And in that phase he says: “O Lord, by Your mercy, by Your grace, I have become a hero, I have started fighting against debasing forces functioning within my mind, functioning within my family, functioning within the society. So by Your grace I have become a hero. I am a hero, I am a viira, thou art Viireshvara [Lord of Heroes].” So in the second phase of sádhaná, Pashupati becomes Viireshvara. It is another name of Lord Shiva. Pashupati becomes Viireshvara. And as a result of further fight, when this fighting tendency, this belligerent tendency, becomes his wont, in that case He becomes a deva, he is called a deva.
ZH_TEXT: 生命就是要奮鬥。當一個人起身奮戰時，他始成為真正的人，而不再是徒具人形的野獸。在此階段，他會說：「哦，主啊！由於您的慈悲，我成了英勇的戰士，開始對抗心中卑劣的習性，也開始與在家庭、社會生活中的阻礙奮戰。所以，因為有您的恩典，我才得以成就自身為英雄，才是個真正的勇者，哦，您是勇者之主(Viireshvara)!」 在靈性修持的第二個階段裡，上主從動物之主(Pashupati)變成勇者之主，這是上主希瓦的另一個稱呼。由於更加努力奮戰，此戰鬥的傾向業已形成習慣，此時他將成為一個神人，他就變成了神。
CITATION_EN: Shrii Shrii Ánandamúrti | Date not known | 05 I Have Become a Hero | Ánanda Vacanámrtam Part 34
CITATION_ZH: Shrii Shrii Ánandamúrti | 日期未知 | 05 成就自身為英雄 | 喜悅甘露集 卷11，P.35

EN_TEXT: In human life there should be – what? Subjective approach through objective adjustment. If only the subjective approach is there and there is no objective adjustment, there equilibrium will be lost. The entire human society will become degraded and destroyed. And if there is only physical activity and no spiritual advancement, human existence will be rendered to the status of brutes or plants, which is not at all desirable. So a spiritual aspirant must always remember the subjective approach through objective adjustment. There is no alternative.
ZH_TEXT: 在生命的進展中，人類必須藉由客體的調適以接近主體。只從事主體的接近，而未有客體的調適，那麼人會失去平衡。整體人類社會也會跟著墮落和毀滅。然而如果只重視客體層面的活動，而忽略靈性的進展，那麼人類的存在將淪落如動、植物般的生命，此非吾人所樂見之結果。所以靈性的修持者一定要牢記「透過客體的調適以接近主體」這句話，此外別無他途可循。

CITATION_ZH: Shrii Shrii Ánandamúrti | 日期未知 | 05 透過客體的調適以接近主體 | 喜悅甘露集 卷9，P.36

EN_TEXT: The resultant of these vrttis, or expressed sentiments, is the saḿskára of the mind concerned. Saḿskáras have a momentum whose inherent force causes the unit body to propel to the force of momentum activating therein. Resultant propensity consists of three aspects – physical [desire], psychic urge and spiritual [longing]. The last one causes neither a good nor a bad reaction; here is a balanced state. The propensitive equipoise is a characteristic only of the Macrocosmic Entity, since in It lies everything, nothing is beyond or external to It. Hence it remains unassailed.
ZH_TEXT: 情感的展現或習性作用的結果和心靈中潛藏的因果業力有關。業力含有一股非表達不可的動力，這活躍的動力驅策著個體。 習性的表達包含三個方面：物質層面的慾望、心理層面以及靈性層面的渴望。靈性層面的渴望所造成的業力沒有所謂好壞，在此它是處於一種平衡的狀態。 唯有大宇宙心靈才有平衡的心靈習性，因為萬有一切均含攝其中，沒有任何東西超越它而存在，故它永恆如新，不受影響。

EN_TEXT: How to attain bhakti, how to withdraw the mind from baser propensities and drive it towards the subtlest entity, the abhiiśt́a? The simplest formula is “action minus jiṋánam [knowledge] is equal to devotion” – “karma minus jiṋánam is equal to bhakti.”
ZH_TEXT: 如何獲得虔誠？如何從低下、粗鈍的心靈習性中將心靈回收導向最精細的實體(abhiiśt́a)?最簡單的方式就是下列的公式：行動減去知識等於虔誠。

EN_TEXT: Every incident of this universe takes place within His mind, every entity is a creation of His vast imagination. He does not require hands and legs to do his work. He guides and rejuvenates all with His psychic power.
ZH_TEXT: 宇宙中的每一事件都在祂的心靈內發生，所有實體皆是祂無限想像的創造，祂不需手和腳來完成祂的工作，而是以其心智力量來引導並賦予一切活力。
CITATION_EN: All Shine with His Effulgence,  | Subháśita Saḿgraha Part 6

EN_TEXT: You are dancing in His mind; your dances are creating a special type of vibration within His mind; it gives Him pleasure. You are doing good work; your good work creates a special type of vibration in His mind; it gives Him pleasure. Whatever good thing you do, it gives Him pleasure.
ZH_TEXT: 你在祂的心靈裡跳舞，你的舞蹈在祂的心靈裡製造出某種波動，讓祂覺得快樂。你正在行善，你所做的事也在祂的心靈裡製造出某種波動，這也讓祂感到快樂。不論你做了什麼好事，都會取悅祂。任何你所發展的好念頭都會取悅祂。

EN_TEXT: All inferences are emanated from the Cosmic Mind, from the mind of the Supreme Father. You are dancing, you will be dancing; but these dances you are dancing within the mind of your Supreme Father. You are dancing within the mind of Parama Puruśa. You are dancing in His mind; your dances are creating a special type of vibration within His mind; it gives Him pleasure. You are doing good work; your good work creates a special type of vibration in His mind; it gives Him pleasure. Whatever good thing you do, it gives Him pleasure.
ZH_TEXT: 所有的微波元素都是從大宇宙心靈、至上之父的心靈而來。你在跳舞，你將要跳舞，但你所跳的舞正在你至上父親的心靈裡，你在至上意識的心靈裡跳舞。你在祂的心靈裡跳舞，你的舞蹈在祂的心靈裡製造出某種波動，讓祂覺得快樂。你正在行善，你所做的事也在祂的心靈裡製造出某種波動，這也讓祂感到快樂。不論你做了什麼好事，都會取悅祂。任何你所發展的好念頭都會取悅祂。

EN_TEXT: In quest of subtler objects, man felt, man realized, that the subtlest of this universe from which all waves, all expressions, emanate, is my Supreme Goal. And that Supreme Goal, that subtlest object, that perennial source of all inferences, is my goal, is my Parama Puruśa, is my Supreme Father. So a spiritual aspirant must always remember that his goal is not something physical or something psychic. His only goal is the hub of this universe, is the nucleus of this Cosmological order, is that Parama Puruśa, the Supreme Father. All human aspirations culminate at that very point. All human desires and longings coincide there at that particular desideratum.
ZH_TEXT: 在精益求精的過程中，人類了悟到至上意識才是宇宙間最精細的目標，祂是所有波動、表達之源。這所有微波元素永恆之源方才是我至上的目標，祂就是至上意識，是我至上的父親。所以，靈性修持者應牢記於心，此至上的目標絕非一物質或心理產物。生命唯一的目標就是宇宙的核心，就是至上意識、至上之父。人類所有的渴望在此達到極致，在此目標一切均皆合一。

CITATION_ZH: Shrii Shrii Ánandamúrti | 日期未知 | 16 究竟真理 | 喜悦甘露集 卷11，P.111

EN_TEXT: After having analysed the various types of ahaḿkára and their evil effects, we need to examine the ways and means of getting rid of these defects. Chaitanya Mahaprabhu has offered a psychological method to save oneself from the malady of ahaḿkára. Ahaḿkára is really a mental ailment, and a person suffering from this disease requires psychological treatment. The following shloka summarizes the line of treatment suggested by Chaitanya Mahaprabhu: Trńádapi suniicena taroriva sahiśńuna; Amanitá mánadeyaḿ kiirttaniya sadá Harih. [You must be more humble than the grass and more tolerant than the trees. You must give respect to those whom no one respects, and always do kiirtana to the Lord.]
ZH_TEXT: 分析各種我執所帶來的不良作用後，我們必須找出對治之道。Chaitanya Mahaprabhu提出一個心理對治法，以使人免於這種自負的「大頭症」。因為我執的確是一種心理疾病，心病需要心藥來治療。下述偈子就是他所提出的方法：Trńádapi suniicena taroriva sahiśńuna; Amanitá mánadeyaḿ kiirttaniya sadá Harih. 「你必須比小草謙卑，比大樹堅忍不拔。你必須尊敬那些不為人所尊敬的人，並且永遠唱頌至上的聖名(kiirtana)。」
CITATION_EN: Shrii Shrii Ánandamúrti | Date not known | 18 Safeguards against the Defects of Jiṋána and Karma | Ánanda Vacanámrtam Part 23
CITATION_ZH: Shrii Shrii Ánandamúrti | 日期未知 | 19 擺脫知識與行動的缺點 | 喜悅甘露集 卷7，P.134~135

EN_TEXT: By becoming a true spiritual aspirant you know God in yourself. You know that truth in yourself. That is what your life is to be.
ZH_TEXT: 當你成為真正的靈性修持者時，你就會在你的內在了悟到上主。你會知道真理不假外求，就在你的裡面。這才是你的人生。

CITATION_ZH: Shrii Shrii Ánandamúrti | 日期未知 | 28 法性修持 | 喜悅甘露集 卷9，P.152

EN_TEXT: The purpose of all creation, the purpose of all human beings, is to know what we are; that is why we are all born in this world. The very purpose of our human existence is to know what we are. There is no other purpose in this universe. Remember always that the very purpose of our creation is to know Him, the Supreme Entity which is in front of you all the time.
ZH_TEXT: 萬有眾生之目的、人類之目的皆在於了知自身為何，這就是我們來到這個世界的原因。所以我們存在的唯一目的為的就是了悟我們自己，再也沒有其他的目的了；永遠要記住萬有一切的目的就是了悟那個時時刻刻都呈現在你面前的祂。

CITATION_ZH: Shrii Shrii Ánandamúrti | 日期未知 | 28 法性修持 | 喜悅甘露集 卷9，P.153~154

EN_TEXT: The very purpose of our human creation is to follow the true dharma; is to maintain spiritual practices in this very life, and to become one in Him. So dharma sádhaná means that by following dharma we follow our sádhaná, we follow our spiritual practices. By following the spiritual practices we become one with Him. That is the final victory. That is the final goal of all human beings on this planet. Having proper restraint over your animal nature, try to follow the true human nature; the true human nature is to know yourself.
ZH_TEXT: 遵循我們真正的法性、此生堅守靈性修持並且努力與至上意識合一就是我們人類真正的目的。遵循法性即靈性修持，因靈性修持而得以與祂合一，這就是法性修持之意；這是極致的成就，也是人類最終的目標。適當控制住你的動物傾向，努力奉行人類真正的法性，人類真正的法性就是了悟真我。
CITATION_EN: Shrii Shrii Ánandamúrti | Date not known | Dharma Sádhaná | Ánanda Vacanámrtam Part 31
CITATION_ZH: Shrii Shrii Ánandamúrti | 日期未知 | 法性修持 | 喜悅甘露集 卷9，P.156

EN_TEXT: Happiness is derived by getting what one desires. If one does not get what one desires, one cannot be happy. One becomes sad and miserable. The clearly-reflected consciousness in people, which alone distinguishes them from animals, seeks the Cosmic Entity or the Infinite. And so people derive real happiness only when they can attain the Cosmic Entity or get into the process of attaining It.
ZH_TEXT: 快樂之產生是由於得到了想要的東西，一個人如果得不到所想要的東西就不會快樂。人內在清晰反映的意識，使其有別於動物，使其不斷地追求宇宙本體或永恆。因此人只有在達到宇宙本體或學會達到祂的方法時，才能得到真正的快樂。

EN_TEXT: There are innumerable individual minds in this universe, and as there is a reflection [of Paramátman] on each one, there appear to be many átmans [unit consciousnesses]. The collective name for all these átmans or unit consciousnesses is Paramátman, Bhúmácaetanya, Brahma or Bhagaván.
ZH_TEXT: 在這宇宙中有無數個體，並且因為個體意識反映在每個人身上，因此顯得有許多自性本體或個體意識。所有這些自性本體或個體意識之總稱為「至上本體」、「宇宙意識」或「薄伽梵」。

EN_TEXT: Only by advancing in the direction of Brahma, and by attaining this original form, can human beings be liberated from this illusory world. To attain oneʼs original self is to attain the universal Puruśa. The object-free unit soul and the object-free universal soul are one and the same entity.
ZH_TEXT: 只有朝著至上意識的方向前進，回到其原來的樣子，人才能從虛幻的世界中得到解脫。要達到我們本來的自性就是要達到宇宙意識。沒有客體的個體靈魂和沒有客體的宇宙靈魂是一體的。

EN_TEXT: The last and most important difference between Brahma and human beings is the difference in their characteristic property, or dharma. The dharma of human beings is to do sádhaná and become a muktapuruśa (emancipated being), while that of Saguńa Brahma is to provide an opportunity to each and every one of its units to become a muktapuruśa.
ZH_TEXT: 宇宙本體與人之間最後也是最重要的不同處是在他們的特質或法性。人的法性是從事修持並成為一個解脫的人，而俱屬性宇宙本體的特性則是為祂的每個個體提供成為一個解脫者的機會。
CITATION_EN: Shrii Shrii Ánandamúti | 1955, 'What Is This World?', "Ananda Marga: Elementary Philosophy"
CITATION_ZH: Shrii Shrii Ánandamúti | 1955，世界的本質，激揚生命的哲學，P.74

EN_TEXT: Buddhitattva comes into being due to the qualifying influence of the sentient principle of Prakrti on the unit consciousness. This also brings about the feeling of “I” and creates the knowledge of existence of unit consciousness.
ZH_TEXT: 我覺是由於造化勢能的悅性力量影響個體意識而產生的。這同時產生了「我」的感覺及個體意識對存在的認識。
CITATION_EN: Shrii Shrii Ánandamúrti | 1955 | 04 Who Am I and What Am I? | Ananda Marga: Elementary Philosophy
CITATION_ZH: Shrii Shrii Ánandamúrti | 1955年 | 04 我是誰？我是什麼？ | 阿南達瑪迦：激揚生命的哲學，P.78

EN_TEXT: The process or reaction which restores mind to its original form, the deformity being due to the actions of mind, is experienced as karmaphala (result of actions). The intensity with which an action is performed and thus deforms the mind will be exhibited to the same extent in the reaction or karmaphala.
ZH_TEXT: 心靈由於行為而變形，若要回復至原來的形態，則必須經歷其反作用，此一過程即稱為因果業報。造成心靈變形的行為強度，在行為的反作用力（果報）發生時，也會展現出同樣的強度。
CITATION_EN: Shrii Shrii Ánandamúrti | 1955 | 05 What Is My Relation with the Universe and the Cosmic Entity? | Ananda Marga: Elementary Philosophy
CITATION_ZH: Shrii Shrii Ánandamúrti | 1955年 | 05 我與世界及宇宙本體之關係 | 阿南達瑪迦：激揚生命的哲學，P.89

EN_TEXT: Human beings themselves are answerable for their fate as it is their actions alone which create it. They alone will have to bear the consequences of all their actions. No one else can substitute for them. Their good deeds beget good results, while bad ones beget bad results, and they will have to experience both without any exception. This is the law of Prakrti and no one can change this law.
ZH_TEXT: 人本身應為其命運負責，因為是他自己的行為造成的。只有他本人須為其所有行為承受後果，沒有人能代替。好行為產生好的果報，不良的行為產生壞的結果，而當事者必須毫無例外的經歷二者。這是造化勢能的法則，沒有人能改變此法則。
CITATION_EN: Shrii Shrii Ánandamúti | 1955 | What Is My Relation with the Universe and the Cosmic Entity? | Ananda Marga: Elementary Philosophy
CITATION_ZH: Shrii Shrii Ánandamúti | 1955 | 我與世界及宇宙本體之關係 | 阿南達瑪迦：激揚生命的哲學，P.100

EN_TEXT: One experiences the result of oneʼs actions in a subsequent life and cannot then recollect the actions whose results bring happiness and grief, because a personʼs memory is not large enough to remember or know the deeds of their past lives. Reactions which humans experience were collected in previous lives, and in present life they cannot make out the cause of such experiences, and hence term these experiences as fate or the unknown future.
ZH_TEXT: 一個人在來世經歷其前一世的行為果報，不過在經歷前世果報時，人並無法記得給他帶來快樂及悲傷後果的前世行為，因為人的記憶並沒有強到足以記得或知道其前世的行為。人經歷的反作用由前一世累積下來，在這一世，他無法了解這種經歷的原因，因此稱此種經歷為命運或不可知的未來。
CITATION_EN: Shrii Shrii Ánandamúrti | 1955 | 05 What Is My Relation with the Universe and the Cosmic Entity? | Ananda Marga: Elementary Philosophy
CITATION_ZH: Shrii Shrii Ánandamúrti | 1955 | 05 我與世界及宇宙本體之關係  | 阿南達瑪迦：激揚生命的哲學，P.100

EN_TEXT: Good deeds are those which enlarge the reflection of Consciousness without leading one to go against the laws of Prakrti, called Vidyámáyá – which is associated with vaerágya and viveka. Vaerágya means to attempt to understand the proper use of things and to use them correctly. Discrimination between good and evil is viveka. Viveka is, therefore, necessary for following vaerágya, and vaerágya is a great contributory factor in achieving emancipation (mukti).
ZH_TEXT: 良好的行為就是能擴張意識的反映，即是符合「宇宙向心力」(Vidyámáyá)的行為，亦即不執著(Vaerágya)與明辨(Viveka) 。 不執著是要人了解對東西正確及適當的運用，能分别善惡即是明辨。 要遵循不執著先要能明辨，而不執著是達到解脫的必要因素。
CITATION_ZH: 1955，人應如何活在世界上，激揚生命的哲學，P.104

EN_TEXT: This right use of a thing is vaerágya. Right use of anything within the idea of vaerágya does not make oneʼs mind a slave to a constant longing for the object. One becomes indifferent to it. By developing indifference or not being constantly attracted by crude things, oneʼs mind becomes subtle.
ZH_TEXT: 在不執著的觀念下正確運用事物，可使人心不會成為欲望的奴隸，而會使一個人對於物質無所掛心，再藉著發展不執著或始終不受粗鈍事物所吸引，則心智將愈趨精細。
CITATION_EN: Shrii Shrii Ánandamúrti | 1955 | 06 How Should Human Beings Live In This World? | Ananda Marga: Elementary Philosophy
CITATION_ZH: Shrii Shrii Ánandamúrti | 1955年 | 06 人應如何活在世界上 | 阿南達瑪迦：激昂生命的哲學，P.105

EN_TEXT: Discrimination between good and evil is viveka. To consider the use of alcohol as an intoxicant to be evil and its use as a medicine to be good is viveka. The same thing by change in its use can become good or evil, and discrimination between the two is viveka. It is with discrimination (viveka) only that mind can determine the goodness or evil in a thing or in its uses. Viveka is, therefore, necessary for following vaerágya, and vaerágya is a great contributory factor in achieving emancipation (mukti). Thus vaerágya and viveka alone are good deeds or Vidyámáyá.
ZH_TEXT: 能分別善惡即是明辨，將酒精用來迷醉他人身心即是為惡，而當作藥用即是為善，這就是明辨之用。同一件東西的用途可好可壞，而能分別其中是非者即是明辨。唯具有明辨，心靈才能決定某物及其用途是好是壞。因此要遵循不執著先要能明辨，而不執著是達到解脫的必要因素。因此只有不執著及明辨才是良好的行為。
IT_TEXT: La discriminazione tra bene e male è viveka. Considerare cattivo l’uso dell’alcol come sostanza inebriante e considerare buono il suo uso come medicina è viveka. La stessa cosa, cambiando il suo utilizzo, può diventare buona o cattiva, e la discriminazione tra le due possibilità è viveka. È soltanto attraverso il discernimento (viveka) che la mente può determinare il bene o il male presenti in una cosa o nel suo utilizzo. Viveka è dunque necessario per seguire il vaerágya (l'uso corretto di ogni cosa), e il vaerágya è un importante fattore che contribuisce al raggiungimento della liberazione (mukti). Perciò soltanto vaerágya e viveka sono vere buone azioni, ovvero Vidyámáyá.
CITATION_EN: Shrii Shrii Ánandamúrti | 1955 | 06 How Should Human Beings Live In This World? | Ananda Marga: Elementary Philosophy
CITATION_ZH: Shrii Shrii Ánandamúrti | 1955年 | 06 人應如何活在世界上 | 阿南達瑪迦：激揚生命的哲學，P.105

EN_TEXT: The purpose of the Qualified Supreme Entity (Saguńa Brahma) in creating human beings is to make them follow Its course towards the subtle so as to take them back to the supreme rank. This forms the nature (dharma) of human beings. To get back to the supreme rank, effort for the elevation of unit consciousness is necessary, and actions should also be in keeping with the laws of Prakrti so that She does not create obstacles to progress. Hence the people of the first category, that is, good people, are natural (prákrta manuśya), as they work according to their nature (dharma), and they alone serve the purpose for which the Qualified Supreme Entity (Saguńa Brahma) made them.
ZH_TEXT: 俱屬性至上本體創造人的目的，乃是為了使人遵循祂的方針而走向精細，以便將他帶返最高的本源，這形成了人的本性。要回到最高的境界，則必須為提昇個體意識而努力，同時行為也應遵守造化勢能的法則，如此造化勢能才不致在前進的道路上製造障礙。因此，只有第一等的人才是合乎自然的，因為他們是依循著自己的本性而行，也只有他們才符合俱屬性至上本體創造他們的目的。
IT_TEXT: Lo scopo dell’Entità Suprema qualificata (Saguṇa Brahma) nel creare gli esseri umani è far sì che essi seguano il Suo percorso verso il sottile, così da ricondurli allo stato supremo. Questa è la natura (dharma) dell’essere umano. Per ritornare allo stato supremo è necessario uno sforzo volto all’elevazione della coscienza individuale, e le azioni devono essere in accordo con le leggi di Prakṛti, affinché essa non ponga ostacoli al progresso. Per questo motivo, le persone della prima categoria — cioè le persone buone — sono naturali (prākṛta manuṣya), poiché agiscono secondo la loro natura (dharma), e solo esse realizzano il fine per cui l’Entità Suprema qualificata (Saguṇa Brahma) le ha create.
CITATION_EN: Shrii Shrii Ánandamúrti | 1955 | 06 How Should Human Beings Live In This World? | Ananda Marga: Elementary Philosophy
CITATION_ZH: Shrii Shrii Ánandamúrti | 1955年 | 06 人應如何活在世界上 | 阿南達瑪迦：激揚生命的哲學，P.107

EN_TEXT: The human mind is so made that it has the capacity of becoming like the object to which it is attached. The unit consciousness that wants to return to Cosmic Consciousness quickly has to become devoted to Cosmic Consciousness, and this is bhakti. “I am That” is the idea to which the unit consciousness has to be completely devoted in order to become That one day. Bhakti, devotion, or calling Cosmic Consciousness, thus leads one to become like That.
ZH_TEXT: 人類的心靈被造得有能力變成與它所專注的事物一樣。個體意識要想很快地回到宇宙意識也必須專注於宇宙意識，而這就是虔誠。「我就是祂」是個體意識必須完全專注的思想，以便有一天能成為「祂」。因此虔誠或呼喚宇宙意識是讓人變得像祂。
CITATION_EN: Shrii Shrii Ánandamúrti | 1955 | 06 How Should Human Beings Live In This World | Ananda Marga: Elementary Philosophy
CITATION_ZH: Shrii Shrii Ánandamúrti | 1955年 | 06 人應如何活在世界上 | 阿南達瑪迦──激揚生命的哲學，P.114

EN_TEXT: The wish of the Qualified Supreme Entity is to obtain merger with the Non-Qualified Entity or the supreme rank for every one of Its units.
ZH_TEXT: 俱屬性至上本體的意願，是在使祂的每個個體與無屬性宇宙本體或無上的境界合一。
CITATION_ZH: 1955 | 〈人生之目標〉，《阿南達瑪迦：激揚生命的哲學》 P.120

EN_TEXT: To steady the vacillation of the mind, to concentrate the mind, to make the mind more subtle, are the ways to achieve freedom from the bondage of Prakrti.
ZH_TEXT: 安定浮盪的心靈與集中心靈，使心靈由粗鈍變為更精細，這些都是從造化勢能的束縛中解脫出來的方法或途徑。
CITATION_EN: Shrii Shrii Ánandamúrti | 1955 | Intuitional Practice and Its Necessity | Ananda Marga: Elementary Philosophy
CITATION_ZH: Shrii Shrii Ánandamúrti | 1955年 | 08 靈修及其必要性 | 阿南達瑪迦──激揚生命的哲學，P.131

EN_TEXT: People have been shackled by Prakrti and imprisoned in this wide prison – the world. It would never be possible for them to become free without the help of another person. Besides this, it is not possible for anyone to learn an art all by themselves. One must have someone who can teach them or whom they can imitate. Such a person from whom one can learn an art is a preceptor. Intuitional practice (sádhaná) is also an art and has to be learned from a preceptor. Hence emancipation is not possible without a preceptor (guru). A guru is always a prime necessity for obtaining emancipation.
ZH_TEXT: 人被造化勢能關在這個廣大的監獄（世界）裡，若無他人的幫助，便絕不可能身獲自由。 此外，一個人不可能靠自己習得所有的微奧法門，他需要旁人的教導或借鏡，而可使人們從其學習的人即為導師。修持也是一種方法，必須從師學習，因此若無一位真正的上師指引，解脫是不可能的。上師永遠是求得解脫的必要條件。
CITATION_EN: Shrii Shrii Ánandamúrti | 1955 | 08 Intuitional Practice and Its Necessity | Ananda Marga: Elementary Philosophy
CITATION_ZH: Shrii Shrii Ánandamúrti | 1955年 | 08 靈修及其必要性 | 阿南達瑪迦──激揚生命的哲學，P.135

EN_TEXT: The purpose of the Qualified Supreme Entity in manifesting the creation is to obtain emancipation for each one of Its units. In order to fulfil this purpose, It will have to appear before anyone who has a yearning for emancipation. This yearning or state of mental uneasiness caused by the intense desire for emancipation heralds the arrival of the opportune moment. The Qualified Supreme Entity, in the form of a great preceptor, will appear to those who have reached this opportune moment by virtue of their intense desire for liberation.
ZH_TEXT: 俱屬性至上本體創造此宇宙的目的是在為祂的每一個體求得解脫，而為了達到此目的，祂必將出現在每個渴求解脫的人面前。這種渴望或由於強烈地渴望解脫而心神不安的狀態稱為機緣的成熟。俱屬性至上本體所示現的偉大上師，只會接觸有強烈解脫欲望且時機成熟的人。
CITATION_EN: Shrii Shrii Ánandamúrti | 1955 | 08 Intuitional Practice and Its Necessity | Ananda Marga: Elementary Philosophy
CITATION_ZH: Shrii Shrii Ánandamúrti | 1955年 | 08 靈修及其必要性 | 阿南達瑪迦──激揚生命的哲學，P.136

EN_TEXT: 1955, Intuitional Practice and Its Necessity Ananda Marga: Elementary Philosophy
ZH_TEXT: 靈修意指由造化勢能的束縛影響下得到自由。由上師所傳授的修持法門即是去除宇宙離心力的方法。因此真正的靈修在開始時，會遭遇到宇宙離心力更大更明顯的反抗力。障礙是由造化勢能所製造，所以要得到解脫，必須以靈修作為武器來打敗它，宇宙離心力則利用障礙作為武器來阻止修行者的成功。我們應將靈修中的障礙視為好的兆頭，象徵著宇宙離心力開始衰竭。
CITATION_ZH: 1955，靈修及其必要性，激揚生命哲學，P.139

EN_TEXT: Forcing oneself to leave worldly life only to keep away from its attractions will serve no purpose. This causes mental agitation and pain and may even bring about oneʼs downfall. To give up the world merely for one doubtful advantage, instead of developing strength of character and firmness of mind, brings one no credit. The brave live among temptations in order to face and overcome them step by step rather than avoiding them due to their fear. Sádhaná means waging war on avidyá, and to win it one has to face the enemy instead of running away or appeasing him. Thus to give up the worldly life merely due to fear of its temptations is not a reasonable approach.
ZH_TEXT: 一個人若不發展堅定的品德及堅強的心靈，而只是為了這個不確定的小小方便就遠離世俗是無益的。勇者會生活在誘惑之中，面對它們，逐步地克服，而不是由於害怕而一昧地逃避。靈修即是向宇宙離心力宣戰，為了要戰勝，就必須面對敵人，而非逃跑或姑息。因此只是為了害怕誘惑而放棄世俗的生活實非明智之舉。
CITATION_EN: Shrii Shrii Ánandamúrti | 1955 | 09 Why Are People Afraid of Intuitional Practice? | Ananda Marga: Elementary Philosophy
CITATION_ZH: Shrii Shrii Ánandamúrti | 1955年 | 09人為何畏懼靈修 | 阿南達瑪迦──激揚生命的哲學，P.146

EN_TEXT: To lead a worldly life and also to practise sádhaná is very convenient. For a person living the normal life of a householder has far greater conveniences and advantages available to him or her than has an ascetic who renounces the world. Retreating to the jungle is not a way to obtain relief from the trials and worries of the world. There is yet another great advantage in living a worldly life. It provides one with the opportunity to serve humanity.
ZH_TEXT: 不規避世俗生活同時也從事靈修是最合宜的。因為普通家居生活，遠較棄世的苦行生活有著更多的方便。在山林中尋找清靜並不可能脫離世俗的憂慮煩惱。世俗的生活還有另一極大的益利，亦即提供服務人群的機會。
CITATION_EN: Shrii Shrii Ánandamúrti | 1955 | 09 Why Are People Afraid of Intuitional Practice? | Ananda Marga: Elementary Philosophy
CITATION_ZH: Shrii Shrii Ánandamúrti | 1955年 | 09 人為何畏懼靈修 | 阿南達瑪迦：激揚生命的哲學，P.148

EN_TEXT: The feelings of weal and woe are creations of the mind. Although the mind is limited, its orbit is vast. The aspirant undertakes spiritual practice through the mind. When the aspirant merges his or her mind in Brahma through sádhaná, he or she attains Brahma. They earn an eternal abode above all weal and woe and they cannot entertain any feeling of difference. They see Brahma in everything.
ZH_TEXT: 福與禍的感受都是心靈的產物。心靈雖然有限，但它的範疇卻是浩瀚無垠。修行者透過心靈來從事靈性的修持，將心靈融入至上意識，他就到達了至上意識。在所有的禍與福上，他獲得了永恆的住所，他們不再持有任何的分別心，他們在萬有中都見到至上意識。
CITATION_EN: Shrii Shrii Ánandamúrti | c. 1955 DMC | 08 The Form of Sádhaná | Subháśita Saḿgraha Part 1
CITATION_ZH: Shrii Shrii Ánandamúrti | 約1955年於某大法會 | 09 云何靈性修持 | 靈性科學集成 卷1，P.124

EN_TEXT: The principles of Yama and Niyama perfectly illustrate how one should deal with the surrounding world. The potentiality of an ideal humanity is inherent in Yama and Niyama. Those who are established in Yama and Niyama attain emancipation from the aśt́apásha and śad́aripu arising from Avidyá (the extroversial force). In this connection it is important to remember that overcoming the aśt́apásha and śad́aripu is not the same as eliminating them. In order to survive, one will have to maintain these páshas and ripus, but you should not be subservient to them, rather they should be subservient to you.
ZH_TEXT: 持戒與精進完整地教導了吾人處世之道，遵守持戒與精進可發展出理想的人性，並能從無明力量的八大束縛與六大敵人中得到解脫。克服八大束縛與六大敵人不是意謂在消除它們；為了生存，個人必須要維繫這些束縛與敵人，但不應受其宰制，反之應成為其主人。
CITATION_EN: Shrii Shrii Ánandamúti | 1956, Jamalpur | Sádhaná, Ananda Marga Caryácarya Part 1
CITATION_ZH: Shrii Shrii Ánandamúti | 1956年於加滿坡 | 靈性修持(Sádhaná)，阿南達瑪迦生活指引卷一，P.15

EN_TEXT: Let us move together, let us radiate the same thought-wave, let us come to know our minds together, Let us share our wealth without differentiation, like sages of the past, so that all may enjoy the universe. Let our aspirations be united, let our hearts be inseparable, Let our minds be as one mind, so that we live in harmony and become one with the Supreme.
ZH_TEXT: Shrii Shrii Ánandamúrti 1956年於加滿坡 09 團體靜坐阿南達瑪迦生活指引卷1,P.28
CITATION_EN: Shrii Shrii Ánandamúrti | 1956, Jamalpur  | 09 Dharmacakra  | Ananda Marga Caryácarya Part 1

EN_TEXT: Your Treasures Sublime ideology, universal love, and unshakeable unity among yourselves. Your Flag A triangular saffron flag with a white swastika inside. Your Pratiika [Emblem] A triangle with one vertex up superimposed on another triangle with one vertex down, with the rising sun having a swastika inside. These are symbols of energy, knowledge, advancement and permanent victory, respectively. You shall protect, in all respects and at all costs, the dignity of your treasures and the sanctity of your flag, of your emblem, and of the pratikrti [photo] of Márga Guru.
ZH_TEXT: 你們的寶藏崇高的理念、宇宙之愛、以及你們彼此間堅定不移的團結。 你們的旗幟橘紅色的三角形旗幟，裡面有白色的卐(swastika)符號。 你們的靈性標誌(Pratiika) 一個頂點向上的三角形加在另一個頂點向下的三角形，中間有一個向上昇起的太陽，太陽裡面有一個卐(swastika)符號。它分別象徵能量、知識、前進和永恆勝利。 你們要不計代價在各方面，保護這些寶藏的尊嚴，以及旗幟、靈性標誌及瑪迦上師照片的神聖性。

Unit beings must be made to appreciate Its majesty.
ZH_TEXT: 阿南達瑪琪必須要遵守的責任：無形、無始、無限的至上意識是眾生應追尋的唯一實體，此實體即是至上的上師；祂以阿南達慕提之名及形象，向我們揭示了靈性直覺科學，應竭盡所能讓眾生皆能體察其神聖性。

ZH_TEXT: 透過各種大大小小的工作來喚醒人性。人性的真諦就是神性，而其完美就是至上之境。對此，靈性修持者務必須臾不可忘懷。

EN_TEXT: What place does knowledge or reasoning occupy in tapah sádhaná? This is a very important question. Truly speaking, far greater knowledge is required to render service pertaining to tapah than to render service pertaining to shaoca. Tapah devoid of knowledge is bound to be misused.
ZH_TEXT: 實踐奉獻服務時，知識或推理佔何種地位是個非常重要的問題。實在地說，在從事與奉獻服務有關的鍛鍊時，所需的知識遠比從事潔淨鍛鍊時所需的知識要多。沒有足夠的知識，必然會誤用奉獻服務。

EN_TEXT: The attachment to happiness is the primary vrtti (propensity) of living beings. Infinite happiness is ánanda (bliss). This ánanda is called Brahma. That (Brahma) having been attained, all thirst is permanently quenched. To long for and run after the Great is dharma. Therefore dharma should always be practised.
ZH_TEXT: 對快樂的渴望是所有生靈首要的心靈情緒傾向；無限的快樂即是喜悅，這個喜悅即稱為至上意識；達到至上意識時，所有的渴望都得到了永恆的滿足；對至上意識的渴望和追求即是法性。因此，必須不斷的從事法性的修持。

EN_TEXT: What you must do is simply surrender to the Lord and leave everything else to Him and Him alone. Your ideal should be the Lord, and your effort should be towards a complete self-surrender. You should ask the Lord to make you what He wants. You should ask the Lord to take that work from You which He desires.
ZH_TEXT: 你應該做的只有「臣服」，對上主完全的臣服，一無所求地將一切都交給祂。故你生命的典範應是上主本身，你應努力達到完全的臣服。你應該隨上主高興把你變成祂想要的，你應請上主讓那個你做祂想要你做的事。

EN_TEXT: Salutations to that respected Guru having the form of an unbroken, undivided circle, by whom the movable and immovable worlds are pervaded, by whom the supreme stance of salvation is shown.  Salutations to that respected Guru by whom the eyes of one blinded by the darkness of ignorance are opened with a stick that applies the ointment of spiritual knowledge.  The Guru as Supreme Progenitor, the Guru as Guardian, the Guru as the one who has the withdrawing power, the Guru who alone is the Supreme Subject – salutations to that respected Guru.
ZH_TEXT: 謹向本自圓滿俱足的至上古魯致敬，祂遍佈三千大千世界祂賜予眾生究竟的解脫。 謹向本自圓滿俱足的至上古魯致敬，祂以靈性的知識，打開了眾生為無明黑暗所遮蔽的雙眼。 古魯即是至上的創造者，古魯即是至上的維繫者，古魯即是至上的毀滅者；古魯即是至上意識，謹向尊敬的古魯，獻上最深的禮敬。

EN_TEXT: What is bhajana? You know, in the process of ideation there are several varieties. One of those varieties is bhajana. When the sádhaka employs all his or her sensory and motor organs in serving his or her object of ideation, that is called bhajana. Devotees sing the name of their Lord, and their ears hear that kiirtana, that bhajana; that is, all their indriyas, all their sensory and motor organs, are engaged in serving the Lord. That particular type of ideation is called bhajana.
ZH_TEXT: 何謂「虔誠之歌」(bhajana)?你們知道，在理念作用的過程中，有許多不同的類型，其中一種就是「虔誠之歌」。靈性的修持者運用其所有的感覺和運動器官，為其理念作用的目標而服務，就稱為「虔誠之歌」。虔誠者唱頌著上主的聖名，他們的耳朵聆聽著上主聖名之唱頌以及虔誠的歌曲，也就是說他們所有的器官（包括所有的感覺和運動器官）都致力於對上主的服務。這種特別的理念作用型態，即稱之為「虔誠之歌」。
IT_TEXT: Che cos’è il bhajana? Come sapete, nel processo dell’ideazione esistono diverse modalità. Una di queste modalità è il bhajana. Quando il sādhaka impiega tutti i propri organi sensoriali e motori al servizio dell’oggetto della sua ideazione, questo si chiama bhajana. I devoti cantano il nome del loro Signore e le loro orecchie ascoltano quel kīrtana, quel bhajana; cioè, tutti i loro indriya, tutti gli organi sensoriali e motori, sono impegnati nel servizio del Signore. Questa particolare forma di ideazione si chiama bhajana.

EN_TEXT: Psycho-physical parallelism is very easy, while psycho-spiritual parallelism requires repeated mental efforts. That is why wise sádhakas superimpose Brahmabháva on physical objects and mental thoughts. At once they cease to be physical or mental, they become spiritual. After all, each and every object – physical or psychic – is nothing but an expression of Brahma. As a result, one will not have to reap the consequences of oneʼs actions. This is the only way by which one can prevent oneʼs mind from being crudified due to constant psycho-physical parallelism.
ZH_TEXT: 心理欲取得與物質層面的平行是非常容易的，然而心理欲取得與靈性層面的平行卻需要持續有恆的心智鍛鍊。這就是為什麼明智的修行者要將至上理念波流(Brahmabháva)置於物質客體和心理念頭之上的原因。只要他們不再被引導朝向物質或心理，他們就會導向於靈性。畢竟不管是物質或心理，每一種客體終究都是至上意識的展現，所以如果將至上理念波流置於一切事物之上，那麼吾人的任何行動就不會有果報的問題產生。這是在不斷與物質取得平行的過程中，避免心靈粗鈍化的唯一方法。
CITATION_EN: Shrii Shrii Ánandamúrt | 1969, Ranchi | 15 Bhusuku and Brahmabháva | Ánanda Vacanámrtam Part 33

EN_TEXT: People were carefree on elephantsʼ backs, but they are sufficiently careful when they are driving a motor car or scooter. When going to the moon or Mars, people should be sufficiently cautious. The body and mind should be properly adjusted. This is called environmental adjustment. Ásana, práńáyáma [yogic postures and breathing], etc., help us in this adjustment.
ZH_TEXT: 人坐在象背上可悠哉悠哉的，但是駕車或騎摩托車就得小心，當他們要上太空到月球或火星，就要更謹慎了。人類的身、心都必須適當地調適，這就是對於環境的調適。瑜伽體位法、呼吸控制法等都能幫助我們做這方面的調適。
IT_TEXT: In passato le persone stavano tranquille sul dorso degli elefanti, ma oggi, quando guidano un’automobile o uno scooter, devono prestare molta attenzione. E quando andranno sulla Luna o su Marte, dovranno essere ancora più prudenti. Il corpo e la mente devono essere adeguatamente adattati. Questo è chiamato adattamento ambientale. Le ásana, il pránáyáma  [le posture e respirazione yogica], ecc., ci aiutano in questo adattamento.
CITATION_EN: Shrii Shrii Ánandamúrti | c. 1969 | 04 Scope for Environmental Adjustment | Ánanda Vacanámrtam Part 33
CITATION_ZH: Shrii Shrii Ánandamúrti | 約1969年 | 04 環境的調適 | 喜悅甘露集 卷10，P.21

EN_TEXT: The Cosmic will guides animals and other objects of the universe. Humans are also guided by Him. But due to the influence of ego, humans are directly controlled by ego and indirectly by the Cosmic Mind. If humans move according to the will of the Cosmic Mind, their speed will be accelerated.
ZH_TEXT: 大宇宙的心意引導著生物以及宇宙間其他各種物體，人類雖然也在祂的引導下，但受自我感的影響，人類直接受制於自我感的操控，間接受制於大宇宙心靈。如果人類能夠順應大宇宙心靈的心意而行動，則他們前進的速度會加快許多。
IT_TEXT: La volontà cosmica guida gli animali e gli altri oggetti dell’universo. Anche gli esseri umani sono guidati da Lui. Ma, sotto l’influenza dell’ego, gli esseri umani sono guidati direttamente da esso e solo indirettamente dalla Mente Cosmica. Se gli esseri umani si muovono secondo la volontà della Mente Cosmica, la loro velocità sarà accelerata.
CITATION_EN: Shrii Shrii Ánandamúrti | c. 1969 | 05 Our Concept of Creation and Cosmic Mind | Ánanda Vacanámrtam Part 33
CITATION_ZH: Shrii Shrii Ánandamúrti | 約1969年 | 05 創造與大宇宙心靈 | 喜悅甘露集 卷10，P.28

EN_TEXT: If human beings cannot surrender themselves at the altar of Parama Puruśa they can never attain spiritual progress in life. Without total surrender, Macrocosmic grace is not attained, and without Macrocosmic grace nothing is attained. Besides this there is no other way, (Nányah Panthá Vidyateyanáya).
ZH_TEXT: 倘若人不能臣服於至上意識，他們就無法獲得靈性生命的進展。沒有全然的臣服，無法得到大宇宙的恩典，沒有大宇宙的恩典，則終將一無所獲。除此之外，別無他途可循(Nányah Panthá Vidyateyanáya)。

EN_TEXT: Humans, in spite of their numerous defects and loopholes, are divine beings. Sometimes due to their momentary weaknesses they commit some mistakes or crimes; but after all, they are manifestations of God. Everyone is a divine creature and everyone is destined to be perfect some day or other. Whatever we are now is the result of our thoughts and actions in the past, and whatever we shall be in the future will be the result of what we think and do now.
ZH_TEXT: 縱然人類有許多缺點，但仍舊是一神性的存在。有的時候他們因為一時的軟弱而犯下過錯或罪行，但他們終究是上主的展現。每個人都是神聖的，有朝一日也終將變成完美的。現在的我，是過去思想行為所造成的結果，而將來的我，亦會是現在言行思維的結果。
CITATION_EN: Shrii Shrii Ánandamúrti | 1969, Ranchi | 12 Dasha, Bháva and Mahábháva | Ánanda Vacanámrtam Part 33
CITATION_ZH: Shrii Shrii Ánandamúrti | 1969年於Ranchi | 12 靈性喜悅的境界 | 喜悅甘露集 卷10，P.71

EN_TEXT: The more the mind gets concentrated, the more the mind goes deep, the more bliss a person will experience. Ultimately, they will become one with the Supreme Mind. On their part there will be no physical or psychic effort. They will have living bodies which, without any movement, will look like dead bodies. This is sárúpya samádhi – the individual and Paramátmá become one. In this state, the sádhakaʼs mind remains full of knowledge.
ZH_TEXT: 心靈越集中，則越能深入禪定，也越能體驗更多的喜悅，最後與大宇宙心靈合而為一。在此終極之境，修行者不必再有肉體或心智的努力，他們仍擁有活生生的肉體，只是靜止不動看起來像是死去的肉體。這就是「與至上一體」的三摩地境界(sárúpya samádhi)──個體與至上本體合而為一。在這個狀態下，靈性修持者的心靈充滿了靈性的認知。

CITATION_ZH: 1969年於Ranchi | 三摩地與死亡，喜悅甘露集卷10，P.79

EN_TEXT: Even a golden vessel needs polishing occasionally. Unmaintained it gathers dust and dirt and loses its lustre. Similarly, even a good person or a sádhaka needs proper maintenance, for in a world of constant change, care must be taken that the change be always towards the better or the higher. Keeping good company is essential for this positive development. While bad company strengthens the bondage of the soul, good company is conducive to liberation and salvation. The keeping of good company is conducive to liberation and is known as satsauṋga in Sanskrit.
ZH_TEXT: 就算閃閃發亮的黃金器皿也需時時勤拂拭，否則亦會因沾惹塵埃而失去光澤。相同的，一個好人或修行者也是一樣，在變動不居的無常世界裡，必須小心護持，以使自己能夠一直朝向更高、更好的境界前進。為此，與善為伍就成了很重要的一件事。與惡友為伴會強化對靈魂的束縛；反之，與善為伍則對解脫有益，這在梵文稱為satsauṋga。
CITATION_EN: Shrii Shrii Ánandamúrti | 1969, Ranchi | 21 Satsaunga | Ánanda Vacanámrtam Part 33
CITATION_ZH: Shrii Shrii Ánandamúrti | 1969年於Ranchi | 21 與善為伍 | 喜悅甘露集 卷10，P.113

EN_TEXT: Each and every object of this universe, whether animate or inanimate, is emanating countless vibrations. The Macrocosmic Mind is the controller of these vibrations. In the case of living beings, the mind controls everything directly, and in the case of non-living entities, the Macrocosm controls everything. The wind blows, the water flows, the stone rolls, the leaves flutter – each of these inanimate objects has a unit mind, but only a dormant one. They cannot create vibrations by themselves; the Cosmic Mind creates vibrations for them, but in the case of living beings, although the controller is the unit mind, the unit mind is also the limited expression of the Cosmic Mind, and thus they are bound to follow the dictates of the Cosmic Mind. The purpose of the spiritual practice of a sádhaka is to transform the unit mind into Cosmic Mind.
ZH_TEXT: 宇宙間的萬事萬物，無論有生命抑或無生命，都放射出無數的波動。大宇宙心靈是所有這些波動的控制主。就有生命的個體而言，個體心靈直接控制所有這些波動；就無生命的個體而言，是大宇宙心靈控制了所有的一切。風在吹、水在流、石頭在滾動、葉子飄搖等等，每一個無生命的個體都有一個個體心靈，只是它們是處於蟄伏的狀態。它們自身無法製造出波動，而是大宇宙心靈為它們創造出波動。以有生命的個體來說，雖然其控制者是個體心靈，然而事實上，此個體心靈是大宇宙心靈的有限展現，因此，它們最終還是必須聽從大宇宙心靈的支配。 靈性修持者從事靈修鍛鍊的目的，就是要將個體心靈轉化為大宇宙心靈。

ZH_TEXT: 你的生命只有一個目標，你的責任就是「臣服於至上意識的聖壇前」，你只能希望祂對你的安排能夠成功。

EN_TEXT: For spiritual happiness a constant endeavour is required. The mind must be concentrated on the object of meditation, all the psychic thoughts and feelings should be directed to Parama Puruśa. A relationship of deep love must be established with Him so that there remains only one propensity in the mind the intense desire for Parama Puruśa. The type of samádhi that a sádhaka attains with such a devotional sentiment is called bháva samádhi.
ZH_TEXT: 要得到靈性的喜悅，你必須持續有恆的努力。心靈必須集中於靜坐冥想的對象上，所有的思想念頭和情感均必須導向於至上意識。你必須和祂建立起真愛連繫，如此你的心靈方可只有一個心靈情緒：亦即除了至上意識以外再無其他實體的存在。靈性的修持者以此種虔誠的情懷所達到的三摩地境界，就稱為「喜悅波流三摩地」(bháva samádhi)。

EN_TEXT: As a result of surrender the smaller “I” of the unit mind is guided is guided by the bigger “I”. In the case of mundane desire for pleasure, name, fame etc. the feelings that are produced in the nerve cells and fibres are controlled by the small “I”. But the spiritual vibrations produced in the human body are created and controlled by the Cosmic Mind. That is, the small “I” is concerned with the mundane pleasures whereas the big “I” is concerned with spiritual bliss. The small “I” differs from individual to individual but the bigger “I” is the same in all. The purpose of sádhana is to convert the small “I” into the bigger “I”. Metaphorically speaking, the bigger “I” is the moon in the sky which is related to everyone through every generation.
ZH_TEXT: 因為「臣服」，故個體心靈的「小我」受到宇宙的「大我」之引導。神經細胞和神經纖維所產生出的世俗享樂覺受，乃受制於個體「小我」;然而人體內所產生出的靈性波動則是由大宇宙心靈所創造及主宰。所以，「小我」與世俗享樂有關，而「大我」則與靈性的喜悅相關。「小我」因人而異，而「大我」則是眾生一同。靈性修持的目的就是要把小我轉化為大我。拿個比喻來說，大我是天上的明月，與世世代代的每一個眾生都有關連。

EN_TEXT: There are two types of satsauṋga – external and internal. Just as the best medicine is Parama Puruśa Himself, the best satsauṋga is also Parama Puruśa. Internal satsauṋga is the satsauṋga of Parama Puruśa, that is, the thought of Parama Puruśa during all the [waking] hours of the day, even when the bodily organs are engaged in worldly activities. Internal satsauṋga is absolutely essential. Those practising internal satsauṋga may, as far as practical, attend external satsauṋga also, but if they cannot do so at any time, there will be no harm. But mere external satsauṋga, that is, the mere sitting among good persons while the mind forgets Parama Puruśa or remains engrossed in undesirable thoughts, is not good.
ZH_TEXT: 與善為伍有內、外在兩種型態。就如同至上意識是最好的醫藥，至上意識也一樣是你最佳的友伴。內在的與善為伍就是以至上意識為伍，亦即二六時中，即使身體忙碌於世俗的工作，也要時時刻刻觀想、持念至上意識。 這是絕對的必要。從事內在與善為伍的人，在實際上也會伴隨做到外在與善為伍，即使無法時時同時做到內、外在與善為伍，也不致造成傷害。但是如果僅只是做到外在的與善為伍，也就是與一群好人在一起，但心靈卻沒有至上意識，或只是想著一些不好的念頭，這就不好。
IT_TEXT: Esistono due tipi di satsauṋga: esteriore e interiore. Così come la migliore medicina è Parama Puruśa stesso, allo stesso modo il miglior satsauṋga è Parama Puruśa. Il satsauṋga interiore è il satsauṋga con Parama Puruśa, cioè il pensiero costante di Parama Puruśa durante tutte le ore di veglia della giornata, anche quando gli organi del corpo sono impegnati nelle attività mondane. Il satsauṋga interiore è assolutamente essenziale. Coloro che praticano il satsauṋga interiore possono, per quanto possibile, partecipare anche al satsauṋga esteriore, ma, se in qualche momento non riescono a farlo, non vi sarà alcun danno. Il solo satsauṋga esteriore, invece — il semplice stare seduti tra persone buone mentre la mente dimentica Parama Puruśa o rimane immersa in pensieri indesiderabili — non è benefico.

EN_TEXT: The Supreme Self is the peak of subjectivity. Even when dealing with the many, one must remember that, behind the many, there is the One. We must never lose sight of the fact that the many are but the facets of the One.

EN_TEXT: The Cosmos was, externally, a phenomenon of analysis (vishleśańa), diversity, clash, disturbance of mind and materialism (jad́atá); and internally, a matter of synthesis (saḿshleśańa), oneness, peace, tranquillity and spirituality (ádhyátma). Apará knowledge, that is, the knowledge of the external objectivity, is necessary for worldly activities, but pará knowledge, that is, the knowledge of matters internal, is supreme and superior. Apará knowledge should be controlled by pará knowledge. Educational institutions where only apará knowledge is imparted are not sufficient. Side by side the controlling pará knowledge must be taught. In fact the pará knowledge should have precedence over the apará knowledge, because uncontrolled by pará knowledge, apará knowledge will tend to produce literate brutes who might misuse their knowledge of worldly things. Controlled by pará knowledge, apará knowledge will be used for the welfare and elevation of all of humankind.
ZH_TEXT: 從外在而言，宇宙顯現為分化的現象(vishleśańa)，它是多樣性的，充滿了各種摩擦衝突、躁動的心靈以及粗鈍的物質(jad́atá);然而從內在而言，它是合一的(saḿshleśańa)、是一體的、是平靜、安祥和靈性的(ádhyátma)。世俗的知識(Apará knowledge)是屬於外在客體的知識，對於世俗的活動來說，它是必要的；然而靈性的知識(pará knowledge)，是屬於內在的知識，是超越和至高的。世俗的知識應為靈性知識所控制。教育團體若只教授世俗的知識是不夠的，同時也應授予靈性的知識，事實上，靈性的知識甚至應該優先教導，因為不受靈性知識控制的世俗知識，會教導出一群知識野獸，他們可能濫用他們對於世俗事物的知識。受靈性知識控制的世俗知識，將會被善用在提升人類整體的福祉上。
IT_TEXT: Il cosmo, sul piano esteriore, si manifestava come analisi (vishleśaṇa), diversità, scontro, inquietudine mentale e materialismo (jaḍatā). Sul piano interiore, invece, era sintesi (saṁśleśaṇa), unità, pace, quiete e spiritualità (ādhyātma). La conoscenza apará, cioè la conoscenza del mondo esterno, è necessaria per vivere e agire nel mondo, ma la conoscenza parā, quella che riguarda la dimensione interiore, è superiore e più elevata.  La conoscenza apará deve essere guidata da quella pará. Per questo, le istituzioni educative che insegnano solo la conoscenza aparā sono insufficienti: insieme a essa occorre impartire anche la conoscenza parā, che dovrebbe avere la precedenza. Se la conoscenza aparā non è guidata dalla conoscenza parā, finisce per produrre “bruti alfabetizzati”, persone istruite ma incapaci di usare il sapere per il bene. Quando invece è orientata dalla conoscenza parā, la conoscenza aparā diventa uno strumento per il benessere e il progresso di tutta l’umanità.

EN_TEXT: Although there are some external differences among human beings in language, colour, etc., in all essential matters they are from the same source, all have originated from the singular entity, Parama Puruśa. They differ only externally and apparently.
ZH_TEXT: 雖然人類在外在各方面，諸如語言、膚色等有所差異，但所有內在的精髓都是源自相同的本源，來自於同一個本體──至上意識。人類間的不同只在於外在表相。

EN_TEXT: In this universe all these entities are divine entities, and people must only realize it. Nobody is helpless and alone in this universe. We all have mundane, supramundane, and spiritual relationships with the universe. So it is the bounden duty of human beings to expand their mental arena, because basically all these infinite entities have one goal – the goal of the Supreme Entity. Human entities must expand themselves so much that they can go beyond the fetters of limitation. There should not be any inferiority or superiority complex in anybody. Those who preach individual and racial superiority are committing sins against human dharma [human spiritual nature]. Like earth, air, and water, this dharma is common to one and all – and all will have to become one with that Universal Entity.
ZH_TEXT: 宇宙間所有的存在都是神性的存在，這是人類所必須了悟的，在此宇宙中沒有任何人是無助和孤單的。我們和這個宇宙間一直保持著世俗、超世俗和靈性的聯結。所以每個人責無旁貸，必須擴展其心靈領域，因為基本上所有這些無盡的個體都有著相同的目標──至上本體。人類必須擴展他們自己以便超越一切有限的束縛。 沒有人應懷有自卑感或優越感，主張種族優劣論的人違反人類的法性，犯下重大的罪過。此法性一如土壤、空氣和水，是所有人類所共有的特質，而且每一個人都必須與此一宇宙本體合而為一。

EN_TEXT: The Lord creates original things in His liilá. When the jiiva is in his or her jiivabháva (is individuality-conscious), his internal waves are imaginary for him, but external things are true for him, as they are the result of His liilá or His saḿkalpa. Humans perceive external things according to their reactive momenta or saḿskáras. But while you are experiencing a dream, what you think in the dream [is as true for you as what you see externally while awake]. When through sádhaná your mind gets unified with that of the Lord, this external world becomes imaginary for you. The universe is but the play of vibrations and can be controlled by developing control over these vibrations. When the causal factor is known to you, it is kriidá, and when the causal factor is not known to you, it is liilá. When you bring under your control this world which is made by the vibrating waves of His liilá, this world is subject for you. Yours is a subject without any object and that is pralaya in unit life.
ZH_TEXT: 上主在祂的神性遊戲中從事最原始的創造，而具個體意識的個體，其內在的波流對他而言是一種想像，然而外在之物對他而言，卻是活生生的真實，因為人是祂大宇宙心靈遊戲的產物或者說是祂的意願之產物。人類根據各人的業力以感知外在的事物，所以他們在清醒時所感知的事物對他們而言是真實的，而在作夢時，你也會以為夢中所見為真實的，就像你在清醒時看到的外在事物一樣。透過靈性的修持，你的心靈將與上主的大宇宙心靈合一，此時外在之物於你而言就不過是一種想像了。 整個宇宙僅僅只是一齣波流的遊戲，控制了這些波流你就控制了這齣戲。當一齣戲的原因為你所知曉，這齣戲就稱為「世間遊戲」(kriidá);當你不知其致因要素為何時，就稱為「神性遊戲」(liilá)。 當你控制了這個神性遊戲下的波流世界，你就成了這世界的主體，你的世界就是沒有客體的主體，此為個體生命的消滅(pralaya)。
IT_TEXT: Il Signore crea cose originali nella Sua līlā. Quando il jīva è nel suo o nella sua jīvabhāva (cioè è cosciente della propria individualità), le sue onde interne sono immaginarie per lui o per lei, ma le cose esterne sono reali, poiché sono il risultato della Sua līlā o del Suo saṁkalpa. Gli esseri umani percepiscono le cose esterne secondo i loro momenti reattivi o saṁskāra. Ma mentre sperimentate un sogno, ciò che pensate nel sogno è per voi reale tanto quanto ciò che vedete esternamente quando siete svegli. Quando, attraverso il sādhanā, la vostra mente si fonde con quella del Signore, questo mondo esterno diventa immaginario per voi. L’universo non è altro che il gioco delle vibrazioni e può essere controllato sviluppando il controllo su queste vibrazioni. Quando il fattore causale vi è noto, è krīḍā; quando il fattore causale non vi è noto, è līlā. Quando portate sotto il vostro controllo questo mondo, che è fatto dalle onde vibranti della Sua līlā, questo mondo diventa oggetto per voi. Il vostro è un soggetto senza alcun oggetto, e questo è pralaya nella vita individuale.

EN_TEXT: When a knower of Truth merges in the Supreme Being, his or her petty sense of existence is lost, and, attaining unity with the Supreme Entity, the person becomes supreme himself or herself. Spiritual practice is the means for the expansion of the soul, not for its annihilation; so samádhi does not mean suicide but self-transcendence.
ZH_TEXT: 當了悟之人融入於至上時，他個體微小的存在感就會消失，達到與至上本體的合一，而成就自身為至上的本體。靈性的修持不是為了消滅靈魂，而是為了讓靈魂擴展，因此，三摩地的境界即非意指自殺，而是自我的超越。

EN_TEXT: When a knower of Truth merges in the Supreme Being, his or her petty sense of existence is lost, and, attaining unity with the Supreme Entity, the person becomes supreme himself or herself. Spiritual practice is the means for the expansion of the soul, not for its annihilation; so samádhi does not mean suicide but self-transcendence. One who has known Brahma becomes Brahma Itself, for the unit entity takes on the very form of its object of ideation. One who has Brahma as his or her object of ideation becomes Brahma Itself.
ZH_TEXT: 當了悟之人融入於至上時，他個體微小的存在感就會消失，達到與至上本體的合一，而成就自身為至上的本體。靈性的修持不是為了消滅靈魂，而是為了讓靈魂擴展，因此，三摩地的境界即非意指自殺，而是自我的超越。了悟至上意識者，成就自身為至上意識本身，因為個體會取得其觀想、持念之目標的形象。當一個人以至上意識為其觀想、持念的目標時，他就會變成那個目標，也就是成為至上意識本身。

EN_TEXT: Whenever performing any action, you must analyze to what extent the action about to be undertaken will ensure physical, psychic, spiritual, social and economic progress, and you must also consider whether your action will truly bring welfare to the world. When you are certain that your actions are truly benevolent, you must immediately throw yourselves into those actions.
ZH_TEXT: 在從事任何行動時，你要分析清楚，這行動要做到什麼程度才能確保身、心、靈以及社會、經濟層面的進展，而且你也必須考慮到你的行動是否真的可以為這世界帶福祉。如果你確定你的行為是真正的善行義舉，你不可猶豫必須立即投入這些行動。

EN_TEXT: Whenever performing any action, you must analyse to what extent the action about to be undertaken will ensure physical, psychic, spiritual, social and economic progress, and you must also consider whether your action will truly bring welfare to the world. When you are certain that your actions are truly benevolent, you must immediately throw yourselves into those actions. The inspiration behind your righteous intellect comes from Parama Puruśa, and thus it is He who will provide you with the requisite strength to accomplish the task.
ZH_TEXT: 在從事任何行動時，你要分析清楚，這行動要做到什麼程度才能確保身、心、靈以及社會、經濟層面的進展，而且你也必須考慮到你的行動是否真的可以為這世界帶來福祉。如果你確定你的行為是真正的善行義舉，你不可猶豫必須立即投入這些行動。在你良善智力背後的鼓舞力量來自於至上意識，所以祂也會提供你必要的力量以完成此一工作。
IT_TEXT: Ogni volta che vi apprestate a compiere un’azione, dovreste valutarne attentamente la portata: in che misura essa favorirà il progresso fisico, psichico, spirituale, sociale ed economico? E, soprattutto, considerate se contribuirà realmente al benessere del mondo. Quando giungete alla chiara convinzione che un’azione è autenticamente benevola, dovete impegnarvi in essa senza esitazione. L’ispirazione che sostiene un intelletto retto ha la sua origine in Parama Puruśa; ed è proprio da Lui che proviene la forza necessaria per portare a compimento l’opera intrapresa.

EN_TEXT: If the human body is compared to a chariot, then the passenger is the Átma, unit consciousness, the intellect is the charioteer, and the mind is the reins. When the intellect determines that a particular action is supported by conscience, then the intellect is sure to receive all kinds of assistance from Parama Paruśa. Thus I have said, and I repeat: never be hesitant or afraid to perform any righteous deed. The human body and mind which are just like machines, have to be fully utilized.
ZH_TEXT: 人的身體若被比喻成一輛戰車，那麼坐在戰車上的乘客就是自性（個體意識）;分別明辨的智力是戰車的駕馭者；而心靈則是韁繩。當智力決定了一個為良知所支持的行動時，那麼智力必然會從至上意識處獲得各種幫助。因此，我再重複說一次：在從事任何正確的行動時，永遠不要猶豫或害怕。人類的身體和心靈就如同一部機器，你必須充分善用之。

EN_TEXT: You must accept Him as the ultimate Goal of your lives, and then move on. If impediments arise in your movement towards the Goal, they must be removed from the path; and those circumstances which are beneficial to your progress must be encouraged. In this way you will individually progress, and that individual progress will also advance the collective life.
ZH_TEXT: 你必須以祂為你生命終極的目標，並且不斷向祂前進！如果在前進道上出現了阻礙，你必須將它們除去；若出現對你的前進有助益的事物，則你必須予以鼓勵。如此你將獲得個人的進步，而個人的進步也會促進集體生命的進步。
IT_TEXT: Dovete accettare Parama purusa come Meta ultima della vostra vita, e poi andare avanti. Se nel vostro movimento verso la Meta sorgono ostacoli, questi devono essere rimossi dal cammino e quelle circostanze che favoriscono il vostro progresso devono essere incoraggiate. In questo modo progredirete individualmente, e quel progresso individuale farà avanzare anche la vita collettiva.

EN_TEXT: Brahma is the lord of the evolved objects; He is the controller of every one of them. This very Lord moves in the womb as the [foetus] and when it is born, the event, in fact, should be called the birth of Brahma, because all creations are but manifestations of Brahma Himself... A river gives up its name and identity and completely merges in the sea; thereafter it cannot maintain its own existence, it is the sea.
ZH_TEXT: 至上意識是所有物體的主人，祂是每一個客體的控制主。這個主人像胎兒般在子宮內活動，當胎兒誕生時，事實上應被稱作「至上意識的誕生」，因為所有的創造都是至上意識自身的展現。…… 就像滔滔百川奔向大海，完全融入大海裡，再也沒有各自的名字和身分，此後已無各自自我的存在，都成了海洋本身。

EN_TEXT: Kiirtana composed according to nandana vijiṋána induces in a person the tactual perception of mohana vijiṋána; it sways the finite humankind with the vibration of the unlimited and infinite; it makes humans in their little homes hear the call of the far-away blue firmament.

EN_TEXT: According to Tantra the kulakuńd́alinii is the sleeping divinity. By virtue of sádhaná and with the help of mantrágháta [striking at the kulakuńd́alinii with powerful incantative vibrations] and mantra caetanya [conceptual understanding of and psychic association with a mantra], and by smashing all obstacles, the kuńd́alinii can be raised to the sahasrára cakra. The practice adopted to raise the kuńd́alinii is called purashcarańa in Tantra. The kuńd́alinii is the sleeping divinity. To arouse it from slumber and raise it upwards is quite a struggle and hence hummm must also be the acoustic root of the kuńd́alinii. The controlling point of the kuńd́alinii, the múládhára, is called mańipadma or mahámańipadma in Maháyána Buddhist philosophy. The Tibetan Maháyániis recite oṋḿ mańipadme hummm while turning their dharma cakras [prayer wheels]. I have seen oṋḿ mańipadme hummm inscribed on the walls of Tibetan caves.
ZH_TEXT: 根據密宗，庫拉孔達里尼(Kulakuńd́alinii)為沈睡的神性。經由靈修，並藉助於以強有力的梵咒的波動敲擊庫拉孔達里尼(mantrágháta)以及對於梵咒心理意義之概念上的了解(mantra caetarya)，並且粉粹所有障礙後，孔達里尼能夠被提昇至頂輪。用來提昇孔達里尼的修持在密宗裡稱之為樸拉恰拉那(Purashcarańa)。孔達里尼就是沈睡的靈性。將它從沈睡中喚醒，並往上提昇是個相當大的奮鬥，因此「吽」亦必須為孔達里尼的音根。孔達里尼的控制點海底輪在大乘佛教哲學裡稱為摩尼輪(mańipadma或mahámańipadma)，西藏的大乘佛教徒在轉祈禱輪(dharma cakras)的時候持誦唵嘛呢帕咩吽(oṋḿ mańipadme hummm)，我曾看過oṋḿ mańipadme hummm銘刻於西藏山洞之壁上。

EN_TEXT: Whatever you have said, or are saying, or will say in future, lies within you as dormant vitality. A great potentiality lies dormant in each human being, just as a huge banyan tree lies latent within a tiny seed. The banyan seed sprouts when light, air, water and fertile soil exist in requisite amounts. It subsequently grows foliage and branches, and in the course of time develops into a gigantic tree. Similarly, the immense potentialities of human beings lie latent and hypnotized in the kulakuńd́alinii at múládhára cakra as dormant humanity. When the kuńd́alinii is raised upwards through mantrágháta and mantra caetanya in the process of meditation (this process is called purashcarańa in Tantra and amrtamudrá or ánandamudrá in yoga), the doors of human potentiality start opening one after another. Human beings grow in beauty and vitality, their flowers divine, their foliage lush. Such individuals develop into great people in the eyes of the public and finally become one with the Supreme Entity. This process is called parábhyudaya in the scriptures.
ZH_TEXT: 無論你已經說的，或正在說的，或未來要說的任何話語均以蟄伏的生命力存在於你的內在。一個偉大的潛能蟄伏於每一個人裡面，正如同一棵巨大的菩提樹潛伏於一粒小小的種子裡。當陽光、空氣、水以及肥沃的土壤充足時，菩提樹的種子就會發芽。接著它就長出葉子及枝條，隨時日的推移，最後，長成一棵巨大的樹木。同樣地，人類巨大的潛能以蟄伏的人性含藏在海底輪的庫拉孔達里尼裡，呈睡眠狀態地潛伏著。當孔達里尼經由靜坐過程中梵咒的敲擊與梵咒的覺醒（此過程在密宗裡稱之為Purashcarańa，在瑜伽裡稱之為甘露印amrtamudrá或喜悅印ánandamudrá），往上提昇時，人類潛能之門開始一一開啟。人類在美與力中成長，其花朵神聖，其樹枝葉繁茂。這樣的個人在眾人的眼中發展成偉大的人物，最後與至上本體合而為一。此過程在經典裡稱之為Parábhyudaya。

EN_TEXT: No attachment to worldly objects will be developed if we observe Yama and Niyama, since every item of Yama-Niyama is part of Brahma Sádhaná through worldly deeds. Hence when you are able to perfectly observe the spiritual practice of Yama-Niyama, your mind becomes absorbed in Brahma – the ultimate goal of this spiritual practice.
ZH_TEXT: 如果我們能遵循外在行為的控制和內在行為的控制，就會發展出對世俗事物沒有執著之心。因為內、外在行為控制的每一項目，都是一種透過世俗的行為而從事的至上靈性修持。因此當你能夠完美地遵守內、外在行為控制的靈性鍛鍊，你的心靈就會融入至上意識──靈性修持的最終目標。
IT_TEXT: Non si svilupperà alcun attaccamento agli oggetti del mondo se osserviamo Yama e Niyama, poiché ogni principio di Yama e Niyama costituisce una parte del Brahma Sadhana praticato attraverso le azioni della vita quotidiana. Pertanto, quando sarete in grado di osservare perfettamente la disciplina spirituale di Yama e Niyama, la vostra mente si assorbirà in Brahma, che è la meta ultima di questa pratica spirituale.

EN_TEXT: We should strengthen ourselves by remaining in normal situations and endeavouring to become superhuman. By developing superhuman powers we can awaken the element of eternal humanity amongst us. This eternal human entity alone is Brahma. In order to attain this power, meanness must be shunned, because this is the sádhaná for the Infinite. Feelings of differentiation are a great impediment.
ZH_TEXT: 我們應該保持在正常狀態下來強化自己並努力成為超人。從發展超人的力量中，我們可以喚醒內在永恆人性的要素，此永恆的人類本質就是至上意識；要得到這個力量，則必須去除一切卑劣的思想行為，這是為了得到無限的至上意識而從事的靈性修持。分別心是一大障礙。
IT_TEXT: Dovremmo rafforzarci vivendo nelle normali situazioni della vita e impegnandoci a diventare superumani. Sviluppando poteri superiori possiamo risvegliare dentro di noi l’elemento dell’umanità eterna. Questa entità umana eterna è Brahma stesso. Per acquisire questa forza, occorre abbandonare ogni meschinità, perché questo è il sadhana dell’Infinito. I sentimenti di differenziazione e separazione costituiscono un grande ostacolo.

EN_TEXT: The Supreme Brahma resides within the feeling “I am” situated amidst the concealed intuition of the mind. Our existence is in him. He exists in the sun-rays. Due to Him the perception of the world is possible. Having created our ego and scattered innumerable toys around us. He has hidden Himself among them. When we come to see Him in all things created by Him, our ego gets lost. The feeling of unit “I” shall be merged in the Universal “I”.
ZH_TEXT: 至上意識安住在「我是」的覺受中，它位於心靈潛藏的直覺裡。我們存在於祂裡面。祂存在於陽光中，由於祂，我們才能認識這個世界。祂創造了我們的自我意識，在我們周遭散播了無數玩具後，祂便隱藏其中，當我們在祂所創造的萬有中見到祂時，我們的我執就會消失，個體「我」的感覺就會融入到大宇宙之「我」中。
IT_TEXT: Il Supremo Brahma risiede nel sentimento dell’«io sono», situato nel cuore dell’intuizione nascosta della mente. La nostra esistenza è in Lui. Egli è presente nei raggi del sole. Grazie a Lui è possibile la percezione del mondo. Dopo aver creato il nostro ego e aver disseminato intorno a noi innumerevoli giocattoli, Si è nascosto in mezzo ad essi. Quando arriviamo a vederLo in tutte le cose create da Lui, il nostro ego si perde. Il sentimento dell’io individuale si fonde allora nell’Io Universale.

EN_TEXT: Life resembles an ever-flowing spring. Pushing aside the stones of obstructions and difficulties, marching on with vigorous speed is its Dharma.
ZH_TEXT: 生命有如永恆流注的清泉，推開阻礙和困難的巨石，以強力的速度向前邁進，即是生命的法性。

EN_TEXT: As people, guided by their intellect, continue to gather practical experiences of the ups and downs of this world, they gradually start to realize that their psychic capacities are too inadequate to accomplish any great task. Then, faced with the stark realities of life, they realize that they have no alternative but to merge with the Supreme Consciousness. At that stage, whatever they do will have a cosmic support and will be genuine. That is why enlightened persons always prefer to remain unified with the Supreme Entity. This is considered the highest attainment of knowledge.
ZH_TEXT: 當人於塵世運用其聰明才智不斷累積許多浮沈的體驗，他了解到個人心智的能力實在無法完成偉大的工作。面對此項生命中赤裸裸的事實，人除了與至上意識合而為一外，別無他法可尋。此時一切作為皆發自至誠，不論他要做什麼都會受到大宇宙心靈的支持。所以悟道之人永遠都願安住於至上之境。這是知識上最高的成就。
IT_TEXT: Guidati dall’intelletto, nel corso della vita gli esseri umani continuano a confrontarsi con gli alti e bassi concreti di questo mondo e, a poco a poco, giungono a comprendere che le loro capacità psichiche sono insufficienti per realizzare qualsiasi grande compito. Allora, di fronte alle dure realtà della vita, scoprono di non avere altra alternativa se non fondersi con la Coscienza Suprema. A quel punto, qualunque azione compiano sarà sostenuta dalla dimensione cosmica e avrà un carattere autentico. È per questo che le persone illuminate preferiscono sempre rimanere unificate con l’Entità Suprema: ciò è considerato il più alto conseguimento della conoscenza.

EN_TEXT: One can execute some ordinary types of work with oneʼs own little intellect. But if one aspires to undertake any noble ventures, then one has to unite oneʼs own intellect with the Cosmic Intellect, and work with the help of the Supreme knowledge of Parama Puruśa. This is the spirit of karma sannyása.
ZH_TEXT: 吾人可以運用自己微不足道的聰明來從事一些一般性的工作。如果我們胸懷大志，想要從事偉大神聖的事業就必須將自己的聰明才智與大宇宙心靈的才智結合，再加上至上意識之至上真知的相助，這就是行動的基本精神。
IT_TEXT: Alcuni lavori ordinari possono essere svolti con il proprio limitato intelletto. Ma se si aspira a intraprendere opere nobili e grandi imprese, allora occorre unire il proprio intelletto all’Intelletto Cosmico e agire con l’aiuto della conoscenza suprema di Parama Purusa. Questo è il vero spirito del karma sannyāsa.

EN_TEXT: What is the relationship between karma-sannyása and parábhakti? When the Supreme Consciousness remains in His unassailed state, in His original stance, He is called Para Brahma. But when that Para Brahma is transmuted into different ideas or objects, then that Supreme Consciousness is termed Apara Brahma. Attachment towards Apara Brahma is called aparábhakti, and intense love for Para Brahma is called parábhakti.
ZH_TEXT: 行動的基本精神和至上的虔誠(parábhakti)間的關係為何？當至上意識維繫在完全超然和最初的狀態，祂稱為「至上意識」(Para Brahma)。但是當至上意識轉變成不同的觀念或物體，那麼至上意識即名為「大千世界」(Apara Brahma)。對大千世界的執著梵文稱為阿帕拉‧巴克提(aparábhakti)，對至上意識精誠的愛即是至上的虔誠(parábhakti)。

ZH_TEXT: 行動的根本精神就是要超越時間、空間和人物的範疇。只有以至上意識為生命目標的人，才能達到行動基本精神之個體智力與大宇宙智力合一的極致境界。什麼是虔誠？當心靈遠離一切世俗的事物，朝至上意識急奔而去，此即名為虔誠。當靈性之士朝至上意識前進，他們的心靈於不知不覺中轉化了。

EN_TEXT: Now who is the doer of karma? We know that the range of action is limited within the arena of time, space and person. So there are two functional agents or doers of action: the microcosm on the one hand and the Macrocosm on the other. Apart from these two, no third entity can be of any relevance in the matter of attaining the proper finality of action. The awakening of psychic desire at any moment compels the physical body to be active, but the body is incapable of any function in the absence of an impetus from the mind. There are two reasons for this. First, there is always the attraction of the Cosmic Mind. Therefore if there is any command from the Supreme, the individual entity is bound to move. Secondly, the unit mind can direct the movement of any other entity in spite of its unwillingness. Hence an action is executed either by a unit mind or by the Cosmic Mind. The wind blows: wind is a blind force devoid of its own psyche. This wind is a material entity, but it moves due to the impetus from the Cosmic Mind. It is similar to that of a top spun by young boys. Boys cannot always spin the tops; they spin only when they are thrown in a particular way, in a perfect fashion, otherwise not. A top has no power to spin unless it is made to do so by a second entity. Likewise the sun is moving around its nucleus with its large family of celestial bodies under Divine inspiration. Hence all physical activities originate from the mind which is the prime mover of all actions. No action can take place without the impulse of mind.
ZH_TEXT: 誰是從事行動者？我們知道行動侷限在時、空、人物的範疇中，所以有兩個行動者：一個是個體小宇宙，另一個則是大宇宙心靈。除此二者，沒有第三個實體可以正確地在行動中達到其最後的目標。心智渴望的覺醒隨時驅策著身體從事行動，但是身體若無來自心靈的動力，則根本無法作用。對於這點，它有兩個理由──第一、大宇宙心靈的吸引是永遠存在的，因此任何來自至上的命令，個體就一定要行動。第二、不論願意與否，個體心靈可以引導任何其他實體的運作。因此，行動是由個體心靈或大宇宙心靈所執行。風吹，風是沒有自己心智的盲目力量。它是一個物質實體，依據大宇宙心靈的驅策而行動。就像是小孩子在玩陀螺，只有以特別的方法、技巧投擲時它才會旋轉，否則它就無法旋轉。所以陀螺除非經由第二個實體的作用，否則它是沒有力量旋轉的。同樣的，太陽隨同其銀河系的大家庭在至上的激勵下環繞其核心運轉。因此，所有物質上的行動源自心靈，心靈是一切行動最初的運作者。沒有心靈的驅策就不會有行動。

EN_TEXT: Now what is the method to merge the unit mind in the Cosmic Mind? As the basic trend of the evolutionary process is from the crude towards the subtle, therefore in order to make oneʼs own intellect subtle, one is to take the ideation of the subtlest entity, not to remain engrossed in crude objects. With the constant ideation of the Supreme, the mind will gradually attain more and more subtlety and will ultimately be converted into the subtlest entity. After this the sense of separation in the microcosm ceases to exist, and it becomes one with the Cosmic Mind.
ZH_TEXT: 如何將個體心靈融入大宇宙心靈？如果進化的過程是從粗鈍走向精細，為了使我們的聰明才智也精細化，吾人必須以最精細的實體為理念導向，而不是熱衷於粗鈍的事物。藉著心念不斷觀想、持念至上意識，心靈會逐漸精細，最後就會轉變成最精細的實體。當小宇宙個體的這種分離感不復存在時，它就與大宇宙心靈合而為一。

EN_TEXT: One should move ahead in oneʼs mission after determining oneʼs goal. Once the goal is fixed there remains almost no possibility, of error; hence you should always remember your goal. But once you fall into the trap of error it leads to danger. This is the reason why I advise people to remember their guru mantra, to always remain aware of the goal. The souls of those people who practice sádhaná in this way enter the abode of Brahma.
ZH_TEXT: 在決定自己的道路確定目標後，就要使命必達，勇往直前。一旦有了正確的目標，幾乎就不太可能會出差錯，因此你必須永遠將目標牢記於心。然而一旦你掉入錯誤的圈套，此過失就會導致危險，這就是為何我建議人們要記得古魯梵咒(guru mantra)的原因，也就是要人們永遠不要忘了自己的目標。以此方式努力鍛鍊的人，其靈魂將會進入至上之境。

EN_TEXT: The secret (to eradicating the Karma from past lives) is that while performing any action, one must remember that Parama Puruśa is always watching oneʼs action. A genuine spiritualist will have to establish a relation of love with Parama Puruśa.
ZH_TEXT: 要消除累世所積的業力，其秘訣是在從事任何行動時，一定要記得至上意識正在觀看著你的一舉一動。真正的靈性修持者必須與至上意識建立起愛的關係。
CITATION_EN: Shrii Shrii Ánandamúti | 1 January 1979 DMC, Patna | The Path of Salvation | Subháśita Saḿgraha Part 11
CITATION_ZH: Shrii Shrii Ánandamúti | 1979年1月1日於Patna大法會 | 解脫之道 | 靈性科學集成卷11，P.53

EN_TEXT: If I serve each and every microcosm, He will be pleased, and that will be the only way to establish a sweet relationship with Him: in no other way can it be done. Now what is the need to arouse love and affection for Him? In this way spiritual aspirants themselves will attain bliss.
ZH_TEXT: 如果我為每個個體小宇宙服務，祂將會非常高興，這是與祂建立甜美關係的唯一途徑，此外別無他途可循。為什麼需要喚起對祂的愛和情感？因為用這種方法，靈性修持者自身才會獲得喜悅。
CITATION_EN: Shrii Shrii Ánandamúrti | 1 January 1979 DMC, Patna | 05 The Path of Salvation | Subháśita Saḿgraha Part 11
CITATION_ZH: Shrii Shrii Ánandamúrti | 1979年1月1日於Patna大法會 | 05 解脫之道 | 靈性科學集成卷11，P.59

EN_TEXT: You should always remember one thing: that your spiritual practice, your mundane activities, your worldly ideology, your social, economic, and moral ideals in every sphere of your existence must be suffused with the ideation that you love your Lord, and you should love Him for only one reason – to please Him.
ZH_TEXT: 你應該永遠記住一件事：你的靈性修持、你所從事的世俗活動、你處世的觀念、你生命中有關社會、經濟和道德理想的種種一切，都必須充滿著「我愛我的上主」這個理念，你愛祂只有一個理由，那就是取悅祂，讓祂感到高興。
CITATION_EN: Shrii Shrii Ánandamúrti | 1 January 1979 DMC, Patna | 05 The Path of Salvation | Subháśita Saḿgraha Part 11
CITATION_ZH: Shrii Shrii Ánandamúrti | 1979年1月1日於Patna大法會 | 05 解脫之道 | 靈性科學集成卷11，P.60

EN_TEXT: During your spiritual practices you should ensure that Parama Puruśa is your mental object and you are His subject. It sounds funny that human beings become the subject and Parama Puruśa the object. In the absolute sense, Parama Puruśa is the supreme controller of everything, the Supreme Subjectivity, with human beings as His object. Usually, human beings cannot make Parama Puruśa their mental object. Therefore, when you repeat your iśt́a mantra, or when you ideate, you should remember that, in fact, you are the object and Parama Puruśa is the subject. That is, in meditation you do not see Parama Puruśa, but Parama Puruśa sees you.
ZH_TEXT: 當你從事靈性修持時，你會以為至上意識是你心靈的客體，而你是祂的主體，人變成主體，而至上意識是客體，聽起來似乎好笑，然而在絕對的觀念裡，至上意識是萬物的至上控制者，是至高的主體，我們才是祂的客體，通常人類是無法使至上意識成為他們心靈的標的，因此當你持念你的目標梵咒(Iśt́a Mantra)，或做觀想時，你必須記住，事實上你是客體，而至上意識才是主體。也就是說，當你靜坐時，不是你在看著至上意識，而是至上意識看著你。
CITATION_EN: Shrii Shrii Ánandamúrti | 1 January 1979, Patna | 11 You Are Not Helpless | Ánanda Vacanámrtam Part 7
CITATION_ZH: Shrii Shrii Ánandamúrti | 1979年元旦於Patna | 147 你永不無助 | 喜悅甘露集 卷4，P.71

EN_TEXT: Fully utilize your strength and all the other qualities you have received from Parama Puruśa. When you have exhausted them, when you have no strength, intelligence or spiritual power left in you, Parama Puruśa will provide you with the things you need most. You should not waste your valuable time by entreating Parama Puruśa to give you this or that. Remember, you are never alone and should never have any fear or apprehension. You should not sit down and lament, “Oh, what will happen to me now?” Such thinking is totally absurd. Parama Puruśa will certainly see the problem and take the necessary steps in all circumstances. Just as a small child never has to think about itself – its parents think about its well-being – similarly, you should not concern yourself about your own needs. Let Parama Puruśa worry about that while you carry on your duty fearlessly and cheerfully. You will see that Parama Puruśa will certainly do everything necessary to protect the interests of His affectionate and beloved children.
ZH_TEXT: 充份運用你得自至上意識的能力和特質，當你盡了全力、當你缺乏知識或靈性力量時，至上意識自然會給你所最需要幫助。你不應該浪費寶貴的光陰向至上意識乞求這個或那個。記住，你永不孤單也不該心存畏懼與不安，不應枯坐哀嘆道：「噢！我會發生什麼事呢？」這不是很可笑嗎？至上意識當然會視問題的狀況，做祂最適當的安排，就如同一個小孩，從來無需為自己擔心，他的母親自然會為他照料好一切。同樣的，你無需擔心你的需求，應無所懼而愉悅的去從事你的職責，而把你的需求交給至上意識安排，至上意識會用各種不同的方法保護祂所關愛的孩子們。
CITATION_EN: 1 January 1979, Patna | 11 You Are Not Helpless, Ánanda Vacanámrtam Part 7
CITATION_ZH: 1979年元旦於Patna | 147 你永不無助，喜悅甘露集 卷4，P.72

EN_TEXT: But in order to attain the goal of salvation, of final emancipation, one will have to accept Neohumanism [if not at the first step, then] as the final course of action; one will have to establish oneself in Neohumanism just on the eve of oneʼs final merger with Parama Puruśa – maybe for a few moments only; otherwise it is impossible for one to establish oneself in perfect spirituality and attain Parama Puruśa. Neohumanism is the last word for attaining Him. Those who did not accept Neohumanism from the beginning – who accepted it just before the final stage – also followed a defective path. If Neohumanism is accepted just before the final state, then the world will have been deprived of those peopleʼs service. Perhaps they did not lose anything personally, but there was certainly a collective loss for the whole humanity. Had they really accepted Neohumanism from the very first step of their spiritual movement, then the trees and plants, the animals and other creatures – all the animate and inanimate worlds – would have benefited immensely. But as they did not accept it in the initial stage, so the world was at a loss.
ZH_TEXT: 為了達到解脫的目標，獲得究竟解脫，人在最後仍然必須以新人道主義為其最終之行動（即使非以新人道主義為起步）。在達到與至上意識合一之前夕，就算只有頃刻，他也必須是立足於新人道主義之境，否則該人無法達到靈性的圓滿境界而與至上意識合一。新人道主義是達到祂與否的決定性字眼。 沒有從一開始即接受新人道主義者，而只在最後階段才接受的人，他們所走的也是一條有缺陷的道路。如果只在最後階段才接受新人道主義，那麼這世界就少了這些人的服務。或許對他們個人而言並沒有任何損失，但對整體人類而言的確是個大損失。要是他們在靈性道上的第一步起即接受新人道主義，那麼所有的樹木、植物、動物、其他生物等等有生命、無生命的一切個體，都將雨露均霑受益無窮。但由於他們並未在一開始就接受，故對世界而言，是個損失。
CITATION_EN: Shrii Shrii Ánandamúrti | 1 January 1983 DMC, Anandanagar | 14 Perfect Spirituality and Neohumanism | Neohumanism in a Nutshell Part 1
CITATION_ZH: Shrii Shrii Ánandamúrti | 1983年1月1日於喜悅之城大法會 | 03 完美的靈性與新人道主義 | 完美生命的實踐，P.19

EN_TEXT: Movement or mobility is a must for psychic existence, for any existence. Otherwise nothing will exist in this universe. And this movement is called [vrtti]. In English you may say “propensity”, but “propensity” is not the proper term. Vrtti. And when this vrtti, this psychic urge, or this psychic mobility, is towards the crude, it is called pravrtti; and when it is towards the subtle it is called nivrtti. The sages used to say: Pravrttireśá bhútánáḿ sthúlá nivrttistu maháphalá [“The pravrtti of human beings is a crude thing, but nivrtti is something that yields good results”].
ZH_TEXT: 對於心靈的存在或任何存在而言，行動或動力是必須的，否則這宇宙不會有任何東西存在。心靈的行動就稱為「心靈情緒傾向作用」(vritti)，英文稱為propensity，但這麼稱呼並不適當。Vrtti是心靈的慾望，這種心靈的動力若朝向粗鈍，就稱為pravrtti，即「導向世俗慾望；若朝向精細，就稱為nivrtti，即導向無慾。聖人常說：「Pravrttireśá bhútánáḿ sthúlá nivrttistu maháphalá」──「人類導向世俗慾望的心靈傾向作用是粗鈍的，然而朝向無慾的心靈傾向作用則會帶來好的結果。」

EN_TEXT: If, in this way, you are fighting those inner and outer bondages with one hand, and serving the universe with the other hand, what will happen? Your existence will be blissful in each and every field of your movement. So oneʼs very existence will be joyful, oneʼs very existence will be blissful.
ZH_TEXT: 如果你能一手打擊內、外在束縛，一手服務整個宇宙，那麼將產生什麼結果？你每個行動都將充滿喜悅，因此你的存在將無比愉悅、將喜樂滿溢。
CITATION_EN: Shrii Shrii Ánandamúrti | 1 January 1986 DMC, Calcutta | 01 Existential Flow and Its Culminating Point | Subháśita Saḿgraha Part 17

EN_TEXT: In the psychic sphere, when the mind proceeds internally towards its Supreme Fulfilment, there will also be three separate stages for accelerated progress: Prańipátena pariprashnena sevayá.
ZH_TEXT: 在心理層面，當心靈往內在朝向至上的圓滿成就而前進時，因其加速進展之程度也分為三個階段：完全臣服(Prańipátena)、靈性提問(pariprashnena)和服務(sevayá)。
CITATION_EN: Shrii Shrii Ánandamúrti | 1 January 1987 DMC, Tiljala, Calcutta | 01 Physical Propulsion, Psychic Propensities and Spiritual Attainment | Subháśita Saḿgraha Part 18
CITATION_ZH: Shrii Shrii Ánandamúrti | 1987年1月1日於Tiljala, Calcutta大法會 | 09 物質動力、心靈習性和靈性成就 | 完美生命的實踐，P.60

EN_TEXT: Nothing is static in this universe of ours. Not only in the realm of physicality, but in the psychic stratum also there is, we find, this movement. So the mental structure of each animate body moves sometimes with proper acceleration, sometimes with retardation. Where there is retardation, a day will come when the mental structure will get crudified and become one with crude or material objects. So it is the duty of each and every sane human being to see that there remains movement in his or her mind, in his or her mental world, and that mental world, that mental movement should be charged with proper acceleration, because when there is no acceleration, retardation is sure to take place.
ZH_TEXT: 我們這個宇宙沒有一樣事物是停止不動的。不僅在物質的領域是如此，在心理的領域中亦是如此。 因此，每一個生命個體其心靈構造的行動，有時會以適當的加速度來進行，而有時速度會減緩。若速度持續減緩，此心靈構造終有一天會粗鈍化，而變成粗鈍的物質。 明智的人皆有責任了解他們必須以適當的加速度來驅策心靈的行動，因為不加快速度，速度一定就會減慢。
CITATION_EN: Shrii Shrii Ánandamúrti | 1 January 1987 DMC, Tiljala, Calcutta | 01 Physical Propulsion, Psychic Propensities and Spiritual Attainment | Subháśita Saḿgraha Part 18

EN_TEXT: One must have a balanced diet. “Whatever I get, that I will eat” – this must not be the policy of a sane being. This human body is a composite of protoplasmic cells, and these protoplasmic cells are made of the food we take in. If the food and drink is defective, then the protoplasmic cells will also become defective, and the human mind, which is the collective mind of so many protoplasmic minds, will also become defective. That is why támasik or static food has a negative influence on the human mind. These are the requisite factors.
ZH_TEXT: 一個人必須要有均衡的飲食。理智的人絕對不應「拿到什麼就吃什麼」。我們人的肉身是由原生質細胞所組成的，而這些原生質細胞又是由我們所攝取的食物而形成的。如果我們吃的或喝的東西有缺陷，那麼所形成的原生質細胞也會是有缺陷的；人的心靈是許多心靈質細胞的集合心靈，也一樣會變成有缺陷的。這就是為什麼惰性食物對人類心靈有負面影響的原因。這些都是必要的因素。
CITATION_EN: Shrii Shrii Ánandamúrti | 1 January 1987 DMC, Tiljala, Calcutta | 01 Physical Propulsion, Psychic Propensities and Spiritual Attainment | Subháśita Saḿgraha Part 18
