EN_TEXT: You should always remember that you do not belong to an ordinary family, to an ordinary lineage. Those who are the sons and daughters of Parama Puruśa certainly cannot belong to an ordinary lineage. You have a personal relationship with Parama Puruśa, and because of that intimate relation you can say to Him, “Oh Parama Puruśa, you know me very well; so if You think it proper, You may bestow Your grace upon me. But it depends on You.” Parama Puruśa certainly has great love and affection for His children; He will certainly want His sons and daughters to reach their ultimate goal. And whatever bliss human beings may attain by reaching that Supreme Stance, I know that in Parama Puruśaʼs mind the happiness will be even more. Victory to you all.
ZH_TEXT: 你要永遠記得，你並非屬於普通家庭，不是來自凡俗血統。至上意識的兒女當然不是普通的，你和至上意識有著私人的關係，因為這親密的關係，你可以對祂說：「哦，至上意識！您深深了解我，所以若您認為適當，請您賜予我恩典。但這全仰賴於您。」至上意識對祂的孩子當然有著無比的愛和深深的情感，祂當然希望祂的孩子達到終極的目標。而且我也確知，無論人類因達到該至上之境獲得多少喜悅，至上意識心中的喜悅只有更多。祝你們勝利！
CITATION_EN: Shrii Shrii Ánandamúrti | 1 January 1988 DMC, Anandanagar | 03 Propensities and Pramá | Subháśita Saḿgraha Part 18
CITATION_ZH: Shrii Shrii Ánandamúrti | 1988年1月1日於喜悅之城大法會 | 13 心靈習性作用與完美的平衡 | 靈性科學集成 卷13，P.132

EN_TEXT: The subjective approach is to first withdraw the crude mind gradually from the external world and merge it in the subtle mind, and then to merge the subtle mind in unit consciousness. When unit consciousness is merged in Cosmic Consciousness, a human being is said to have attained the supreme fulfilment in life. In the present world, human beings face such tremendous difficulties in maintaining their objective adjustment that they cannot afford to give any time for their subjective approach. This is the greatest tragedy of the day! That is why I would like to advise you to build a healthy human society as early as possible, so that each and every human being gets enough scope and time for spiritual progress.
ZH_TEXT: 所謂「主體的接近」，就是將粗鈍的心靈從外在的世界收攝回來，並融入精細的心靈中，然後再將精細的心靈融入個體意識中，而當一個人的個體意識融入於宇宙意識時，就可以說他已經達到生命中最高的成就。在目前的世界，人類面對著如此巨大的困難去保持其客體的調適，以至於他們沒有任何時間從事於主體的接近，這是今日最大的悲劇，所以，這就是我要你們儘早建立一個健全的人類社會，以便每個人能有足夠的機會與時間去達到靈性上進步的原因。
IT_TEXT: L’approccio soggettivo consiste anzitutto nel ritirare gradualmente la mente grossolana dal mondo esterno e fonderla nella mente sottile, e poi nel fondere la mente sottile nella coscienza individuale. Quando la coscienza individuale si fonde nella Coscienza Cosmica, si dice che l’essere umano abbia raggiunto il supremo compimento della vita. Nel mondo attuale, gli esseri umani affrontano difficoltà così enormi nel mantenere il loro adattamento oggettivo da non potersi permettere di dedicare alcun tempo all’approccio soggettivo. È la più grande tragedia dei nostri giorni! Per questo motivo desidero consigliarvi di costruire il prima possibile una società umana sana, affinché ogni essere umano abbia spazio e tempo sufficienti per il progresso spirituale.
CITATION_EN: Shrii Shrii Ánandamúrti | 2 January 1979, Patna | 13 An Ideal Life | Ánanda Vacanámrtam Part 7
CITATION_ZH: Shrii Shrii Ánandamúrti | 1979年1月2日於Patna | 149 理想的生活 | 喜悅甘露集 卷4，P.85

EN_TEXT: The characteristic of a unit mind is that its goal is multi-purposive whereas its expression is unilateral, confined to a particular space, time and individuality. The goal of the Cosmic mind, however, is uni-purposive and Its expression multilateral, manifested in all time, space and individuality. This is the major difference between the microcosm and Macrocosm. A unit mind can only think of one object at a particular time, or remain attached to one entity at a particular time, but cannot exist in more than one place or at more than one time. But the Cosmic Mind expresses Himself in more than one action, at more than one place, and in more than one entity. A microcosm expresses itself unilaterally, but nurtures desires which are multilateral. It may want to be a king, and a billionaire, and a learned person, and so much more. But when it actually performs actions, it can only act in one direction, not many. But the Macrocosmic endeavours are multilateral. His only desire is to get all His reactive momenta exhausted through the suffering of the microcosms; to move towards fullness through the various times, spaces and individualities.
ZH_TEXT: 個體心靈之特性是多重目標、單一展現，侷限在特定的時、空、人物中；而大宇宙心靈則是單一目標，其表現則是在各種時、空、人物中多重的展現。這是小宇宙個體與大宇宙心靈最主要的差別。個體心靈在某一時間裡只能想一個目標或只能掛念一個實體，不能同時存在於多重的時間或空間裡。但大宇宙心靈同時能以多重行動、在各個地方、用一個以上的實體來展現自己。個體小宇宙的展現是單方面的，但慾望卻是多方面的，或許他想成為一國之君、也想成為億萬富翁和大學者……等等。但當他從事行為時，卻只能單向行動，無法多向行動。然而大宇宙心靈卻可多邊同時進行，祂唯一的念頭就是透過個體小宇宙的苦難來耗盡其因果業力，透過各種時、空、人物以朝向圓滿究竟前進。
IT_TEXT: La caratteristica di una mente unitaria è che il suo fine è multiplo, mentre la sua espressione è unilaterale, confinata a un determinato spazio, tempo e individualità. Il fine della Mente Cosmica, invece, è unico, e la Sua espressione è multilaterale, manifestata in ogni tempo, spazio e individualità. Questa è la principale differenza tra microcosmo e Macrocosmo. Una mente unitaria può pensare a un solo oggetto in un dato momento, oppure rimanere legata a una sola entità in un dato momento, ma non può esistere in più di un luogo o in più di un tempo. La Mente Cosmica, invece, Si esprime attraverso più di un’azione, in più di un luogo e in più di un’entità. Il microcosmo si esprime in modo unilaterale, ma coltiva desideri multilaterali. Può desiderare di essere un re, un miliardario, una persona colta, e molto altro ancora. Ma quando passa all’azione, può agire soltanto in una direzione, non in molte. Il Macrocosmo si esprime in molti modi e in molte forme. Il suo movimento fondamentale è attraversare fino in fondo tutte le conseguenze dell’esistenza individuale, affinché nulla resti incompiuto e la pienezza originaria possa essere ritrovata. Quando questa esperienza è vissuta dal punto di vista limitato dei singoli esseri, essa può apparire come sofferenza.

EN_TEXT: You will have to concentrate your mind. Instead of developing an attachment for mundane objects, you should develop an attachment for Parama Puruśa (Viśńu). Here the word “mamata” signifies the feeling of being oneʼs own. None of the objects of this universe can be called your own. You came to this Earth without any possessions and you will leave empty handed, too. So how can any object be called your own? It cannot. This is true knowledge. There is nothing in this universe which you can call your own except Parama Puruśa. If this idea is not cultivated humans will become inactive and averse to work. In my opinion, the best way is objective adjustment through subjective approach. If you do not feel that all objects and entities are a part of you, you cannot develop any love and affection for His creation. The balance between your unit being and the external world will be impaired and your movement towards Parama Puruśa will be hindered. Remember that the love you develop for this worldly creation must always be channelized towards Parama Puruśa. He, being the owner of the external objective world, is the only object for you to possess. When you realize this, adjustment with the objective world will come naturally and effortlessly. All human beings should have the idea in their minds that the only entity in this universe which they can call their own is Parama Puruśa.
ZH_TEXT: 你必須集中心靈，不要執著於世俗的東西，而應發展出對至上意識的執著。在這裡mamata（瑪瑪塔）這個字意指「屬於自己的那種感覺」。此宇宙中沒有任何東西可以說是你自己的，你沒有帶任何東西來到此地球，你亦將雙手空空而離去，所以怎麼可能有任何東西可說是你的呢？那是不可能的，這就是真正的知識。除了至上意識之外，此宇宙中沒有任何東西你可以稱為你所有，如果沒有養成此種想法，人們將變得消極而厭惡工作。依我的看法，經由主體的接近做客體的調適是最佳的途徑。如果你不覺得所有客體與實體是你的一部分，則你無法對祂的創造物產生任何愛與感情，你個體的生存與外在世界之間的平衡將受到傷害，而且你朝向至上意識前進的活動亦將遭受阻礙，請謹記你對世上萬物的愛必須永達都導向於至上意識。祂是外在客體世界的主人，也是你唯一能擁有的東西，當你了悟此點，你將自然而然，不費吹灰之力就達到與此客體世界的協調。所有的人類都必須懷有此種想法：在此宇宙中，能稱為屬於自己的唯一實體就只有至上意識。
IT_TEXT: Concentra la mente.  Invece di sviluppare attaccamento verso gli oggetti mondani, dovresti sviluppare attaccamento verso Parama Puruśa (Viṣṇu). Nello sloka il termine mamata esprime la sensazione di ciò che si percepisce come proprio. Nessun oggetto di questo universo può essere considerato tuo. Sei arrivato su questa terra senza alcun possesso e te ne andrai allo stesso modo, a mani vuote. Come potrebbe, dunque, un oggetto essere definito tuo? Non può. Questa è la vera conoscenza: non c’è nulla in questo universo che tu possa chiamare tuo, eccetto Parama Puruśa. Se questa idea non viene coltivata, le persone perdono entusiasmo e smettono di impegnarsi davvero. A mio parere, la via migliore è l’aggiustamento oggettivo attraverso un approccio soggettivo. Se non senti che tutti gli oggetti e gli esseri fanno parte di te, non potrai sviluppare amore e affetto per la Sua creazione. L’equilibrio tra il tuo essere individuale e il mondo esterno si altererà e il tuo movimento verso Parama Puruśa verrà ostacolato. Ricorda: l’amore che sviluppi per questa creazione deve sempre essere canalizzato verso Parama Puruśa. Poiché Egli è il proprietario del mondo oggettivo, è l’unico “oggetto” che tu possa realmente possedere. Quando realizzerai questo, l’aggiustamento con il mondo esterno avverrà in modo naturale e senza sforzo. Ogni essere umano dovrebbe mantenere nella propria mente l’idea che l’unica Entità che può chiamare realmente sua, in tutto l’universo, è Parama Puruśa.

EN_TEXT: You must not aspire to be the white-coloured vipra, the blood-red-coloured Kśatriya, the blood-and-black-coloured, i.e., yellow-coloured vaeshya or the dark-coloured shúdra. You have to rise above all these. To attain the state beyond the attributes, you have to meditate on Puruśa, reflect on your universality and know your original form. In the beginning, you have to become the white-coloured vipra. Then you will have to shake off the vipra feeling and finally merge into the Cosmic Consciousness which is free from all colours.
ZH_TEXT: 你不應期望成為白色的聰明智士、血紅色的武士、黃色的商人或黑色的勞工。你必須超越這一切。要達到超越屬性的境界，你必須將心安住於宇宙意識，將其反映到你的宇宙胸懷上，並了知自己的本來面目。開始時，你須成為白色的聰明智士，然後你應擺脫此聰明智士的情感，最後融入沒有任何顏色的宇宙意識裡。
IT_TEXT: Le distinzioni fondate sui colori mentali e sulle tendenze non sono una meta spirituale, ma uno stadio da trascendere. Non devi aspirare a essere il vipra di colore bianco, il kśatriya di colore rosso sangue, il vaeshya di colore giallo, né lo shúdra di colore scuro. Devi andare oltre tutte queste condizioni. Per raggiungere lo stato che è al di là degli attributi, devi meditare su Puruśa, riflettere sulla tua universalità e conoscere la tua forma originaria. All’inizio devi diventare il vipra di colore bianco. Poi dovrai scrollarti di dosso il sentimento di vipra e infine fonderti nella Coscienza Cosmica, che è libera da ogni colore.

EN_TEXT: Good people, spiritual aspirants [sádhakas], absorb more positive microvita than non-spiritual people, so all their propensities move with positive vitality. In a spiritual sádhaka, all the positive propensities of the anáhata cakra are positively strengthened as a result. This is sentient psycho-panoramic maximitis. If one moves towards crudeness, there will be static psycho-panoramic minimitis. When this knowledge is acquired by a large number of people in this world, together they will absorb more positive microvita. By doing so they will benefit themselves individually, and at the same time the whole world will be benefited.
ZH_TEXT: 善人和靈性修持者吸收正性微生命比非修行者多，所以他們的心靈情緒傾向都活躍著正性生命力，因此一個靈性修持者身上，其心輪所有正性的心靈情緒傾向也都必然隨之增強，此即悅性之心智的最大的展現。如果人類朝向粗鈍移動，就會導致惰性之心智的最小的展現。當這世界有許多人得到這種知識後，他們將一起吸取更多的正性微生命。如此一來不但他們個人獲得助益，同時整個世界也將受益。
IT_TEXT: Le persone buone, gli aspiranti spirituali [sādhaka], assorbono più microvita positivi rispetto alle persone non spirituali, perciò tutte le loro propensioni si muovono con una vitalità positiva. In un sādhaka spirituale, tutte le propensioni positive del cakra anāhata vengono di conseguenza rafforzate positivamente. Questo è chiamato massimità psico-panoramica senziente (sentient psycho-panoramic maximitis). Se invece ci si muove verso la grossolanità, si avrà minimità psico-panoramica statica (static psycho-panoramic minimitis). Quando questa conoscenza viene acquisita da un gran numero di persone nel mondo, esse, insieme, assorbiranno più microvita positivi. Così facendo, beneficeranno se stesse individualmente e, allo stesso tempo, ne trarrà beneficio l’intero mondo.

EN_TEXT: Give respect to those who are not respected by others, and to those who are not even recognized as human beings, give recognition. Go to them and say, “Donʼt worry, I will always help you. As long as I am here you need not feel unnecessarily concerned.” Give hope and consolation to human beings – give them respect, give them recognition as human beings. Tell them, “You are also human beings and worthy to be treated with respect and dignity.” These are the real signs of a genuine devotee, an ideal sádhaká [spiritual aspirant]. I want you all to try to become genuine devotees like this.
ZH_TEXT: 尊敬那些不受他人敬重之人，承認那些不被認可之人。走近他們，對他們說：「無需擔心，我會永遠幫助你們，只要我在這裡，你無需憂慮！」給與人類希望和安慰──給與他們尊敬，認可他們，告訴他們：「我們同為人，同樣值得敬重和尊嚴的對待。」 這才是真正虔誠者、完美靈性修持者真實的表徵，我期望你們都能成為這樣一位真正的虔誠者。

EN_TEXT: Those who want to prosper in life must destroy these six defects in themselves: nidrá [sleep], tandrá [drowsiness], álasyaḿ [lethargy], bhayaḿ [fear], krodha [anger], and diirghasútratá [procrastination]. It is said, “Those who long for their well-being, who very much wish for their all-round development, will have to give up these six bad habits. A person desirous of welfare must necessarily be free from these defects, otherwise oneʼs progress is bound to be impeded, retarded.”
ZH_TEXT: 想要生命成功者必須摒除下列六項缺點：睡眠(nidrá)、昏沉(tandrá)、懶情(lasyaḿ)、恐懼(bhayaḿ)、憤恕(krodha)和拖延(diirghasútratá)。 有言道：那些渴望真正福祉、祈求全面性開展的人，必須根除這六項壞習慣，否則其進步將會受到阻礙。

EN_TEXT: The mind, instead of exerting its control directly from the sahasrára cakra, exerts its control through the other cakras, the other plexi. Hence in order to advance spiritually, one has first to establish control over these lower cakras, then finally over the sahasrára cakra. If one, conversely, tries to control the sahasrára first while the other cakras remain uncontrolled, spiritual practice on the sahasrára may be hampered. Not only that; even if the sahasrára cakra can be brought under control, the final result will not be good if the subsidiary cakras are not brought under control. It is not enough that the driver of a car be efficient, the car as well must be free from any defect.
ZH_TEXT: 心靈經由其他的脈輪來行使其控制作用，而非直接由頂輪來遂行其控制。因此，為了在靈性上的進步，吾人首先必須能控制這些較低下的脈輪，最後再控制頂輪，反之，若一個人當其他的脈輪都尚未能控制時，卻努力的想控制頂輪，此對以頂輪所從事之靈性修持可能會受到阻礙。不僅如此，即使能控制頂輪，但卻未能控制其他的附屬脈輪，最後的結果可能亦非有益的。一部車子單單駕駛能力高超，是不夠的，車子也必須沒有任何缺失才行。
IT_TEXT: La mente, invece di esercitare il proprio controllo direttamente dal sahasrāra cakra, opera attraverso gli altri cakra, gli altri plessi. Perciò, per avanzare spiritualmente, bisogna prima stabilire il controllo su questi cakra inferiori e, solo alla fine, sul sahasrāra cakra. Se si tenta di intervenire direttamente sul sahasrāra trascurando gli altri cakra, la pratica spirituale sul sahasrāra risulterebbe difficile. Non solo: anche se si riuscisse a portare sotto controllo il sahasrāra cakra, il risultato finale non sarebbe positivamente buono se gli altri cakra sussidiari non fossero parimenti controllati. Non è sufficiente che il conducente di un’auto sia esperto: anche l’auto deve essere priva di difetti.

EN_TEXT: Attraverso il sadhana facciamo risalire verso l’alto la kulakuṇḍalinī e, al termine del percorso, avviene l’unione di Rādhā e Kṛṣṇa. Non trasmettere ciò che può danneggiare la vita individuale o collettiva è corretto, ma ciò che può fare bene va condiviso. Così le persone saranno più motivate a praticare il sadhana.
ZH_TEXT: 我們透過靈性靜坐修持將庫拉孔達里尼提升，最後「拉達」和「克里斯那」合而為一。要提升這沉睡的靈性潛能是有技巧的，往昔這個技巧是不公開的，那時有些人認為這些技巧最好是密傳；如果是會對個人或整體生命有所傷害的事物，當然最好是不傳，但是如果是對眾生有益之事，那麼就應該廣為傳播，如此也能激起人們靈修的熱情。

EN_TEXT: It may happen that you are tormented by someone in your personal life and tolerate everything out of fear. If one day you summon up all your courage to oppose that person, you will find that the tyrant retreats ignominously. Similarly, under the spell of fear, a community may allow itself to be exploited by another community. But if the exploited community turns against the exploiters, the tyrants will take to their heels. There is a great need for courage. Never surrender to fear in individual or collective life.
ZH_TEXT: 倘若你在個人的生活中受到某人的折磨，由於恐懼，你容忍一切。如果有一天，你鼓起勇氣對抗這個人，你會發現那個惡人必會羞愧的避開。同樣的，在恐懼的陰影下，一個社會可能聽任自身被另外一個社會所剝削，但是如果被剝削的社會，奮起反抗剝削者，這些惡霸將會倉皇逃走。這需要很大的勇氣，在個人或集體生活中，不要向恐懼投降。

EN_TEXT: Before starting a noble task you need not consult the almanacs or the positions of the stars; start it immediately. But when you want to do something harmful, try to delay it for as long as you can. With the passing of time, and a change in mentality, you may decide not to do it any more. While you are executing your noble task do not waste your time. In this practical world, in this relative world, the most valuable relative factor is time. Once the time has passed and gone, it does not return again, so never misuse time. May you prosper. May victory be with you.
ZH_TEXT: 投身於崇高的理想時，不用去算命卜卦、查曆書或算星辰方位，請即刻開始；反之，當你動念為害時，盡可能的拖延，隨著時間的消逝、心態的轉變，你可能決定不再去做。 當你從事崇高的行為時，不要輕擲荒廢了寶貴的時間，在此現實相對的世界裡，最有相對價值的就是時間，時間一去不復返，所以切莫輕忽錯用，祝你們成功，願勝利與你們同在！
IT_TEXT: Prima di iniziare un’azione nobile non c’è bisogno di consultare almanacchi o la posizione delle stelle: comincia subito. Quando invece stai per fare qualcosa di dannoso, cerca di rimandarlo il più a lungo possibile. Con il passare del tempo e con un cambiamento di mentalità, potresti decidere di non farlo più. E mentre porti avanti un’azione nobile, non sprecare il tuo tempo. In questo mondo pratico, in questo mondo relativo, il fattore relativo più prezioso è il tempo. Una volta che il tempo è passato, non ritorna più: non sprecarlo mai. Che tu possa prosperare. Che la vittoria sia con te.

EN_TEXT: The basic dharma of humans, on the other hand, is mánava dharma, Bhágavata dharma. This essential or basic dharma expresses the essential distinguishing character of a human. But no place is given to this basic dharma; only the secondary dharmas are being cultivated. Poems are being composed, business is going on, politics is going on, speeches are being delivered; but human beings are totally denied their basic mánava dharma. But what exactly is the state of affairs where Bhágavata dharma is absent? Well, it is something like watering an uprooted tree. Devoid of the quality of humanity, what can one do with the secondary qualities alone? To expect fruit from an uprooted tree is nothing but sheer foolishness. Similarly, if people are lacking in their basic mánava dharma, they are no longer human beings. Nothing can be expected of them. They are finished, they are worthless.
ZH_TEXT: 人類的法性是至上法性(mánava dharma, Bhágavata dharma)。這不可或缺或基本的法性展現了人類與眾不同的重要特徵。但人卻忽視這些主要法性，而只顧著培養第二法性。人類忙碌於作詩填詞、從商、從政、演講……等，完全忘了他們的至上法性。他們忘了如果沒有至上法性，那麼其他的事物實際上會是何種狀態？這就如同對著一棵連根拔起的樹澆水。人類沒有了主要的特質，光有次要特質，又有何用？期待沒有根的樹長出果實不是極其愚蠢嗎！同樣的，人類如果缺少至上法性，就不能被稱為「人」，他們沒有資格被稱為「人」，你無法對一無是處的他們有所期待，他們完全失去了一個做為「人」的價值。
IT_TEXT: Il dharma fondamentale degli esseri umani è il mānava dharma, il Bhāgavata dharma. Questo dharma essenziale esprime il tratto distintivo dell’essere umano. Ma a questo dharma fondamentale non viene dato spazio, perché gli esseri umani scelgono di coltivare solo i dharma secondari. Si compongono poesie, si fanno affari, si pratica la politica, si tengono discorsi, e così gli esseri umani rinunciano al loro dharma fondamentale, il mānava dharma. Ma qual è, esattamente, la condizione in cui il Bhāgavata dharma è assente? È qualcosa di simile all’annaffiare un albero sradicato. Privati della qualità dell’umanità, che cosa si può fare con le sole qualità secondarie? Aspettarsi frutti da un albero sradicato non è altro che pura stoltezza. Allo stesso modo, se le persone sono prive del loro mānava dharma fondamentale, non sono più esseri umani. Non ci si può aspettare nulla da loro. Sono finiti, sono privi di valore.

EN_TEXT: People may have performed good deeds in this life and their souls may have reached a higher level, but if they happen to die before attaining liberation, their progress is thwarted, is stopped, until they receive a new life. Because, as has been mentioned, sádhaná is possible only when one has a physical body. That is why the physical body is called dharmakśetra.
ZH_TEXT: 人們在世時也許會從事好的行為，他們的靈魂也許會到達一個很高的境界，但如果此世沒有獲得解脫就死了，他們的進步就會停止，一直到他們再度獲得新的肉身為止。因為我說過了，從事靈性修持的最基本條件就是要具足這個肉身。所以此肉身被稱為「法性戰場」。
IT_TEXT: Le persone possono anche aver compiuto buone azioni in questa vita e le loro anime possono aver raggiunto un livello più elevato; ma, se accade che muoiano prima di aver conseguito la liberazione, il loro progresso viene ostacolato, viene interrotto, finché non ricevono una nuova vita. Questo perché, come è stato detto, il sādhana è possibile solo quando si possiede un corpo fisico. È per questo motivo che il corpo fisico è chiamato dharmakṣetra.

EN_TEXT: The Entity whom you are trying to attain – Parama Puruśa – is your own innermost self. Your relation with Him is not external, to be defined by courts, laws, or society. It is a family relationship. The desire in your mind to meet God is only born when He is inclined towards you. It is the result of His desire to meet you. Your meeting with God is not a unilateral affair, it is a mutual thing. You walk one step towards Him and He will come twenty towards you.
ZH_TEXT: 你努力想要達到的至上本體，就是你最內在的「真我」。你與祂之間並非法律或社會所界定的外在關係，而是一種家庭的親情聯繫。唯有當祂親近你時，你的心靈才會湧現與祂合一的渴望，而這是由於祂渴望與你相遇使然，你與至上的接觸不是一廂情願的關係，這是相互的渴望。你朝向祂前進一步，祂便會向你走二十步過來。

EN_TEXT: When dishonest people dominate over society, when administration is in the hands of the corrupt, honest people keep a low profile. When adharma reigns in society, when people are goaded by immoral persons and compelled to act by them, then and only then is it that people deviate from their dharma... What a miserable and helpless condition people are in when they have to lower their heads in fear before sinners, and adharma triumphs over dharma! They can do nothing under such circumstances. Under such awful circumstances, Parama Puruśa Himself has to come and take stern measures. In order to save humankind from such an extreme situation, Parama Puruśa will certainly have to do something.
ZH_TEXT: 當社會多為不正直之人所掌控，且政府官員又多貪污腐敗時，好人處處受壓制，只能低調以對；當非法性控制了整個社會，人們受迫於不道德之人的驅策，而致使背離了法性。…… 人們會是多麼悲慘和無助啊！眼見非法性在法性之上勝利狂囂，而他們必須在惡人面前害怕得低下頭去。在如此惡劣的情況下，至上意識本身必須降臨並且採取嚴厲的手段，以拯救受苦受難的人類。至上意識當然必須要有所行動。
IT_TEXT: Quando le persone disoneste dominano la società, quando l’amministrazione è nelle mani dei corrotti, le persone oneste sono costrette a tenere un profilo basso. Quando l’adharma regna nella società, quando gli esseri umani vengono istigati da persone immorali e da esse costretti ad agire, allora e solo allora le persone deviano dal proprio dharma. Quanto è misera e impotente la condizione delle persone quando sono costrette ad abbassare il capo per paura davanti ai peccatori, e l’adharma trionfa sul dharma! In tali circostanze non possono fare nulla. In condizioni così terribili, Parama Puruṣa stesso deve venire e adottare misure severe. Per salvare l’umanità da una situazione tanto estrema, Parama Puruṣa dovrà certamente fare qualcosa.

EN_TEXT: Nothing is gained by becoming a jiṋánii [intellectual]. [Jiṋána] has use only so far as devotion has not been born. When you eat tasty food, the paper on which you place this food is jiṋána. The food itself is karma, and the taste of the food is bhakti. If you have absorbed the food and got its taste, the dirty paper of jiṋána has to be thrown in the dustbin. This alone is wisdom. Be wise!
ZH_TEXT: 成為「知識分子」(jinánii)，你將一無所得。只有虔誠情感未生之處，知識方有用處。用來墊可口食物的紙就是知識，食物本身是行動，而品嚐可口的食物就是虔誠。當你吃過了這美味的食物後，墊在下面的紙就沒有用了，就該被丟棄於垃圾桶裡。唯有如此方為明智之舉，做個明智之人吧！
IT_TEXT: Nulla si ottiene diventando un jñānī [un intellettuale]. La jñāna ha utilità solo finché la devozione non è ancora nata. Quando mangi un cibo saporito, la carta su cui appoggi quel cibo è la jñāna. Il cibo stesso è il karma, e il sapore del cibo è la bhakti. Se hai assimilato il cibo e ne hai gustato il sapore, la carta sporca della jñāna deve essere gettata nel cestino. Solo questo è saggezza. Sii saggio!

EN_TEXT: Gold and iron have their respective dharmas. In just the same way, human beings have their own dharma. If human beings deviate from their own dharma – mánava dharma – no more can they be called humans. Humansʼ glory lies in their own dharma. So it is desirable that they be loyal to their svadharma [own dharma]. Even if people feel better off living like animals, and find it very troublesome to live like human beings, they will have to live like humans. Suffering notwithstanding, their character as human beings should not be lost. Here the term svadharma means mánava dharma, and paradharma stands for whatever is outside this mánava dharma. It is better to embrace death established in svadharma; for humans pashu dharma [animal dharma] is dangerous. Humans should always remain firm in their mánava dharma; therein lies their greatness. Not even for a moment should people forget this.
ZH_TEXT: 金子和鐵各有其法性，同樣的，人類也有他們自己特別的法性。如果人類偏離了自身的法性，他們就不能被稱為「人」了。人類的光輝存在於他們的法性裡，所以人類應該堅守自己的法性。即使他們覺得像動物般過日子較舒坦，做為人可真麻煩，他們仍然必須活得像個人。儘管受苦受難，他們仍然不該忘懷他們身為人的特質。 人類自身的法性在此指的就是至上法性，除此之外的一律稱為動、植物法性。寧可為遵行至上法性而死，因為對人類而言，動物法性是危險的。所以人類應牢牢固守自己的人類法性，他們的偉大亦在此。人類一刻都不能忘懷此事。
IT_TEXT: L’oro e il ferro hanno ciascuno il proprio dharma. Allo stesso modo, anche gli esseri umani hanno il loro dharma. Se gli esseri umani deviano dal proprio dharma – il mānava dharma – non possono più essere chiamati esseri umani. La gloria dell’essere umano risiede nel suo dharma. È quindi auspicabile che le persone restino fedeli al proprio svadharma (dharma personale). Anche se qualcuno dovesse sentirsi più a proprio agio vivendo come un animale e trovasse molto gravoso vivere come un essere umano, dovrà comunque vivere come un essere umano. Nonostante la sofferenza, il carattere umano non deve andare perduto. Qui il termine svadharma significa mānava dharma, mentre paradharma indica tutto ciò che è esterno a questo mānava dharma. È meglio accogliere la morte restando stabiliti nel svadharma; per gli esseri umani, il pashu dharma (dharma animale) è pericoloso. Gli esseri umani devono sempre rimanere saldi nel loro mānava dharma; in ciò risiede la loro grandezza. Neppure per un istante le persone dovrebbero dimenticarlo.

EN_TEXT: For human beings the main jiivanavrtti [driving force in life] is to worship Parama Puruśa, to love Him with their entire being. In order to worship Parama Puruśa, human beings need body, mind and soul. To pursue their sádhaná, people have to live, and in order to live, they have to strive for food, clothing and shelter. But provision of food, clothing and shelter are not their main concern. These things are no doubt necessary to keep themselves fit for sádhaná; people have to make necessary arrangements for these things; but surely these things are not the end. Whenever someone forgets this, a downfall sets in in that personʼs life, because thereby that person has set his or her foot on the path of paradharma, discarding their own svadharma.
ZH_TEXT: 對人類而言，生命的驅策力(jiivanavrtti)是禮拜至上意識，是用他們全部的生命去愛祂。 為了禮拜至上意識，人需要肉身、心靈和靈魂。他們必須活著才能從事靈性的修持，為了活著，他們必須努力尋求食物、衣服和居住處所。無疑地這些的供給是必須的，人們必須為這些事而忙碌，但可確定的是這些不是目標，不該是他們所最關心的事。當人們忘了這一點，他們的生命即墮落，因為他們丟棄自身的法性，而讓自己走上動、植物法性之道。
IT_TEXT: Per gli esseri umani la principale jiivanavrtti [forza motrice della vita] è adorare Parama Puruśa, amarlo con tutto il proprio essere. Per adorare Parama Puruśa, gli esseri umani hanno bisogno di corpo, mente e anima. Per portare avanti il proprio sādhaná, le persone devono vivere e, per vivere, devono impegnarsi a procurarsi cibo, vestiario e riparo. Ma la fornitura di cibo, vestiario e riparo non deve essere la loro preoccupazione principale. Queste cose sono senza dubbio necessarie per essere in grado di praticare il sādhaná; le persone devono predisporre quanto è necessario a questo scopo; ma certamente queste cose non sono il fine ultimo. Ogni volta che qualcuno dimentica questo, nella sua vita inizia un declino, perché in tal modo quella persona ha messo piede sul sentiero del paradharma, abbandonando il proprio svadharma.

EN_TEXT: Human beings express their feelings in different ways. One way is that one brings oneʼs vibrations from the realm of ideation down to the physical world, makes them descend to the quinquelmental world with the help of sensory and motor organs. Another way is that with the help of the subtler artistic aspects of that expression, one transports it to oneʼs psychic realm making use of oneʼs subtler sensory feelings. The feeling human beings express in the physical realm, is called worldly action. When expression is brought to the psychic realm, it is called lalita carcana [the cultivation of fine arts]. Lalita carcana is also called simply “the fine arts” or “subtler arts”.
ZH_TEXT: 人類以各種不同的方式來傳達他們的情感。將思想、概念的波動，透過感覺或運動器官之助，在五大原素所構成的物質世界表達，是其中之一。另一個方式則是利用精細的感覺將此表達的波動，以藝術的方式傳達至一個人的心智領域。人類在物質層面所展現的情感稱為「世俗物質層面的行動」，而在心智層面的展現，則稱為「藝術的涵養」(lalita carcana)，亦可簡稱為「精細的藝術」。
IT_TEXT: Gli esseri umani esprimono i propri sentimenti in modi diversi. Un modo consiste nel portare le proprie vibrazioni dal piano dell’ideazione al mondo fisico, facendole discendere nel mondo quinquelementale con l’aiuto degli organi sensoriali e motori. Un altro modo consiste nel trasferire l’espressione al piano psichico attraverso i suoi aspetti artistici più sottili, facendo uso delle sensazioni più fini dei sensi. Il sentimento che gli esseri umani esprimono nel piano fisico è chiamato azione nel mondo. Quando l’espressione viene portata nel piano psichico, essa è chiamata lalita carcana [la coltivazione delle arti raffinate]. Lalita carcana è chiamata anche semplicemente “arti raffinate” o “arti sottili”.

EN_TEXT: Some people announced that women are not entitled to spiritual salvation. If women want to attain spiritual emancipation they will have to be reborn as men. What an absurd proposition! All are the progeny of Parama Puruśa, some of them are sons, some are daughters. Can Parama Puruśa ever give any decree that only His sons will be entitled to liberation and salvation and His daughters will not attain it? This is indeed a strange and unnatural proposition; it is sheer villainy... On one side the malevolent forces are to establish their professed dogmas and on the other hand Parama Puruśa wants the all-round development of human intellect. Hence I call upon you to carry on a ceaseless and pactless fight against dogma. You are sure to be crowned with victory.
ZH_TEXT: 有些人宣稱女人沒有資格得到靈性解脫；如果女人想要達到靈性的解脫，她們必須再生為男人。這是什麼荒謬的主張啊！萬物都是至上意識的子孫，有些是祂的兒子有些則是女兒。 難不成至上意識曾下令說，只有祂的兒子才有資格得到自在及究竟解脫，而祂的女兒則不然？這實在是一種奇怪又不合常理的主張，這是十足的惡行。…… 在一方面，邪惡力量強烈地要建立他們所謂的教條；在另一方面，至上意識想要人類智力的全面發展。所以我呼籲你們對教條作永不止息無條件的奮戰。你們一定會得到勝利。

EN_TEXT: Only that person who remains free from all superstitions and moves towards the Supreme Entity with genuine devotion, and one-pointed ideation on Him, and whose inner soul runs unhindered towards the Cosmic Soul, attains Him, attains everything in life, and attaining Him gets merged in Him.
ZH_TEXT: 唯有不盲目崇拜並以真正的虔誠之心向至上本體前進，以祂為唯一目標且內在靈魂無懼任何險阻，勇敢邁向至上靈魂之人終能達到祂，圓滿生命中的一切，最後融入於祂。

ZH_TEXT: 並非所有的物質實體都能轉變成為意識。當生命能量和心靈不開展時，那實體就必須遵循惰性的道路，唯有喚醒生命能量和心靈者能夠立足於意識。

EN_TEXT: He is the veritable Shiva, blessedness personified. Whatever He does, He does for all. Just as parents sometimes have to punish their children and cause them to weep to rectify their bad habits, similarly Parama Puruśa leads human beings to supreme blessedness through trials and tribulations. If once you can know Him, you will attain bliss.
ZH_TEXT: 祂是名副其實的希瓦──神聖喜悅的化身。祂所做的一切都是為了眾生。就像父母有時會處罰小孩，讓他們哭泣以導正他們的行為，至上意識也會以考驗和磨練來引導人類走向真正的福祉。只要你了悟祂，必得喜悅。

ZH_TEXT: 尋求解脫之人的唯一要務就是與祂合一；得到祂，所有恐懼、腐朽、死亡、憎恨和憂慮的束縛將一一被粉碎而消失於無形。

EN_TEXT: The rhythm in which the vibrational flow of the Cosmic Mind vibrates the annamáya kośa of individual microcosms – veins, nerves, arteries, blood, lymph, etc. – is the initial stage of the divine Cosmic sound. When this sound is heard in the annamáya kośa it resembles that of a cricket. When this Cosmic sound vibrates the kámamaya kośa it resembles the sound of ankle bells. In the manomaya kośa it resembles a flute (the mystic sádhakas of the Vaeśńava cult describe it as the sound of Lord Krśńaʼs flute); in atimánasa kośa, the resonance of a gong; in vijiṋánamaya kośa, the buzzing of bees or the rolling of ocean waves; and in hirańmaya kośa, a prolonged oṋḿ sound.
ZH_TEXT: 振動在個體小宇宙肉身層次的宇宙心靈波韻律，如靜脈、神經、動脈、血液、淋巴液等，是神聖宇宙音聲最初始的階段。這些聲音在肉身層次聽起來像是蟋蟀聲；振動在粗鈍心靈層次的宇宙音聲聽起來就像是腳踝鈴聲；在精細心靈層次像是笛聲（維識努信仰密傳法門的靈修聖者將此聲音形容成上主克里斯那的笛聲）;在超心靈層次則像是銅鑼的共鳴聲；在下意識心靈層次像是蜜蜂的嗡嗡聲或海潮滾動的聲音；在致因心靈層次則是拉長的唵聲。

EN_TEXT: This Supreme Entity lies hidden in the existential feeling of each individual as its witness. He is reflected on the mirror of the buddhitattva (existential “I”) of every entity. One who has made this reflecting mirror spotless through the constant practice of sádhaná can better understand the glory of this Entity. Those who have known this Entity have attained immortality.
ZH_TEXT: 至上本體以見證者的身分隱藏於每個個體的我覺裡。祂被反映在每一實體的我覺明鏡上。透過持續有恆的靈性修持，去除反映鏡上的污垢，則能對此實體的偉大有較深的了解。了悟此實體之人將達到不朽的境界。

EN_TEXT: With the decreasing economic dependence of women on men, the inequity of the dowry system will cease to exist. But to expedite this process, it is essential to propagate high ideals among young men and women. Our sons and daughters are not commodities like rice, pulse, salt, oil or cattle that they can be haggled over in the marketplace.
ZH_TEXT: 隨著女人仰賴男人程度的降低，嫁妝制度的不平等將不再存在。但是為了加速這個過程，重要的是對年輕的男女宣揚崇高的理想。我們的兒女並不是商品，可像稻米、豆子、鹽、油或牛隻一般在市場上討價還價地販賣。
IT_TEXT: Con la progressiva diminuzione della dipendenza economica delle donne dagli uomini, l’iniquità del sistema della dote cesserà di esistere. Tuttavia, per accelerare questo processo, è essenziale diffondere ideali elevati tra i giovani uomini e le giovani donne. I nostri figli e le nostre figlie non sono merci come riso, legumi, sale, olio o bestiame, da contrattare nel mercato.

EN_TEXT: When the human intellect becomes ardently eager to venture into a new enterprise in the psychic sphere, dogma again comes into the picture and insists, “Oh, no! You must not do like this. It will bring about your ruin.” Thus, in every sphere, at every step, dogma puts a blockade on the human mind, on the human intellect.
ZH_TEXT: 當人類智力熱切渴望進入心智層面的新領域，教條又再度降臨，堅持認為：「哦！萬萬不可！你不可以這麼做，你會毀了你自己。」教條就像這樣，在每一層面、每一步伐上將人類的心靈、心智封鎖得死死的。

EN_TEXT: The history of the human race should be written according to the inherent special characteristics of human beings. Only then will we know how successful the human beings of the past were in developing their latent noble qualities, and how much they have progressed today. A handful of people out of millions may reach the pinnacle of progress and provide inspiration for thousands of others, but this will not benefit the entire human race. We will have to be particularly persevering to ensure that the special characteristics, that is, the innate dharma, of all people are fully developed.
ZH_TEXT: 人類種族的歷史應該根據人類天生的特質來編寫。只有那樣，我們才能知道過去的人類在發展他們潛在的高貴特質是多麼地成功，並且到了今天他們到底有多大的進步。百萬人中的一小撮人可能達到成功的顛峰並給予千餘人鼓勵，但是這樣不會帶給整個人類種族利益，我們必須堅定不移地保證此所有人類內在法性的特質能完全地發展。
IT_TEXT: La storia della razza umana dovrebbe essere scritta in base alle caratteristiche speciali intrinseche degli esseri umani. Solo allora sapremo quanto successo abbiano avuto gli esseri umani del passato nello sviluppare le loro nobili qualità latenti e quanto progresso sia stato compiuto fino a oggi. Un pugno di persone, tra milioni, può raggiungere il vertice del progresso e offrire ispirazione a migliaia di altri, ma questo non porterà beneficio all’intera razza umana. Dovremo essere particolarmente perseveranti nell’assicurare che le caratteristiche speciali, cioè il dharma innato, di tutte le persone siano pienamente sviluppate.

EN_TEXT: Whatever thoughts any small child, or boy or girl, or adolescent, youth, middle-aged person or old person may have in their individual lives, in family life it is the responsibility of the guardians of the family to control them. Children are generally like their parents. But the overall responsibility of guardianship lies with the samája gurus. They should see that no oneʼs thoughts cross the line from that which it would be better to forsake, to that which is actually punishable. And as in individual life, so in social life, the samája gurus should see that the collective thinking does not cross the line from that which it would be better to forsake, to that which is actually punishable. If, in spite of everything, peopleʼs defective thoughts do reach the stage of punishability, indiscipline will affect the entire social structure. To put an end to the indiscipline and restore order to social life is the major responsibility of a sadvipra. For this reason there is no place for carefree relaxation in a sadvipraʼs life. A sadvipra has to bear, and staunchly bear, the entire responsibility of protecting society. If the mentality of any group of the society reaches the punishable stage, sadvipras will have to form another and more disciplined group.
ZH_TEXT: 不論是幼兒、小男生、小女生、青少年、青年、中年人或銀髮族，不管什麼人在他們個人的生命中有過什麼念頭，在家庭生活中，家長就該負起管束的責任，因為通常孩子會像他們的父母。社會層面的生命和個體生命相同，全體社會監護的責任在社會導師(samája gurus)的身上，他們應該看管好每個人的思想，同時也應看管好集體的思潮，不讓任何人的思想或集體的思潮越過被處罰的界線。個人不好的思想如果到達該受處分的階段，那種違法亂紀的惡行將對整個社會結構造成影響。結束此種惡行並恢復社會的秩序則是完美道德智士主要的任務，因此，對完美道德智士而言，生命無一刻是可安逸放縱、樂活輕鬆的。完美道德智士必須堅定的扛起保護社會的所有責任。社會中任何一個團體的想法如果踰越了被處罰的界線，那麼完美道德智士就必須組織另一更有紀律的團體以對抗。
IT_TEXT: Qualunque siano i pensieri che un bambino piccolo, un ragazzo o una ragazza, un adolescente, un giovane, una persona di mezza età o un anziano possano avere nella loro vita individuale, nella vita familiare spetta ai tutori della famiglia la responsabilità di controllarli. I figli, in genere, somigliano ai genitori. Tuttavia, la responsabilità complessiva della tutela ricade sui samāja guru. Essi devono vigilare affinché i pensieri di chiunque non oltrepassino il confine tra ciò che sarebbe meglio abbandonare e ciò che è effettivamente punibile. E come nella vita individuale, così anche nella vita sociale, i samāja guru devono fare in modo che il pensiero collettivo non oltrepassi il confine tra ciò che sarebbe meglio abbandonare e ciò che è realmente punibile. Se, nonostante tutto, i pensieri difettosi delle persone giungono allo stadio della punibilità, l’indisciplina finirà per intaccare l’intera struttura sociale. Porre fine all’indisciplina e ristabilire l’ordine nella vita sociale è la principale responsabilità di un sadvipra. Per questa ragione, nella vita di un sadvipra non c’è spazio per un rilassamento spensierato. Un sadvipra deve assumersi, e assumersi con fermezza, l’intera responsabilità della protezione della società. Se la mentalità di un qualsiasi gruppo della società raggiunge il livello della punibilità, i sadvipra dovranno formare un altro gruppo, più disciplinato.

EN_TEXT: The zealous and intelligent spiritual aspirant is to suspend his sensory feelings into the crude mind; those of the crude mind are to be guided, are to be diverted, unto the subtle mind, the working mind, the individual ego; those of the individual ego are to be guided, are to be diverted, towards the pure ‘I’ feeling; and the pure ‘I’ feeling should become one with the pure cognition. This process of merger may be effected with the help of jiṋána, karma and bhakti.
ZH_TEXT: 真誠和聰明的修行者會收攝感官的作用於粗鈍心靈裡，並引導粗鈍心靈的作用融入個體自我感作用的精細心靈中，繼而再予以導向純粹的我覺，而純粹我覺則應與純粹認知力合而為一。這種融入的過程可藉由知識法門、行動法門和虔誠法門之助而完成。
IT_TEXT: L’aspirante spirituale zelante e intelligente deve sospendere le proprie sensazioni sensoriali nella mente grossolana; le sensazioni della mente grossolana devono essere guidate, devono essere indirizzate, verso la mente sottile, la mente operante, l’ego individuale; le sensazioni dell’ego individuale devono essere guidate, devono essere indirizzate, verso il puro sentimento dell’“io”; e il puro sentimento dell’“io” deve diventare uno con la cognizione pura. Questo processo di fusione può essere realizzato con l’aiuto di jñāna, karma e bhakti.

EN_TEXT: You are being propelled now by your sádhaná. Sádhaná is an important aspect of human existence. But dharma is that which protects your sádhaná. Without dharma there is no sádhaná, without sádhaná there is no dharma. The two are interdependent. They move together. So you have to be a dhármika. You have to follow your true nature. By following your true nature you become a true spiritual aspirant. By becoming a true spiritual aspirant you know God in yourself. You know that truth in yourself. That is what your life is to be.
ZH_TEXT: 你受到靈性修持的驅策，靈性修持是人類生存的一個重要面向，而法性則是用以保護你的靈性修持。沒有法性，就不會有靈性修持，反之亦然，兩者相輔相成，併肩齊行。所以，你必須是法性的遵行者，必須依照真正的法性特質而行，如此你方堪稱為真正的靈性修持者。當你成為真正的靈性修持者時，你就會在你的內在了悟到上主。你會知道真理不假外求，就在你的裡面。這才是你的人生。

EN_TEXT: One has to be actions-free in order to merge into “Iishvara”. But we have seen above that so long as Prakrtiʼs dominance prevails, it is not possible to be actions-free. By merely relinquishing the desire or pursuit of the fruits of action it is hard to get rid of the vanity of a doer, of the idea that “I do”, in so far as we cannot extricate ourselves from the objects of our actions or from the contemplation of accomplishment. To avoid these, one has to always contemplate that one is a machine and Brahma alone is the machine operator who gets the work done through this machine.
ZH_TEXT: 我們必須不受行動的束縳，方能與至上的控制者合而為一。但從上述所言看來，只要宇宙力量佔了優勢，就無法沒有行動。只是放棄對行為結果的渴望或追求，而無法將自身從行為的目的中或從對成就的念念不忘裡擺脫出來，則很難去除掉行為者的虛榮感或是「我做」的這個念頭。為了避免這些，我們必須總是想著：我們只是機器，只有至上意識是機器的操作者，祂透過這部機器來完成工作。

EN_TEXT: The belief has to be developed that Brahma is only served or chosen by Brahma. That is, Brahma inspires us to donate and again receives the same through others. It is simply by the grace of Brahma that we act and have the favourable opportunity of performing this act. It is possible to avoid the doerʼs vanity or kartrtvábhimána tyága by developing this belief.
ZH_TEXT: 必須發展出只有至上意識服務至上意識，或是只有至上意識選擇至上意識的信念。那就是祂鼓舞我們佈施，而祂再次由受施者處收到同樣的結果。也就是由於祂的恩典我們才能行動，也才有絕佳的機會來從事這個行動。藉由發展這種信念，即可避開行為者的虛榮，亦即捨棄從事行為的虛榮心。

EN_TEXT: However all is not over by renouncing the desire or abandoning the doerʼs vanity. So long as Prakrti is active, rajoguńa is there, causing actions. Doing any act means being caught by the cycle of action and reaction. What is the way out? The only way is to surrender all actions to Brahma and to ideate that every action is performed by Brahma. Such actions will not be called our own. The actions have been performed by Brahma alone and their consequences, whether good or bad, will be borne by Brahma alone. In that case we have no separate identity.
ZH_TEXT: 然而只是捨棄對行為結果的欲望或放棄行為者的虛榮心，事情仍尚未結束。只要宇宙力量仍然活躍，變性的力量就會繼續產生行動。從事任何的行為，意指陷於行為和反作用力的循環中。其解決之道是什麼呢？唯一的方法就是將所有行為臣服於至上意識，並且視一切行為都是由至上意識所做，如此才不會被說成是自己所做的行為。它們的結果不論是好或壞，都將只由至上意識來承擔，在此情形下，我們與祂是一體的。

EN_TEXT: Salvation means the eternal emancipation from this very Karma or Yajiṋa. Ordinarily Yajiṋa is of four kinds: Bhúta Yajiṋa, Nr Yajiṋa, Pitr Yajiṋa and Adhyátma Yajiṋa. Yajiṋa is performed to achieve emancipation from the consequences of action and to annihilate the Unit “I”. The fourfold services enumerated under Nr yajiṋa can be easily be performed by anyone. Every human being gets more or less opportunity for rendering services.
ZH_TEXT: 解脫意指永遠的從行動(Karma或Yajiṋa)中解放出來。通常行動(Yajiṋa)分為四種：對宇宙萬有的服務(Bhúta Yajiṋa)、對人類福祉的服務(Nr Yajiṋa)、對祖先和古聖先賢致敬(Pitr Yajiṋa)和對至上的服務(Adhyátma Yajiṋa)。 從事行為是為了要消除個體之「我」，並從行為的結果中得到解脫。任何人都可以輕易從事對人類福祉服務中所列舉的四種服務，每人多少都會有從事服務的機會。

EN_TEXT: At the time of rendering service, you should feel that object of service is Náráyańa or God and that you are a spiritual aspirant. With such feelings there is no room for conceit. Conceit causes the fall of human beings. To get rid of conceit we will have to regard the object of our service as Náráyańa. When you render service to anyone you must mentally address them with sincere devotion. “O Lord, O Náráyańa! Oblige me by accepting my services. You are merciful to me, and for this reason you have appeared before me as a living being to offer this very precious opportunity of rendering service to You.” By maintaining such sentiments, conceit will not arise in you, nor will you be bound by the reactions of your actions.
ZH_TEXT: 從事服務時，你應心懷服務的對象即是上帝，而你則是靈性的渴望者，內心有此胸懷則不會有自負感。自負會造成人的墮落，要消除自負，我們必須視所服務的對象是上帝(Narayana)。 當你為任何人服務時，內心須誠摯地念道：「哦！主啊！哦！上主那拉衍那！請接受我的服務。由於您對我的慈悲，您示現為生靈出現在我的面前，賜給我如此珍貴的機會來為您服務。」懷著這樣的胸懷，自負就不會在心中出現，你也不會受到行為的反作用力的束縛。
IT_TEXT: Nel momento in cui compiete un atto di servizio, dovreste sentire che l’oggetto del vostro servizio è Nārāyaṇa, o Dio, e che voi stessi siete aspiranti spirituali. Con tali sentimenti non rimane spazio per l’orgoglio. L’orgoglio causa la caduta degli esseri umani. Per liberarci dall’orgoglio dobbiamo considerare l’oggetto del nostro servizio come Nārāyaṇa. Quando offrite il vostro servizio a qualcuno, dovreste mentalmente rivolgervi a quella persona con sincera devozione: «Signore, Nārāyaṇa, concedimi la grazia di accettare il mio servizio. Tu sei misericordioso con me e, per questo motivo, sei apparso davanti a me come un essere vivente per offrirmi questa preziosissima opportunità di servirti.» Coltivando tali sentimenti, in voi non sorgerà orgoglio, né sarete vincolati dalle reazioni delle vostre azioni.

EN_TEXT: Wherever I look Hari is visible. To attain this stage is the consummation of the aspirantʼs efforts. By working with ideation of Brahma, you will gradually be able to perceive Brahma in everything. Why should ideation of Brahma or Hari be adopted? Before realizing this you will have to understand what Bháva signifies.
ZH_TEXT: 不論看向何處，所看到的都是至上意識(Hari)。靈性渴望者努力的圓滿成就即是達到此境界。工作時心懷至上意識，逐漸地你就能在一切事物中都感受到至上意識。為何要心懷至上意識呢？明白此點之前，必須先了解Bháva的意義。

EN_TEXT: Spontaneous idea: In this case, the ideas spring from within and only the true ideas get expressed. This occurs while you are in Iishvara Prańidhána. Initially the feeling of “I am” certainly exists in the aspirantʼs mind. He or she feels that “I am practicing Sádhaná for a realization of Brahma.” In the method of Sádhaná prescribed of Ananda Marga, this feeling of “I am” having been developed and expressed spontaneously is then transformed into feelings of Brahma. This spontaneous idea is not easily understood by those who do not practice Sádhaná.
ZH_TEXT: 自發的理念：這種情形的理念來自內在，而且只有真正的理念會表達出來。當你在從事將心念安住於至上意識(Iishvara Prańidhána)的修法時，這種理念就會展現出來。 最初「我是」的感覺必然存於修行者心中，他會覺得：我是為了了悟至上意識而從事靈性的修持。阿南達瑪迦所傳授的靈性修持方法，會自然的發展並表達出這種「我是」的感覺，然後再轉換成對至上意識的感覺。這種自發的理念對那些不從事靈性修持的人而言是很不容易理解的。
IT_TEXT: Idea spontanea: in questo caso, i pensieri non sono imposti dalla volontà o dall’ambiente, ma nascono spontaneamente dal profondo della mente, e ciò che emerge è soltanto ciò che è autentico. Questa esperienza avviene durante Iishvara Pranidhána, quando la mente è concentrata interiormente. All’inizio, chi medita sente chiaramente il proprio “io”: percepisce sé stesso come colui che sta praticando il sadhana per realizzare Brahma. Ma, nel sadhana dell’Ananda Marga, questo senso iniziale di “io sono colui che pratica” — quando matura e si esprime in modo sempre più spontaneo — gradualmente si trasforma in un sentimento più ampio, in cui l’io individuale si fonde in un senso di unità con Brahma. Questa forma di idea spontanea è difficile da comprendere per chi non medita, perché appartiene a uno stato mentale molto sottile.

EN_TEXT: Inculcate divine sentiment by saturating love wherever you have to perform Bhúta Yajiṋa, Nr yajiṋa, and Pitr yajiṋa. It is meaningless to love out of fear. Where there is no love, there cannot be complete surrender of the self and the yajiṋa is fruitless.
ZH_TEXT: 在任何需要你從事對萬有的服務、對人類福祉的服務以及對先人及古聖先賢致敬之處，都要以完全的愛並心懷神聖的情感來做。因恐懼而愛是沒有意義的，沒有愛就無法將自我完全臣服，而此項服務也將毫無結果。

EN_TEXT: You should regard yourself as an instrument of Náráyańa and go on doing your work in a detached manner. Where a person is suffering from pain, you may ask whether they are only reaping the consequences of their actions and whether in these circumstances it is proper for you to serve them. The answer is very simple. I should not even think that he or she is reaping the consequences of actions. My purpose is to decide the intention with which I will act. I will have to think that in the pursuit of a particular design, Paramátman is suffering distress and in this way, He is giving me an opportunity to render service. Out of His grace He is obliging me by accepting my services. Náráyańaʼs designs are inscrutable, so you must look upon the distressed with divine sentiments.
ZH_TEXT: 你應將自己視為至上意識的工具，以不執著之心來從事你的工作。當一個人受苦時，你或許會問，他是否正遭受其因果的報應呢，在此情形下為他們服務是否適當？答案非常簡單，我根本不會去想他是否遭受到因果報應。我的目的只需決定要以什麼樣的心態去做。我會想至上意識以此方式遭受痛苦，祂讓我有服務衪的機會。由於祂的恩典，祂會藉由接受我的服務來幫助我，上蒼的計劃是不可思議的，所以你必須以莊嚴赤誠之心去看待那些遭受苦難的人。

EN_TEXT: Where action yoga, penance or knowledge is affected with feelings of distinctions, arrogance is bound to come into play and individual distinctions are created. When an act is dedicated to Paramátman, its consequences are also dedicated to Him. The unit is neither the doer nor the bearer of the consequences. What is it to you then? Occasionally, an affectatious vanity is seen in the aspirant which is not meant for his or her personal end, but rather for the sake of Paramátman. This is called Sáttvika vanity. The vanity associated with selfless service is not derived from the mean unit “I” feeling, but from the feeling of Universal “I”. Rádhá says, Bandhu tomári garave garavinii hám Rúpasii tomári rúpe. “I pride in You. This beauty that Rádhá has belongs to You. It is your beauty which has given comeliness to Rádhá. Is it not that I receive the inspiration to act from you? You are the doer and You alone are the enjoyer.”
ZH_TEXT: 當行動、瑜伽、苦行或知識為分別心所影響時，自負勢必生起，個體的分別心也會產生出來。當行為是奉獻給至上意識時，它的結果也是奉獻給祂。個體既非行為者亦非行為結果的擁有者，那麼你究竟是什麼呢？有時修行者故意裝出自負的樣子，但這並不是為了個人的目的而是為了至上意識的緣故，這稱為悅性的自負。與無私服務結合一起的自負並非源自個體的「我」感，而是來自大宇宙的「我」感。拉達(Rádha)說道：Bandhu tomári garave garavinii hám Rúpasii tomári rúpe。我以您為豪。拉達(Rádhá)所擁有的美是屬於您的。就是您的美賜給了拉達美麗的容顏。難道我不是從您那裡得到從事行為的鼓勵嗎？您是行為者，也只有您是享受者。
IT_TEXT: Quando il karma yoga, la disciplina spirituale o la conoscenza sono accompagnati dal senso di essere “qualcuno di distinto”, nasce inevitabilmente l’arroganza e si rafforza il senso di separazione tra gli esseri. Quando invece un’azione è dedicata a Paramātman, anche i suoi frutti vengono affidati a Lui, senza appropriazione personale: l’individuo non è più né colui che agisce né colui che porta i risultati dell’azione. Che cosa resta allora da rivendicare come “mio”? Talvolta, nell’aspirante spirituale si manifesta una sorta di vanità apparente, che però non è rivolta al proprio interesse personale, bensì a Paramātman. Questa viene chiamata vanità sāttvica. La vanità associata al servizio disinteressato non nasce dal ristretto senso dell’“io” individuale, ma dal sentimento dell’“Io” universale. Rādhā dice: Bandhu tomāri garave garavinī hām Rūpasī tomāri rūpe. «Io mi glorio in Te. La bellezza che Rādhā possiede appartiene a Te. È la Tua bellezza che ha reso bella Rādhā. Non è forse da Te che ricevo l’ispirazione ad agire? Tu sei l’agente, e Tu solo sei il fruitore.»

EN_TEXT: You should act precisely with this sentiment. The more a person works with feelings of detachment, the greater is his or her Godward speed and the more the “I” feeling is annihilated. The Unit “I” feeling will be completely annihilated by the time you are completely established in the divine feeling. Detached actions are the fight against the unit self and for the attainment of the Universal “I”.
ZH_TEXT: 您應以此心境來從事行動，人愈是以不執著之心做事，則其走向神性的速度也愈快，而「我」感也會消除得愈多。當你完全的立足於神性之境時，個體的「我」感也就完全消除了。對行為的不執著即是對抗個體小我達到宇宙大我的戰鬥。

EN_TEXT: There are three processes for attaining freedom from the bondage of action: (1) relinquishing any desire for the fruits of action, or Phalákáḿkśá Tyága, (2) Abandoning the vanity of performing an act, or Kartrtvábhimána Tyága, and (3) surrendering all actions unto Brahma. All of these have to be followed in the individual life, but it must be kept in mind that they all have to be strictly observed. To be more explicit, these rules are the different aspects of one and the same process.
ZH_TEXT: 要從行動的束縛中達到自由有三步驟：（一）放棄對行為結果的任何渴望(Phalákáḿkśá Tyága)。（二）捨棄從事任何行為的虛榮心(Kartrtvábhimána Tyága)。（三）將所有的行為臣服於至上意識。在個人的生命中必須牢記也必須嚴格的遵守、奉行這些步驟。更明確的說，這些原則是同一方法的不同層面及其步驟。

EN_TEXT: Wherever I look Hari is visible. To attain this stage is the consummation of the aspirantʼs efforts. By working with ideation of Brahma, you will gradually be able to perceive Brahma in everything. Why should ideation of Brahma or Hari be adopted? Before realizing this you will have to understand what Bháva signifies. Bháva is where the mind is sanctified. All the ten directions are brightened by the rays of the sun of Love, and love is developed for the Supreme Brahma. The mind develops gentleness or tenderness. This is the aim behind treating the objects of service with ideation of Brahma.
ZH_TEXT: 不論看向何處，所看到的都是至上意識(Hari)。靈性渴望者努力的圓滿成就即是達到此境界。工作時心懷至上意識，逐漸地你就能在一切事物中都感受到至上意識。為何要心懷至上意識呢？明白此點之前，必須先了解Bháva的意義。 心靈聖潔之處即是巴伐(Bháva)。愛的陽光使十方世界充滿了光明，此愛是為至上意識而開展。心靈也變得親切和溫柔。這就是以心懷至上意識的理念來對待所服務對象之目的。

IT_TEXT: Quando una persona soffre, potreste domandarvi se non stia semplicemente raccogliendo le conseguenze delle proprie azioni e se, in tali circostanze, sia giusto servirla. La risposta è molto semplice. Non dovreste neppure pensare che quella persona stia raccogliendo le conseguenze delle proprie azioni. Ciò che dovete stabilire è l’intenzione con cui agirete. Dovrete pensare: «Nel realizzare un particolare disegno, Paramátman sta soffrendo e, in questo modo, mi sta offrendo l’opportunità di prestare servizio. Per Sua grazia, Egli mi concede il favore di accettare il mio servizio». I disegni di Náráyaṇa sono imperscrutabili; perciò dovete guardare le persone afflitte con sentimento divino.

EN_TEXT: The unit beings, due to ignorance, look upon these numerous animate and inanimate entities as finite expressions of that Infinite Entity. Later, in the process of cultivation of knowledge and action, they begin to understand that they are the multifarious expressions of that Infinite Entity. Still later when they reach the pinnacle of devotion they see the Supreme Entity is everything.
ZH_TEXT: 無知的個體把數不盡的生物、無生物當成無限本體的有限展現；爾後當透過正確的知識以及行動，有限的個體開始了解到他們是無限本體的多面向展現；最後當他們達到虔誠的極致時，他們看待萬事萬物皆是至上本體的顯現。

EN_TEXT: The Entity whose thought-world is this vast universe is not only the Universal Witness but the Universal Controller too. Even the meanest of the mean, the nastiest of the nasty, and the most infernal insects are not deprived of His grace, are not beyond His controlling touch. Conversely, even the greatest of the great, the overlord of the sea-girt earth, and the most venerable and distinguished people are powerless before Him, behumbled by His awesome personality. The sweet springs of nectar flow at the behest of His towering personality.
ZH_TEXT: 浩瀚無垠的宇宙是宇宙本體所想像出來的世界，祂不只是宇宙的見證者，也是宇宙的控制者。即使是最惡劣、最卑鄙的人或最低下的昆蟲都不能被剝奪至上對他們的恩典，他們也不能跳脫至上的控制。相反的，甚至最偉大、最高的統領或最德高望重的人都臣服於祂，在祂的莊嚴下顯得卑微。甜美的甘泉因祂崇高的意旨而源源湧出。

EN_TEXT: To give a limited form to that unlimited entity is a grave error; to present crude offerings to the Supreme Entity is meaningless. For ideation on Brahma there is no need to spend even a cent. If the worship of Brahma was a very expensive affair then none but a handful of billionaires would have been able to do it. Sádhaná is the birthright of all people, just like light, air, and water; the Infinite Entity is the common patrimony of all, not the private property of any particular individual.
ZH_TEXT: 將無限的實體限制在有限形象的束縛裡是極大的錯誤，以粗鈍之物供養至上本體是毫無意義的。因為心中持念至上意識無需花費一分一毛。如果禮拜至上所費不貲，那麼只有億萬富翁才有錢做得到。靈性修持就像空氣、陽光和水，是每個人與生俱來的權利。無限的至上本體是眾生共同的財產，非某些特殊份子的私人財產。

EN_TEXT: The Effulgent Entity is so vast that He is beyond your capacity of perception, so tiny that He is beyond your capacity of conception. If you think that He is very far from you, He will remain forever beyond your reach. If you think that He is near, He will be so near that you need not move even an inch to attain Him.
ZH_TEXT: 這燦爛的本體是如此廣大超越你感知的能力，如此微小以致你無法想像。如果你認為祂離你很遠，那麼祂將永遠在你所不及之處；如果你認為祂與你非常貼近，那麼祂比你認為的更為親近。

EN_TEXT: To attain Him You will have to become like Him. He is devoid of the thought of enjoyment, He is bereft of all desires and volitions. To attain Him you will have to think of Him, to ideate and meditate on Him. There is no other way to become one with Him.
ZH_TEXT: 你必須像祂一樣，才能達到祂：祂沒有任何享樂的念頭，沒有意欲。你想達到祂就必須想著祂、念著祂，以祂為目標靜坐觀想祂，這是唯一可與祂合一的方法。

EN_TEXT: Salvation and the attainment of Brahma are synonymous. Only those who are devoid of desires and volitions, only those who are unblemished, can embrace that Supreme Entity as their psychic pabulum. To attain salvation through supreme intuitional knowledge is only possible for those people.
ZH_TEXT: 解脫就是達到至上意識。沒有欲望、純淨無瑕之人才能擁抱至上意識，把至上本體當成心智食糧。這樣的人才可能透過無上的靈性直覺知識得到解脫。

EN_TEXT: As one thinks so one becomes. If one thinks that one is a sinner or a thief one will actually become a sinner or a thief one day. Never allow such negative thoughts to take root in your mind. Whenever you think, think of the Supreme. Your greatness will be determined by the greatness of the object of your thought or ideation.
ZH_TEXT: 一個人怎麼想就怎麼變。如果你一直認為自己是罪人或小偷，終有一日你會真的變成罪人或小偷。絕對不要讓此種念頭在你心靈生根。你應該隨時隨地想著至上意識，你觀想持念對象的偉大程度決定了你的偉大。

EN_TEXT: The Supreme Entity is the Singular, Colourless Entity. Due to the influence of the sentient, mutative and static principles various colourful psychic expressions originate from Him. In fact the difference in the nature of the psychic emanations is the cause of the differences in their colourful expressions.
ZH_TEXT: 至上本體獨一無二、沒有顏色。由於受到悅性、變性、惰性三種法則的束縛，不同顏色的心智表達才源源自祂而來。不同的顏色代表不同性質的心智呈現。

EN_TEXT: This Entity exists equally before creation, within creation and after creation. To this Supreme Entity our prayer is, “Guide our intellect and wisdom along the path of righteousness.” Human beings receive the necessary guidance to move along the path of righteousness from Saguńa Brahma. He creates diverse situations and provides constant inspiration to enable human beings to learn and move along the path of virtue. The awe-inspired human beings should pray to Him alone for the secret hints to move along the right path so that they can fulfil His desire as His willing instruments. He is the only hope and aspiration of all the microcosms of the universe.
ZH_TEXT: 至上本體同時存在於創造前、創造時以及創造之後。我們對這樣的本體只能如是祈禱：「請引導我們的聰明才智走上正確的道路吧！」人類從俱屬性至上本體處得到該有的指引，祂創造出各種情況讓我們學習並不斷地鼓舞人們沿著美德之道前行。受此偉大莊嚴所鼓舞的人們只應如是祈禱並沿此道努力前行，做為祂的工具圓滿祂的意願。祂是宇宙中所有小宇宙個體唯一的希望及激勵。
IT_TEXT: Questa Entità esiste ugualmente prima della creazione, all’interno della creazione e dopo la creazione. A questa Entità Suprema la nostra preghiera è: «Guida il nostro intelletto e la nostra saggezza lungo il sentiero della rettitudine». Gli esseri umani ricevono la guida necessaria per procedere sul sentiero della rettitudine da Saguńa Brahma. Egli crea situazioni diverse e fornisce un’ispirazione costante affinché gli esseri umani possano apprendere e avanzare sul cammino della virtù. Gli esseri umani, colmi di meraviglia e reverenza, dovrebbero rivolgersi unicamente a Lui, pregandolo di ricevere le indicazioni sottili che li guidino lungo il giusto cammino, così da poter realizzare il Suo volere come Suoi strumenti consapevoli. Egli è l’unica speranza e aspirazione di tutti i microcosmi dell’universo.

EN_TEXT: The mighty Himalayas do not know that they exist, but for a tiny fly existence is quite real. This tiny fly has the potentiality to become a great personality one day in the course of evolution. The fly that you see today is a very insignificant creature, but after hundreds of thousands of years it may become a towering personality of great eminence – a mighty genius. Hence a wise person never despises anyone. There is nothing in the world to be despised, nothing to be slighted or belittled.
ZH_TEXT: 龐大的喜馬拉雅山不知道自身的存在，但對一隻小小的蒼蠅而言，活著是很真實的事，這隻小小的蒼蠅具有十足的潛力，在進化的歷程中將有朝一日變成偉大的人。你們今日所看到的蒼蠅是如此渺小微不足道，但在幾十萬年的進化演變後，它或許變成一個赫赫有名的大人物──一個偉大的天才。所以一個明智的人不應鄙視任何人。這世界上任何事物皆不該被渺視、被輕忽貶抑。

EN_TEXT: The development of intuition is possible only in living beings who undergo greater psychic clash. Intuition and the awakened kuńd́alinii (sleeping divinity) are indistinguishable. To arouse the kuńd́alinii through psychic clash and intuitional practice means to develop intuition. A person whose kuńd́alinii has awakened does not belong to the crude world of material enjoyment, but is a true citizen of the world of intuition.
ZH_TEXT: 唯有心智承受很大衝擊的生靈才能有直覺能力的發展。直覺和被喚醒的靈性沈睡能量(kuńd́alinii)幾乎一樣。藉由心智摩擦的衝擊力和直覺的鍛鍊喚起此一靈性沈睡的能量就是「靈性直覺的開展」。一個靈性沈睡能量被喚醒的人，不再是屬於粗鈍世界的物質享受之人，而是屬於真實靈性直覺世界的子民。

EN_TEXT: While performing virtuous deeds people must consider themselves as instruments of the Lord. By ideating that the Cosmic Being is the actual doer, and by surrendering the fruits of all actions to Him, one will not have to undergo any reaction. The authorship of the actions will devolve on the Lord. On the one hand such virtuous deeds will greatly benefit the world, and on the other hand they will increase the number of good saḿskáras of Saguńa Brahma. As He already has so many, it will hardly make any difference to Him at all! The burden of His saḿskáras will not increase in any way. The stable energy in which saḿskáras lie embedded is called paráshakti (stable force of divinity) in intuitional science. As long as microcosms exist, action is a must. Thus all human beings should be persuaded to engage themselves in righteous deeds. If persuasion fails, they should be compelled to tread the virtuous path under pressure of circumstances.
ZH_TEXT: 當從事善行時，人們應把自己當成是上主的工具，藉著觀想至上本體才是真正的行為者，並將所有行為之成果臣服於祂，才不會有任何果報。把行為者的身分還給上主。善行一方面可利益眾生，另一方面此舉亦會增加俱屬性至上本體好的業力。既然祂已擁有許多，對祂而言並無差別！祂的業力重擔不會因此而增加。在直覺科學中，業力深植的能量稱為「宇宙神性力量」(paráshakti)。只要個體小宇宙存在，就一定會有行動，因此，所有的人皆應主動從事正當的行為，不然則應在環境的壓力下被強制走上道德之路。

EN_TEXT: The Cosmic Entity alone is infinite and eternal. It alone is limitless. And the eternal longing of human beings for happiness can only be satiated by realization of the Infinite. The ephemeral nature of worldly possessions, power and position can only lead one to the conclusion that none of the things of the finite and limited world can set at rest the everlasting urge for happiness. Their acquisition merely gives rise to further longing. Only realization of the Infinite can do it. The Infinite can be only one, and that is the Cosmic Entity. Hence it is only the Cosmic Entity that can provide everlasting happiness – the quest for which is the characteristic of every human being. In reality, behind this human urge is hidden the desire, the longing, for attainment of the Cosmic Entity. It is the very nature of every living being. This alone is the dharma of every person.
ZH_TEXT: 只有宇宙本體是無限、永恆的。而人類對快樂的無限渴求也只有藉著認知永恆才能得以滿足。世俗財物、權力及地位的短暫特性，帶給人唯一的結論即是：在此有限的世上，沒有一件東西可滿足人對快樂的永恆追求。獲得某些東西只會引起更進一步的渴求；只有了悟無限才能真正滿足此渴求。無限的東西只有一個，那就是「宇宙本體」(Brahma)。因此唯有宇宙本體能供給恆久的快樂，而人的本性就是在追求恆久的快樂。事實上，潛藏在人類欲望之後的即是那達到宇宙本體的渴望。這是每個生物的天性，也是人的法性。
IT_TEXT: Solo l’Entità Cosmica è infinita ed eterna. Solo Lei è senza limiti. E l’eterna aspirazione dell’essere umano alla felicità può essere appagata unicamente dalla realizzazione dell’Infinito. La natura effimera dei beni mondani, del potere e della posizione sociale conduce inevitabilmente alla conclusione che nulla di ciò che appartiene al mondo finito e limitato può placare l’inesauribile anelito alla felicità. Il loro conseguimento non fa che generare un desiderio ulteriore. Solo la realizzazione dell’Infinito può soddisfarlo. L’Infinito può essere uno solo, e questo è l’Entità Cosmica. Pertanto, soltanto l’Entità Cosmica può donare una felicità duratura – quella felicità la cui ricerca è caratteristica di ogni essere umano. In realtà, dietro questo impulso umano si cela il desiderio, l’anelito, di conseguire l’Entità Cosmica. Questa è la vera natura di ogni essere vivente. Questo soltanto è il dharma di ogni persona.

EN_TEXT: In this fight against avidyá shakti one must have sufficient weapons. You know, a soldier requires weapons, and sádhaná is a fight. In your internal sphere, that is, in your mind, you should have ten weapons. Those ten weapons are five Yama and five Niyama [moral principles]. And similarly, while fighting against evil forces in this crude physicality, you should have ultra-modern physical weapons also. Those who want disarmament and those who want to ban the atom bomb are not friends of human society. They do not want to accelerate the speed of human society. Rather they want to retard its progress. Weapons you must have, but you should have control over your body and mind. There must not be any abuse or misuse of your weapons.
ZH_TEXT: 在與無明離心力的抗戰中，人必須要有足夠的武器。你們知道，戰士需要武器，而靈性修持也是一種戰鬥。在內在，也就是你的心中必須具備十種武器。這十種武器就是內、外在行為控制準則(Yama/Niyama)。同樣的，在外在粗鈍的物質世界中，你也必須擁有超先進的武器裝備以抵抗外在邪惡的力量。那些希望裁減軍備和禁止原子彈的人非人類社會之友，他們並不想要人類社會加速進步，反而處處阻礙其進展。你們必須要有武器，但是你們應先控制你們的身、心，不可濫用或誤用你們的武器。
IT_TEXT: In questa lotta contro la avidyā śakti occorrono armi sufficienti. Un soldato ha bisogno di armi e il sādhana è una lotta. Nella vostra sfera interiore, cioè nella mente, dovete avere dieci armi. Queste dieci armi sono i cinque Yama e i cinque Niyama [principi morali]. Analogamente, mentre si combattono le forze malvagie nella cruda sfera fisica, occorre disporre anche di armi fisiche ultramoderne. Coloro che vogliono il disarmo e coloro che vogliono proibire la bomba atomica non sono amici della società umana. Essi non vogliono accelerare il progresso della società umana; al contrario, vogliono rallentarne l’avanzamento. Le armi sono necessarie, ma occorre avere controllo sul corpo e sulla mente. Non deve esserci alcun abuso o uso improprio delle armi.

EN_TEXT: For three bad features of human nature – singing oneʼs own praises more and more, trying to get others to praise oneself, and condemning others – the way to save oneself from these mental diseases is to do kiirtana at the top of oneʼs voice. If you do kiirtana, no such disease will get the chance to enter into you. None of them will get the opportunity to infect you.
ZH_TEXT: 三種人性劣質──不斷自吹自擂、企求他人阿諛奉承以及貶抑他人──救贖自己免於這些心理疾病的方法，就是大聲盡情唱頌Kiirtana。如果你唱跳Kiirtana，這些疾病就完全沒有機會侵染你，一個都沒有。
IT_TEXT: Tre cattive caratteristiche segnano la natura umana: cantare sempre più le proprie lodi, cercare di ottenere le lodi degli altri e condannare gli altri. Il rimedio a queste malattie mentali è praticare il kiirtana a piena voce. Se fai kiirtana, nessuna di queste malattie avrà la possibilità di entrare in te. Nessuna di esse avrà l’occasione di infettarti.

EN_TEXT: It is advised that one should acquire virtue (punyam) around the clock. Now the question is, what is virtue? By simply taking a dip in the waters of the Ganges will one acquire virtue? Of course not. Then what is virtue?  Aśt́ádashapuráńeśu Vyásasya vacanandvayam  Parópakárarah Puńyáya pápáya parapiiŕańam. Doing good to others is virtue; doing harm to others is sin. In this world there is no shortage of wicked people who have an innate desire to commit atrocities and harm others. What should the virtuous people do? They should acquire virtue by doing good to others, to the society, to the country, and to the masses. Their actions should promote the socio-economic well-being of the people in a skilled way.
ZH_TEXT: 忠告諸位，在二六時中分分秒秒裡皆應擁有美德。然而問題是，何謂美德？僅浸泡在恆河裡就能得到美德嗎？非也，那麼什麼是美德呢？Aśt́ádashapuráńeśu Vyásasya vacanandvayam  Parópakárarah Puńyáya pápáya parapiiŕańam。奉行眾善即是美德，傷害他人便是罪惡。世上有許多邪惡的人天生即有行惡或害人之心。具有美德者應何所為？他們應從善以待人、造福社會、國家，為所有的人民百姓謀福利，應以各種善巧方便來促進人們在社會和經濟上的福祉。

EN_TEXT: Kiirtana is an integral part of bhakti márga. During kiirtana devotees entreat Him, “Come, O Lord, come to me. Come and sit amongst us, your devotees. We will love You and sing kiirtana for You; we will adore You with all the warmth of our hearts.” This is the philosophical side of devotion. But the fundamental point is that the devotee will have to merge in the Lord. Initially it is dvaeta, because in the beginning there are two entities, the devotee and the Lord, but ultimately, when they become one, it is advaeta. That is why it is called dvaetádvaetaváda. As long as the devotees remain in the darkness of ignorance there is duality, but when their existence becomes illumined by the effulgence of divine knowledge by virtue of karma sádhaná, jiṋána sádhaná and bhakti sádhaná, they are said to be in the state of non-dualism.
ZH_TEXT: 靈性頌舞(Kiirtana)是虔誠之路不可或缺的部分。在唱跳Kiirtana時，虔誠者向祂懇求：「來呀，上主，到我這來，到我們這些虔誠者中坐下來。我們愛您、為您唱誦Kiirtana，以我們所有衷心的溫熱崇拜您。」這是虔誠在哲學層面的展現。但最根本的核心點在於虔誠者必須融入上主。最初是「二元」(Dvaeta)，因為起初存在虔誠者與上主，但最終兩者合而為一時便是「不二」(Advaeta)，這就是為什麼它被稱為「二元不二論」(Dvaetádvaetaváda)。只要虔誠者仍處於無明黑暗中，就存在二元性；當他們的生命因實踐行動、知識與虔誠靈修而散發出神聖知識的光輝時，他們便進入不二論的境界。
IT_TEXT: Il kiirtana è una parte integrante del bhakti mārga. Durante il kiirtana i devoti Lo implorano: «Vieni, o Signore, vieni a me. Vieni e siedi in mezzo a noi, tuoi devoti. Ti ameremo e canteremo il kiirtana per Te; Ti adoreremo con tutto il calore dei nostri cuori». Questo è l’aspetto filosofico della devozione. Ma il punto fondamentale è che il devoto deve fondersi nel Signore. Inizialmente si tratta di dvaita, perché all’inizio vi sono due entità, il devoto e il Signore; ma, in ultima analisi, quando diventano uno, si tratta di advaita. Per questo viene chiamato dvaitādvaitavāda. Finché i devoti rimangono nell’oscurità dell’ignoranza vi è dualità; ma quando la loro esistenza viene illuminata dallo splendore della conoscenza divina, grazie al karma sadhana, al jñāna sadhana e al bhakti sadhana, si trovano nello stato del non-dualismo.

EN_TEXT: You should know that the nature of the world is such that nowhere in it is there any permanence or freedom from struggle. There is always unrest and conflict. If anyone thinks that there should be peaceful coexistence, and that that is the greatest human treasure, they will be making a mistake. It is not the greatest human treasure, because it goes against jaeva dharma [the nature of living beings]... Vidyá and Avidyá do not exist side by side. They fight. Fortune and misfortune do not exist together either. Even the different aspects of auspicious power are in conflict with one another.
ZH_TEXT: 你們應知世界的本質就是戰鬥，永不止息的奮戰，它永遠都處在動盪不安和衝突中。如果有人認為應該可以和平共存，這種方式才是人類最珍貴的寶藏，那他們就錯了。那不會是人類最珍貴的寶藏，因為和平共存違反生靈法性(jaeva dharma)。…… 向心力和無明離心力絕不可能共存。它們必定交戰。幸運和不幸也不可能共存，即使都是好的力量，在不同層面間，它們一樣互相爭戰。
IT_TEXT: Dovete sapere che la natura del mondo è tale che in nessun luogo vi è permanenza o assenza di lotta. C’è sempre inquietudine e conflitto. Se qualcuno pensa che debba esistere una pacifica coesistenza e che questa sia il più grande tesoro umano, commette un errore. Non è il più grande tesoro umano, perché va contro il jaeva dharma [la natura degli esseri viventi] … Vidyā e Avidyā non esistono fianco a fianco. Esse combattono. Anche fortuna e sfortuna non coesistono. Persino i diversi aspetti del potere benefico sono in conflitto tra loro.

EN_TEXT: No one should ever think, “I am a sinner, I have sinned”, but rather, “Whatever I may be, I certainly belong to Parama Puruśa. Whatever wealth I possess – in body, mind and soul – has been given by Parama Puruśa. I will make the best use of this to serve Him, to make Him happy. I have not come to this world for self-gratification, but for one purpose: to make the best use of the wealth that Parama Puruśa has bestowed on me by serving the progeny of Parama Puruśa in this expressed world. If I serve His creation, He will certainly be pleased with me.” Those who serve humanity, serve Parama Puruśa at the same time. To please Parama Puruśa one will have to serve humanity, serve His children. And while doing this one should be free of any kind of inferiority complex or sin. Whatever you may be, you belong to Parama Puruśa. Thus, do virtuous deeds from this very moment. This will surely bring about your well-being.
ZH_TEXT: 無論何時皆不應有人認為自己是罪人，而應想著自己不論是一個怎麼樣的人，都是屬於至上意識的。凡我身、心、靈所擁有的財富，都是至上意識所賜，我當以最佳的運用來服務祂，使祂快樂。我不是為了自己的快樂而來此塵世，來此只有一個目的：就是要把至上意識給與我的財富做最好的利用，來服務至上意識在此大千世界的子女。如果我服務祂所創造的萬有，祂一定會為我而高興。 那些服務人群之人，同時也服務了至上意識，要取悅至上意識，我們必須服務人群、服務祂的孩子。從事此種服務，一定會解除各種自卑情結或罪業。不論你是一個怎麼樣的人，你都是屬於至上意識。因此，就從這一刻起，開始默默行善，這一定會為你們帶來福祉。

EN_TEXT: Under no circumstance can there be any Dharmic difference. Rather Dharmic people love all because to them everyone is the progeny of Parama Puruśa and this cosmos is His creation. That is why it is verily the duty of every Dharmic person to establish a relationship of love and affection with each being created by Him and to express that love by serving society. You shall always remember that you have come into this world for the practice of Dharma and to generate friendship, love and affection in the human society. Those who stick to the path of Dharma shall be victorious for eternity.
ZH_TEXT: 在任何情況下，法性不可能有所不同，遵循法性者愛所有的人，因為對他們而言每一個人都是至上意識的子孫，宇宙萬有都是祂創造出來的，這就是為什麼每一個遵循法性的人，他們真正的責任就是以慈愛之心對待祂所有的創造物，並藉著從事社會服務來傳播愛。 你必須永遠記住你來到世間的目的是要從事法性的鍛鍊和在人類社會傳播友誼、愛。那些堅守法性道路的人將會得到永遠的勝利。
IT_TEXT: In nessuna circostanza può esistere alcuna differenza dharmica. Al contrario, le persone dharmiche amano tutti, perché per loro ognuno è progenie di Parama Puruśa e questo cosmo è la Sua creazione. Per questo è davvero dovere di ogni persona dharmica stabilire un rapporto di amore e di affetto con ogni essere creato da Lui ed esprimere tale amore servendo la società. Dovete sempre ricordare che siete venuti in questo mondo per la pratica del Dharma e per generare amicizia, amore e affetto nella società umana. Coloro che rimangono saldi sul sentiero del Dharma saranno vittoriosi per l’eternità.

EN_TEXT: Some people say that there is a difference of opinion amongst the various Dharma (religions). In reality, however, there cannot be any difference of opinion in Dharma, for Dharma is one for the entire human race. That Dharma is the endeavour to attain Parama Puruśa... The external desire of the human mind depends upon the theory of expansion (vistára). That alone is Dharma. That is why Dharma is for each and every human being; indeed, it is for the whole universe. The one Dharma for this earth and the entire cosmos as well, is to love Parama Puruśa and to rush towards Him because of that love. Dharma was one in the past, today it is also one, and even in the future it shall remain one.
ZH_TEXT: 有人說在各種不同的法性（宗教）裡，各有不同的觀點。然而事實上對法性而言不可能有不同的觀點和看法，因為全人類的法性只有一個而且是唯一的：人類的法性就是努力與至上意識合一。…… 人類心靈永恆的渴望，即是依於擴展的道理而來。唯有如此方是法性，所以法性是給與所有的人；事實上，法性是給全宇宙的，給與這個地球和全宇宙的法性是相同的，就是愛至上意識；並且因為這個愛，萬物都快速的朝祂前進。在過去法性是唯一的，現在也是如此，未來亦將如此，法性永遠是唯一的。
IT_TEXT: Alcuni affermano che vi siano differenze di opinione tra i vari Dharma (religioni). Ma in realtà nel Dharma non può esserci alcuna differenza di opinione, perché il Dharma è uno per l’intera razza umana. Questo Dharma è lo sforzo di raggiungere Parama Puruśa. La naturale tendenza espansiva della mente umana si fonda sulla teoria dell’espansione (vistára). Questo è Dharma. Per questo il Dharma appartiene a ogni essere umano; anzi, all’intero universo. L’unico Dharma per questa terra e per l’intero cosmo è amare Parama Puruśa e slanciarsi verso di Lui per effetto di quell’amore. Il Dharma era uno nel passato, oggi è uno e anche in futuro rimarrà uno.

ZH_TEXT: 除非民眾得到啟蒙，否則任何完善的規劃都無從談起，管理不善的亂象亦將延續。我並非要求你們必須普及政治教化──這對你們而言或許辦得到，也或許辦不到──但至少，你們應該點燃他們對政治的覺醒意識。

EN_TEXT: People are desperate to develop themselves, so if they are not guided onto the path of welfare by the sáhityikas, they will follow the path of evil. They have no time to count the waves as they sit on the shore of the sea of time. They do not and they will not sit quietly, suppressing their desires and propensities in the hope that some day someone will come and direct them onto the path of benevolence.
ZH_TEXT: 世人渴望自我提升，若文學創作者(Sáhityikas)未能導引福祉之路，他們就會墮入邪惡之途。他們坐在時間之海的岸邊，無暇細數波濤浪花；他們不會、也不願壓抑自己的渴望與潛能靜默地坐著，只寄望有朝一日有人指引他們走上仁善之路。
IT_TEXT: Gli esseri umani hanno un bisogno profondo di crescere, esprimersi e sviluppare le proprie capacità. Questa spinta non può essere bloccata o sospesa. Se la cultura – attraverso arte e letteratura – non offre orizzonti costruttivi, quella stessa energia può trovare sbocchi distruttivi. Le persone non restano ferme ad aspettare. Non possono reprimere indefinitamente desideri, passioni e impulsi sperando che, prima o poi, qualcuno indichi loro una direzione positiva. L’energia della vita cerca sempre una via di espressione.

EN_TEXT: As the sense of subtle aesthetics developed in human beings in the course of evolution, a desire to create art also awakened in them. The artistʼs ideal is to be established in transcendentality beyond the bounds of the sensory world. So artists, or more precisely, worshippers of fine art, have to be spiritual aspirants if they want to move in the right direction. The cultivation of fine arts by those who have not developed spiritual sentiment or accepted the spiritual ideal as the goal of life is merely a mockery. Only those who look upon all worldly things from a spiritual perspective can realize in everything the blissful Transcendental Entity.
ZH_TEXT: 隨著人類的進化，精細的美學亦在人類中發展，對藝術創作的渴望也在人的心中覺醒。立足於超越感官世界的超覺之境乃藝術家之理想，故這些藝術工作者，或更精確地說，這些精細藝術的信仰者，如果他們想要在正確的道路上前進，則本身必須是一個靈性的渴望者。一個沒有發展靈性情感或以靈性理念為生命目標的人，就算有藝術的修養，也不過是藝術道上的冒牌貨。唯有以靈性精神看待萬事萬物者，方能在一切事物中了悟到此一充滿喜悅的超覺本體。
IT_TEXT: Con il progressivo sviluppo, nel corso dell’evoluzione, del senso estetico sottile nell’essere umano, si è risvegliato in lui anche il desiderio di creare arte. L’ideale dell’artista è stabilirsi nella trascendentalità, oltre i limiti del mondo sensoriale. Perciò gli artisti, o più precisamente i cultori delle arti raffinate, devono essere aspiranti spirituali se vogliono procedere nella giusta direzione. La pratica delle arti da parte di chi non ha sviluppato un sentimento spirituale o non ha assunto l’ideale spirituale come scopo della vita è soltanto una caricatura. Solo coloro che osservano tutte le cose del mondo da una prospettiva spirituale possono riconoscere, in ogni cosa, la beata Entità Trascendentale.

EN_TEXT: The actual significance of the word sáhitya [loosely, “literature”] is inherent in the word itself. Sáhitya is defined as “that whose characteristic is to move with (sahita = ‘with’) the trends of life”. Sáhitya, literature, is not the invention of the superficial side of social life, nor is it the colourful spell of fantasy. Rather it is the portrait of real life, an external expression of the internal workings of the mind, a bold and powerful expression of the suppressed sighs of the human heart. In order to preserve the sanctity and prestige of its name, literature must maintain a rhythm that reflects the dynamic currents of society.
ZH_TEXT: 文學的梵文是「sáhitya」，其真正意義就蘊涵在這個字上，因為「sáhitya」這個字的特色是「一起行進」──和生命的潮流並肩而行。文學既不是社會生活的膚淺發明，也不是任何綺麗炫人的幻想；相反地，它是真實生活的寫照，是心靈內在深處的外在表現，是人類心中被壓抑之嘆息大膽而強烈的表現。為了保持其名字的聖潔與威信，文學一定要保持其律動與社會的動態趨勢同一步調。
