EN_TEXT: Human beings are not merely destined to fill their bellies. There is much more to human life than that. Human beings are veritable children of God having a thirst for unlimited happiness. Limited physical wealth can never quench their infinite thirst. Obviously, their Práńa Dharma should provide them with the necessary ways and means to satisfy their unlimited hunger. Communism ignores the higher human and spiritual values of life. It lets the human soul stand unrecognized. The condition of human beings in todayʼs communist countries is no better than that of domestic cattle in dairy farms.
ZH_TEXT: 人類的使命絕非僅止於填飽肚子，人生的意義遠大於此。人類無疑為上主之子，渴望著無限的喜悅；有限的物質財富永遠無法熄滅無盡的渴求。他們的原力法性(Práńa Dharma)顯然應為他們提供必要的途徑與手段，以滿足無盡的渴求。共產主義忽略了生命中更高層次的人文與靈性價值，任意摧殘人性至模糊難辨，當今共產國家的人民處境並沒有好過乳牛畜牧場裡的牲畜。
IT_TEXT: Gli esseri umani non sono destinati semplicemente a riempire il proprio ventre. La vita umana è molto più di questo. Gli esseri umani sono veri figli di Dio, portatori di una sete di felicità illimitata. Una ricchezza fisica limitata non potrà mai placare la loro sete infinita. È evidente, dunque, che il loro Prāṇa Dharma deve offrire i mezzi necessari per soddisfare questa fame senza confini. Il comunismo ignora i valori umani e spirituali più elevati della vita. Non riconosce l’anima umana. La condizione degli esseri umani nei paesi comunisti odierni non è migliore di quella del bestiame allevato nelle fattorie da latte.

EN_TEXT: Who is the liberator? The muktidátá should not be within the bondages of Prakrti, but He should maintain a close link with the expressed universe. That consciousness which maintains a close link with the expressed world is the muktidátá – who knows all the pains, all the sorrows, all the happiness, all the glories of he expressed universe. He should be one with the universe, otherwise He will not be in a position to realize the sorrows and pains of the suffering humanity.
ZH_TEXT: 誰才是解脫者呢？解脫者不應該受造化勢能的束縛，但祂又應該與此化現世界維持緊密的聯繫。與此化現世界維持緊密聯繫的至上意識就是解脫者──祂了知這顯現世界中所有的痛苦、悲傷、快樂和榮耀。祂與此世界應該是一體的，否則祂如何明白苦難人類的悲傷和痛苦。

EN_TEXT: Human society is one and indivisible. A human being cannot live alone. If a person wants to drink water from a well, he or she needs a rope and a bucket, and to tie the rope one needs a hook. For all these things, the help of the others is indispensable... So, it is always better for people to work together as far as possible – the more that human beings work together, the better it is. If this principle is not followed the spirit of society will be broken, adversely affecting the very existence of human beings. People have to eat food individually – another person cannot eat your food for you – however a meal can be shared collectively. Where individuality dominates human life, the environment, the welfare of different groups and even the continued existence of humanity may be adversely affected.
ZH_TEXT: 人類社會是一體而不可分割的，人是無法離群索居的。如果有人要從井中汲水來喝，他就要有一條繩子、一個水桶，以及能綁上繩子的鉤子。要獲得這些東西，他人的幫助是不可或缺的。…… 所以，人們要是愈能在一起工作便愈好。如果不遵守這個原則，那麼社會的精神便會瓦解，對於人類的生存本身會產生惡劣的影響。吃飯時只能自己吃自己的，別人不能代勞，但是一頓飯，卻可以由大家一起共享。只要是讓個體性主宰人類的生活，則環境、不同團體的福利、甚至是人類持續生存與否，都會受到惡劣的影響。
IT_TEXT: La società umana è una e indivisibile. Un essere umano non può vivere da solo. Se una persona vuole bere acqua da un pozzo, ha bisogno di una corda e di un secchio, e per legare la corda occorre un gancio. Per tutte queste cose, l’aiuto degli altri è indispensabile… Dunque, è sempre meglio che le persone lavorino insieme per quanto possibile: quanto più gli esseri umani collaborano, tanto meglio è. Se questo principio non viene seguito, lo spirito della società si spezza, con conseguenze negative per l’esistenza stessa dell’umanità. Le persone devono mangiare individualmente – un altro non può mangiare il tuo cibo al posto tuo – tuttavia un pasto può essere condiviso collettivamente. Quando l’individualità domina la vita umana, l’ambiente, il benessere dei diversi gruppi e persino la sopravvivenza dell’umanità possono esserne danneggiati.

EN_TEXT: While rendering service to the entire society, you will have to move ahead because on the one hand you will be blessed by society, and on the other you will take inspiration from it enabling you to march ahead with much more speed. You must always bear in mind that this created world is created by Parama Puruśa. Thus it is very very dear to Him. When you render service to created beings it is as good as serving Him.
ZH_TEXT: 當你為這社會整體服務的同時，你也要記得必須向祂前進。一方面你因服務社會而受到社會對你的祝福回饋；另一方面，你從服務社會當中獲得激勵的力量，讓你能更加速向祂前進。你當永遠牢記於心：這世界是至上意識的創造，所以對祂而言，這世界是非常親愛的，當你對造化之萬有服務時，也等同於對祂從事服務。
IT_TEXT: Nel rendere servizio all’intera società, dovrete avanzare, perché da un lato sarete benedetti dalla società, e dall’altro ne trarrete ispirazione, che vi permetterà di procedere con ancora maggiore velocità. Dovete sempre tenere a mente che questo mondo creato è stato creato da Parama Puruśa. Perciò è a Lui carissimo. Quando rendete servizio agli esseri creati, è come servire Lui.

EN_TEXT: What is the source of permanent happiness? Only that object which is itself unlimited can provide unlimited and permanent happiness to human beings. How can a finite object give infinite happiness? Today it exists; tomorrow it disappears. “Yah ágacchati sah gacchati” – Whatever comes, goes. Every finite object comes and ultimately goes. When you come in contact with an infinite entity you will continue to enjoy eternal happiness even though you are a finite entity.
ZH_TEXT: 什麼是永恆喜悅的根源？唯有本身是無限者，才能夠給我們永恆無限的快樂，才是永恆喜悅的根源。一個有限的東西如何能夠給我們無限的快樂呢？今天它存在，明天就消失，「Yah ágacchati ti sah gacchati」──有來必有去，每個有限事物的出現，最後一定會消失，縱然你如此有限，但當你與無限的本體接觸時，你就會持續享受永恆的喜悅。

EN_TEXT: All molecules, atoms, electrons, protons, positrons and neutrons are the veritable expressions of the same Supreme Consciousness. Those who remember this reality, who keep this realization ever alive in their hearts, are said to have attained perfection in life. They are the real bhaktas [devotees]. When this devotional cult does not remain confined to a mere practice, but instead is elevated to a devotional sentiment, a devotional mission, to the realm of devotional ideation – when the underlying spirit of humanism is extended to everything, animate and inanimate, in this universe – I have designated this as “Neohumanism”. This Neohumanism will elevate humanism to universalism, the cult of love for all created beings of this universe.
ZH_TEXT: 所有的分子、原子、電子、質子、陽電子及中子等，全部都是相同至上意識的具體顯現。永遠銘記在心並且實現這個真理的人，可說已臻於生命的完美境界，他們是真正的虔誠者。此時虔誠不再只是一種鍛鍊(devotional cult)，而昇華成為一種虔誠的情感、一種虔誠的使命感，進而達到一種虔誠的理念境界。當人道主義的基本精神擴展到宇宙間一切有生命、無生命的萬有時，我稱它為「新人道主義」。這種新人道主義將提升人道主義成為宇宙主義，此乃對宇宙萬有的大我之愛。
IT_TEXT: Tutte le molecole, gli atomi, gli elettroni, i protoni, i positroni e i neutroni sono autentiche espressioni della medesima Coscienza Suprema. Coloro che ricordano questa realtà, che mantengono viva questa consapevolezza nel loro cuore in ogni momento, si dice che abbiano raggiunto la perfezione nella vita. Essi sono i veri bhakta [devoti]. Quando questo culto devozionale non resta confinato a una semplice pratica, ma si eleva a sentimento devozionale, a missione devozionale, fino a diventare ideazione devozionale – quando l’impulso profondo dell’umanesimo si espande fino ad abbracciare tutto ciò che esiste, animato e inanimato, in questo universo – io ho definito tutto questo “Neoumanesimo”. Questo Neoumanesimo eleverà l’umanesimo all’universalismo, al culto dell’amore per tutti gli esseri creati di questo universo.

EN_TEXT: Now, what is the role of devotional sentiment, the most valuable treasure of humanity? It is to transform the sense of worldly existence into the supreme spiritual stance. If a materialistic philosophy contains any narrowness, like the geo-sentiment we discussed, an imbalance is bound to occur between the inner and outer worlds, and psycho-physical imbalance will be inevitable. That is why, in spite of possessing everything, people will remain poor and deprived. In the past this geo-sentiment has caused enormous harm to many individuals and groups of people. Intelligent people must keep themselves aloof from this geo-sentiment and support nothing that is based on it, because it pollutes the devotional sentiment; it degrades human beings and undermines human excellence.
ZH_TEXT: 人類最珍貴的寶藏──虔誠情感，它究竟扮演著何種角色呢？它就是能將世俗存在感轉化為最高的靈性境界。唯物主義的哲學若包含任何狹隘的觀念（如前述的地域性的情感），則必定造成內、外在世界之間的失衡，並且不可避免的造成人身、心的失衡。這就是人雖擁有了世俗的一切，而其內在仍然感覺貧乏空虛的原因。這種地域性的情感往昔曾對許多個人及社會造成了無數的傷害，明智之士必須遠離這種地域性的情感，並反對任何以它為基礎的事物，因為它污染了虔誠心，致使人類墮落並逐漸損害到人類的卓越性。
IT_TEXT: Qual è il ruolo del sentimento devozionale, il tesoro più prezioso dell’umanità? È quello di trasformare il modo in cui viviamo la vita quotidiana, elevandolo a una consapevolezza spirituale superiore. Se una filosofia materialistica contiene qualche forma di ristrettezza, come il geo-sentimento di cui abbiamo parlato, è inevitabile che si produca uno squilibrio tra il mondo interiore e quello esteriore, e uno squilibrio psico-fisico sarà altrettanto inevitabile. Per questo motivo, pur possedendo tutto, le persone rimarranno povere e prive interiormente. In passato questo geo-sentimento ha causato danni enormi a molti individui e gruppi di persone. Le persone intelligenti devono mantenersi lontane da questo geo-sentimento e non sostenere nulla che si fondi su di esso, perché inquina il sentimento devozionale; degrada l’essere umano e ne mina l’eccellenza.

EN_TEXT: This concern for the vital rhythm throbbing in other human creatures has driven people to the fold of humanism, has made them humanists. Now, if the same human sentiment is extended to include all creatures of this universe, then and only then can human existence be said to have attained its final consummation. And in the process of expanding oneʼs inner love to other creatures, there should be another sentiment behind this human sentiment, which will vibrate human sentiment in all directions, which will touch the innermost recesses of the hearts of all creatures, and lead one and all to the final stage of supreme blessedness.
ZH_TEXT: 體認及關心他人體內也有生命的悸動，已將人類帶入人道主義的範疇而成為人道主義者。假使相同的這種人類情感能再擴展到涵蓋宇宙中所有的生靈，唯有那時人類的生命才算達到終極的完美境地；並且在擴展個人內在的愛心到其他生靈的過程中，應該還有另外一種情感隱藏在人類情感之後。這種更高的情感會將人類情感向四面八方激盪散發，它會觸及一切生靈內心的最深處，並且也會引導個體及整體朝向至上喜悅的終極之境邁進。
IT_TEXT: Questa sensibilità verso il ritmo vitale che pulsa negli altri esseri umani ha condotto le persone nell’ambito dell’umanesimo, le ha rese umaniste. Ora, se questo stesso sentimento umano viene esteso fino a includere tutte le creature di questo universo, allora e solo allora si può dire che l’esistenza umana abbia raggiunto il suo compimento finale. E, nel processo di espansione del proprio amore interiore verso le altre creature, dovrebbe esserci un altro sentimento dietro questo sentimento umano, un sentimento che lo faccia vibrare in tutte le direzioni, che tocchi gli strati più profondi del cuore di tutte le creature e conduca tutti, senza eccezione, allo stadio finale della suprema beatitudine.

EN_TEXT: The recognized book on Ananda Marga Philosophy is Ánanda Sútram. Usually a philosophical treatise has four main sections – (1) ontology, (2) metaphysics, (3) ethics, (4) epistemology. But in Ananda Marga philosophy two more sections, in addition to the above-mentioned four, have been added. They are (1) psychology and (2) spiritual cult. In Western philosophy there is no mention of spiritual cult, because Western philosophers had no opportunity to learn such a cult. The main reason is that in the theology prevalent in the west there is no concrete spiritual cult.
ZH_TEXT: 阿南達瑪迦的哲學論述以《阿南達經》(Ánanda Sútram)為主。通常一部哲學論述包含四個部分：本體論(ontology)、形而上學(metaphysics)、道德學(ethics)和認識論(epistemology)。但在阿南達瑪迦的哲學中除上述四種之外，另外還有兩個部分，即心理學和靈性修持法門。西方的哲學並未提及靈性修持法門，因為西方哲學家並無機緣學習到此種鍛鍊方法，主要乃由於流行於西方的神學裡並無具體的靈修鍛鍊方法。
IT_TEXT: Il testo di riferimento riconosciuto della filosofia dell’Ananda Marga è l’Ánanda Sūtram. Di norma, un trattato filosofico presenta quattro sezioni principali: (1) ontologia, (2) metafisica, (3) etica, (4) epistemologia. Nella filosofia dell’Ananda Marga, però, a queste quattro sezioni se ne aggiungono altre due: (5) la psicologia e (6) il culto spirituale. Nella filosofia occidentale non vi è menzione di un culto spirituale, perché i filosofi occidentali non hanno avuto l’opportunità di conoscerne uno. La ragione principale è che, nella teologia prevalente in Occidente, non esiste un culto spirituale concreto.

EN_TEXT: The inner import of society is collective movement. The primary stage of this movement is morality. The idealistic element of mind which inspires the human beings towards the cosmic goal is moralism. Social life has to start its journey from this moralism. The journey will end at the point where universal humanism encompasses every human being in the universe. The only resource needed on the journey is sádhaná. Hence it is said, morality is the base of life, sádhaná is the means and divine life is the goal.
ZH_TEXT: 社會的內在含義為集體的行動，此行動首要的階段在於道德：鼓舞人類心靈朝向宇宙目標前進的理想主義，其要素就是道德。社會生活的旅程必須始於道德，而終於世上每人都涵蓋在宇宙的人道主義中，此旅程所需的唯一資源就是靈性修持。所以說道德是生命的基礎，靈性修持是方法，而神聖的生命是目標。

EN_TEXT: A state of mental equilibrium and equipoise is called peace. It is important to know how the state of peace is attained, and how it is disturbed. A systematic, spiritual practice leads to psychic balance, whereas dogmatic faith in superstitions disturbs mental peace. Spiritual discipline and relentless struggle against superstition are required to maintain psychic peace.

One attains this strength in exchange for oneʼs devotion, not in exchange for oneʼs knowledge.
ZH_TEXT: 首要之務是必須先運用自己已經擁有的力量，當你認為自己已經完全耗盡至上意識所給予的力量時，才可以向祂請求：「哦！至上意識！你給我的力量並不足以完成我所要做的工作。如果你期望我完成工作，請給我更多的力量吧！」謹記，如果你沒有完全運用本身所具有的力量，你就沒有權利要求至上意識給予額外的力量。我們以虔誠換取力量，而非以知識來換取。

Quando ti accorgi che questa forza è ormai quasi esaurita, puoi rivolgerti a Parama Purusa: «O Signore, la forza che mi hai dato non è sufficiente per portare a termine il compito che mi è stato assegnato. Ricorda: non hai il diritto di chiedere più forza se non stai utilizzando completamente quella che già possiedi dentro di te. EN_TEXT: What does kiirtana mean? To sing in a loud voice the qualities of the Lord – not mentally...when you do kiirtana loudly your mind remains engaged. It cannot do anything else. At that time it is not possible to abuse someone or to have a worldly conversation. The mind is busy vocalizing, rather I will say that it is given over to the vocalization. The vocal cords are busy in that, the mind is employed in that thought, and the ears are hearing it, they donʼt have any chance to go here and there. For this reason the rule of vocalizing kiirtana loudly makes it both heard and sung.
ZH_TEXT: Kiirtana的意思為何？就是大聲唱頌上主的特質，而非輕聲在心裡默念。……當你大聲唱頌時，你的心靈沉浸其中，無法從事其他的事情，彼時你不可能責罵別人或談論世俗之事。心靈忙於唱頌，我們甚至可說是全心貫注於唱頌，聲帶用於此，心靈沉浸於此，耳朵亦如是聆聽，它們沒有機會往各處而去。因為這個原因，大聲唱頌上主的聖名讓心靈同時在唱和聆聽。
IT_TEXT: Che cosa significa kiirtana? Cantare ad alta voce le qualità del Signore – non mentalmente… Quando si pratica il kiirtana ad alta voce, la mente rimane impegnata. Non può fare altro. In quel momento non è possibile insultare qualcuno o intrattenere una conversazione mondana. La mente è occupata nel canto; anzi, direi che è completamente assorbita nel cantare. Le corde vocali sono impegnate in questo, la mente è concentrata su quel pensiero e le orecchie lo ascoltano: non hanno alcuna possibilità di vagare altrove. Per questo motivo, il kiirtana va cantato ad alta voce, così da essere nello stesso tempo cantato e ascoltato.

EN_TEXT: Kiirtana has Raso vae sah. He is full of rasa, that is. sweetness, full of bliss. People derive bliss from it. They get bliss from kiirtana. So if Náráyańa were to reside in a yogiʼs heart then no one would enjoy bliss; only that yogi would enjoy bliss. So what does Náráyańa say? Madbhaktá yatra gáyanti tatra tiśt́hámi Nárada. He says: “O Narada, I reside where my devotees do my kiirtana.” In other words, “I go where my devotees are doing kiirtana, where they are creating the Hariparimańd́ala.” This is why people get bliss from kiirtana.
ZH_TEXT: 上主聖名的唱頌(kiirtana)有無限的波流(raso vae sah)。祂滿溢著波流(rasa)，也就是充滿了甜美的喜悅。人們從中獲得喜悅，他們從唱頌上主的聖名中得到無限的喜悅。所以，若上主那拉衍那安住在瑜伽行者的心中，那麼就沒有任何人會享受到此種喜悅，只有那個瑜伽行者他自己會享受到喜悅。因此祂說道：「Madbhaktáh yatra gáyante tatra tiśt́hámi Nárada」──哦，那拉達！我安住在我的虔誠者唱頌我的名字之處，在他們所創造的「哈里帕里曼陀羅」之處！這就是為什麼人們唱頌上主聖名時能夠得到喜悅的原因。

EN_TEXT: Now in each and every person there is an “I” feeling, the small “I” of an individual. Similarly there is a great “I” also in every person and that great “I” is Parama Puruśa. He is not an object of a distant heaven for human beings. People are always preoccupied with their small “Iʼs” and thus there is no limit to their afflictions. But if they concern themselves with their great “I” they will have no problem whatsoever: they can overcome all afflictions.
ZH_TEXT: 每一個人都有存在我覺，亦即個體的小我。同樣的，每個人也有一個大我，此大我就是至上意識。對人類而言，祂不是遠在天邊的一個存在。人類總是為這小我而忙忙碌碌，所以他們的痛苦也就沒完沒了。但如果他們能將自身與這大我聯結，就不會有任何問題了，他們將可克服一切困難。

EN_TEXT: Human beings love Parama Puruśa and He loves human beings: this love is always mutual, not unilateral. So what should human beings offer to Him? He lacks nothing. When He is the creator of this entire universe, then He is the proprietor of all the wealth of the universe. So what can human beings offer Him? The only way to please Him is to serve the universe, to serve the entire living world, because everything is His creation.
ZH_TEXT: 人類愛至上意識，至上意識也愛他們，這種愛是相互的，不是單方面的。祂什麼也不缺，那麼人類應該獻給祂什麼？祂是宇宙的造物主，所以宇宙間一切的財富都是祂的，那麼人類可以給祂什麼呢？取悅祂的唯一方法就是為這宇宙服務，為此有情世界服務，因為萬有一切都是祂的創造。
IT_TEXT: Gli esseri umani amano Parama Puruśa ed Egli ama gli esseri umani: questo amore è sempre reciproco, non unilaterale. Che cosa dovrebbero dunque offrirgli gli esseri umani? Egli non manca di nulla. Essendo il creatore di questo intero universo, è il proprietario di tutta la ricchezza dell’universo. Che cosa possono quindi offrirgli gli esseri umani? L’unico modo per compiacerlo è servire l’universo, servire l’intero mondo vivente, perché tutto è Sua creazione.

EN_TEXT: In the scriptures the normal word for pátaka is dośa; so a pátakii is called a duśt́a, an atipátakii is called a dúrácárii, and a mahápátakii is a sudúrácárii. All these three types of people should be avoided; one should stay away from them. But Bhagaván Shrii Krśńa has said that even for such people there is no reason to worry: Api cet sudúrácáro bhajate Mámananyabhák; Sópi pápavinirmuktah mucyate bhavabandhanát. “If a sudúrácárii devotes himself or herself single-mindedly to My worship, forgetting everything else, and” – Mámananyabhák – “takes refuge in Me with unswerving attention,” “then he or she too is liberated from all sins and earthly bondages.” Hence no one has any reason to worry. Once anyone has taken refuge in Parama Puruśa, their future is secure.
ZH_TEXT: 經典中對「普通的罪行」稱為dośa，所以一個犯了普通可彌補之罪的人稱為duśt́a;而犯了難以彌補之罪的人稱為durácárii;犯了無可彌補、罪大惡極之人則稱為sudurácárii。這三種人吾人皆應避免之，應遠離之。但上主克里斯那在薄伽梵歌中曾說道即使是犯了這些罪過之人，也無需憂慮：Api cet sudúrácáro bhajate Mámananyabhák; Sópi pápavinirmuktah mucyate bhavabandhanát. 「即使是最邪惡的人，若能一心禮拜我，我也將使他從身、心、靈三層束縛中解脫出來。」 「如果一個罪大惡極之人誠心禮拜我，並且心無二念以我為庇護(Mámananyabhák)，那麼他也將從所有世俗的束縛和罪惡中得到解脫。」 因此，人無需擔心，一旦你以至上意識為庇護，那麼你的未來將是安全的。

EN_TEXT: There should be proper arrangements for the study of history. But that history must be real history, not the history of a particular class, king or minister. Unfortunately, the biased history is always written according to the dictates of the ruling class of different countries. The study of this biased history is detrimental to society. It should not occur. You people of today are more enlightened. Your intellectual capacity is no less than anyone elseʼs. That is why you should write a new history of the human race by your collective endeavour. The history that you will write in future must unequivocally reflect such important factors as how human society has evolved through trials and tribulations; what difficulties were confronted and how human beings overcame them and moved towards their goal with firm steps; and how even today they are advancing by solving numerous problems.
ZH_TEXT: 對於歷史的閱讀應有適當的安排。但是所閱讀的歷史必須是真正的歷史，不是某一特定階級、國王或宰相的歷史。 不幸的是，偏頗的歷史老是根據各個國家的統治階層的命令來記載；閱讀如此偏頗的歷史只會對社會有害，不應該讓這樣的事情發生。 今日的人們更為進步，智力也無可比擬；因此應該經由共同的努力寫出一部嶄新的人類歷史。未來所要寫下的歷史必須明白地反映出一些重要的因素，像人類社會如何經由各種試煉及考驗而進化、人類遭遇了何種困難及如何克服並以堅定的腳步邁向他們的目標，甚至今日他們仍然經由解決許多的問題而繼續前進。
IT_TEXT: Dovrebbero esistere adeguate disposizioni per lo studio della storia. Ma quella storia deve essere storia autentica, non la storia di una particolare classe, di re o di ministri. Purtroppo, la storia di parte viene quasi sempre scritta secondo le direttive della classe dominante nei diversi Paesi. Lo studio di una storia così faziosa è dannoso per la società. Non dovrebbe accadere. Voi, uomini e donne di oggi, siete più illuminati. La vostra capacità intellettuale non è inferiore a quella di nessun altro. Proprio per questo dovreste scrivere una nuova storia del genere umano attraverso il vostro sforzo collettivo. La storia che scriverete in futuro dovrà riflettere in modo inequivocabile fattori fondamentali, mostrando come la società umana si sia evoluta attraverso prove e tribolazioni, quali difficoltà abbia affrontato e in che modo gli esseri umani le abbiano superate avanzando verso la loro meta con passo saldo, e come, ancora oggi, stiano progredendo risolvendo innumerevoli problemi.

EN_TEXT: Regarding the path of devotion that devotion should not be taken as a mere cult or as a mere principle; it should be accepted as the highest mission in life. Devotion leads humanity towards the stage of subtlety, and finally ensconces a person in the state of supreme bliss. That is why in the scriptures devotion has also been called puśt́i márga, that is, a path by which all of human existence becomes spiritually strengthened: the mind becomes more stable, one realizes more and more spiritual bliss – in a word, the whole of human existence becomes blissful.
ZH_TEXT: 虔誠之道不應僅被視為只是一種鍛鍊的法門或原理，而應被當作生命中最高的使命。虔誠引導人類朝向精細的層次，最後安住於至上喜悅之境。這就是為什麼在經典中虔誠亦被稱為「強健之道」(puśt́i márga)的原因，因為它是一條能讓人類於靈性上更堅強，心靈更加穩定，了悟更多靈性喜悅的道路──總而言之，使人類的整體存在充滿了喜悅。

EN_TEXT: And if he finds that you have the potentialities to do His work, but you are lacking in self-surrender and you have not forgone your ego, then in such a case He will first create circumstances in which your ego will be forced to yield and surrender. After this only will the Lord choose you to be the medium for His work. You do know, similar was the case with Arjuna. Arjuna had the potentiality, but he also had some ego left in him. Shrii Krśńa first made him surrender by showing His virát́a rúpa [Cosmic form], and then alone was Arjuna chosen to be the medium.
ZH_TEXT: 如果祂發現你有能力完成祂所交付的工作，但你卻有強烈的自我感、沒有臣服之心時，祂就會先製造一些狀況讓你不得不臣服。當你的自我感消除後，祂才會選你作為從事祂的工作之媒介。你知道，像阿尊拿就是這樣的例子。阿尊拿有十足的潛能，但他仍帶有些微自我感。所以上主克里斯那先向他展現其宇宙的形象(virát́a rúpa)以使阿尊拿臣服，然後才選阿尊拿成為祂工作的媒介。

EN_TEXT: The present Cosmic Citta is limited, but the Cosmic [[citta particles are]] infinite and will continue throughout eternity. When we discover that the Cosmic [[citta is the innumerable expressions of the citta manifestations]] in their totality, then we are correct in calling It infinite. Remember that your personality will also advance through transmutation like all other entities. The total extinction of the Cosmic mind will never occur. You have no cause to fear any final dissolution of the universe.
ZH_TEXT: 目前存在大宇宙心靈質的顯現是有限的，但是宇宙的心靈質是無限且持續至永恆的。當我們發現大宇宙心靈實際上是無數心靈波質的整體呈現時，那麼說宇宙心靈波質是無限乃是正確的。 請記住，你的人格也將和所有其他個體一樣，歷經變化而向前邁進。大宇宙心靈絕不會整個的滅絕掉，所以你沒有理由懼怕宇宙的末日。
IT_TEXT: L’attuale universo, in quanto manifestazione del Citta Cosmico, è limitato; ma le particelle del Citta Cosmico sono infinite e il loro processo di espressione continuerà per l’eternità. Quando comprendiamo che il Citta Cosmico è l’insieme delle innumerevoli espressioni delle manifestazioni del citta nella loro totalità, allora è corretto chiamarlo infinito. Ricordate che anche la vostra personalità progredirà attraverso la trasmutazione, come tutte le altre entità. L’estinzione totale della Mente Cosmica non avverrà mai. Non avete alcun motivo di temere una dissoluzione finale dell’universo.

EN_TEXT: On one side there is the rubbish heap of the past and people are clinging to that rubbish heap because they have not yet been shown the way out. And on the other side, there is the call of the new. Under such conditions what will that Mahásambhúti do who gave guidance to the human race in the past? With courage he will call to human beings and declare: “Give up the rubbish of the past. It can only harm you and lead you to your death. Move ahead. Answer the call of the new. I am with you. There is no reason to be afraid.”
ZH_TEXT: 一堆過時的無用之事累積在一邊，而許多人卻緊抱著不放，因為他們不知道哪裡有出路，另一邊新的事物又不斷在呼喚他們。在此情況下，對於這個過去曾給予人類指引以肉身降臨的至上意識(Mahásambhúti)而言，祂該怎麼做呢？祂將以勇氣呼喚人類並宣示道：「將過去的垃圾丟棄吧！往前邁進，回應新事物的召喚吧！我和你們在一起，你們無需恐懼！」
IT_TEXT: Da un lato vi è il cumulo di rifiuti del passato e le persone vi si aggrappano, perché non è stato ancora mostrato loro il modo per uscirne. Dall’altro lato, vi è la chiamata del nuovo. In tali condizioni, che cosa farà quel Mahásambhúti che in passato ha guidato il genere umano? Con coraggio chiamerà gli esseri umani e dichiarerà: «Abbandonate i rifiuti del passato. Possono soltanto danneggiarvi e condurvi alla rovina. Andate avanti. Rispondete alla chiamata del nuovo. Io sono con voi. Non c’è alcun motivo di avere paura.»

EN_TEXT: One should be Ekbuddhi. Hanuman said: I am one-minded, not many-minded. Although there is no difference between Náráyańa and Ráma, I donʼt know anyone but Ráma. I donʼt know any Náráyańa. So you should always keep in mind that one should proceed ahead with one name, not many. Therein lies success, prosperity, everything.
ZH_TEXT: 吾人心智應該專一。哈奴曼說：我心境專一，而非多方導向。雖然「那拉衍那」和「羅摩」並無不同，但我只識「羅摩」，而不識任何「那拉衍那」。 所以，你們應牢記在心，一個人應認定上主的其中一個名字向前邁進，不要使用許多名字。所有的成功，一切盡在於斯。

CITATION_ZH: Shrii Shrii Ánandamúrti | 1979年3月2日傍晚於Siliguri | 05 唯一的本體，無盡的名稱 | 喜悅甘露集 卷5，P.41

EN_TEXT: Later on, with the further development of philosophy and science the number of impediments and obstacles faced by humans became fewer than those which the ancient humans faced while moving along the path of spirituality during the days of backward science and philosophy. The people of today do not have to labour quite as hard as Vaishishta and Vishvamitra had to do in order to discover the way to move ahead, because modern science and philosophy today are valuable aids to human progress. The people of today are able to realize the Supreme Entity in one life, or maybe in 15 to 20 years, for which they had to practice penance for lives together in the past. Apart from the direct help of philosophy and science, the spiritual quest also greatly helped human beings in their elevation. The humans of today have started to realize that they are the progeny of Parama Puruśa, an integral part of Parama Puruśa. If people can properly ideate on Parama Puruśa, they will realize Brahma. On imbibing cosmic ideation all kinds of ailments will be cured... It is a fact that humans will make further progress in the future. Those who will assist in this human progress are the Sadvipras. Those who are trying to obstruct human progress are veritable demons in human form (rákśasa). Not only will human beings have to strengthen the hands of the Sadvipras to facilitate smooth social progress, they will also have to remain ever-vigilant against these demons in human form and wage constant war against them. There should not be any hesitation.
ZH_TEXT: 隨哲學與科學持續進步發展，人類在靈性道路上所面臨的障礙與阻力，已比遠古時期少得多。當今人類不需如同古聖先哲Vaishishta與Vishvamitra歷經艱難探索昇華之道，因現今科學與哲學已成人類進化的寶貴助力。如今人們只需一生甚或十五、二十年即能證悟天人合一之境，過往卻需苦修數世。除獲科學與哲學直接協助，靈性探索也極力促進人類提升。當今人類已開始覺知自身是至上意識(Parama Puruśa)的子民，是祂不可分割的部分。人們若能正確觀想至上意識即能證悟宇宙真理，各類身心疾患均得療癒。…… 人類未來必然更為進化。協助人類昇華者即為「聖導哲人」(Sadvipras)，而試圖阻礙者不過是披著人皮的惡魔(rákśasa)。人類不僅須給予聖導哲人堅強後盾以促進社會穩健進展，且需時刻緊盯人形惡魔，毫無遲疑、永不懈怠的與其爭戰。
IT_TEXT: Successivamente, con l’ulteriore sviluppo della filosofia e della scienza, il numero degli impedimenti e degli ostacoli affrontati dagli esseri umani è diminuito rispetto a quelli che gli antichi dovevano superare lungo il cammino spirituale, in un’epoca in cui scienza e filosofia erano ancora arretrate. Le persone di oggi non devono faticare quanto dovettero fare Vaishishta e Vishvamitra per scoprire la via del progresso, perché la scienza e la filosofia moderne costituiscono preziosi strumenti di supporto all’avanzamento umano. Gli esseri umani contemporanei possono realizzare l’Entità Suprema in una sola vita, o forse in quindici o vent’anni, mentre in passato era necessario praticare austerità per molte vite consecutive. Oltre all’aiuto diretto della filosofia e della scienza, anche la ricerca spirituale ha contribuito in modo determinante all’elevazione dell’umanità. Gli uomini e le donne di oggi stanno iniziando a comprendere di essere progenie di Parama Puruśa, parte integrante di Parama Puruśa. Se le persone riescono a ideare correttamente su Parama Puruśa, realizzeranno Brahma. Assorbendo l’ideazione cosmica, ogni genere di afflizione sarà superato... È un fatto che l’umanità compirà ulteriori progressi in futuro. Coloro che assisteranno questo progresso umano sono i Sadvipra. Coloro che tentano di ostacolarlo sono veri e propri demoni in forma umana (rákśasa). Gli esseri umani non solo dovranno sostenere e rafforzare l’azione dei Sadvipra per favorire un progresso sociale armonioso, ma dovranno anche restare costantemente vigili contro questi demoni in forma umana e combatterli senza sosta. Non deve esserci alcuna esitazione.

EN_TEXT: As long as you crave for your own selfish happiness, the happiness of the Cosmic touch will continue to elude you. So take your small “I” with all its pettiness towards the Great – enlarge and broaden it. Be one with that Sublime Entity and then alone can you truly attain Him. When you attain that Cosmic Bliss, you will no longer desire any fragmentary pleasure of the world.
ZH_TEXT: 只要你仍渴求自我的快樂，至上碰觸的快樂就會遠離你。所以帶著你小小微不足道的「我」朝向至上前進，擴展它吧！和那崇高的至上實體合一，你才能真正得到祂。當你達到那個至上喜悅的境地時，你便不再渴求任何世俗間不完整的快樂。

EN_TEXT: Will human beings give up all their worldly occupations after the attainment of this Brahmic happiness? Why should they? Those whose lives are saturated with the sweet nectar of Cosmic Bliss. Will go on performing even more perfectly all their worldly duties as the cherished tasks assigned by Brahma Himself. They will not be concerned about their own happiness or pleasure in any work. For the collective happiness of all creatures in the universe they will continue to discharge all their responsibilities carefully and painstakingly, for the collectivity of the universe is the Life of their lives, the Soul of their souls – Brahma. They will employ their insignificant ego to further the happiness of the Great Ego.
ZH_TEXT: 人類在達到至上喜悅之境後，是否要放棄所有的世俗之物？何需如此！徜徉在至上喜悅甜蜜的人，更能完美的盡他們世俗該盡的責任，他們珍惜地把這些責任當成至上意識本身所交付的工作，不會在乎工作是否滿足他們自己的快樂，他們會為宇宙整體生命的快樂而小心、努力地履行他們的責任，因為宇宙的整體是他們生命的生命、靈魂的靈魂，是至上意識。他們更進一步奉獻他們微不足道的小我於大我的快樂上。
IT_TEXT: Gli esseri umani abbandoneranno forse tutte le loro occupazioni mondane dopo aver raggiunto questa beatitudine brahmica? Perché mai dovrebbero farlo? Coloro le cui vite sono impregnate del dolce nettare della Beatitudine Cosmica continueranno a svolgere ancor più perfettamente tutti i loro doveri mondani, considerandoli i compiti più cari affidati da Brahma stesso. Non saranno preoccupati della propria felicità o del proprio piacere in alcuna attività. Per la felicità collettiva di tutte le creature dell’universo continueranno ad adempiere a tutte le loro responsabilità con cura e scrupolosità, poiché la collettività dell’universo è la Vita della loro vita, l’Anima della loro anima: Brahma. Essi impiegheranno il loro insignificante ego per accrescere la felicità del Grande Ego.

EN_TEXT: Train yourselves in the ideal of the lily, which blossoms in the mud and has to keep itself engaged in the struggle for existence day in and day out, parrying, bracing and fighting the shocks of muddy water and the force of storms and squalls and various other vicissitudes of fortune; and yet it does not forget the moon above. It keeps its love for the moon constantly alive... Similarly, perhaps you are an ordinary creature – perhaps you have to pass your days in the ups and downs of worldly existence – yet do not forget that Supreme One. Keep all your desires inclined towards Him. Always keep yourself merged in His thought. Go deep into the mood of that Infinite Love. By this your worldly activities will not be hampered in any way.
ZH_TEXT: 像百合花般的訓練你自己，百合花生長在污泥裡，必須為了生存而奮戰，日日夜夜為掙脫污濁而努力，承受日曬雨淋、命運接踵而至的打擊，但它從未忘記生命中的月光，它在月光的愛中不斷的成長著。……同樣的，你也許只是一個再平凡不過的人，你也許也必須為了生存經歷你生命中的起起伏伏，但是，你仍舊應該深深地走入那無限的愛裡。不要忘了至上意識，將你所有的渴望都朝向祂，永遠讓自己融入於祂的思想裡，融入那無盡的愛裡。這樣你所從事的任何世俗活動才不會是束縛。

CITATION_ZH: Shrii Shrii Ánandamúrti | 1956年3月5日Phálgunii滿月日大法會 | 02 波動、形狀與顏色 | 靈性科學集成 卷3，P.83

EN_TEXT: You must completely surrender. To attain that Infinite One with the help of your mental concentration and strength, you have to surrender yourselves. But, remember self-surrender does not mean suicide. On the contrary, your soul will have its full expression. Your existence will not become contracted, for contraction is inert in principle. Hence in the Sádhaná of self-surrender the ego is expanded, not contracted... You will have to dedicate yourselves to His feet wholly and unreservedly. You will earn godliness in proportion to the extent that you surrender yourselves, and finally, after merging that acquired godliness of yours in His Entity, you will attain eternal bliss.
ZH_TEXT: 你必須完全臣服，靠著你心智集中的力量將自身臣服。臣服不是結束自己的生命，相反的，你的靈魂會得到圓滿的表達，你的存在不會被壓縮，因為壓縮是惰性力量的表現。因此，在自我臣服的靜坐修持裡，你的自我得以擴展，而不會被壓縮。……所以，你要全然、毫無保留地將自身獻於祂的蓮足前，你臣服多少就會得到多少神性，直至最後將你所得到的神性融入在祂的本體裡，你將獲得永恆的喜悅。

EN_TEXT: Human existence is trifarious. That is, it has three strata – physical, psychic and spiritual. None of these strata should be neglected. Although the psychic stratum is more important than the physical stratum, even so the physical stratum cannot be ignored. Likewise, the spiritual stratum is more important than the psychic stratum, but the psychic stratum must not be neglected on that account. Cultivation of the psychic stratum also is essential. The mentality of those who do not practise spirituality, but only look after their physical and psychic development, will become crude. Those who are concerned only about their physical development and spiritual elevation but do not work for their mental progress will gradually become psychically inert. The collective intellectual progress of the society will be checked forever. If people do not make an effort to develop physically, the society as a whole will suffer for the lack of strong, healthy men and women. Since that is not desirable at all, there should be equal emphasis to develop in every stratum of life, and there should be a perfect balance in the three strata.
ZH_TEXT: 人類的存在是三方面的，亦即它有三個層面──身體的、心理的與靈性的，這些層面一個也不能忽視。雖心理層面比身體層面更加重要，即使如此，身體層面也不能被忽視。同樣的，靈性層面比心理層面更加重要，但也不能因為這個原因而忽視心理層面，心理層面的培養亦屬重要。那些未從事靈性修持而只注重身、心發展的人們，其心理將變得粗鈍；而那些只關心身體發展與靈性提升，卻未為其心理進步而努力的人們，他們的心理也將逐漸失去活力，社會集體智力的進步將永遠受到抑制。人們如果不努力在身體層面求發展，則社會整體會因缺乏健康、強壯的男女而受苦。既然那不是我們所樂見的結果，那麼在生命的每一個層面都要給予同等的重視與發展，在這三個層面之間應保持完美的平衡。
IT_TEXT: L’esistenza umana è triplice: si articola in tre livelli – fisico, psichico e spirituale. Nessuno di questi dovrebbe essere trascurato. Sebbene il livello psichico sia più importante di quello fisico, ciò non significa che quello fisico possa essere trascurato. Allo stesso modo, il livello spirituale è superiore a quello psichico, ma neppure lo sviluppo mentale deve essere ignorato: anche la coltivazione della sfera psichica è essenziale. Quando la spiritualità viene trascurata e ci si limita a curare lo sviluppo fisico e psichico, la mentalità delle persone tende inevitabilmente a diventare grossolana. Coloro che si preoccupano soltanto dello sviluppo fisico e dell’elevazione spirituale, ma non lavorano per il progresso mentale, diventeranno psichicamente passivi. Il progresso intellettuale collettivo della società verrebbe così ostacolato per sempre. Se le persone non fanno uno sforzo per svilupparsi fisicamente, la società nel suo complesso soffrirà per la mancanza di uomini e donne forti e sani. Poiché questo non è affatto desiderabile, dovrebbe esserci uguale enfasi nello sviluppo di ogni livello della vita, e dovrebbe esserci un perfetto equilibrio tra i tre livelli.
CITATION_EN: Shrii Shrii Ánandamúrti | 5 March 1984, Jammu | 43 Táńd́ava and Kaośikii | The Awakening of Women
CITATION_ZH: Shrii Shrii Ánandamúrti | 1984年3月5日於Jammu | 3-1-5 勇士舞與高士基舞 | 女性的覺醒

EN_TEXT: Human beings not only want expansion, but undisputed authority in the process of expansion. Not only do they seek the Supreme shelter, they want to bring that shelter within their reach. Out of this desire to attain the Supreme, out of this longing to become as vast as the Supreme, they discovered the science of intuitional practice.
ZH_TEXT: 人類的生命不僅只是渴求擴展，同時也渴望在擴展的過程中成為生命的主人。他們不僅只是尋求至上的庇護，他們更要達到至上之境。在此種欲與至上合一的渴望中，想要成就如同至上廣大無垠的境界，他們發現了靈性直覺的修行。
CITATION_EN: Phálgunii Púrńimá 1958 DMC, Amrah, Birbhum | The Macrocosmic Stance and Human Life, Subháśita Saḿgraha Part 7
CITATION_ZH: 1958年3月6日Phálgunii滿月日於Amrah, Birbhum大法會 | 至上之境與人類的生命，靈性科學集成卷7，P.11

EN_TEXT: The struggle in collective life, with the sadvipras in the position of leadership, will continue endlessly. Sadvipra after sadvipra will come: the torch carried by one will be handed over to the next. But the sádhaná of individual life is not endless – it culminates in the attainment of Brahma.
ZH_TEXT: 在完美智士領導下集體生命的奮戰將永不停歇。完美智士會一位接著一位不斷的出現，他們手中的慧炬將傳遞下去。但個人生命的靈性修持並非永無止境──它止於與至上本體的合一。
CITATION_EN: Shrii Shrii Ánandamúrti | Phálgunii Púrńimá 1958 DMC, Amrah, Birbhum | 02 The Macrocosmic Stance and Human Life | Subháśita Saḿgraha Part 7

EN_TEXT: In Ananda Marga this divine flow of Brahma is embedded in different lessons of spiritual meditation. Thus, those who practice this meditation, whether in the present or the future, whether within time or beyond time, will certainly cry, sing and dance with exquisite spiritual joy, and advance steadily towards the blissful Macrocosmic stance.
ZH_TEXT: 在阿南達瑪迦（喜悅之路），此至上本體神性的波流是隱藏在靈性靜坐的各課程中。因此修持此靜坐課程之人，不論是現在或未來，亦不論是在時間範疇內或超越時間之外，一定會因精細的靈性喜悅而哭泣、歌唱和舞蹈，他們必將朝向喜悅的大宇宙境界穩健地邁進。
CITATION_EN: Shrii Shrii Ánandamúrti | Phálgunii Púrńimá 1958 DMC, Amrah, Birbhum | 02 The Macrocosmic Stance and Human Life | Subháśita Saḿgraha Part 7
CITATION_ZH: Shrii Shrii Ánandamúrti | 1958年3月6日Phálgunii滿月日於Amrah, Birbhum大法會 | 02 至上之境與人類的生命 | 靈性科學集成 卷7，P.28

EN_TEXT: If you throw a stone in the pond, the ripples that it causes vibrate other objects in the pond. Similarly, when the Cosmic flow is inspired by Puruśottama it vibrates in its entirety, thereby vibrating all the receptive minds in the universe. These emanated vibrations take different forms to provide momentum to human beings in different ways. This force of inspiration keeps all the receptive minds connected to Puruśottama, the Supreme Source of all emanations, and motivates them to rush towards Him. When the Macrocosmic stance dances in its individual Macrocosmic Flow, the microcosms dance in parárasa.
ZH_TEXT: 如果你向池塘丟一顆石頭，它所產生的漣漪將波及池中其他物體。同樣的，受到宇宙核心意識鼓舞激盪的大宇宙波流，其整體之波流亦將撼動宇宙中所有能感受的心靈，其所散發之波動以不同的方式取得各種形式來鼓勵人類。此種鼓舞的力量使得所有能感受的心靈與至上核心意識──所有一切展現的至上本源緊緊相繫，並促使他們快速地朝祂前進。當大宇宙之境舞動於其自身的大宇宙波流時，個體小宇宙即舞動於至上波流的境界。

EN_TEXT: If two sheep grazing in separate fields see each other, they will run to each other as they prefer to graze together... Human beings are also social beings. If they have to live alone for a long time they feel restless and search frantically for the company of others. So human beings should be very careful in selecting the leaders of society... Personality cults, whether good or bad, have existed since ancient times and will continue to exist in the future... Leaders should only be recognized after considering the extent to which they possess qualities like intelligence, wisdom, integrity, pioneering zeal, readiness to sacrifice, etc.
ZH_TEXT: 兩隻在不同田野間覓食的綿羊若是互見彼此，便會奔赴相聚，因為牠們更喜歡一起吃草。…… 人類一樣也是社會群性動物，一旦被迫長久獨居便感焦躁不安而迫切尋求同伴；故人類在選擇社會領袖時尤須格外謹慎。……  無論好壞，英雄崇拜自古有之，將來仍將存在。……推舉領袖應檢視其聰明才智與人格秉性、拓展開創精神以及奉獻熱忱等特質程度而定。
IT_TEXT: Se due pecore che pascolano in campi separati si scorgono, correranno l’una verso l’altra, perché preferiscono pascolare insieme... Anche gli esseri umani sono esseri sociali. Se devono vivere soli per molto tempo, si sentono inquieti e cercano freneticamente la compagnia degli altri. Per questo motivo gli esseri umani dovrebbero essere molto cauti nello scegliere i leader della società... I culti della personalità, buoni o cattivi che siano, esistono fin dall’antichità e continueranno a esistere anche in futuro. I leader dovrebbero essere riconosciuti soltanto dopo aver valutato fino a che punto possiedono qualità come intelligenza, saggezza, integrità, spirito pionieristico, disponibilità al sacrificio, ecc.
CITATION_EN: Shrii Shrii Ánandamúrti | 6 March 1988, Calcutta | 06 Leadership – Excerpt A | Prout in a Nutshell Volume 3 Part 15

EN_TEXT: What is that geo-sentiment which inflicts the first blow on the inner asset of humans? It is to let oneʼs sentiment flow towards a particular territory. One does not consider whether what one is doing is right or wrong, logical or illogical. In this situation, sentiment is substituted for logic; and in the next phase, superstition is substituted for logic. All those religious, economic, political or social theories which are based on geo-sentiment, yield to superstition from their very inception. The so-called religions which have mouthed high-sounding ideals but are essentially motivated by geo-sentiment, become converted into reservoirs of superstition, into oceans of blind faith. They submerge humanity in a quagmire of superstitions, and people struggle in that filth for ages. Their progress is checked forever.
ZH_TEXT: 地域情感對人類內在資產帶來的第一個傷害是什麼？就是它讓人類情感導向一個特定範圍，使得人不會考慮他所做之事是對或錯，合不合理。在此情況下，理性為情感所取代，在下一階段，理性又被迷信所取代。凡是植基於地域情感的宗教、經濟、政治或社會理論，從一開始便陷於迷信。所謂的宗教，雖然高談理想，但基本上它受地域情感所驅策，而成為迷信之淵藪、盲目信仰的海洋。它們將人類埋進迷信的沼澤裡，使得人類在這種污濁中掙扎了很長的時間，人們的進步一直受到阻礙。
IT_TEXT: Che cos’è quel geo-sentimento che infligge il primo colpo alla ricchezza interiore dell’essere umano? È il lasciar fluire il proprio sentimento verso un determinato territorio. Non ci si domanda se ciò che si sta facendo sia giusto o sbagliato, logico o illogico. In questa situazione il sentimento prende il posto della logica; e nella fase successiva la superstizione prende il posto della logica. Tutte quelle teorie religiose, economiche, politiche o sociali che si fondano sul geo-sentimento degenerano in superstizione fin dal loro stesso nascere. Le cosiddette religioni che proclamano ideali altisonanti, ma che in realtà sono motivate dal geo-sentimento, si trasformano in serbatoi di superstizione, in oceani di fede cieca. Esse sommergono l’umanità in una palude di superstizioni, e le persone lottano in quel fango per secoli. Il loro progresso rimane bloccato per sempre.

EN_TEXT: Human beings do not know what their real needs are, but Parama Puruśa knows the needs of each and every person. He needs nothing for Himself. He wants only to give to the world. He provides jiivas with everything according to their necessity. He provides these things either directly, or indirectly through other jiivas. He teaches human beings to move in a certain way so that their needs might be easily fulfilled. If they do not act according to His counsel their needs will not be fulfilled. If the people, however, sincerely follow the path laid down by Him, all their needs will be met and their bondages removed.
ZH_TEXT: 人類對自身真正的需求並不了解，然而至上意識(Parama Puruśa)洞悉人人所需。祂一無所求，對世間唯有給予。祂依眾生(jiivas)所需給予一切：或直接或間接經其他眾生傳遞。祂教導人類以正念行事，以便需求易於足受，反之則否。但凡人們虔誠追隨祂所指之道，一切需求均得滿足，所有束縛亦隨之消解。

EN_TEXT: The more human beings are established in Neohumanism, the more they will be absorbed in the colours of their inner minds instead of the colours of the external world. It is not that they will avoid the social festivities of the colour festival of Dolyátra, but the social side should not be taken as everything. Rather, by offering all their psychic colours to the Supreme Consciousness, they will become more concerned with their mental colours than with the external ones.
ZH_TEXT: 人類越是立足於新人道主義，越能專注於內在心靈的顏色，而非外在世界的顏色。並不是說要他們不要舉辦色彩節這個社會性慶典，只是不應把色彩節的社會性意義視為一切，而是說，藉由向至上意識奉獻他們心靈所有的顏色，他們會更關心自己心靈的顏色甚於外在的顏色。
CITATION_EN: Shrii Shrii Ánandamúti | 9 March 1982, Calcutta | Inner Asset | The Liberation of Intellect: Neohumanism
CITATION_ZH: Shrii Shrii Ánandamúti | 1982年3月9日於Calcutta | 內在資產，智力解脫之路：新人道主義，P.41

EN_TEXT: There are some people who are pessimistic. They say that the society around us is very bleak, that it has no expression of vitality and that it seems that everyone is in a deep slumber. Pessimists say this because they have never made any detailed study of human history, nor do they care to. Had they done so, they would certainly be optimistic, because if they had looked carefully at the symptoms of pause, they would have realized that significant preparations were being made for the subsequent phase of speed. So under no circumstances should human beings be pessimistic. That is why I am always an incorrigible optimist, because I know that optimism is life.
ZH_TEXT: 總有些人消極悲觀，說我們身處的社會冷峻蒼白、毫無生機，彷彿人人陷落沉睡酣眠 。悲觀者之所以如此，出於不曾深入研究人類歷史，甚且毫不在意 。倘若他們曾經細心探究，必然轉為樂觀：因為只要仔細觀察「停滯（沈潛）」期的種種徵兆，就會發現人們其實正為下一「加速（揚升）」階段做著極為關鍵的準備 。因此，在任何情況下，人類都不應悲觀 。這就是為什麼我始終是個無可救藥的樂觀主義者，因為我知道：樂觀就是生命。
IT_TEXT: Ci sono persone pessimiste. A loro giudizio, la società che ci circonda è molto cupa, priva di vitalità, e tutti sembrano immersi in un sonno profondo. I pessimisti parlano così perché non hanno mai compiuto uno studio approfondito della storia umana, né si curano di farlo. Se lo avessero fatto, certamente sarebbero ottimisti, perché, osservando attentamente i segni della pausa, avrebbero capito che si stanno compiendo importanti preparativi per la successiva fase di accelerazione. Perciò, in nessuna circostanza gli esseri umani dovrebbero essere pessimisti. È per questo che io sono sempre un ottimista incorreggibile, perché so che l’ottimismo è vita.
CITATION_EN: Shrii Shrii Ánandamúrti | 10 March 1979, Calcutta | 05 Dynamicity and Staticity | A Few Problems Solved Part 3
CITATION_ZH: Shrii Shrii Ánandamúrti | 1979年3月10日，加爾各答 | 05 Dynamicity and Staticity（05 揚升與沈潛） | A Few Problems Solved Part 3（一些已解問題 卷3）

EN_TEXT: All the creatures which have come to live in this world, do not want to leave it – they all want to survive. Thus we must grant them their right to remain in this world, their right to survive. We must forever fulfil their needs so that they will not have to leave this world prematurely. We must make arrangements for the food, clothes, education, shelter and medical treatment of each and every individual, so that all can live in this world as long as possible and become assets to the earth. We must provide them with the inexhaustible resources for their forward movement towards their spiritual goal. This very mentality is known as sama-samája tattva. All the expressions of human life will have to be based on this sama-samája tattva.
ZH_TEXT: 所有來到此世界的生物都想要生存，不想離開這個世界。我們必須承認牠們也有生存的權利，我們一定也要滿足牠們所需，不該讓牠們提早離開這個世界。每一個人的食物、衣服、教育、住所和醫療所需，我們也都應該為他們安排，讓所有的人都盡可能地長久活在這世界上，並成為地球的資產。我們必須提供他們無窮無盡的資源，讓他們朝向靈性的目標前進。這種心理正是社會平等法則，人類生命所有的展現，都必須立基於此一社會平等法則。
IT_TEXT: Tutte le creature che sono venute a vivere in questo mondo non desiderano lasciarlo: tutte vogliono sopravvivere. Dobbiamo quindi riconoscere loro il diritto di rimanere in questo mondo, il diritto di vivere. Dobbiamo soddisfare costantemente i loro bisogni affinché non siano costrette a lasciare prematuramente questo mondo. Dobbiamo predisporre per ogni individuo il necessario in termini di cibo, vestiti, educazione, alloggio e cure mediche, affinché tutti possano vivere su questa terra il più a lungo possibile e diventare una ricchezza per il mondo. Dobbiamo inoltre fornire loro le risorse inesauribili per il loro avanzamento verso la meta spirituale. Questa mentalità è chiamata il principio della società equa (sama-samāja tattva). Tutte le espressioni della vita umana dovranno fondarsi su questo sama-samāja tattva.

EN_TEXT: We all equally feel cold and heat, We all feel the pangs of hunger and thirst; To raise tender plants into mighty trees We struggle equally hard.
ZH_TEXT: 我們都同樣感受到冷與熱；也同樣感受到飢和渴，為使幼苗長成大樹，我們一樣要艱苦奮鬥。

EN_TEXT: The followers, the disciples, of the guru, are men and women of flesh and blood having physical structures. They have their sorrows and miseries, their tears and smiles. This is their life. They have their problem of food and clothing; they have their pleasures and pains, their tears of pain and tears of joy; they become elated in happy circumstances and depressed when things go wrong. It is the duty of a guru to provide his followers with the wherewithal for their progress. This is what an ideal guru is to do in the physical sphere. As a guru in the physical world, he will have to teach mankind such techniques as will solve their wordly problems – problems of food, clothing, education and medical treatment. A guru must see to it that their mundane problems are solved. So in order to be a guru, one must come onto this earth with the highest qualifications in the spiritual field, and with the greatest capacity to face the mountainous obstacles in the physical world. To shoulder the responsibility of a guru is not childʼs play.
ZH_TEXT: 古魯的追隨者和弟子們都是擁有血肉之軀的男女，他們有他們的悲傷和痛苦，有他們的眼淚和歡笑，這就是他們的生命。他們有食物和衣服的問題，他們有自己的快樂和痛苦以及快樂和痛苦的眼淚；在快樂的環境下，他們興高采烈，當事情出差錯時又是無比的沮喪。古魯的責任就是為其弟子的進步，提供所必要的東西。這就是一位完美的古魯在物質層面上的作為。身為一位物質世界的古魯，他必須教導人類這些方法來解決他們世俗的問題——食物、衣服、教育和醫療上的問題。一位古魯一定要注意他們世俗的問題是否得到解決。 所以為了要成為古魯，一個人來到塵世必須具備在靈性上最高的資格以及在物質世界上面對如山之障礙的最大能力。肩負起古魯的責任並非是兒戲。
IT_TEXT: I seguaci, i discepoli del guru, sono uomini e donne in carne e ossa, dotati di una struttura fisica. Hanno le loro sofferenze e le loro miserie, le loro lacrime e i loro sorrisi. Questa è la loro vita. Hanno i loro problemi di cibo e di vestiario; hanno i loro piaceri e i loro dolori, le lacrime del dolore e le lacrime della gioia; si esaltano quando le circostanze sono favorevoli e si deprimono quando le cose vanno male. È dovere di un guru fornire ai suoi seguaci i mezzi necessari per il loro progresso. Questo è ciò che un guru ideale deve fare nella sfera fisica. Come guru nel mondo fisico, egli dovrà insegnare all’umanità quelle tecniche che possano risolvere i problemi della vita materiale – problemi di cibo, di vestiario, di educazione e di cure mediche. Un guru deve assicurarsi che i loro problemi mondani vengano risolti. Perciò, per essere un guru, bisogna venire su questa terra con le più alte qualificazioni nel campo spirituale e con la più grande capacità di affrontare gli ostacoli giganteschi del mondo fisico. Assumersi la responsabilità di essere guru non è un gioco da bambini.

EN_TEXT: Policies will differ according to changes in time, space and person, but principles will remain the same because they are all pervading and because their cognitive faculty is omniscient. In this present age of transition, you are seeing many theories change and being discarded before your very eyes. If any group of people clings to the skeletons of the past, they will also be rejected. Intelligent people will not cling to old, outdated ideas. Rather they will wholeheartedly embrace that theory which adjusts with time, space and person and will continue to exist forever.
ZH_TEXT: 政策會隨時、空與人的變化而有所不同，但原理原則恆久如一，因其無所不在且無所不知。 在此變革時代，你們正親眼見證諸多理論汰換更迭，任何死抱陋習屍骸者均將被時代摒棄；智者絕不眷戀過時陳腐的觀念，總是全心全意擁抱能隨時、空、人調整並永續存在的理論。
IT_TEXT: Le politiche varieranno in base ai cambiamenti di tempo, spazio e persona, ma i principi rimarranno gli stessi, perché sono onnipervadenti e perché la loro facoltà conoscitiva è onnisciente. In questa attuale epoca di transizione, state vedendo con i vostri stessi occhi molte teorie cambiare ed essere abbandonate. Se qualche gruppo di persone rimane aggrappato agli scheletri del passato, anche quel gruppo verrà respinto. Le persone intelligenti non resteranno attaccate a idee vecchie e superate. Al contrario, accoglieranno con convinzione quella teoria che sa adattarsi al tempo, allo spazio e alla persona e che quindi potrà continuare a esistere per sempre.

EN_TEXT: Where did this universe come from – what is the source of its emanation? Sorrow is not a personal entity; hence out of sorrow nothing can be created. But Ánandam or the Infinite Happiness is a personal Entity. Parama Puruśa in His eternal stance is ánandasvarúpa, the embodiment of bliss. When He descends from His eternal stance to His transitory form then whatever emanates from Him in that state certainly imparts less bliss than that which flows [[from]] His Eternal Being. The stage in which Parama Puruśa does not create and does not even desire to create anything, is His nityabháva [eternal stance]. And the [[bliss in which, through that nityabháva, Parama Puruśa remains,]] is called nityánanda.
ZH_TEXT: 這宇宙源自何處？哪裡是它的根源？悲傷是不具人格的實體，因此，無一物是從悲傷中創造出來的。但是「無限的喜悅」是具人格的實體，至上意識永恆之境稱為「喜悅的化身」(ánandasvarúpa)，當祂從永恆之境降臨到這無常的世間，難道在該境界中祂所放射出來的喜悅會不如祂本身的喜悅嗎？祂永恆的存在是至上意識尚未從事創造的如如不動之境，在此境界中，祂甚至沒有創造的意願。在這種狀態中至上意識的喜悅境界稱為「永恆喜悅之境」(nityánanda)。
IT_TEXT: Da dove proviene questo universo, qual è la fonte della sua emanazione? La sofferenza non è un’entità personale; pertanto, dalla sofferenza non può nascere nulla. L’ānandam, o Felicità Infinita, invece, è un’Entità personale. Parama Purusa, nella Sua condizione eterna, è ānandasvarūpa, l’incarnazione della beatitudine. Quando Egli discende dalla Sua condizione eterna alla Sua forma transitoria, tutto ciò che da Lui emana in quello stato trasmette certamente una beatitudine minore rispetto a quella che fluisce dal Suo Essere eterno. La condizione in cui Parama Purusa non crea e non desidera neppure creare nulla è la Sua nityabhāva (condizione eterna). E la beatitudine nella quale, attraverso questa nityabhāva, Parama Purusa dimora è chiamata nityānanda.
CITATION_EN: Shrii Shrii Ánandamúrti | 20 March 1979 DMC, Kanpur | 10 What Are the Noble Truths? | Subháśita Saḿgraha Part 11
CITATION_ZH: Shrii Shrii Ánandamúrti | 1979年3月20日於Kanpur大法會 | 10 何謂聖諦 | 靈性科學集成 卷11，P.125

EN_TEXT: All the people in this universe are playing the roles allotted to them, but that does not mean that they will truly become that role – they will be as He wishes them to become. Each and every living being is the progeny of Parama Puruśa. All exist with Him, and ultimately they will all merge in Him. So no one should even belittle oneself. A drop of water and the entire quantity of water in the ocean are all the same water. The difference is only that one is very small in quantity and the other is vast. When the drop of water identifies itself with the ocean, then no one will call it a drop any longer – for it has become one with the ocean.
ZH_TEXT: 宇宙間所有的人都在演祂所分派的角色，但這並非意指他們真的就是這個角色──他們會成為祂希望他們扮演的角色。每一個人都是至上意識的孩子，都存在於祂，最後都將融入於祂。所以，沒有人可以貶低自己。一滴水和浩瀚無垠的大海洋是相同的，唯一不同的只是一個小一個大。當小水滴融入大海洋時，再也沒有人會叫它小水滴了，因為它已與大海合而為一。
IT_TEXT: Tutte le persone in questo universo stanno interpretando i ruoli che sono stati loro assegnati, ma questo non significa che quel ruolo rappresenti la loro vera identità: esse diventeranno ciò che Egli desidera che diventino. Ogni essere vivente è la progenie di Parama Puruśa. Tutti esistono con Lui e, alla fine, tutti ritorneranno a Lui. Perciò nessuno dovrebbe mai sminuire sé stesso. Una goccia d’acqua e l’acqua dell’oceano sono la stessa acqua. La differenza sta soltanto nel fatto che la goccia è molto piccola, mentre l’oceano è immenso. Ma quando la goccia d’acqua si identifica con l’oceano, nessuno la chiamerà più goccia, perché è diventata tutt’uno con l’oceano.

EN_TEXT: The mind has a natural tendency to degrade itself; it flows more easily downwards than upwards. So if some people, by virtue of their wealth, impose vulgar cinemas and dramas on others, this will break the lattersʼ spines and they will become paralysed. And those paralysed, spineless people will thenceforth never be able to stand unitedly against cultural or any other kind of exploitation. They will never be able to do so, because mentally they will be completely dead – their capacity to raise their heads in protest will have been crushed forever. How can they raise their heads again? This exploitation in the cultural sphere is accomplished by the propagation of pseudo-culture. Every honest, virtuous, rational person must fight against this pseudo-culture, and inspire others to do the same. If this is not done, the future of humanity will be sealed. It is proper for human beings to struggle for political freedom, for social emancipation; but if their cultural backbone is broken, then all their struggles will end in nothing – like offering ghee into a fire that has died out.
ZH_TEXT: 心靈本身有墮落的傾向，它向下墮落比向上提升容易，所以如果有人利用金錢，強行將一些低俗的電影及戲劇灌輸給別人，將會消磨一個人的志氣，讓他變得麻木不仁。那些麻痺、喪失志氣的人，將無法團結起來對抗文化或其他各種的剝削。他們永遠無法這麼做，因為他們在心態上已然死亡，連抬頭抗議的力量都被徹底摧毀，又如何能再抬起頭呢？在文化層面的剝削是經由宣揚偽文化來達成的。每一個誠實、正直和理性的人，都必須起來對抗這種偽文化，並鼓勵他人也這麼做。假使不這麼做，人類是沒有未來的。人類為政治自由、社會解放而奮戰是正當的，但如果他們文化的骨幹被打斷，那麼他們所有的奮鬥都將一事無成──就像把純奶油倒進獻祭的火裡被燒盡。
IT_TEXT: La mente ha una tendenza naturale a degradarsi: scivola più facilmente verso il basso che verso l’alto. Perciò, se alcuni, forti della loro ricchezza, impongono agli altri cinema e spettacoli volgari, finiranno per spezzare la loro spina dorsale, rendendoli incapaci di reagire. E queste persone, così paralizzate e prive di forza interiore, non saranno più in grado di opporsi unite allo sfruttamento culturale o a qualsiasi altra forma di sfruttamento. Non potranno farlo, perché saranno mentalmente come morte: la loro capacità di sollevare la testa e protestare sarà stata annientata. Come potranno rialzarsi? Questo sfruttamento nel campo culturale si realizza attraverso la diffusione di una pseudo-cultura. Ogni persona onesta, virtuosa e razionale deve opporsi a questa pseudo-cultura e incoraggiare anche gli altri a fare lo stesso. Se ciò non avviene, il futuro dell’umanità sarà compromesso. È giusto che gli esseri umani lottino per la libertà politica e per l’emancipazione sociale; ma se la loro struttura culturale viene distrutta, tutte queste lotte risulteranno vane – come versare olio su un fuoco ormai spento.

EN_TEXT: Women are the mothers of society and therefore men have a duty to serve women. Men are greatly indebted to them. Hence there is no question of women having to regain their freedom from men. Rather, their struggle to rid themselves of whatever shortcomings they may have may be considered as their struggle for emancipation.
ZH_TEXT: 婦女為社會之母，因此服務婦女為男人之責任。男人深受婦女之恩澤，所以無庸置疑，婦女必須從男人手中取回她們的自由。我們甚至可以這麼說，婦女欲擺脫其自身缺點之奮鬥可視為她們尋求解脫的奮鬥。

EN_TEXT: Keep your conscience ever-vigilant. Develop a firm rationalistic mentality, and no one will be able to deceive you by false geo-sentiment. This rationalistic mentality will provide you with sufficient inspiration and strength to fight against socio-sentiment, ordinary humanistic sentiment, and pseudo-humanistic strategy. You will not only gain vocal strength, but become strong in all respects.
ZH_TEXT: 保持你的良知永遠警覺，發展出堅定的理智，任何人都無法以虛假的地域情感來欺騙你。理智會提供你足夠的力量，激勵你與社會情感、一般的人道情感及偽人道策略來戰鬥。你不會只得到口頭上的力量，而會在各方面都變得堅強。

EN_TEXT: If we try to expand the scope of the few fundamental cardinal human principles and draft the constitution, legal code, administrative and judicial systems in adjustment with the expanded scope of those cardinal principles, that will pave the way for the greater unity of human society. Humanity or Neohumanism will thereby acquire accelerated speed, which is one of the essential factors for the path of proper movement. If the fundamental unity of human society increases more and more, and divisive differences steadily decrease, then universal humanity is bound to be united under a common ideology. This should not remain a utopian dream. It should be the first expression of the practical wisdom of humanity.
ZH_TEXT: 試將人類核心基礎原則範疇予以擴增，並據以修擬憲法、法律、行政與司法體系，將為人類社會鋪平合一之道，人道主義或新人道主義(Neohumanism)將加速發展，此為邁向演進正道關鍵要素。若人類社會合一根基日益增強而分歧差異持續減少，則全人類終將在理想願景中合一。此非烏托邦夢想，將是人類務實智慧最耀眼的展現。
IT_TEXT: Se cerchiamo di ampliare il campo di applicazione dei pochi principi cardinali fondamentali dell’umanità e di redigere la costituzione, il codice legale, i sistemi amministrativi e giudiziari in accordo con questo ampliamento, ciò aprirà la strada a una maggiore unità della società umana. L’umanità, o Neoumanesimo, acquisirà così una velocità accelerata, che è uno dei fattori essenziali per un corretto progresso. Se l’unità fondamentale della società umana aumenta sempre di più, e le differenze divisive diminuiscono progressivamente, allora l’umanità universale è destinata a unirsi sotto un’unica ideologia. Questo non deve rimanere un sogno utopico. Deve essere la prima espressione della saggezza pratica dell’umanità.

EN_TEXT: In the struggle to transform Bhaeravii Shakti into Kaośikii Shakti, Citishakti [Cognitive Force] plays a dominant role, because Bhaeravii Shakti is the second stage of Citishakti in the flow of creation. The Cognitive Force manifests itself as Bhaeravii Shakti to expedite the evolution of mind. The will to evolve is primarily dependent on the active role of Bhaeravii Shakti. In fact Bhaeravii Shakti is oneʼs real “I”. It is with Her help that one must carry on oneʼs sádhaná to attain Citishakti. It is just like worshipping the Ganges with the water of the Ganges.
ZH_TEXT: 在努力奮鬥將拜拉維力量轉變成考希奇力量的過程裡，至上認知力(Citishakti)扮演一個最重要的角色，因為在創造的波流中拜拉維力量是至上認知力的第二個階段。至上認知力以拜拉維力量將自身顯現以加速心靈的進化。進化的意願主要是依靠活躍的拜拉維力量。事實上，拜拉維力量就是一個人真正的「我」。正是由於她的幫助，使得一個人會堅持繼續其靈修以達至上認知力之境，這就像以恆河之水來禮敬恆河一般。

EN_TEXT: Each and every stage of Macrocosmic expression – crude, subtle or causal – shines with divine joy. Every atom of the universe is moving in that divine flow, in that rhythmic dance. It is as if this entire universe is the stage for the divine dance of Puruśottama. The divine dance, with Puruśottama as its nucleus, is the blissful flow of joyful creation.
ZH_TEXT: 大宇宙顯現的每一個階段──粗鈍的、精細的或致因的──都閃耀著神性的喜悅。宇宙中的每一個原子都在神性的波流中、在充滿韻律的舞動中向前移動。整個宇宙彷彿就是至上意識神性舞蹈的舞台。以至上意識為核心的神性舞蹈就是充滿歡樂創造的喜悅波流。

EN_TEXT: One who is totally absorbed in ideation on the Supreme becomes one with the Supreme at the time of death. This is certainly true in the case of devotees. The duality between the one who serves and the entity served ceases to exist. Ultimately the one who serves, the entity who is served, and the action of serving become fused into one. If oneʼs goal is right, one is sure to attain the supreme stance. And one who attains the supreme stance will never make the mistake of differentiating between high and low, literate and illiterate, touchable and untouchable.
ZH_TEXT: 一個完全專注於觀想至上的人，在死亡的時刻會與至上合一，這對於虔誠者而言是千真萬確的。服務者與被服務者之間的二元性不復存在，最後服務者與被服務者，以及服務的行動均將融合成一體。如果一個人的目標是正確的，那麼他一定會達到至上之境；而一個業已到達至上之境的人，永遠不會錯誤地認為崇高與低下、博學與文盲、賤民與非賤民等是有差異的。
IT_TEXT: Chi è totalmente assorbito nell’ideazione sul Supremo al momento della morte diventa uno con il Supremo. Per i devoti questa è un’assoluta verità. La dualità tra colui che serve e l’Entità servita cessa di esistere. Alla fine, colui che serve, l’Entità servita e l’atto stesso del servire si fondono in un’unica essenza. Se la meta è quella giusta, la realizzazione suprema è inevitabile. E chi raggiunge questa condizione finale non commetterà mai l’errore di distinguere tra alto e basso, istruito e non istruito, puro e impuro.

EN_TEXT: Bear in mind that this Hari, this Parama Puruśa, loves you so much that if you do His kiirtana with full concentration, with single-mindedness, then the mind becomes one-pointed. If in that state you do sádhaná properly, then you will surely progress.

EN_TEXT: All entities, living or non-living, are rotating around Parama Puruśa – some consciously, some unconsciously, – with so many thoughts and idiosyncrasies, so many bodies and structures. When will their movement come to an end? It will end only when they realize that Parama Puruśa and they themselves are one and inseparable; then will they become one with Parama Puruśa. The more sincerely people will follow the spiritual cult, the more their distance from Parama Puruśa will decrease; and when that distance becomes nil, the microcosms will merge in Macrocosmic Consciousness – jiiva will become Shiva. This is the parágati, the supreme culminating point of all microcosmic movement.
ZH_TEXT: 一切有生命和無生命實體各自以其不同的思想和習性，以及相異的身體、結構，繞著至上意識運行，有些有自覺意識，有些不知不覺。他們的行動什麼時候才會終了？唯有當他們了悟到原來至上意識與他們自身是不可分割的一體，當他們與至上意識合而為一時，這行動方才會終結。人們越真誠遵循靈修法門的鍛鍊，他們與至上意識的距離將越縮小，當彼此之間已無距離時，個體小宇宙就會融入大宇宙意識裡，個體將成就自身為至上意識。這就是個體小宇宙行動的極致終點──波羅揭諦(parágati)。

EN_TEXT: In order to wipe out imperialism, which is rooted deep in the human psyche Neo-ethics based on the following points is indispensable: 1) The Macrocosmic Entity must be accepted as the supreme desideratum in human life. 2) There should be happy adjustment and balanced blending between carbonic and non-carbonic pabula. This is the neo-ethics of the present age; a panacea for the present imperialistic social ills and a mesh of psychic disorders. The application of Neo-ethics will lead to multi-lateral salvation of human society by removing economic exploitation, political suppression, religious indoctrination, cultural imposition and social subordination.
ZH_TEXT: 為根除深植人心的帝國主義，基於以下要點的「新倫理學」(Neo-ethics)不可或缺： 1) 須視「至上本體」(Macrocosmic Entity)為人類生命終極想望。 2) 碳基食糧(carbonic pabula，肉體食物)與非碳基食糧(non-carbonic pabula，精神食糧)應有和諧調整與平衡融合。 此當代新倫理學為現今帝國主義社會弊病與心理失調亂象的萬靈丹：消除經濟剝削、政治壓迫、宗教灌輸、文化強加與社經霸淩，引領人類社會走向「多面救贖」。
IT_TEXT: Per eliminare l’imperialismo, che affonda le sue radici in profondità nella psiche umana, è indispensabile una neo-etica fondata sui seguenti punti: 1) l’Entità Macrocosmica deve essere accettata come il fine supremo della vita umana;  2) deve esserci un armonioso adattamento e un equilibrato bilanciamento tra pabulum carbonico e non carbonico. Questa è la neo-etica dell’epoca attuale: un rimedio universale ai mali sociali imperialistici del presente e alla rete di disordini psichici. L’applicazione della neo-etica condurrà alla salvezza multilaterale della società umana, eliminando lo sfruttamento economico, l’oppressione politica, l’indottrinamento religioso, l’imposizione culturale e la subordinazione sociale.

EN_TEXT: The solidarity and unity of a group depends on the strength and determination of the leadership. If the leadership is not strong the entire structure – social, economic and political – becomes weak and ultimately crumbles down... Comparatively democracy is the most favourable of all the systems of government that have so far been evolved. However there is less scope for strong leadership in a democracy than in a dictator ship. Consequently democratic countries, whether in war, socio-economic development or other spheres of activity, always remain somewhat weak, even though a democracy will usually last longer than a dictatorship. While there is greater scope for the rule of rationality than whimsical rule in a democratic system, the solidarity that is achieved in a dictatorship is not found in a democracy because most people do not want it... The only solution to individual dictatorship, party dictatorship and democratic pandemonium is the Proutistic concept of Sadvipras leadership.
ZH_TEXT: 任何群體的齊心團結取決於領導層的實力與決心，若其不夠堅實，社會整體、經濟與政治結構均將疲軟脆弱，終至分崩離析。…… 當前已成形的所有政府治理體制中，民主制度相對而言最為有利；然而，相較於獨裁政權，民主制度欠缺強勁領導的發揮空間，以致無論在戰爭、社會經濟發展或其他領域，民主國家總是顯得相對溫吞，儘管民主制度通常比獨裁政權持久。雖然民主體制理性統治的空間大於反覆無常的專斷獨裁，然而獨裁政權達成的凝聚團結力，在民主制度中並不可得，因為多數人對這種團結並不渴望。…… 獨夫專制、一黨專政以及民主騷亂的唯一解方，即「進步利用論」倡導的聖導哲人(Sadvipras)領導論。
IT_TEXT: La solidarietà e l’unità di un gruppo dipendono dalla forza e dalla determinazione della leadership. Se la leadership non è forte, l’intera struttura – sociale, economica e politica – si indebolisce e alla fine crolla. La democrazia è il sistema di governo più favorevole tra tutti quelli che finora sono stati elaborati. Tuttavia, in una democrazia vi è meno spazio per una leadership forte rispetto a una dittatura. Di conseguenza, i paesi democratici – sia in guerra, sia nello sviluppo socio-economico, sia in altre sfere di attività – rimangono sempre in qualche misura più deboli, anche se una democrazia generalmente dura più a lungo di una dittatura. Tuttavia la solidarietà che si realizza in una dittatura non si trova in una democrazia, perché la maggior parte delle persone non desidera quel tipo di solidarietà... L’unica soluzione alla dittatura individuale, alla dittatura di partito e al pandemonio democratico è il concetto proutista della leadership dei Sadvipra.

EN_TEXT: Whenever people, after performing some activity, think of the Nucleus of the circum-rotarian universe, their minds become all-pervasive. Such people can never think of harming others; rather they will think only of universal welfare. In that elevated state of mind, they will easily detect those demons in human form and will acquire the necessary capability to properly guide the ordinary or extraordinary individuals or groups who tend to be misguided by all sorts of socio-sentiments (because socio-sentiment is many times more harmful than geo-sentiment).
ZH_TEXT: 無論何時當人們從事某些活動後，心懷運行不息的宇宙核心，他們的心靈就會無限擴展。這樣的人絕不會想要去傷害別人，相反的，他們所想的只會是宇宙的福祉。心靈在那種提升的狀態下，他們很容易辨識出人形惡魔，並且也會得到必要的能力，以正確引導那些容易被各種社會情感誤導的普通人或是非凡之人或是團體（因為社會情感比地域情感的傷害更甚）。

EN_TEXT: The excellence of aesthetic science lies in the fact that one derives joy from the manifold expressions of Parama Puruśa. From the aesthetic point of view, there is no entity but Parama Puruśa. “He is my personal property. I have never come across any other entity that can compare with my Parama Puruśa.” No other category of bhakta thinks or talks in such a way about Parama Puruśa. “That is why I love Him from the core of my heart. It is not enough that I get joy by loving Him. I should act in such a way that He also gets joy.” Both approaches coincide in the science of aesthetics. If we go even deeper, to the very root, we find that whatever we observe in this universe – animals, birds, trees, plants, land, water, hills, mountains, sun, moon, stars and so many other things that we love in numerous ways – all are but the limited expressions of Parama Puruśa.
ZH_TEXT: 美學的卓越即在於吾人能從至上意識多重展現中獲得喜悅的這個事實。從美學的觀點而言，除了至上意識外，別無其他實體。「祂是我個人的財富，我從未遇見過任何一個像我的至上意識般的實體。」沒有其他類型的虔誠者對至上意識作如是思想和談論。「所以我打從心裡深愛著祂。光只是因為愛祂而得到喜悅是不夠的，我還應該從事那些讓祂也感到喜悅的事。」兩種方法在美學中達到一致。如果我們再深入來到根源，則會發現宇宙間任何可見的實體，如各式蟲魚鳥獸、樹木植物、土地、流水、丘陵高山、日月星辰等等，以及各種我們所喜愛的其他事物，所有一切都是至上意識的有限展現。

EN_TEXT: Human beings become overjoyed receiving the limited expressions of joy from Him. They look at the world, with its profusion of changing forms, and become fascinated by them. When this feeling deepens and becomes permanent, it turns into love. Suppose I see something. The vibration radiating from that object produces a sympathetic vibration in the mind. I begins to feel that I should assimilate that vibration, that I should accept it as my own. This is what is known as attraction. When people subjectivize that attraction in the psychic arena, it is called love. What is attraction in the beginning turns into love when it becomes permanent.
ZH_TEXT: 人類感受到來自於祂的有限展現所得到的喜悅，即足以讓他們無法自持。他們看這個世界充滿著無限變化的形象，而深深為其所著迷。當這種感受變得更加濃烈而永恆時，它即轉化為「愛」。假定我看見某個東西，此物體所散發出來的波動，與我心中的波動產生共鳴，我會感覺到我應該消化吸收那個波動，應讓它變成自己的，這就是「吸引力」。當人們在心理層面將此吸引力主體化時，就稱之為「愛」。在開始時是吸引力，而後當它變得永恆時轉化為愛。

EN_TEXT: There are three stages on this path of Neohumanism. The first one is spiritual cult. What is spiritual cult? It is physico-psycho-spiritual cult. This physico-psycho-spiritual process will show you how to remove the defects of the psychic world and also the external world, and enable you to move towards the spiritual world without any delay. This movement towards the spiritual goal will also help you to establish yourself in the psychic and physical worlds, so you will be able to render greater service to the people.
ZH_TEXT: 新人道主義之路有三個階段：第一是靈性鍛鍊。什麼是靈性鍛鍊？就是身體導向心理再導向靈性的鍛鍊。這種由身體朝向心理再朝向靈性的過程，會讓你知道如何去除心理及外在世界的缺點，使你毫不遲疑地朝向靈性世界前進。這種朝向靈性目標前進的運動，也會幫助你立足於心理及物質世界，讓你能夠為人類奉獻更大的服務。

EN_TEXT: The second stage is spiritual essence. This stage is related mainly to the psychic and spiritual strata. If you consider the entire human race, you will see that humanity has a collective mind (not the Cosmic Mind). Now, changes will have to be effected in the mental flow of this collective mind; you will have to create a new wave of thought in it. Because of the manner of human thinking thus far, the pace of human progress has been painfully slow. If it is given a new direction, the speed of progress will be greatly accelerated.
ZH_TEXT: 第二階段是靈性的精髓。此一階段主要涉及心理和靈性層面。如果你為整體人類社會著想，你就會看出人類有一個集體心靈（此非大宇宙心靈）。此集體心靈的心智波流必須要有所改變，你們必須在此集體心靈中創造出一股新的思想波流。因為人類至今為止的思考方式，讓人類進步的步伐十分費力及緩慢。如果能給予一個新的方向，進步的速度將會大大加快。

EN_TEXT: But there is something more beyond this, which I have described as “spirituality as a mission”. So first there is “spirituality as a cult”, secondly, “spirituality in essence”, and thirdly, “spirituality as a mission”. All existential phenomena are emanating from the Existential Nucleus. The existential nucleus of a single individual has a direct link with the Cosmological Hub, a direct link with the Existential Nucleus of the Cosmological order. But this path is not psycho-spiritual; according to Neohumanism, the final and supreme goal is to make oneʼs individual existential nucleus coincide with the Cosmic Existential Nucleus (nádabindu yoga, in the language of Tantra).
ZH_TEXT: 但仍有某些事情遠超過靈性的精髓，我稱它為「靈性的使命」。所以，首先是「靈性的鍛鍊」，其次是「靈性的精髓」及第三「靈性的使命」。所有存在現象都是從存在之核心放射出來，個體存在之核心直接與大宇宙秩序的核心相連結。但這不是一條心理導向靈性的道路，根據新人道主義，人類最終及最高的目標，是要使個體存在核心與大宇宙存在核心合而為一（以密宗之術語來說，就稱為nádabindu yoga）。

EN_TEXT: The noblest form of social service is to educate the public and create a sense of consciousness in them. This sense of consciousness is to be inculcated in each and every human being. This is your duty. The goal of education is to elevate the all-round standard, and especially the intellectual standard. In addition, the elevation of the moral standard is extremely necessary in the sphere of education. This moral standard is deficient today. It is lacking in the present educational system also. You are to create a new social order. Therefore, you should first acquire more and more knowledge in different spheres of life and also you are to upgrade your morality. Along with your intellectual standard, if you have morality, then everybody will respect you. Try to acquire as much knowledge as possible through our own books. Education which leads to the acquisition of knowledge plus morality makes for a peaceful society.
ZH_TEXT: 最高貴的社會服務形式就是教育大眾，並且在他們心中創造對意識的認知。灌輸每人此種對意識的覺知，這是你們的職責。教育的目標是提升全面的水準，特別是知性的水準。此外，在教育領域中，極其需要道德水準的提升。今日正是缺少此道德水準，在現今的教育體制中也缺乏此道德水準。你們要創造一個新的社會秩序。因此，首先應當在生命的不同領域獲得愈來愈多的知識，並且也要提升自己的道德。如果你能夠具有知性水準再加上道德，那麼每個人都會尊敬你。儘可能試著經由阿南達瑪迦本身的書籍來獲取知識。能夠獲得知識加上道德的教育，才會創造一個和平的社會。

EN_TEXT: A spiritual aspirant is established in heaven or eternity by performing spiritual sádhaná. This means that vidyámáyá [cosmic centripetal force] has two forces, samvit and hládinii. Through samvit a human being earns knowledge, moving away from the darkness of ignorance; through samvit humans move towards the life.
ZH_TEXT: 靈性的渴望者藉由從事靈性修持將己身立足於天堂或永恆之境。這意指什麼呢？即宇宙向心力(vidyámáyá)有兩個力量：靈性覺醒的力量(samvit)和提升的力量(hládinii)。透過「靈性覺醒」的力量，人類得到知識，遠離無知的黑暗。透過此一力量，人類迎向生命。
IT_TEXT: Un aspirante spirituale si stabilisce nel cielo o nell’eternità praticando il sadhana spirituale. Ciò significa che vidyámáyá [la forza cosmica centripeta] possiede due potenze: samvit e hládinii. Attraverso samvit l’essere umano acquisisce conoscenza, allontanandosi dall’oscurità dell’ignoranza; attraverso samvit gli esseri umani avanzano verso la vita.

EN_TEXT: There are six cakras from múládhára to ájiṋá. These six cakras are controlled from different places in the body. Each cakra is vibrated in a certain way with the vibration of energy from the cosmic mind. In the same way, the seventh cakra or gurucakra is also vibrated by a special energy of Parama Puruśa. Now this gurucakra or guru entity or form of guru is also him, that is, that Supreme Entity, and he is attracting everything in this universe towards himself with unparalleled affection from one controlling point. The space measured by ten fingers lying between ájiṋá and sahasrára cakras also belongs to him. This ten-fingered space is the abode of Niśkala Brahma or pure Brahma. So the spiritual aspirant will have to gradually rise up from the bottom to the top, through múládhára, svádhiśt́hána, mańipura, anáhata, vishuddha, ájiṋá, and there, after bathing in the confluence of three rivers [in ájiṋá cakra] and being vibrated by the grace of Parama Puruśa, they will gradually rise upwards to the highest point of the ten-fingered abode of Parama Puruśa(1) and arriving there they merge into and become one with Him, this being the highest stage of sádhaná. This is nirguńa nirvikalpa samádhi [non-attributional supreme spiritual stance].
ZH_TEXT: 從海底輪到眉心輪共有六個脈叢結，各於身體的不同點控制著。每個脈輪都受到來自大宇宙心靈能量波流的某種振動，而產生特有的波動方式。同樣的，第七個脈輪，即「古魯輪」也受到至上意識特殊能量的撼動。 這個古魯輪、古魯實體或古魯的形相也都是至上本體。祂吸引著宇宙萬有以無比的愛從一個控制點中朝向祂。在眉心輪和頂輪間十指之處的地方也屬於祂，此「十指之處」即純意識(Niśkala Brahma)的住所。所以靈性的修持者必須逐步從底下往上提升，通過海底輪、生殖輪、臍輪、心輪、喉輪、眉心輪，經過眉心輪三條河流匯流的洗禮，及至上恩典波流的撼動，他們將逐漸提升往至上意識十指之處的最高住所而前進，最後到達祂安住之地，與祂合而為一。這就是靈性修持的最高境界，這就是「無餘依三摩地」的境界(nirguńa nirvikalpa samádhi)。
IT_TEXT: Ci sono sei cakra, dal mūlādhāra fino all’ājñā. Questi sei cakra sono controllati da differenti centri del corpo. Ognuno di essi vibra in modo particolare sotto l’influsso dell’energia proveniente dalla mente cosmica. Allo stesso modo, anche il settimo cakra, il gurucakra, vibra grazie a una speciale energia di Parama Puruṣa. Questo gurucakra, la forma o entità del Guru, è anch’esso Lui, la stessa Entità Suprema; ed è da questo punto di controllo che Egli attira verso di Sé tutto ciò che esiste nell’universo con un amore incomparabile. Anche lo spazio simbolicamente descritto come misurato in dieci dita, situato tra l’ājñā cakra e il sahasrāra cakra, appartiene a Lui. Questo spazio di dieci dita è la dimora di Niṣkala Brahma, il Brahma puro. Perciò l’aspirante spirituale deve salire gradualmente dal basso verso l’alto, attraversando mūlādhāra, svādhiṣṭhāna, maṇipūra, anāhata, viśuddha e ājñā. In questo punto, dove convergono le tre correnti sottili iḍā, piṅgalā e suṣumṇā, e dove la coscienza viene interiormente pervasa dalla grazia di Parama Puruṣa, l’aspirante può proseguire la propria ascesa verso l’alto fino al punto più elevato della dimora di Parama Puruṣa, lo spazio simbolico delle dieci dita. Giunto a questo livello, egli si fonde in Lui e diventa uno con Lui: questa è la più alta fase del sadhana. Questo stato è nirguṇa nirvikalpa samādhi, la suprema realizzazione spirituale priva di attributi. Giunto là, egli si fonde in Lui e diventa uno con Lui: questa è la più alta fase del sadhana. Questo stato è nirguṇa nirvikalpa samādhi, cioè la suprema realizzazione spirituale priva di attributi.

EN_TEXT: The Supreme Cognitive entity became metamorphosed into many-the One Universal Father, the One Supreme Progenitor, continuing His divine sport with His innumerable children. During the enactment of a drama, all the characters, the dramatis personae (some are acting as great scholars, some fools, some as extremely happy and some as wretched beings) should bear in mind that they are simply playing the roles allotted to them. They should always think, “In reality, I am neither very happy nor very miserable, I am not an erudite scholar nor a fool. I am merely acting a particular role-be it Emperor Shahjáhán or Aurangzeb.” If people remember this, they will neither be afflicted with sorrow nor elated with joy. This is what is called cosmic inheritance, cosmic heritage.
ZH_TEXT: 至上認知實體從「一」演變成「多」，宇宙之父、至上之祖與祂的孩子們不斷遊戲於此神聖的大戲裡。 但在戲中所有的演員皆應記住，他們只是扮演被指定的角色（有人飾演偉大的學者，有人飾演愚蠢的笨蛋；有人扮演快樂的人，有人扮演悲傷的人。）他們應永遠記得：「真正的我，既不快樂亦不悲傷，我不是學富五車的大學者，也不是一個笨蛋。我只是扮演我的角色，或許是沙哈罕皇帝，或者是奧朗則布。」如果人們能如此牢記於心，他們將不會為悲傷所侵蝕，也不會被快樂沖昏頭。這就是我所謂來自於至上本源的「至上的稟性」。
