EN_TEXT: All the created objects are revolving around Puruśottama. Some are rotating at a greater distance with a long radius, and some are moving at a shorter distance with a short radius. The nature of the ideation and inherent saḿskáras of entities varies from one to another, and accordingly the physical structures of individual entities also vary. And all the entities with their respective mass and wonts are revolving around the nucleus. This movement continues as long as they think, “I and my Lord, I and the Universal Father are separate entities.” As soon as they think, “No, I and my Lord are not separate entities – just as the ocean and its drops of water are not separate entities. The drops of water are part of the ocean”-then they are no longer misguided. They rush towards Puruśottama and merge in Him.
ZH_TEXT: 萬有眾生均圍繞著著至上核心意識而旋轉。有些實體以較大的半徑繞著祂旋轉，有些實體則以較短的半徑。每個實體間因理念作用和業力性質的不同而彼此相異，也因身體結構的不同而有差別，隨著各自的結構和習性，各有其半徑繞著核心在旋轉著。只要此個體心中仍認為：「我和我的上主是分別獨立的個體。」這種行動就會一直持續下去，直到有一天他心想：「不！我和我的上主之間沒有任何差別。就像海洋和小水滴一般，它們不是分別獨立的個體。這一滴水是屬於海洋的一部分。」此時，他們就不會再被誤導了。於是他們奔向核心意識，並融入祂。

EN_TEXT: In order for someone to awaken or gradually increase their internal stamina one will have to engage in proper work as follows: Trńád api suniicena. A person should be more humble than a blade of grass. Grass is such an ordinary thing. People walk on grass and the grass endures it. However, that grass contains tremendous life force. Rather, grass has even more life force than human beings. How much strength do animals like cows and elephants get by eating grass! Yet this grass bears the neglect of human beings without showing any reaction. But here it does not say “as tolerant as grass”, but rather that human beings will have to acquire more tolerance than grass.
ZH_TEXT: 為了醒悟或逐漸增強內在心智的力量，一個人必須致力於如下：Trńádapi suniicena:人應比小草更謙虛。小草是如此平凡不起眼，人們踐踏其上，它亦無怨無悔承受之。然而，它卻具有無比強大的生命力，其生命力甚至比人類還要強韌。試想像牛、大象等動物靠著吃草獲得多麼大的力量啊！然而這樣的小草卻忍受人類的忽略而並無作出任何不滿的回應。雖然在此處並沒有說「如小草般堅忍」，但人類的確應該學習比小草還要能夠忍耐。

EN_TEXT: Bear in mind that you have a duty towards others, but that no one has any duty towards you. Everyoneʼs individual duty is fixed. Only one who move forward with this as his or her only thought can do proper service. Otherwise the thought may remain in the mind of the one doing service that I have done such and such work for that person, so that person ought to do such and such for me. The thought must remain in the mind of the one doing service that I have a duty towards others but no one has any duty towards me. Just as a tree serves and benefits everyone by giving shade, fruit, flowers and firewood without asking anything in return.
ZH_TEXT: 你要記得：你對他人有責任，但人家並沒有回饋你的義務。每個人都有一定的責任義務，一個人唯有心懷此念向前進，才能從事正確的服務，否則當人從事服務時，不免心裡常常盤旋著：「我為某某人做了什麼和什麼，所以他也應該回報我什麼和什麼。」的念頭。所以一個從事服務的人要牢記於心：「我對他人有責任，但沒有人該對我負任何責任。」 正如同大樹的服務，它予人庇蔭、果實、花朵和木柴，卻未曾向人要求任何回報。

EN_TEXT: Under no circumstances should anyone think that Parama Puruśa can remain far away from them, because He cannot remain away from His created beings at all-it is contrary to his very nature... The Supreme Entity is surely showering His grace on all, but those who hold the umbrella of ego on their heads cannot be drenched by the rains of His grace. What is sádhaná? Sádhaná is the systematic endeavour to remove this umbrella of ego from over oneʼs head.
ZH_TEXT: 在任何情況下，任何人皆不應認為至上意識離他們遙遠，因為祂如何能夠與祂所創造的眾生保持遙遠的距離呢？這違反祂的本性。……至上意識的確也有賜給他甘霖雨露，但卻因為他那把自負的傘使得他無法得到恩典的滋潤。靈性修持是什麼？就是有系統的努力將這把自負的傘從你頭上移開。

EN_TEXT: Those objects of preyas which are enjoyable by the unit mind, are fragmentary. Such attraction for fragmentary objects of pleasure is called káma or mundane longing. And the attraction for the integral One, for the Great “I”, is called Prema or Divine Love. The movement of káma is towards unit entities and hence it is extroversial; the movement of prema is towards the Soul, towards Supreme Peace, and thus it is introversial.
ZH_TEXT: 個體心靈享受的世俗快樂都極其破碎不全，對於此種破碎快樂的吸引稱為「世俗渴望」(káma);而對於整體大我的吸引，則稱為「神聖的愛」(Prema)。世俗渴望的行動朝向個體，所以是向外的；而神聖的愛朝向至上靈魂，朝向至上平靜，所以是向內的。

EN_TEXT: What do the wise people do? First, they judge within themselves with cool heads which is shreya and which is preya. The way of discrimination and judgment is to distinguish shreya from preya after close analysis. Humans are not inanimate but conscious beings. Their dominant feature is their mind with its power of judgment, and through this judgment, their intellect finds proper expression. It is not the way of human beings to run heedlessly after things regardless of whether they are shreya or preya; in every human action there should be the appreciable stamp of their intellect.
ZH_TEXT: 那麼明智者會怎麼做呢？首先，他們會以冷靜的頭腦明辨何者為「至上福祉」，何者為「世俗快樂」，經過仔細的分析後就很容易明白。人類並非無生命的存在，而是具有意識的生靈，最明顯的特徵即為他們的心靈具有真知明辨的能力，透過此種分辨的能力，他們的智力得到正確適當的表發。人類不該不加分別就去追逐任何事物，在人類的每一個行動裡，都應運用他們相當的智力。
IT_TEXT: Che cosa fanno le persone sagge? Anzitutto, dentro di sé, con mente lucida e sangue freddo, valutano che cosa sia shreya (il bene supremo, duraturo) e che cosa sia preya (il piacere immediato, la gratificazione temporanea). La via del discernimento e del giudizio consiste proprio nel distinguere, dopo un’analisi attenta, lo shreya dal preya. Gli esseri umani non sono entità inanimate, ma esseri coscienti. La loro caratteristica predominante è la mente, con la sua capacità di giudizio; ed è attraverso questo giudizio che l’intelletto trova la sua espressione appropriata. Non è proprio dell’essere umano correre sconsideratamente dietro alle cose, senza distinguere se siano shreya o preya; in ogni azione umana dovrebbe essere visibile l’apprezzabile impronta dell’intelletto.

EN_TEXT: Shreya and preya are totally divergent in principle – one is guided by vidyá or the introversive principle, the other, by avidyá or the extroversive principle; one leads to discrimination, the other to ignorance – one to light, the other to darkness. Pará-vdyá that leads to shreya guides people towards perfection, towards the ultimate state of desirelessness; and Apara-vidyá that leads to preya propels them into dense darkness, the thrall of ultimate negativity and crudeness.
ZH_TEXT: 至上福祉和世俗快樂在原則上是完全相反的，一個是由宇宙向心力量所引導，另一個則是由宇宙離心力量所引導；一個朝向真知明辨，一個則導向無知；一個趨向光明，一個走往黑暗。 朝向至上福祉的靈性真知(Pará-vdyá)導引人們圓滿，通往沒有欲望的終極之境。而帶領人們從事世俗享樂的世俗知識(Apara-vidyá)將他們推往黑暗的深淵，掉進全然負性及粗鈍的束縛裡。

EN_TEXT: Obstacles are the concomitants of sádhaná, struggling is a good sign. By these obstacles sádhakas can understand that their spiritual practice is on the right track. Spiritual philosophy comes into being only when sádhakas struggling with avidyáʼs hindrances, vindicates their move towards Brahma after defeating the base propensities of avidyá by their own intellect and judgment.
ZH_TEXT: 困難伴隨著靈性修持而來，所以掙扎奮戰是個好現象。因為這些困難的出現表示他們的靈修是在正確的軌道上。只有當靈性修持者與無明力量戰鬥，靈性哲學才得以產生，才證明他們藉由其智力及判斷力打敗了無明的卑劣習性，而朝向至上本體前進。
IT_TEXT: Gli ostacoli accompagnano inevitabilmente il sádhaná; il fatto stesso di dover lottare è un buon segno. Proprio attraverso questi ostacoli i sádhaka possono comprendere che la loro pratica spirituale sta procedendo nella direzione giusta. La filosofia spirituale nasce soltanto quando i sádhaka, affrontando gli ostacoli dell’avidyá, confermano il loro cammino verso Brahma, dopo aver vinto le tendenze inferiori dell’avidyá con il proprio intelletto e il proprio discernimento.

EN_TEXT: Brahma is the unarguable entity. He is beyond all arguments, for only an object which the mind can hold within its small compass can be the subject of argument. Your mind can comprehend such qualities like what is dark and what is fair, and thus you can also argue on such points. But regarding that Consciousness where your mind ceases to exist you certainly cannot say whether He is dark or fair. Brahma is unarguable, because He is beyond the ambit of mind.
ZH_TEXT: 至上意識是不容爭辯的實體，祂超越在所有的爭辯上；只有可以把持在心靈狹小範疇內的物體，才可成為爭論的目標。你的心靈能夠了解的，像什麼是黑暗、什麼是公平，這樣的東西，你才可能去辯論它，在你心靈不存在之處的至上意識，你當然無可置喙，不管祂是黑暗還是公平。至上意識不容爭辯，因為祂超越你心靈的範疇。

ZH_TEXT: 有情眾生的世界是至上意識的想像波流創造出來的。解脫眾生的至上意識(Taraka Brahma)其願力就是來解脫這些生命個體，但唯有那些想要得到解脫者方可獲得解脫。

EN_TEXT: This mystery is the drama of Parama Puruśa. Living beings are only characters in that drama. Human beings have come to this earth with a fixed role to play, and that role must be properly observed. One should always bear in mind that one is a character in this divine drama. And who is the author or composer of this drama? Táraka Brahma.
ZH_TEXT: 這裡頭似乎隱藏有某些特殊的奧秘，而此一奧秘正是至上意識的遊戲。有情眾生即是那齣戲劇的唯一角色。人類來到這世界扮演著某一固定的角色，而且必須正確扮演。人應永遠記住他們只是宇宙大戲中的一個演員。這齣戲劇的作者或導演是誰？就是解脫眾生的至上意識。

EN_TEXT: One should remember: We are only playing specific roles in a great drama. I will act properly according to the role I have been given in this drama. This is a personʼs duty. It is meaningless for a person to think about anything more than this – about what is beyond oneʼs power.
ZH_TEXT: 吾人當謹記：我們都只是在宇宙大戲中扮演某一特殊的角色，我將依照導演的安排盡心演好我所扮演的角色，此即人類的職責。多想無益，而且那些也超越我們所能想像的範疇。

EN_TEXT: How can one shake off the influence of static inertness? How can one get freedom from the bondages of names and forms? Just as the goldsmith uses a hammer and process of melting (in fire) to extract the real gold from the various ornaments, similarly a practical spiritual aspirant will have to break the bondages of names and forms in this expressed world through the cultivation of knowledge (which is mutative) and devotion (which is sentient). By virtue of the heat of the fire of sádhaná and the strength derived from sustained intuitional practice, a sádhaka can overcome the static inertness, the apparent cause behind the quinquelemental universe. Life and the world will become effulgent with the resultant unfoldment of latent consciousness.
ZH_TEXT: 如何才能擺脫惰性力量的影響呢？如何才能不受制於名相、形象的束縛呢？就像金匠使用鐵鎚和火將金飾品中的金子焠煉出來，靈性修持者一樣，必須透過知識的培養（此乃變性力量）、以及虔誠的心（此乃悅性力量），切斷婆娑世界一切名相、形象的束縛。經由靈性修持的熾熱烈焰和靈性直覺鍛鍊所得之力量，靈修者將克服惰性力量──造成五大原素背後的原因──的束縛，潛伏意識開展的結果，使得生命和世界洋溢著燦爛的光輝。
IT_TEXT: Come può una persona liberarsi dall’influenza dell’inerzia statica? Come può ottenere la libertà dai vincoli dei nomi e delle forme? Così come l’orefice utilizza il martello e il processo di fusione (nel fuoco) per estrarre l’oro puro dai vari ornamenti, allo stesso modo un aspirante spirituale pratico dovrà spezzare i vincoli dei nomi e delle forme in questo mondo manifesto attraverso lo sviluppo della conoscenza (che è mutativa) e della devozione (che è senziente). In virtù del calore del fuoco del sadhana e della forza derivata da una pratica intuizionale costante, un sādhaka può superare l’inerzia statica, la causa apparente dell’universo quinquelementale. La vita e il mondo diventeranno radiosi grazie al conseguente dispiegarsi della coscienza latente.

Human beings need Cosmic inspiration to motivate them to move forwards. Their psychic development is not possible through intimidation or by creating circumstantial pressure.
ZH_TEXT: 個體小宇宙透過與可怕的阻礙不斷奮戰而朝向至上生命的目標前行，這才是真法性。人類需要靠著來自宇宙的鼓舞動力前行，在脅迫或環境的壓力下，心智的擴展是不可能的。

EN_TEXT: Behind this playful stance of the Cosmic Entity lies His eternal immutable stance, which is a passive witness to the ever-changing forms of His Macropsychic manifestation. When devotees see His mutable forms with genuine spiritual vision they realize that they are already ensconced in His immutable stance. This is the state of supreme realization. In this state the miseries caused by the binding fetters vanish and the sádhakas become illuminated by the sweet touch of the playful, blissful, immutable Parama Puruśa. This is the supreme spiritual fulfilment.
ZH_TEXT: 在此宇宙本體多采多姿的展現背後，就是祂那永恆不變的境界，祂見證著大宇宙心智層各種形象變化的展現。當虔誠者能夠以真誠的靈性視野目證祂那所有的變化形象時，他們就知道自己已經立足於祂那永恆不變的境界裡了。這就是至上了悟的境界。在此境界，所有造成悲傷痛苦的束縛完全消失，靈修者在全然喜悅、嬉戲的、永恆不朽的至上意識甜美觸碰下，發出燦爛的光芒。此即為至上靈性的圓滿。

EN_TEXT: From the beginning every created being is situated in bliss. The very moment a newborn infant opens his eyes upon the world, he feels a type of bliss. The earthʼs light and air infuses a wondrous feeling of bliss in his mind. Not only a human child, every newborn being feels this certain type of bliss from the start.
ZH_TEXT: 每一個被創造出來的生命個體在一開始都是處於喜悅的狀態。新生的嬰兒在張開雙眼看見這個世界的當下，他第一個感覺是一種喜悅。地球的陽光和空氣在他的心靈裡注入一種奇妙的喜悅感受。不僅對人類的新生兒是如此，對任何新生命的誕生在一開始也都是這種感覺。
IT_TEXT: Fin dall’inizio ogni essere creato vive nella beatitudine. Nel preciso istante in cui un neonato apre gli occhi sul mondo, egli prova un certo tipo di beatitudine. La luce e l’aria della Terra infondono nella sua mente una sensazione meravigliosa di beatitudine. Non solo il bambino umano: ogni essere appena nato prova, fin dall’inizio, questo particolare tipo di beatitudine.

EN_TEXT: If the object of ideation, the object of meditation, has no boundary, what will happen? The unit mind will be converted into the Infinite Mind, that is, the microcosm will be transmuted into the Macrocosm... The simplest way to get cured of all psychic ailments is to use guru mantra while performing every action, every mundane duty.
ZH_TEXT: 如果觀想的目標、禪定的標的是無限的，那麼會是如何？個體心靈將被轉化為無限的大宇宙心靈，也就是說個體小宇宙會變成大宇宙心靈。…… 對治所有心理疾病的良方就是在你從事每一個行動、每一個世俗工作時使用古魯梵咒，這是最簡單的方法。
IT_TEXT: Se l’oggetto dell’ideazione, l’oggetto della meditazione, è senza limiti, che cosa accadrà? La mente individuale verrà trasformata nella Mente Infinita; cioè, il microcosmo sarà trasmutato nel Macrocosmo... Il modo più semplice per guarire da tutti i disturbi psichici è usare il guru mantra mentre si compie ogni azione, ogni dovere della vita quotidiana.

EN_TEXT: We are meditating so that He may guide our intellect and understanding along the path of righteousness. Let our intellect not be degraded, because if human beingsʼ intellect is all right then everything is all right. But if a personʼs intellect becomes degraded, then no matter how many qualities one has, everything becomes spoiled. So, as long as a person does not get the path of sádhaná, he or she should pray to god for one thing or the other. This prayer is called Vedic initiation.
ZH_TEXT: 我們觀想持念祂，因為祂可以引導我們的智力和悟性走上正確的道路。讓我們的智力不要墮落，因為只要人類的智力有正確的方向，那麼所有的事情都會導向正確。如果人類的智力墮落，則不論其人有多少特質，所有的一切均皆毀於一旦。所以，只要一個人尚未走上靈性修持的道路，他就應該向上帝要求一件事，這種祈禱即稱為「知識的啟蒙」。
IT_TEXT: Noi meditiamo affinché Egli possa guidare il nostro intelletto e la nostra comprensione lungo il sentiero della rettitudine. Il nostro intelletto non deve degradarsi, perché se l’intelletto degli esseri umani è a posto, allora tutto è a posto. Ma se l’intelletto di una persona si degrada, allora, per quante qualità essa possa avere, tutto si rovina. Perciò, finché una persona non trova il sentiero del sádhaná, dovrebbe pregare Dio per una cosa o per un’altra. Questa preghiera è chiamata iniziazione vedica.

EN_TEXT: The only prayer to Parama Puruśa is, “Let Him guide us for the attainment of supreme bliss.” This is termed as Vaedika diikśá. Tántrika diikśá gives direction for action in the physical, psychic and spiritual domains. Tántrika diikśá is not confined to mere prayers. Tántrika diikśá indicates the path of action, and helps one attain fulfilment through action.
ZH_TEXT: 對至上意識唯一的祈求應該是：請祂引導我們到達至上喜悅之境；這就是知識的啟蒙。密宗的啟蒙(Tántrika diikśá)則在身、心、靈各層面皆給予行動的導引，它不僅只是祈禱，它並且指出行動的道路，透過行動幫助修持者達到圓滿。
IT_TEXT: Nel commentare il Savitr ṛk, ho detto che il suo obiettivo principale è dhiyo no pracodayāt, cioè orientare il nostro intelletto e le nostre tendenze verso la Beatitudine suprema. Per questo motivo, l’unica vera preghiera rivolta a Parama Puruṣa è: «Che Egli guidi il nostro intelletto verso la Beatitudine suprema». Questo è ciò che viene chiamato dīkṣā vedica. La dīkṣā tantrica, invece, fornisce una direzione concreta per l’azione nei campi fisico, psichico e spirituale. Non si limita alla preghiera: indica un percorso pratico e conduce alla realizzazione attraverso l’azione stessa.

EN_TEXT: Human progress can take place in the material world or in aesthetic science. What is the speciality of this aesthetic science? When does aesthetic science become sweet and fascinating? It becomes so when internal psychic expressions move towards the supra-sensuous. It becomes crude in the absence of the supra-sensuous. But when there is dominance of the supra-sensuous, it establishes human beings in intuitive ideation (prajiṋábháva). When we cultivate a particular part or aspect of the science of music or aesthetic science, it is to be remembered that aesthetic science will have to be based on mysticism. What is mysticism? Mysticism is the never-ending endeavour to find out a link between the finite and the Infinite.
ZH_TEXT: 人類的進步可以發生在物質世界或在美學心理層面。此一美學心理的特點何在？它何時可以變得甜美又讓人陶醉？當內在心理的表達朝向超感官之境前進時，這種甜美醉人的特性就出現了。若非如此，它即變得粗鈍。當超越感官之境成為主導時，它使得人類立足於直覺理念波流的境界(prajinábháva)。當我們培育音樂或任何美學素養時，一定要記得美學的基礎在於神秘學。神秘學是什麼？神秘學就是一種企圖連結有限與無限的永恆努力。

EN_TEXT: In case of a person who experiences such obstacles to a lesser degree, the kalá is not properly transformed into káśt́há. At that moment, obstacles are a great necessity. Obstacles should appear. One should invite obstacles. What is the benefit if obstacles come along the path? The transformation of kalá [sysltaltic flow] into káśt́há [linear flow] will be accelerated. Obstacles will appear in personal life, in the collective life, in social life, in all spheres of human life. Obstacles need to come and are desirable. If you struggle against obstacles, you will stand to gain and will never lose. That is why obstacles are to be considered as friends.
ZH_TEXT: 當一個人曲度波流的變化尚未能正確地轉化為較直的波流時，此時障礙對他而言就是必要的，困難應該要一再地出現，他應該要歡迎這些障礙的到來。來到道上的困難和障礙帶來何等益處呢？能讓曲度波流加快變直。困難在個人生命中會出現，在集體生活也會出現，在社會生活中一樣出現，在人類生活的每一層面它都會出現。阻礙必須出現而且它應受到歡迎。如果你一直在與困境奮鬥，那麼你只會有所得，絕對不會有所失。所以要把困難當成是你的朋友。

EN_TEXT: Human beings must always try and adjust their own microcosm with the Macrocosmic blendings. The microcosms will have to move with accelerating speed towards the Supreme Entity – towards the non-manifest supreme rays. In this endeavour, human beings are bound to be successful if they try. If human beings make proper effort, they must succeed, they will have to succeed, because their ectoplasmic entity and endoplasmic coverage are both influenced by microvita.
ZH_TEXT: 人類必須始終以他們的小宇宙嘗試著與大宇宙混成協調。小宇宙必須以加速度朝向至上的本體前進──向不顯現的至上光芒前進。只要他們試著以如此的努力去做，必定可成功。如果人們施以正確的努力，他們一定能成功，必得成功；因為他們的心質體與心質被覆蓋兩者，都受到微生元的影響。
IT_TEXT: Gli esseri umani devono sempre cercare di armonizzare il proprio microcosmo con le combinazioni macrocosmiche. I microcosmi dovranno avanzare con velocità crescente verso l’Entità Suprema – verso i raggi supremi non manifesti. In questo sforzo, gli esseri umani sono destinati al successo se realmente si impegnano. Se compiono lo sforzo adeguato, devono riuscire, riusciranno, perché la loro entità ectoplasmatica e il loro rivestimento endoplasmatico sono entrambi influenzati dai microvita.
CITATION_EN: Shrii Shrii Ánandamúrti | 14 April 1988, Kolkata | 12 Sidereal Year | Microvitum in a Nutshell
CITATION_ZH: Shrii Shrii Ánandamúrti | 1988年4月14日於加爾各答 | 11 恆星年 | 微生元概要

EN_TEXT: The more that government revenue is spent on developmental programmes – not including the salaries of government employees – the better it is for the countryʼs economy. This policy will render great service to the masses and lead to increasing socio-economic development. As a result of the constant circulation of capital, national wealth will increase. While the government must think about the bare necessities of government employees, increasing the salaries of government employees by reducing the amount of money spent on public services can never be supported. The more that money is invested in developmental programmes, the better it is.
ZH_TEXT: 政府的歲入花在發展計劃上的愈多（這不包括政府雇員的薪水），對於國家的經濟就愈好。此一政策對於大眾服務良多，並能不斷增加社會經濟的發展，因為資金不斷流通，國家財富就會增加。儘管政府一定要照顧到政府雇員的基本需求，但以減少公眾服務上的支出來增加政府雇員的薪水，是行不通的。投資在發展計劃上的錢愈多，結果會愈好。
IT_TEXT: Quanto maggiore è la quota delle entrate governative destinata ai programmi di sviluppo – escludendo gli stipendi dei dipendenti pubblici – tanto migliore sarà la situazione per l’economia del paese. Questa politica renderà un grande servizio alle masse e condurrà a un crescente sviluppo socio-economico. Come risultato della costante circolazione del capitale, la ricchezza nazionale aumenterà. Sebbene il governo debba provvedere ai bisogni essenziali dei dipendenti pubblici, non si può in alcun modo sostenere un aumento dei loro stipendi ottenuto riducendo le risorse destinate ai servizi pubblici. Quanto più denaro viene investito nei programmi di sviluppo, tanto meglio è.
CITATION_EN: Shrii Shrii Ánandamúrti | 17 April 1988, Kolkata | 28 Developmental Programmes | Proutist Economics
CITATION_ZH: Shrii Shrii Ánandamúrti | 1988年4月17日於加爾各答 | 28 發展計劃 | 進用論經濟學

EN_TEXT: To realize His manifestation in the vast sky of your inner mind you will have to make your mental plate absolutely clean and spotless through the process of sádhaná. In this process of mental purification you will experience that the Supreme Entity has come within your inner mind (buddhitattva) and has established His contact with the inner core of your heart. Remember that He is only attainable through ideation.
ZH_TEXT: 為了在你內在心靈廣闊的天空了悟他的展現，你必須透過靈性修持去除心智板上所有的塵垢。在心智淨化的過程中，你將體驗到至上本體來到你的內在心（我覺），並且與你内在核心緊密相連。你必須牢記於心：唯有透過心中對祂的持念才能得到祂。
CITATION_EN: Caetra Púrńimá 1957 DMC, Nathnagar, Bhagalpur | Form and Formless | Subháśita Saḿgraha Part 5
CITATION_ZH: 1957年4月18日於巴加爾布爾納斯納加爾 | 形象與無形無相 | 靈性科學集成卷5，P.104

EN_TEXT: How does the individual move ahead? There is Hari on one side and Hara on the other. On the one side there is progress; on the other side there is destruction. While Hara symbolizes destruction, Hari symbolizes creation. The world moves on through the clash of Hari and Hara (Hariharátmaka). A small and beautiful bud appears on a plant.The flower blooms, unfolds itself completely. Till now, there is the sport of Hari. Thereafter the play of Hara begins. The petals wither and fall off, one after the other. As there is creation on the one hand, destruction awaits on the other. Sometimes we die and sometimes we live. The individual has to move ahead through struggles. One has nothing to fear. Why should one fear death? People have to attain immortality by waging war against death. This is our sádhaná.
ZH_TEXT: 個體要如何向前邁進？一邊是哈里(Hari)，另一邊是哈拉(Hara)。一邊是進步，一邊是毀滅。當「哈拉」代表毀滅時，「哈里」就代表著創造。這世界不斷在創造和毀滅的摩擦衝擊中向前進(hariharátmaka)。一株植物上一朵小小的花苞正要綻放，而後花朵盛開將自身完全展現，目前為止是哈里的創造遊戲。哈拉的毀滅遊戲繼而開始，花瓣淍落，花兒謝了。由於這一頭正行創造，另一頭毀滅即行等待。有時我們生，有時我們死，個體生命必須透過不斷的奮戰向前進，吾人無需恐懼。我們為什麼要害怕死亡呢？人們必須與死亡奮戰以成就不朽，這就是我們的靈性修持。

EN_TEXT: We stand to create a powerful, dynamic and upsurging social consciousness, especially among women, so that they are inspired to rise, abolish dogma and annihilate all symbols of slavery, and usher in a new era of coordinated cooperation and glorious achievement. Let women be the vanguard of a new revolution which humanity must achieve for a glorious tomorrow.
ZH_TEXT: 我們主張創造一個有力的、活潑的、向上提升的社會意識，尤其是在婦女之間，以鼓舞她們上進；廢除教條，棄絕所有奴隸的象徵，以引進一個協調合作與光榮成就的新紀元。為了達到人類明日的榮光，讓婦女成為新革命的先鋒吧！

EN_TEXT: Each and every man, each and every individual, should make maximum utilization of his self. That is, one must not waste a single second in developing his intellectual capacity, intellectual potentiality and spiritual potentiality.
ZH_TEXT: 每個人都應該把自己做最大的利用。也就是說，時時刻刻都沒有浪費，時時刻刻都在培養自己的心智能力、心智潛能、靈性潛能。

EN_TEXT: Now, wherever there is any expression or wherever there is no expression, the Witnessing Entity is there, just like the light of a stage, a theatrical stage. When there is an actor, the light is there, witnessing the activities of the actor. The actor says something, recites something, and the light of the stage witnesses the activities of that particular actor. And when a singer comes, that light witnesses the activities of the singer. A dancer comes, and that very light witnesses the activities of the dancer. And when nobody is present – no actor, no dancer, no singer – the light, that very light, witnesses that “Nobody is present here now.” It expresses the fact before the audience, before the spectators, that there is nobody on the stage. Similarly, where there is expression, that Cosmic Light, that Cosmic Father, is there. And where there is no expression, the Father is there to say that nobody is present now – just like that light of the theatrical stage.
ZH_TEXT: 不管有無任何展現、表達，那目證的本體一直都存在著，就像戲院舞台上的燈光。當舞台上的演員在演出時，就有燈光照著他，目睹著他所有的活動。無論他是說話、吟誦，舞台上的燈光都目證著那位演員所做的一切。當換成歌唱家走上舞台時，那燈光就目證著那位歌唱家的活動。再換成舞蹈家進場，同樣的燈光依舊目證著那位舞蹈家的活動。而當台上沒有任何人，沒有演員、沒有舞者、沒有歌者在舞台上時，那同樣的燈光即目證著「現在沒有任何人在場」。它在聽眾面前，在觀眾面前展現一個事實，就是舞台上沒有任何人。同樣的，當有任何展現時，宇宙的光源，宇宙之父就在那兒。當沒有任何展現時，至上之父依然在那兒表示「現在沒有人出現」—就像戲院舞台上的燈光一樣。
CITATION_EN: Shrii Shrii Ánandamúrti | 22 April 1969, Manila | 12 Stages of Samádhi | Ánanda Vacanámrtam Part 23

EN_TEXT: Whatever you do, repeat your Guru mantra in your mind. In other words, while doing your work take the name of Parama Puruśa so that your action will be sanctified. If you find that you are not in a position to do anything else, then sing kiirtana loudly. In this way you will always remain close to Lord. What do you gain by doing kiirtana? Several sense organs become engaged. The tongue is occupied. So during that time you wonʼt have thoughts like, “I will eat this, eat that;” no kind of greed will remain. The sense of taste and taste buds are obstructed. The ears are busy hearing the kiirtana, so they have no scope to go elsewhere. The mind is always thinking of that, so it also has no scope to go elsewhere. And if kiirtana is combined with dance then oneʼs attention is directed to the rhythm of the dance. As a result of the dance, hormones are secreted from the glands. So under no circumstances can the mind degenerate. There is no way for it to go down. This is the way of the wise.
ZH_TEXT: 無論你做何事，都要記得在心裡複誦你的「古魯梵咒」，換言之，在工作時記得持念至上意識的名字，如此你的行為將神聖化。倘若你發現自己無所事事，那麼大聲高唱至上的聖名(kiirtana)。這樣你將永遠與上主緊密相繫。 從事「至上聖名的唱頌」(kiirtana)所得為何？因為在唱頌時，你同時讓許多感官都沉浸於此，舌頭因為忙著唱頌，所以沒有空閒去想：「我要吃這個、吃那個。」味覺和味蕾被阻斷，不會起貪念；耳朵因為聆聽唱頌，也不會有閒暇去聽其他的東西。心靈也是一直沉浸於至上聖名的唱頌之中，所以也不會往四處亂跑。如果唱頌至上聖名又加上靈性舞蹈，則一個人的注意力將放在舞蹈的韻律節奏上。跳靈性之舞的結果，使得腺體分泌荷爾蒙。故無論從哪一個角度而言，心靈都不可能會墮落，它沒有墮落的機會，此乃最明智的方法。
IT_TEXT: Qualunque cosa facciate, ripetete mentalmente il vostro Guru mantra. In altre parole, mentre svolgete il vostro lavoro prendete il nome di Parama Puruśa, affinché la vostra azione venga santificata. Se vi accorgete di non essere in grado di fare altro, allora cantate kiirtana ad alta voce. In questo modo rimarrete sempre vicini al Signore. Che cosa si ottiene facendo kiirtana? Diversi organi di senso vengono impegnati. La lingua è occupata, e quindi in quel momento non sorgeranno pensieri come: «Mangerò questo, mangerò quello»; e ogni impulso di appetito scomparirà. Il senso del gusto e le papille gustative vengono neutralizzati. Le orecchie sono occupate ad ascoltare il kiirtana, perciò non hanno alcuna possibilità di rivolgersi altrove. La mente è costantemente impegnata a pensare a quello, e quindi anche per essa non c’è spazio per vagare altrove. Se poi il kiirtana è accompagnato dalla danza, l’attenzione viene diretta anche al ritmo della danza. Come risultato della danza, le ghiandole secernono ormoni. Così, in nessuna circostanza la mente può degenerare. Non c’è alcuna possibilità che scenda verso il basso. Questo è il modo dei saggi.
CITATION_EN: Shrii Shrii Ánandamúrti | 22 April 1979, Kolkata | 09 The Supreme Entity – the Non-Doer | Ánanda Vacanámrtam Part 10
CITATION_ZH: Shrii Shrii Ánandamúrti | 1979年4月22日於加爾各答 | 21 宇宙意識非行為者 | 喜悅甘露集 卷5，P.186

EN_TEXT: One has to transcend the cycle of actions and reactions. One must desist from wrong actions. “I will restrain myself from unrighteous actions. I shall not do anything unjust, come what may. I shall fight against evil. I shall fold my hands before a righteous person.” This is the lifestyle of a righteous person. “I shall be vociferous against injustice and shall remain humble before a righteous individual. I shall commit no evil. I shall do as much good as possible, and while doing so, I shall tell Parama Puruśa at every step that I desire no reward and want nothing auspicious, in return for my good deeds. Let these be Yours.”
ZH_TEXT: 人必須超越作用力與反作用力的循環，人必須不再造惡：「我要克制自己不做壞事，不管處境為何，皆不再從事任何不義之事，我要與邪惡奮戰到底。在正義之士前合掌致敬。」此為正直之人當有之生活方式。「向不公不義之人宣戰、對正義之士謙恭，努力行善不為惡；同時在走每一步路時，都向至上意識表白：自己無意於得到任何好的回報，願所有善行的福報皆歸於祂！」
IT_TEXT: Bisogna trascendere il ciclo delle azioni e delle reazioni. È necessario astenersi dalle azioni sbagliate. «Mi tratterrò dalle azioni ingiuste. Non compirò nulla di ingiusto, qualunque cosa accada. Combatterò contro il male. Unirò le mani in segno di rispetto davanti a una persona retta.» Questo è lo stile di vita di una persona giusta. «Sarò fermo e deciso contro l’ingiustizia e rimarrò umile davanti a una persona retta. Non compirò alcun male. Farò quanto più bene possibile e, nel farlo, dirò a ogni passo a Parama Puruśa che non desidero alcuna ricompensa né alcun beneficio, in cambio delle mie buone azioni. Che tutto questo sia Tuo.»

CITATION_ZH: Shrii Shrii Ánandamúrti | 1979年4月23日於加爾各答 | 22 至上本體是全然的見證者 | 喜悅甘露集 卷5

EN_TEXT: A person can easily become omniscient. How can a living creature, a living being, be omniscient? The secret is, if you want to know all, know one. And that one is your own “I”. And if you want to know everything, if you try to know everything, you will not be able to know anything.
ZH_TEXT: 人可以輕易變得無所不知──一個活著的凡人，怎能無所不知呢？秘訣在於：若你想了知一切，先認識「一」，此「一」即你自己這個「我」。如你欲曉萬事、試解萬物，你將一無所知。

EN_TEXT: The mind has two main qualities – thinking and recollection. Both these qualities deteriorate in the absence of exercise of those glands, and there is no process for restoring them. Considering all this – considering the location of the glands, and the effect of chandas and mudrás – Shiva invented a unique and perfect dance: táńd́ava. As long as a dancer remains above the ground, he derives much benefit; when he touches the ground, then those benefits are assimilated by the body.
ZH_TEXT: 心靈有兩大主要特質──思考和回憶。此二種特質在腺體沒有適當的作用下即逐漸退化，同時無法恢復。希瓦顧及這所有一切，也考慮到腺體所在的位置，以及音樂曲調和身印姿勢的影響等諸多因素，而發明了一種獨特且完美的舞蹈──勇士舞(táńd́ava)。舞者只要持續保持騰躍在地面之上，他即獲益匪淺，一旦他接觸到地面，則那些好處就會被身體吸收。
IT_TEXT: La mente possiede due qualità principali: il pensiero e la memoria. Entrambe queste qualità si deteriorano in mancanza dell’esercizio di quelle ghiandole, e non esiste alcun processo per ripristinarle. Tenendo conto di tutto questo – considerando la posizione delle ghiandole e l’effetto dei chanda e dei mudrá – Shiva ideò una danza unica e perfetta: il tándava. Finché il danzatore rimane sollevato da terra, trae grandi benefici; quando invece tocca il suolo, tali benefici vengono assimilati dal corpo.

EN_TEXT: What is the correct way to surrender? Prayer? Asking God for this and for that? There the responsibility for what you ask is yours – you might ask for something very inferior, although you approach the All-Powerful for it. The best prayer therefore is, “O Lord, do whatever You think fit and best for me. I do not know in which way lies my good – You know.” There was a demon who prayed that he might die neither during day nor during night. God granted the prayer and he was killed at sunset – twilight. Do not be foolish like this. As long as you pray, you are not surrendering, for you are requesting something for yourself. You are looking after yourself. True surrender is only looking after That.
ZH_TEXT: 什麼是「誠服」的正確方法？禱告？祈求上主賜予這個或那個？你必須為自己所求負責，儘管你向全能的主祈求，但你所求的卻可能極為渺小。因此，最好的祈禱應是：「哦，主啊！做任何您認為對我最適當的安排吧！我不知道什麼才是對我最好的，只有您才知道。」 曾經有一個惡魔向上主祈求，讓他不要死於白天和夜晚，上主答應了他，最後他死於傍晚黃昏時。各位不要像他一般愚蠢，做這種祈求。當你有所求之時，你就尚未誠服，因為你仍為了自己，還顧著自己。真正的誠服，目光所及的只有那個「祂」。
IT_TEXT: Qual è il modo corretto di arrendersi? Pregare? Chiedere a Dio questo o quello? In tal caso, la responsabilità di ciò che chiedi è tua: potresti chiedere qualcosa di molto inferiore, pur rivolgendo la tua richiesta all’Onnipotente. La preghiera migliore è dunque: «O Signore, fa’ ciò che ritieni giusto e migliore per me. Io non so dove risieda il mio vero bene – Tu lo sai.» C’era un demone che pregò di non morire né di giorno né di notte. Dio esaudì la sua richiesta, ed egli fu ucciso al tramonto – nel crepuscolo. Non essere stolto in questo modo. Finché preghi, non ti stai arrendendo, perché stai chiedendo qualcosa per te stesso. Ti stai prendendo cura di te. La vera resa consiste solo nel prendersi cura di Quello.
CITATION_EN: Shrii Shrii Ánandamúrti | 26 April 1969, Manila | 45 Surrender | Discourses on Krśńa and the Giitá
CITATION_ZH: Shrii Shrii Ánandamúrti | 1969年4月26日於馬尼拉 | 45 臣服（誠服） | 生命的真諦‧薄伽梵歌

EN_TEXT: This universe of ours is not absolute truth – it is only a relative truth. So the wise should try to know the absolute truth. But simultaneously it is also desirable that while striving to realize the Supreme Entity one should maintain an adjustment with this relative world. While doing oneʼs duties properly with the application of madhuvidyá one can achieve permanent cessation of afflictions from this relative world. Then all the entities of this world will be as sweet as honey for the spiritual aspirant. One should follow the dictum, “Hearts to God and hands to work”. Sádhakas should proceed to the supreme goal with slow but steady steps with bliss within. They must do their duties in the physical world without attachment.
ZH_TEXT: 我們的這個宇宙不是絕對的真實，而只是相對的真實。智者應努力去了解那絕對的真實。但是當一個人努力去了悟至上本體的同時，也應與此相對的世界保持調適。當我們從事自己的職責，適當地運用視萬物皆為至上顯現的宇宙理念時，即能永遠地停止此相對世界的苦難。那麼對於修行者而言，此世界的所有實體將甜美如蜜。一個人應遵守「心向上帝，手做工作」的格言。靈修者應心懷喜悅以緩慢穩定的步伐走向至上的目標。他們應以無執著之心在此物質的世界盡其義務。

EN_TEXT: This universe of ours is not absolute truth – it is only a relative truth. So the wise should try to know the absolute truth. But simultaneously it is also desirable that while striving to realize the Supreme Entity one should maintain an adjustment with this relative world. While doing oneʼs duties properly with the application of madhuvidyá one can achieve permanent cessation of afflictions from this relative world. Then all the entities of this world will be as sweet as honey for the spiritual aspirant. One should follow the dictum, “Hearts to God and hands to work”. Sádhakas should proceed to the supreme goal with slow but steady steps with bliss within. They must do their duties in the physical world without attachment.
ZH_TEXT: 我們的這個宇宙不是絕對的真實，而只是相對的真實。智者應努力去了解那絕對的真實。但是當一個人努力去了悟至上本體的同時，也應與此相對的世界保持調適。當我們從事自己的職責，適當地運用視萬物皆為至上顯現的宇宙理念時，即能永遠地停止此相對世界的苦難。那麼對於修行者而言，此世界的所有實體將甜美如蜜。一個人應遵守「心向上帝，手做工作」的格言。靈修者應心懷喜悅以緩慢穩定的步伐走向至上的目標。他們應以無執著之心在此物質的世界盡其義務。

EN_TEXT: The true identity of a human being is that he or she is the progeny of Parama Puruśa, and will always be. If the same person is merely looked upon as an insignificant, weak and frail human being, it would be demeaning. Human beings are entitled to the transcendental world beyond the realm of the senses. Thus, human beings must not remain oblivious of that transcendental world while caught up in the relative world of trials and tribulations. They must advance towards the spiritual goals.
ZH_TEXT: 人類的真正身分是至上意識的子女，而且永遠如此。如果他們只被視為微不足道、軟弱且意志不堅的人類，那將是自貶身分；人類有權力超越感官的國度到達超覺的世界。當他們陷入苦難的相對世界時，他們不應忽略那個超覺的世界，他們必須朝向靈性的目標前進。
IT_TEXT: La vera identità dell’essere umano è che egli o ella è progenie di Parama Puruśa, e lo sarà sempre. Se la stessa persona viene considerata soltanto come un essere umano insignificante, debole e fragile, ciò costituisce una svalutazione. Gli esseri umani hanno diritto al mondo trascendentale al di là della sfera dei sensi. Pertanto, gli esseri umani non devono rimanere inconsapevoli di quel mondo trascendentale mentre sono immersi nel mondo relativo delle prove e delle tribolazioni. Devono avanzare verso le mete spirituali.

EN_TEXT: The constant pursuit of intellectuality leads one to its furthest point, the place where intuition begins. Hence in the realm of spiritual practice, it is immensely helpful. The path of sádhaná is not devoid of intellect or intuition; rather it is based on intuition. It gives no scope for superstition or blind faith. Instead it facilitates the maximum all-round progress of humanity and the manifestation of the highest human excellence.
ZH_TEXT: 不斷的追求知性，將引導一個人走向它的最遠點，亦即直覺的起點，因此在靈性修持的領域裡，這是非常有助益的。靈性修持的道路並不是沒有聰明智慧或直覺，相反的還以直覺為基礎。它非但沒有迷信或盲從，同時還能促成人類全面且極致的進步及人類最殊勝處的展現。
IT_TEXT: La costante ricerca dell’intellettualità conduce l’essere umano al suo punto più estremo, là dove ha inizio l’intuizione. Per questo, nell’ambito della pratica spirituale, essa è di immenso aiuto. Il cammino del sadhana non esclude né l’intelletto né l’intuizione; ma il suo fondamento è l’intuizione. Non lascia spazio alla superstizione né alla fede cieca. Favorisce invece il massimo progresso globale dell’umanità e la manifestazione della più alta eccellenza umana.

EN_TEXT: When people become tired and uninspired, when they can no longer look towards the future with hope, when their colourful dreams are shattered, at that time the sweetness of a festival brings new joy and vigour in life. Thus in individual and collective life, the importance of festivals is tremendous. One should always remember that festivals should be such that all can take part in them without any ostentatious display of wealth, and with an upsurge of their life force. And these festivals should be conducted in such a way that people take part in them from a spontaneous inner urge. I hope that you will make such arrangements so that all are attracted towards your festivals which will be more and more charming – and this will bring about your collective welfare.
ZH_TEXT: 當人們覺得疲乏了、沒有任何鼓舞的力量，當他們對未來不再有希望，所有彩虹般的夢想已破碎，此時一種激勵人心、迎向新生命的甜美慶典活動將為生命帶來新的喜悅和活力。因此不管對個人生命或是群體生命而言，活動的重要是不在話下的。人人應牢記，無論是誰皆應帶著氣宇軒昂的生命力，而不應為炫耀財富而參與此等活動。並且應該舉行一些讓人們內在有強烈的渴望，願意自動自發來參加的活動。我期許各位能夠舉辦這樣的活動，那麼所有的人都將為你們的活動吸引，這些活動也將愈辦愈出色、更有吸引力，這將為眾生帶來群體的福祉。

EN_TEXT: The vastness of the universe is due to the five fundamental factors. If the liquid factor was withdrawn from this universe, it would be one thousand times smaller than its present size. If the luminous and aerial factors were withdrawn from that universe, it would be a thousand times smaller than a mustard seed. And if the ethereal factor was withdrawn from the remaining portion a small point would remain having a certain position but no magnitude. So, the vast universe is in reality, nothing but a point. The Supreme Entity, in His imaginative flow, has attached the five fundamental factors to this tiny point to create the vast universe. During sádhaná, the mind has got to be one-pointed. That point is the silver line between the relative world and the absolute world. Hence, in the course of sádhaná, when a sádhaka achieves full control over objects (an object is nothing but a collection of inferential vibrations) he or she is said to have attained “tanmátrika samádhi”.
ZH_TEXT: 此浩瀚的宇宙來自於五種基本原素。如果液體原素從宇宙中被回收，那麼宇宙將比目前小一千倍。如果光與氣原素也被回收，那麼宇宙將比一粒芥子還小一千倍。又如果將乙太原素從剩餘的部分回收，那麼所留下來的將只是一個小點，佔有一個位置，但是沒有大小。所以浩瀚的宇宙事實上僅為一個小點。至上本體在其想像的波流中，將此五種基本原素附加至此小點上，而創造出廣大的宇宙。在從事靈修靜坐時，心靈必須成為一點。該點是相對世界與絕對世界之間的銀線。在靜坐的過程中，當靈性修持者達到完全地控制物體（物體只不過是微波原素波動的集合）時，他即是達到微波元素的三摩地。

EN_TEXT: Sometimes innocent people may be subjected to severe punishment because wrong information appeared in the documents and records concerned with their trials. EN_TEXT: The human body is a biological machine. No body deviates from this rule – all physical bodies are biological machines. ZH_TEXT: 只要得到些微至上神聖的恩典，自我感便從粗鈍的肉身消失，對永恆和短暫的分別明辨被喚醒，此真知明辨的力量將修行者置身在至上意識裡。要牢記於心，在靜坐的道路上，虔誠是最重要的因素，有虔誠之處就有上主的恩典，這是必然的。

EN_TEXT: When a microcosm reaches a stage of expanded consciousness, having made considerable psychic progress due to natural clashes or due to contact with more-developed minds, and is able to control the psychic propensities as opposed to being subservient to them, it is called manuśya [human being]. The term manuśya, or mánuśa, means “mind-preponderant being”. With the development of the mind, the physical structure becomes more complex. It can be put in another way: the physical structure grows in complexity in order to serve as a proper vehicle for the expression of a developed mind. When the psychic activities are channelized in different directions or engaged in combatting various obstacles, the brain, the medium of the mind, is bound to become more complex.
ZH_TEXT: 小宇宙個體由於自然的衝擊或與進化較快的心靈接觸，而使其心靈獲致相當的進步，當達到意識擴展的階段，且能夠控制而不屈從於心靈情緒傾向的作用時，即稱為人類。人類(manuśya或mánuśa)一詞意指「以心靈為主導的生物」。 隨著心靈的發展，身體構造變得更複雜。換言之：身體構造變複雜是為了作為已進化心靈表達之適當工具。當心靈活動導向不同的方向或與各種障礙搏鬥時，心靈媒介之大腦也必定會變得更複雜。
IT_TEXT: Quando un microcosmo raggiunge uno stadio di coscienza espansa — dopo aver compiuto notevoli progressi psichici grazie ai normali conflitti evolutivi o al contatto con menti più evolute — e riesce a dominare le proprie tendenze mentali invece di esserne dominato, allora viene chiamato manuśya [essere umano]. Il termine manuśya (o mānusa) significa infatti “essere in cui prevale la mente”. Con lo sviluppo del pensiero, anche la struttura fisica diventa più complessa. In altre parole, l’organismo si evolve per diventare un veicolo adeguato all’espressione di una mente più sviluppata. Quando le attività psichiche vengono indirizzate in molteplici direzioni o impegnate nel fronteggiare vari ostacoli, il cervello — il mezzo della mente — è necessariamente portato a diventare più complesso.

EN_TEXT: What is the source of inspiration of the individualʼs efforts to convert crude energy into subtle energy? In this case the Cognitive Faculty is the source of inspiration. The Cognitive Force manifests itself as Bhaeravii Shakti to expedite the evolution of mind. The will to evolve is primarily dependent on the active role of Bhaeravii Shakti. In fact Bhaeravii Shakti is oneʼs real “I”.
ZH_TEXT: 如何激勵一個人將其粗鈍的能量轉變為精細的能量？此處激勵的來源就是至上認知的能力。至上認知力以拜拉維力量(Bhaeravii Shakti)將自己顯現出來，以加速心靈的進化。想要進化的心念主要依賴活躍的拜拉維力量。事實上，拜拉維力量就是一個人真正的「我」。

EN_TEXT: One should undergo penance for othersʼ welfare, for the well-being of the world; and the good that the world enjoys due to oneʼs sacrifice is the reward. One should not expect any reward greater than this. The good result of a good action is the reward of that action. Similarly the bad result of a bad deed is the negative price of that action.
ZH_TEXT: 我們應為他人的福祉，為世界的福祉而苦行。由於你的犧牲奉獻而讓世界享有美好的結果，這就是回報。除此之外，你不該期望別的。好的結果就是善行本身的報償；壞的結果就是惡行負面的代價。

EN_TEXT: Human beings have come onto this earth to do something good, some thing which will be of some benefit for the society for at least some period of time, if not forever. This is the reason why Vivekananda said, “As you have come to the world, you must leave some mark behind”.
ZH_TEXT: 人類來到這個世界，為的是做一些好事，就算這些好事不能永遠利益這個社會，至少在某段時間內是有益的。這就是為什麼維威卡難陀說：「既然你已來到人世，就應該為世人留下一些東西。」

EN_TEXT: The practice of yoga should be such that it will bring people in contact with the Lord. Yoga practitioners should practice those processes that lead to the different stages of yoga: sálokya, sámiipya, sáyujya, sárśt́hi, kaevalya, etc. That is good both for the society as well as for the individuals concerned. But if one does not advance spiritually and yet one practices Práńáyáma for hours together, it does good neither to the individual nor to the society. The goal of all spiritual endeavour is Parama Puruśa. So whatever we do, we must do keeping Parama Puruśa fixed before our eyes – we must not do anything forgetting Him.
ZH_TEXT: 瑜伽的鍛鍊應該是要讓人能與至上接觸。修行者應鍛鍊能達到下列各境界的瑜伽修持法：「與上主同在」(sálokya)、「與上主有親密覺受」(sámiipya)、「與上主有親密接觸」(sáyujya)、「我就是祂」(sárśt́hi)、「唯一之境」(kaevalya)等。這樣的瑜伽鍛鍊才會對個人及社會都有益處。倘若一個人長時間鍛鍊呼吸控制法，但靈性卻無絲毫進步，那麼對個人和社會都沒有好處。所有靈性修持的努力都是為了至上意識，所以不管我們做什麼，一定要將至上意識置於眼前，片刻也不能將祂忘記。
IT_TEXT: La pratica dello yoga dovrebbe essere tale da mettere le persone in contatto con il Signore. I praticanti dello yoga dovrebbero seguire quei processi che conducono ai diversi stadi dello yoga: sálokya, sámípya, sáyujya, sárśt́hi, kaevalya, eccetera. Questo è benefico sia per la società sia per gli individui coinvolti. Ma se una persona non avanza spiritualmente e tuttavia pratica il práńáyáma per ore e ore, ciò non porta beneficio né all’individuo né alla società. La meta di ogni sforzo spirituale è Parama Puruśa. Perciò, qualunque cosa facciamo, dobbiamo farla mantenendo Parama Puruśa fisso davanti ai nostri occhi – non dobbiamo fare nulla dimenticandoLo.

EN_TEXT: There are some people who think that if they simply ideate on Parama Puruśa daily for some time, then their purpose will be served. But this is not enough. Yes, when you think of Parama Puruśa for some time you will no doubt remain elevated for that period; but when you again become engrossed in your mundane duties you will again become stepped in mire. Who will save you at that time? In each and every action you will have to try to realize the Supreme Entity; then and only then will those actions not be binding. Otherwise, every action will become the cause of great bondage.
ZH_TEXT: 還有一些人認為每一天只要花些時間冥想至上意識，就可以達到至上意識。但這是不夠的。的確，當你冥想至上意識的那段時間，你的心靈毫無疑問是提升的，但是當你回來從事世俗工作時，你又再度陷入泥沼中。那時誰來救你呢？所以，你在每一個行為上，都必須努力去了悟至上意識，唯有如此，你所從事的行為才不會為你帶來束縛，否則，你的每個行為都將只會造成更大的束縛。

And secondly, while maintaining a balance, they should attach importance to every action, considering it to be an action of Parama Puruśa. Thirdly, people should always remember that they have come onto this earth to discharge some God-given duties – that they are merely tools in the hands of the Supreme.
ZH_TEXT: 什麼是人類理想的行為準則？首先，人們必須維持世俗生活和靈性生活間的平衡；其次，每一個行動都應予以同等重視，也就是把一切都視為是至上意識的作為。第三，人應該要記住自己來此塵世，是為了完成上主所賦予的任務，他們只是上主手中的工具。

EN_TEXT: Now, what should be the ideal code of conduct of a human being? The first thing is that people must maintain a balance between their mundane life and their spiritual life. And secondly, while maintaining a balance, they should attach importance to every action, considering it to be an action of Parama Puruśa. Thirdly, people should always remember that they have come onto this earth to discharge some God-given duties – that they are merely tools in the hands of the Supreme. They have come to the world to do some work for the Lord: they themselves had neither any intention nor any necessity to come to this world. The Lord has sent them for a short period to do some work for Him, and they should keep on doing that work with total disregard for praise or blame.
ZH_TEXT: 什麼是人類理想的行為準則？首先，人們必須維持世俗生活和靈性生活間的平衡；其次，在努力維持平衡之際，每一個行動都應予以同等重視，也就是把一切都視為是至上意識的作為。第三、人應該要記住自己來此塵世，是為了完成上主所賦予的任務，他們只是上主手中的工具，來到這世界是為祂做一些事，並非出於自身意願，亦非為了自身的需要而來到這裡的。是上主將他們送來這裡為祂做一些事情的，所以他們應完全無視他人的褒貶，一心持續完成他們的工作。
IT_TEXT: Ora, quale dovrebbe essere il codice di condotta ideale di un essere umano? In primo luogo, le persone devono mantenere un equilibrio tra la vita mondana e la vita spirituale. In secondo luogo, pur mantenendo questo equilibrio, devono attribuire importanza a ogni azione, considerandola un’azione di Parama Purusa. In terzo luogo, devono ricordare sempre di essere venute su questa terra per adempiere alcuni doveri affidati loro dal Supremo e di essere soltanto strumenti nelle Sue mani. Le persone sono venute nel mondo per compiere un lavoro per il Signore: la loro venuta non è dipesa da una decisione personale, né da una necessità propria. Il Signore le ha inviate per un breve periodo affinché svolgessero un lavoro per Lui, ed esse devono continuare a compierlo senza curarsi minimamente delle lodi o delle critiche.

EN_TEXT: The only goal of living beings is to attain Parama Puruśa. This singular goal should permeate the major portion of the activities of ideal human beings. You should always remember that from the moment you get up until the moment you go to sleep, Parama Puruśa is your supreme Goal. Whatever you do, you should do keeping your vision fixed on that Goal. Only to perform His allotted tasks have you come onto this earth. You should always think, “I will die while doing those tasks – even while dying I will continue to do His work.”
ZH_TEXT: 你應該永遠記住，從起床的那一刻到上床睡覺為止，你的目標應該都是至上意識。不管你做什麼事，你都必須將至上意識這個目標置於眼前。你是為了完成祂給你的工作，你方才來到這個世界的，所以你要永遠記得：「我要死於工作之中，甚至在死亡之際仍要持續做祂的工作！」

ZH_TEXT: 沒有任何個體是不重要的，因此你必不可讓無助沮喪的心理滋生，也不應助長失敗或恐懼情結，因為至上的父親，至上的本體永遠與你同在。

EN_TEXT: The beginning and end of Dhármika Sádhaná hinges on only one point, and that is the purity and sanctity of the base. The base alone is solely responsible for the privations and afflictions of humankind. If the base is firm, privations are not privations and afflictions are not afflictions. Ádhára (base): A base is indispensable for every finite object. It is on account of the base that one object is distinguishable from others. No two living beings have an identical base. Every living being carves out for its existence a distinct base from the Universal Cosmic Self, according to its Saḿskáras.
ZH_TEXT: 法性修持(Dhármika Sádhaná)的開始和終了其關鍵只在於一點，那就是根基的純淨和聖潔。根基是造成人類匱乏和痛苦的唯一原因。如果根基牢固，貧困即不再是貧困，痛苦也不再是痛苦了。 根基(Ádhára):根基是每個有限的東西所不可或缺的，由於此根基而使任一物體有別於他物。 沒有兩個生靈擁有相同的根基，每個生靈為了生存，根據其因果業力，在大宇宙心靈中開闢了不同的根基。
IT_TEXT: L’inizio e la fine del sadhana dharmico dipendono da un unico punto: la purezza e la santità della base. È proprio la base ad essere la sola responsabile delle privazioni e delle sofferenze dell’umanità. Se la base è salda, allora le privazioni non sono più privazioni e le sofferenze non sono più sofferenze. Ádhára (base): per ogni oggetto finito è indispensabile una base. È grazie alla base che un oggetto può essere distinto dagli altri. Non esistono due esseri viventi con una base identica. Ogni essere vivente ritaglia per la propria esistenza una base distinta dal Sé Cosmico Universale, in accordo con i propri saḿskára.

EN_TEXT: Svarloka which is called the Manomaya world and it is in this stratum that a person experiences pleasure and pain. In Saḿskrta, heaven or Svarga and Svarloka are synonymous. Pleasure-seeking persons perform righteous deeds motivated by the desire to attain heaven after relinquishing the mortal body. Saḿskáras exist in the very Manomaya world or Manomaya-kośa which is also known as the pure mental sphere. Rajoguńa exists in minor degrees and Saḿskára is generated in the Svarloka. It is the popular belief amongst the Christians, the Mohammedans, the Jains and the ritualistic Hindus that the fruits of virtuous deeds are enjoyed in svarloka or heaven.
ZH_TEXT: 精細心靈世界(Svarloka)又稱為潛意識心靈世界(Manomaya World)，在此層次裡，人體驗到快樂和痛苦。梵文裡Svarga（天堂）和Svarloka是同義的。追尋快樂之人，為了死後能夠上天堂而從事善行。因果業力存在於潛意識心靈世界，亦即潛意識心靈層次，又名為純心靈層次；此處變性力量存在較小的程度，因果業力產生在此精細心靈世界裡。基督教、回教、耆那教以及崇尚儀式的印度教咸信在天堂中可享受善行之果。
IT_TEXT: Svarloka, chiamato anche mondo manomaya, è il livello nel quale una persona sperimenta piacere e dolore. In sanscrito, cielo (svarga) e Svarloka sono sinonimi. Le persone orientate alla ricerca del piacere compiono azioni virtuose motivate dal desiderio di ottenere il cielo dopo aver abbandonato il corpo mortale. I saṁskāra esistono proprio nel mondo manomaya, o manomaya kośa, che è anche conosciuto come la sfera mentale pura. In questo livello il rajoguṇa è presente in misura minore e i saṁskāra vengono generati nello Svarloka. È una convinzione diffusa tra i cristiani, i musulmani, i giainisti e gli induisti ritualisti che i frutti delle azioni virtuose vengano goduti nello Svarloka, cioè nel cielo.

EN_TEXT: Maharloka: Another name for Maharloka in Saḿskrta is Atimánas Loka which means the supramental sphere. Here, Rajoguńa is conspicuous, Sattvaguńa is less conspicuous and Tamoguńa is insignificant. It is in this stratum that saḿskáras first pulsate. The human mind is propelled by its Saḿskáras to undergo the reactions of its actions. The first vibration of the collection of Saḿskáras is created in this sphere. Suppose a person has to visit a cholera-stricken place. Before going there someone whispers to them that he too will contract cholera. On his going there, it happened that he or she actually got cholera. This is the function of the Atimánasa sphere. The first yearnings for Sádhaná, or the initial throbbings of strong desire also take place in this sphere. In the very sphere, the inspiration of the soul first becomes active. For this reason the potentialities of Sádhaná and the classifications for different persons germinate in this sphere.
ZH_TEXT: 超心靈世界(Maharloka)──它的另外一個名稱是Atimánasloka，即意指超心靈世界。此處變性力量是顯著的，悅性力量次之，惰性力量則無足輕重。在此層次裡因果業力最先產生震動，人的心靈受到因果業力的驅策來承受其作用之反作用力。所以因果業力最早的波動即是在此層面產生。假設某人必須去霍亂疫區，啟程之前，有人低聲告訴他也會感染到霍亂，到了那裡，結果真的感染到霍亂，這就是超心靈層次的作用。對靈性修持最早的渴望或最初強烈欲望的震動也發生在這個層次。靈魂的靈感亦在此層次最早開始活躍起來。基於此因，不同的人其靈性修持的潛能皆形成在這個領域裡。
IT_TEXT: Maharloka: un altro nome di Maharloka in sanscrito è Atimānasa Loka, che significa “sfera supramentale”. Qui il rajo-guṇa è predominante, il sattva-guṇa è meno evidente e il tamo-guṇa è insignificante. È in questo livello che i saṁskāra iniziano a pulsare per la prima volta. La mente umana è spinta dai propri saṁskāra a subire le reazioni delle azioni compiute. La prima vibrazione dell’insieme dei saṁskāra si crea in questa sfera. Supponiamo che una persona debba recarsi in un luogo colpito dal colera. Prima di andarci, qualcuno le sussurra che anche lei contrarrà il colera. Una volta arrivata, accade che effettivamente si ammala di colera. Questa è la funzione della sfera Atimānasa. Le prime aspirazioni verso il sādhana, o i primi palpiti di un desiderio intenso, nascono anch’essi in questa sfera. Proprio qui, per la prima volta, l’ispirazione dell’anima diventa attiva. Per questo motivo, le potenzialità del sādhana e le diverse classificazioni degli individui germinano in questa sfera.

EN_TEXT: Janarloka or Subliminal stratum: This is called vijiṋánamaya [[loka]]. True knowledge, wisdom and renunciation dominate in this sphere. These attributes are sometimes conspicuous even in pleasure-seeking persons, but there are obstacles on the way due to the influence of Bhúh. Bhuvah, etc. In this Janarloka, Sattvaguńa is most conspicuous, Tamoguńa is less conspicuous, and Rajoguńa is insignificant.
ZH_TEXT: 下意識世界(Janarloka)──亦稱為下意識心靈(Vijinánamaya)，此層面控制了真知、智慧和不執著。這些特質有時甚至在追求享樂之人身上也明顯的表現出來，但是由於受到物質世界、粗鈍心靈世界等的影響，他們在靈性道上受到了阻礙。在此下意識世界裡，悅性力量最顯著，惰性力量次之，變性力量則無足輕重。

EN_TEXT: Every living being needs a base. In the absence of a base, they merge into the ocean of the cosmos. Suppose, there is a cup of water in a pond. So long as the cup exists the water in the cup also exists. But if the cup is removed, the water in the cup will merge with that of the pond. The base of that water is the cup. It is only when the cup is removed that the water it contains merges with that of the pond. Similarly, the soul merges into Brahma when there is no base to embody it.
ZH_TEXT: 眾生都需要根基，沒有了根基他們便會融入大宇宙之洋裡。譬如在池塘裡有一杯水，只要杯子存在，在杯子裡的水也會存在。但是如果把杯子拿走，杯中之水就會融入池中。那個水的根基就是杯子，只要把杯子拿走，杯中之水就會融入池裡。同樣的，若沒有根基賦予靈魂形體，它就會融入至上意識中。
IT_TEXT: Ogni essere vivente ha bisogno di un sostegno che lo contenga. In assenza di questo supporto, esso si fonde nell’oceano del cosmo. Supponiamo che vi sia dell’acqua in un recipiente immerso in uno stagno. Finché il recipiente esiste, anche l’acqua in esso contenuta esiste come entità separata. Ma se il recipiente non c'è più, l’acqua che conteneva si mescola con quella dello stagno. Il sostegno di quell’acqua è il recipiente. Solo quando il recipiente viene tolto, l’acqua in esso contenuta si unisce a quella dello stagno. Allo stesso modo, l’anima si fonde in Brahma quando non esiste più alcun sostegno che la contenga.

EN_TEXT: The cooperative system is the best system of agricultural and industrial production. Terreni poco fertili possono essere trasformati in fertili campi agricoli con cure adeguate. Questo aumenterà la produzione agricola complessiva e aiuterà inoltre un paese a diventare autosufficiente nella produzione alimentare e delle colture da reddito, liberandolo dalla scarsità di cibo.

EN_TEXT: It is the human mind which is the cause of bondage or liberation. If the mind is in bondage, the person is also in bondage. Similarly, if the mind is liberated the person is also liberated. And the final outcome of our resistance should be the liberation of human beings, animals and plants from all afflictions – not ordinary liberation but permanent liberation. We, the embodiments of Neohumanism – we will have to resist them. And in case we fail, we shall never be able to move towards the subjective world; the extreme agonies of the objective world will thwart our movement.
ZH_TEXT: 沒有這個客體世界我們什麼也做不了，因為我們必須存在於其中。因為狹隘地域情結所帶來的痛苦，我們必須傾盡心中所有的甜美來對抗它，我們應努力奮戰，以為人類、動物、植物帶來解脫痛苦的甜美果實──不僅僅是暫時的解脫，而且是永恆的解脫。我們要以實現新人道主義來對抗那狹隘的地域情結。如果我們做不到，就永遠無法邁向主體的世界，客體世界的無盡痛苦會阻礙我們的前進。
IT_TEXT: Non possiamo fare a meno di questo mondo oggettivo, perché dobbiamo esistere in esso. Con tutta la dolcezza delle nostre menti dovremo contrastare quelle immagini che ci causano dolore a causa del loro ristretto geosentimento. E il risultato finale della nostra resistenza dovrebbe essere la liberazione degli esseri umani, degli animali e delle piante da tutte le afflizioni — non una liberazione ordinaria, ma una liberazione permanente. Noi, incarnazioni del Neoumanesimo, dovremo opporci a quelle tendenze. E nel caso in cui fallissimo, non saremo mai in grado di muoverci verso il mondo soggettivo; le estreme agonie del mondo oggettivo ostacoleranno il nostro cammino.

EN_TEXT: Now the time has come to manifest the glory of kiirtana. And I also want to say further that those who wish to attain spiritual progress in their sádhaná [spiritual practice] will have to do more and more kiirtana. By kiirtana, the mind becomes pure, and with this pure mind, one can do sádhaná. If the mind is made pure even for five minutes by kiirtana, then if you do sádhaná for only five minutes, your sádhaná will be very good – you will surely attain spiritual progress. And because of your spiritual progress, you will come closer and closer to the Supreme Consciousness, you will come in contact with His psychic waves. And in that state you will be able to render still better service to human beings, animals and plants, by means of Neohumanism.
ZH_TEXT: 現在是彰顯至上聖名唱頌之榮光的時刻，我更要強調，那些想要在靈修上獲得進步之人，必須從事更多、更多至上聖名的唱頌。藉此，他們的心靈將變得更為純淨，有了純淨的心靈，將易於從事靈性修持。僅僅五分鐘的至上聖名唱頌，就能讓心靈變得純淨，即使只是五分鐘靜坐，你的靜坐也會是很好的，你必然可以獲得靈性的進步。因為靈性進步了，你會與至上意識更加接近，因而觸及祂心智的波流。在這種境界中，你將可以透過新人道主義的方法為人類、動物和植物提供更好的服務。

EN_TEXT: The two requisite factors in devotion are one, that the object of devotion has to be infinite; and, two, that it is unilateral, because in the process of giving and taking, you become one with Him and there is nobody to take anything from Him. You become one with Him.
ZH_TEXT: 虔誠有兩個要件：第一，虔誠的目標必須是無限的；第二，它必須是單向的，因為在取、予的過程中，你已經與祂融合，已經沒有你的存在來從祂那兒得到任何事物了，你已經與祂合而為一了。

EN_TEXT: The movement of spirituality is never pulsative in character, but rather linear: it flows in a straight line. Due to this straightness, it has no positive curvature or negative curvature. Yet for the sake of convenience we can call it the supreme positivity; and its farthest extremity, the point where resides all human existence, the starting-point of all intellectuals and non-intellectuals, can be termed the supreme negativity. So the movement of a living being starts from the supreme negativity, and as it gradually flows towards the supreme positivity, that is, towards spirituality, its line of movement becomes straight. This is the real path. At the end nothing exists – neither intellectuality nor reality – only spirituality pervades everything. No entity in the external world can claim the status of an absolute entity. Spirituality alone is the absolute stance; and to search for it is the real intellectuality. Whatever people do apart from this is nothing but the expression of their distorted propensities.
ZH_TEXT: 靈性運動的特徵從來不是脈動式的，而是線性的：它沿著直線流動。因其筆直，故無正曲率亦無負曲率。方便起見，吾人可稱其為「至上正性」;而其最遙遠的另一極端──即全人類存在之所在、一切知識分子與非知識分子的起點──則可稱為「至上負性」。因此，生命體的運動始於至上負性，隨它漸次湧向至上正性，亦即邁向靈性，其運動軌跡遂成筆直。此乃真正的道路。最終，世間一無所有──既無理智亦無現實──唯有靈性沁漫萬物。外在世界無一實體可自詡絕對實體，唯有靈性才是絕對立足點；而追尋靈性，方為真正的理智。凡人背道而馳，不過是其扭曲習性的展現。
IT_TEXT: Il movimento della spiritualità non è mai di natura pulsativa, ma piuttosto lineare: scorre in linea retta. A causa di questa linearità, non possiede né curvatura positiva né curvatura negativa. Tuttavia, per comodità, possiamo chiamarla positività suprema; e la sua estremità più lontana, il punto in cui risiede tutta l’esistenza umana, il punto di partenza di tutti gli intellettuali e dei non-intellettuali, può essere definita negatività suprema. Così il movimento di un essere vivente parte dalla negatività suprema e, mentre gradualmente fluisce verso la positività suprema, cioè verso la spiritualità, la sua linea di movimento diventa diritta. Questo è il vero sentiero. Alla fine non esiste nulla – né intelletto né realtà – soltanto la spiritualità pervade ogni cosa. Nessuna entità del mondo esterno può rivendicare lo status di entità assoluta. Solo la spiritualità è la posizione assoluta e ricercarla è la vera attività intellettuale. Qualunque cosa le persone facciano al di fuori di questo non è altro che espressione delle loro propensioni distorte.

EN_TEXT: In the psychic sphere also, we must serve Parama Puruśa, since mind is a very important aspect of human existence. And the best way to serve Parama Puruśa in the mental sphere is to do His kiirtana with love and devotion. When Parama Puruśa sees that “a number of minds are flowing towards Me,” He will certainly feel a soothing touch, and thus this collective movement will benefit both the individuals and the collectivity. This synthetic movement towards the Supreme One will surely reduce the degree of complexity that has arisen from the constant conflicts and clashes in the society today.
ZH_TEXT: 心靈是人類存在的一個重要面向，所以在心智層面也一樣，我們必須對至上意識服務。在心智層面對至上意識最好的服務，就是以最誠摯的愛唱頌至上的聖名(kiirtana)。當至上意識看到許多心靈波流匯集湧向祂，祂一定非常感動，此種集體的波流不但有益於個人，同時對整體也有極大的幫助。此朝向至上本體的一致行動一定會減低今日社會與日俱增的衝突與打擊。

EN_TEXT: The human brain is limited, and its nerve cells also have a limited capacity: they cannot tolerate these growing complexities. Kiirtana gives bliss to Parama Puruśa in the mental sphere, and it also brings joy to human beings both individually and collectively; it leads them on the path of welfare and frees them from all these complexities. It removes all the diseases of the intellect and allows people to think easily and in the proper way.
ZH_TEXT: 人類的腦子是有限的，其神經細胞的能力也是有限的，他們適應不了這些與日俱增的複雜關係。「唱頌至上的聖名」在心智的層面給予至上喜悅，它同時也為個人和集體帶來喜悅。它引導人們走上福祉的道路，讓他們從所有的複雜關係中獲得自由。去除所有病態的心智思維，使人能以自在和適當的方式來思考。

ZH_TEXT: 在靈性層面，對至上意識服務的唯一方法是什麼？就是「靈性的修持」。如果你的心裡湧現「無論日夜，不管順逆，至上意識永遠都與我同在──我沒什麼可擔心的。」當你的心靈有了這種深刻的了悟時，你的靈性修持才算達到靈性圓滿的極致。

EN_TEXT: It is not enough to hold this vast Puruśottama in the citta: rather, one will have to come in His contact and realize Him as the Creator of the universe deep within oneself. Only then can one attain immortality. The supreme goal of sádhaná is not to ideate on Him, but to bring about a total merger of the unit mind in the Cosmic Mind, of the unit consciousness in the Cosmic Consciousness. This is the only real attainment in human life.
ZH_TEXT: 將此無限廣大的宇宙核心意識緊握在心靈質是不夠的，一個人更應在內在深處與祂接觸，並且了悟祂是宇宙的創造者。唯有如此，方能達到永恆之境。靈性修持的至上目標不是心中持念、觀想祂而已，而是要將個體心靈完全融入於宇宙心靈、將個體意識與宇宙意識合而為一。此乃人類生命唯一真正的成就。
IT_TEXT: Non basta contenere questo vasto Puruśottama in citta, nella parte profonda della mente; occorre piuttosto entrare in contatto con Lui e realizzarlo dentro di sé come il Creatore dell’universo. Solo allora si può raggiungere l’immortalità. La meta suprema del sādhana non è ideare su di Lui, ma portare alla completa fusione la mente individuale con la Mente Cosmica, la coscienza individuale con la Coscienza Cosmica. Questa è l’unica vera realizzazione nella vita umana.

EN_TEXT: We are running and shall continue to run to take shelter aboard the only dependable ship on the ocean of the physical universe – the Supreme Entity. That Supreme Entity is the only shelter of all (though He Himself has no shelter). We have no one but Him, we have no other desideratum.
ZH_TEXT: 我們正奔向至上本體繼續向前邁進，祂是此物質世界之洋中唯一可靠的船，我們將奔向祂並登上此至上之舟，以祂為庇護。至上意識是宇宙萬有唯一的庇護，我們一無所有只有祂，祂是我們唯一的目標。

EN_TEXT: In this universe, those entities which are considered controllers of events are often called gods, or devatá. There are various controllers for various events. Parama Puruśa is the Controller of all these controllers and hence is called Parameshvara or Maheshvara.
ZH_TEXT: 在這個宇宙中，能夠控制事物者被稱為神(devatá)，不同的事物有不同的控制者，而至上意識是所有控制者的控制者，所以祂被稱為主宰中的主宰(Parameshvara or Maheshvara)。

EN_TEXT: Within the scope of infinite space, and without the scope of infinite space, He is the Singular entity. So nobody is outside Him. So He is the only goal. He is the only Desideratum, and for Him you say, Bábá náma kevalam. That is, “I am taking the name of that Singular Entity.”
ZH_TEXT: 在無限空間的內在或外在，祂就是那唯一的本體。所以沒有人外於祂而存在。因此祂是你們唯一的目標。為了這唯一的目標，你們高唱：「Bábá Náma Kevalam」意即：我歌詠那唯一本體之聖名。

EN_TEXT: For the devotional approach, nothing external is required; nothing external is required to be done. And because it is the supreme pinnacle of devotional approach, you should remember that it is yours, because Parama Puruśa is cent per cent yours.
ZH_TEXT: 虔誠之道不需要任何外在之物，外表之事一概不必要。這是虔誠之道的極致，你要牢記於心，至上意識是你的，至上意識百分之百是屬於你的。
IT_TEXT: Per la devozione non è richiesto nulla di esteriore; non vi è nulla di esteriore che debba essere fatto. E poiché questa rappresenta la vetta suprema dell’approccio devozionale, dovreste ricordare che essa vi appartiene, perché Parama Purusa è vostro al cento per cento.

EN_TEXT: For the very existence of speed, a sentimental support, a sentimental propulsion is an indispensable necessity. Now, this sentimental support must be based on rationality. Sentimentality based on rationality is the strongest force in the universe. And sentimentality without rationality takes the form of, or rather the distortion of, dogma. Now what does rationality say? Each and every particle of this universe, from a big mammoth to a small blade of grass is of His creation and of the Macropsychic conation. Hence the relationship is that of Father and children, Father and His loving children – the Supreme progenitor and His progeny. There cannot be more than one noumenal cause. The Supreme noumenal entity is a singular one. So the conception of so many gods, so many goddesses, so many ghosts are all based on defective ideas. The Supreme Father, noumenal entity, is a singular entity. And that noumenal entity is the loving Father. Oneʼs relationship with the loving Father is one of love and affection, is a domestic relationship. There is nothing formal, no sort of formality in it. It is purely domestic, a family relationship. So the noumenal cause is not just a theoretical entity; it is your Father, your nearest and dearest one.
ZH_TEXT: 要想加快生命前進的速度，必須要有情感的支持，這種情感的激勵是不可或缺的。而情感的支持必須以理性為基礎。有理性的情感是宇宙間最大的力量，缺乏理性，情感會變成一種教條或扭曲的形態。理性告訴我們：宇宙間的每一粒微塵，從巨大的長毛象到一片小草都是大宇宙心靈想像的創造。因此，祂和造化萬有間的關係如父親和小孩，是父親和祂親愛的子女──是至上之祖和其子孫的關係。所以，不會有一個以上的致因本體，而只有唯一的那一個。是故，諸眾男女神祇、各種精靈的概念是有缺陷的。至上之父、致因本體是唯一的本體，該本體就是我們親愛的至上之父。吾人與親愛的父親間只有愛的聯結，這是一種家人的親情關係。不是什麼拘謹的形式關係，純粹就是親人關係。所以，至上的致因本體不是理論上的實體，祂是你的父親，是你最親愛和最親近的人。

EN_TEXT: You know, the Supreme Noumenal Entity maintains the closest relationship with all other apparent noumenal entities, the so-called noumenal entities, and those so-called noumenal entities maintain a link with each and every expression of this universe. This indirect link of the noumenal entity is called prota yoga in Sanskrit. That is, whatever you are doing is indirectly known to Him through your direct noumenal entity. And not only that, He keeps a direct relationship with you also. “Today we will decorate the hall in a very nice way, as is done in the case of DMC. And when Bábá will see those things, He will say, ‘Let there be DMC.’” See, these things have a direct reflection, not on your apparent noumenal entity, but directly on the Supreme hub, directly on the Supreme noumenal entity. And He will say, “Let me satisfy those little boys and girls by declaring a subject of discourse.”
ZH_TEXT: 你們知道至上本體與所有其他實體間，皆維持著一種最親密的關係。這些實體和宇宙間的每一種展現彼此都有連結。不同實體間非直接的連結在梵文裡稱之為「集體聯繫瑜伽」(prota yoga)，也就是說，任何行動會直接透過這個實體，而間接地為祂所知。非僅如此，祂亦與你有直接的聯繫。若你心想：「今天我們要將靜坐大廳佈置得像大法會一樣的漂亮，當巴巴蒞臨看到時，他會說『讓我們在這裡舉辦大法會吧！』」你們看，這些事情直接反映在至上意識的核心裡，而不是在你們的個體上。於是他將說道：「我來宣佈演講的主題，滿足那些孩子們的心願吧！」
IT_TEXT: L'Entità Noumenica Suprema mantiene il legame più intimo con tutte le realtà noumeniche che stanno alla base delle forme manifeste; e queste realtà, a loro volta, sono collegate a ogni singola espressione dell’universo. Questo collegamento indiretto è chiamato in sanscrito prota yoga. In altre parole, qualunque cosa facciate è da Lui conosciuta indirettamente, attraverso la vostra realtà noumenica individuale. Ma non è solo così: Egli mantiene anche un rapporto diretto con ciascuno di voi. «Oggi decoreremo la sala in modo molto bello, come si fa in occasione del DMC. E quando Bábá vedrà queste decorazioni, dirà: “Che ci sia il DMC.”» Vedete, queste cose hanno una riflessione diretta, non sulla vostra realtà noumenica apparente, ma direttamente nel Centro Supremo, direttamente nell’Entità Noumenica Suprema. Ed Egli dirà: «Voglio soddisfare quei piccoli ragazzi e ragazze introducendo il tema del discorso.»

EN_TEXT: Human approach towards spiritual affairs means fighting against the limitations of time, space and person. So it is the best wont of human beings. Now in the course of this psycho-spiritual advancement, when the particular aspirant crosses the silver line of demarcation between relativity and absolute, he goes beyond the touch of all mundane bondages. And that is the final destination, and that is the desideratum, of all human beings. And this approach of humans is called Bhágavata dharma.
ZH_TEXT: 人類從事靈性的修持意指與時、空、人物等束縛因素奮戰，這是人類最好的習性。在心理導向靈性的前進過程中，當修行之人越過了相對與絕對的最後界線時，他即不受此世俗束縛的控制，那就是所有人類生命的終極目標。人類所遵循的這種途徑就稱為「至上法性」。

EN_TEXT: The woes and anxieties, the pleasure or composure, that a man or an animal enjoys in the physical stratum are extremely limited. That is, the waves of woes and anxieties, or pleasure, function within a short sphere, and that is why they are purely of a temporary nature. The person or the space is also extremely limited. When the particular aspirant crosses the silver line of demarcation between relativity and absolute, he goes beyond the touch of all mundane bondages. And that is the final destination, and that is the desideratum, of all human beings. And this approach of humans is called Bhágavata dharma.
ZH_TEXT: 人或動物在物質層面所遭遇的悲傷或焦慮、快樂或寧靜都極其有限，亦即悲傷、焦慮或者快樂的波動都是作用在一個短暫的範疇裡，所以它們都是短暫無常的。人物和空間也是極其有限的。 當靈性的修持者超越了相對與絕對的銀色界線時，他就不再受到世俗的束縛，這就是人類最終的目的地。人類的這種前進稱之為「至上法性」(Bhágavata dharma)。

EN_TEXT: Ananda Marga has the correct way, through subjective approach and objective adjustment. While followers of Ananda Marga keep their eyes steady on the absolute, they do not ignore this relative world. They work for self-realization and social upliftment, and hence the utilization of their energy is never in vain. When the effort is correct and the utilization right, you will certainly reach the goal.
ZH_TEXT: 阿南達瑪迦是一條正確的道路，它透過客體的調適，以接近主體。行走在阿南達瑪迦之道的人，堅定地朝向絕對永恆前進的同時，他們也並未忽視此一相對的世界。他們同時為自我了悟與利益眾生而工作，因此他們能量的運用不會徒然。有了正確的努力，以及適當的能量運用，你們必然可達到你們的目標。

EN_TEXT: Just when the aspirant crosses the cordon of the supreme static point, just on the other side, he feels another type of pleasure, and in that case (it is a subtler phase) he feels that he is with his Goal, he is with the Supreme Entity. The Universe is also there, but he feels that he has become a strong person – physically, mentally, spiritually – and under such circumstances, he does not care a fig for what the world says. This phase is called bháva. When a man is in bháva, it will be very easy for you to know it, because there will be a certain expression, not in the vocal cord, but from here [taps the anáhata cakra]. Perhaps you have seen someone saying “Bábá! Bábá!” – saying like this. Have you seen it? Because the expression comes from this point [indicates anáhata cakra again].
ZH_TEXT: 當靈性修持者越過宇宙力量惰性的範疇時，他同時感受到到另一種更精細的快樂。他感覺到他與上帝同在，與至上本體同在。此一塵世依舊存在，但他覺得自己在身、心、靈各層面都非常強壯，在這種情況下，他一點也不在乎世俗世界所說的一切，此一階段稱之為「理念波流境界」(Bháva)。我們很容易察覺一個人是否處在這種理念波流境界，因為在這種境界的人有某種特別的表達，這種表達不是來自聲帶，而是來自這裡（巴巴拍拍心輪）。或許你們曾經看過有人像這樣喊道：「巴巴！巴巴！」看過嗎？因為這種表達是來自於這一點（巴巴再次指著心輪）。

EN_TEXT: Though subtle processed you should direct your mental symbolization so that it finds shelter in the spiritual flow. In this way your symbols will be converted into psycho-spiritual waves. What will happen then? In that case it would not be necessary for you to wait for your psychic symbols to get converted into physical symbols. Where the change has been made to the psycho-spiritual plane it has to be converted into the spiritual, and since the átman, the soul, is beyond the sphere of symbolization, the problem of symbolization ends. It will mean final liberation, mokśa. Human beings have been aspiring for this final liberation since time immemorial and those who have understood it should know that they do not have to wait for it endlessly form one life to another. In this very life convert your psychic symbolization into psycho-spiritual symbolization and become and emancipated being.
ZH_TEXT: 你應當經由精細的過程，引導你的心靈，使其在靈性波流中找到庇護所。如此你的表徵就會轉換成由心靈導向靈性的波流。接下來會如何呢？在此情況下，你就不用等到將你的心態物化。如果是由心智導向靈性層面的改變，它就一定會轉變成靈性，因為自性(Átman)是超越象徵表達的範疇，因此以象徵方式表述的問題就到此結束，這意味著究竟解脫(Moksa)。人類從無始以來就在追尋此究竟解脫，了解此點之人應該知道，他們不必生生世世無止盡地等待。就在此生，將你的心境轉變成心智導向靈性之境，而成為一個解脫之人。
IT_TEXT: Benché il processo sia sottile, dovreste dirigere la vostra simbolizzazione mentale in modo che trovi rifugio nel flusso spirituale. In questo modo i vostri simboli si trasformeranno in onde psico-spirituali. Che cosa accadrà allora? In tal caso non sarà necessario attendere che i vostri simboli psichici vengano convertiti in simboli fisici. Quando il cambiamento è stato portato sul piano psico-spirituale, esso deve essere trasformato nello spirituale; e poiché l’átman, l’anima, è oltre la sfera della simbolizzazione, il problema della simbolizzazione termina. Questo significherà liberazione finale, mokśa. Gli esseri umani aspirano a questa liberazione finale da tempo immemorabile, e coloro che lo hanno compreso dovrebbero sapere che non devono attenderla senza fine, da una vita all’altra. In questa stessa vita trasformate la vostra simbolizzazione psichica in simbolizzazione psico-spirituale e diventate esseri emancipati.

EN_TEXT: Life is movement from imperfection to perfection. When inanimate objects become animate there is progress. There is further progress when animate beings become multicellular, metazoic organisms, more and more complicated structures. The imperfection of a crab is not seen in a serpent. The human being is the highest being, the most perfect in structure. The human is thus a perfected animal. But this is only the beginning of progress for the human. The human still has to achieve further physical, intellectual and spiritual perfections.
ZH_TEXT: 生命是從不完美朝向完美的行進。從沒有生命的物體發展成為有生命的個體，這就是一種進步。而當有生命的個體逐漸演化成多細胞、構造複雜的生命個體，則更是向前躍進。螃蟹的缺點在蛇身上就看不見了。人類是最進化的生物，有著最完美的結構。所以，人類是完美的動物。然而擁有人身只是人類進步的開始，他們仍必須往身、心、靈更完美的境界前進。

EN_TEXT: We are all part of that Supreme Being – He is playing with Himself in all our forms. This is a divine play. He is playing hide-and-seek with Himself. Search Him in your little “I” feeling and you will find the King of kings there. In fact, the name of this search is sádhaná.
ZH_TEXT: 我們都是至上本體的一部分，祂是自己和自己在玩遊戲。這是一齣神性的遊戲，是祂與自身在玩躲迷藏。在你小小的我覺裡尋找祂吧！你將發現王者之王就在其中。事實上，這種內在的尋求就是「靈性修持」(sádhaná)。

EN_TEXT: You search Him in the caves of the Himalayas and wander here and there and He is nowhere. But when you attain awareness of Him, you know that He was along with you in your search and that He was seated in your heart.
ZH_TEXT: 你登上喜瑪拉雅山的山洞去尋找，你到處尋尋覓覓，卻發現祂不在任何一個你所尋覓的地方。但是當你了悟祂時，你知道祂一直都與你同在，陪伴著你到處尋尋覓覓，並且也安住在你的心中。

EN_TEXT: When you attain awareness of Him, you know that He was along with you in your search and that He was seated in your heart. He shares your joys and pains, as He is with you through thick and thin. He never leaves you even when all others have abandoned you. Every jiiva, every living being, is the child of Immortality. You have been born in eternity and you are moving towards immortality. Therefore there is no need to be afraid, despondent, or sorry in any condition.
ZH_TEXT: 當你了悟祂時，你知道祂一直都與你同在，陪伴著你到處尋尋覓覓，並且也安住在你的心中。 祂分享你的快樂和痛苦，在任何情況下祂都陪伴著你，在所有人都拋棄你的同時，祂依然對你不離不棄。 每一個眾生都是永恆之子。你從永恆而來，終將回歸於永恆。所以在任何狀況下，你皆無需畏懼、無需沮喪。

EN_TEXT: Some ideas arose in the minds of people, particularly sádhakas, that Brahma is the composite form of Parama Puruśa and Paramá Prakrti; and Shiva was the crystallized manifestation of Brahma. This idea was further developed and took shape long afterwards, during the days of Jain Tantra, Buddhist Tantra, and Post-Shiva Tantra. People were then able to grasp the significance of Shiva Shaktyátmakaḿ Brahma [“Brahma is the composite of Shiva, or Puruśa, and Shakti, or Prakrti”].
ZH_TEXT: 宇宙本體是至上認知法則(Parama Puruśa)和至上運作勢能(Paramá Prakrti)兩者的結合，而希瓦正是至上本體的具體顯現，此一觀念自人們心中特別是從那些靈修者的心裡升起。很久之後，在耆那教密宗、佛教密宗和後希瓦密宗時期，此觀念更加發展成形。那時人們開始能夠理解「Shiva Shaktyátmakaḿ Brahma」的含意──即宇宙本體(Brahma)是宇宙意識(Shiva或Puruśa)和宇宙運作法則(Shakti或Prakrti)所構成。

EN_TEXT: Your aim should be to harmonize your inner mind and your outer expressions. Make your mind within and without one and uniform. There are two personalities in everyone, the inner one and the outer one. The inner one is less complicated, but the outer one appears to be better (it is hypocritically better). The aim of sádhaná is to bring these two personalities closer together and make them one. When you are one and the same, within and without, when all the expressions of your consciousness are in harmony with the Supreme Being, the duality of your being will vanish, and you will be established in permanent peace and greatness.
ZH_TEXT: 你的目標應與內在心靈和外在展現取得平衡，應努力讓心靈的內、外一致。每個人都有內、外兩種人格。內在複雜糾葛，外在看起比較好，這是偽裝得好。靈性修持的目的就是要拉近這兩種人格的距離，讓它們一致。  當你的內、外在是一致的，當你的意識與至上本體和諧共鳴，那麼你二元對立的存在感將會消失，你將立足於永恆的寧靜與偉大的境界中。

EN_TEXT: In the spirit of Dharma, the soul of spirituality is hidden in the “guha”, i.e. your I feeling...Your Lord is there in your own “I” feeling. How to find Him?... He is there in you as the oil is in the oilseed. Crush the seed through Sádhaná and you get the oil. Separate the mind from Cognition or Consciousness; and see that His resplendence lightens up your whole inner being. He is like butter in curd; churn it and He will appear from within. Churn your mind through Sádhaná and Parama Puruśa will appear like butter from curd. He is like a subterranean river in you. Remove the sands of mind and you will find the clear and cool waters within.
ZH_TEXT: 法性的精神、靈性的精髓含藏在「谷哈」(guha)裡，亦即在你的「我覺」中。……你的上主就在你的「我覺」裡，你要如何找到祂呢？…… 祂在你的內在，就如同油含藏在種子裡。透過靈性修持榨取種子，你就可以得到裡面的油。你要能分辨認知本源或意識與心靈的不同，你會見到祂燦爛的光芒照亮你整個內在的生命。祂就好比凝乳裡的奶油，你必須用力攪拌，祂就會在你的內在出現。透過靈性修持用力攪拌你的心靈，至上意識就會像奶油從凝乳中出現。祂如你內在的潛流，你必須將心靈的沙礫去除，才會發現那裡面清涼乾淨的流水。
IT_TEXT: Nello spirito del Dharma, l’anima della spiritualità è custodita in “guha”, il cuore segreto del tuo essere. È lì che dimora il Signore, nel tuo senso dell’Io. Come si può raggiungere quella Presenza interiore? Egli è in te come l’olio è nel seme oleoso. Schiaccia il seme attraverso il sadhana e otterrai l’olio. Separa la mente dalla facoltà conoscente, dalla Coscienza, e vedrai che la Sua radiosità illumina tutto il tuo essere interiore. Egli è come il burro nascosto nello yogurt: lavoralo con pazienza, e il burro affiora. Così, se lavori la tua mente attraverso il sadhana, Parama Purusa emergerà dal profondo, come il burro che si separa dallo yogurt. Egli è come un fiume sotterraneo dentro di te; rimuovi le sabbie della mente e troverai, al suo interno, acque limpide e fresche.

EN_TEXT: As per yoga and Tantra, to Parama Puruśa one is to do namaste. Namah plus te – “I pay respect to You” – namaste. And namaskára means, “I am paying my respects.” And that is why you may use the word namaste only for Parama Puruśa, but namaskára for both Parama Puruśa and the jiiva [unit being]. Tadekaḿ jagatsákśiirupaḿ namámah – “If I am to pay respect to anybody, I am to pay respect to You only.”
ZH_TEXT: 根據瑜伽和密宗，對至上意識，吾人做最敬禮(Namaste)。Namah加上te意為「我對『您』表示敬意」。而Namaskára意指「我表示我的敬意」。所以，Namaste只能用於至上意識，而Namaskára可以適用於至上意識以及個體(Jiiva)。Tadekaḿ jagatsákśiirupaḿ namamah:「如果我要對任何人表示敬意，我將只向『您』頂禮。」
