EN_TEXT: Depend on one only, not on two. Death will not be painful for you, because in death too you attain Him. Merge with Him with all your love. He has given you your organs. Utilize them for Him. With your voice sing His name, His praise, His kiirtana. With your mind think of Him. One who does not do this wastes oneʼs life.
ZH_TEXT: 你們應只仰賴那唯一的至上之主。死亡對你們而言不會是痛苦的，因為你們在死亡中也會獲得祂。所以用你們全部的愛來與祂合一吧！祂已賜予你們各種器官，為祂而善加利用這些器官。以你們的歌聲來呼喚祂、來讚美祂、來唱頌至上聖名(kiirtana)。用你們全部的心力持念祂。否則就是糟蹋生命。

EN_TEXT: You should always remember that you have come here for a very short span. It is just like a waiting room of a railway station. You remain there for a short period and when the train comes, you leave the waiting room. This world is just like that waiting room. You are to remain here for a very short span. You should always remember this fact – “I have come here for a short span and I wonʼt remain here for a very long period. My home is elsewhere. I am just like a tourist.” You should always remember this fact. And as a universal tourist, you, while leaving for your permanent home, will not require a passport.
ZH_TEXT: 你要記得你只是來這裡一段極短的時間，就像是火車站的候車室，只是在那裡等火車來臨，火車一來你就會離開這個候車室。這個世界就是一個候車室，你只是在此短暫停留。 你要永遠記得這項事實──「我只短暫停留，不會久留於此。我的家鄉在他方，我只是個過客。」你要牢記此一事實。做一個宇宙的過客，當你啟程回永恆的家時，是不需要護照的。
CITATION_EN: Shrii Shrii Ánandamúrti | 25 May 1979 evening, Rotterdam | 24 Puńya All Twenty-Four Hours | Ánanda Vacanámrtam Part 12

EN_TEXT: In order to bring the mind to a state of composure you are to do – what? You are to do kiirtana. During kiirtana what happens? The mind gets lifted, exalted, and as a result you will enjoy a particular nature of peace. And if you start your sádhaná just after doing kiirtana, you will enjoy bliss. So kiirtana is a necessity, is an indispensable necessity for proper sádhaná.
ZH_TEXT: 要如何才能讓心靈保持寧靜的狀態呢？你必須從事「至上聖名的唱頌」(Kiirtana)。在唱頌至上聖名時，會怎麼樣呢？你的心靈會提升，自然就會徜徉在一種特別的寧靜之中。如果你在唱頌至上聖名後即刻靜坐，你就會法喜充滿。所以「唱頌至上聖名」(kiirtana)是必要的，對於正確的靈性修持而言是不可或缺的。
CITATION_EN: Shrii Shrii Ánandamúrti | 27 May 1979 evening, Stockholm | 25 The Chance to Be One with Him | Ánanda Vacanámrtam Part 12
CITATION_ZH: Shrii Shrii Ánandamúrti | 1979年5月27日傍晚於瑞典斯德哥爾摩 | 25 回歸至上的本體 | 喜悅甘露集卷 6，P.142

EN_TEXT: The Tantrik practice of Mudrá Sádhaná means to associate with good human beings in order to attain liberation. Here you must remember that salvation is not only spiritual, it is in all spheres of life, in all the strata of life. In all the spheres of life – social, economic, etc. – struggle has to be launched. Wherever there is no food, begin the struggle for it; if clothing is needed, then there should be struggle for it; if there is no irrigation system fight for it. For the highest salvation of the soul is to free it from all bondages.
ZH_TEXT: 為了獲得解脫，一個人必須與善為伍，這是密宗鍛鍊中慕抓修持(Mudrá Sadhana)的意思。你們必須記住，所謂的「解脫」並非只在靈性層面上，而是指生命所有各個層面、所有的階段，包括社會、經濟等等，在在都需要奮鬥。缺乏食物時，就需為食物奮鬥；需要衣物時，就應努力獲得衣物；如果灌溉系統不足，那麼就要想辦法完成。因為靈魂至高的究竟解脫就在於讓它擺脫所有的束縛，得到完全的自由。
CITATION_EN: Shrii Shrii Ánandamúrti | 27 May 1980, Krishnanagar | 09 Do Virtuous Deeds Day and Night | Ananda Marga Karma Yoga in a Nutshell

EN_TEXT: The operative forces of psychic dilation are three in number. These are (1) physical force, created out of physical clash; (2) psychic force, created as a result of clashes in the psychic sphere; and (3) spiritual force emanated from longing for the Great. As a result of operations of these three forces, the psychic body undergoes a dilation. This dilation is not mere puffing up, but an expansion in volume and mass. The quantum of dilation depends directly on the proximity of the destination. That means the dilation increases as the distance decreases. The increase in mass is due to ever-increasing clash amongst the belligerent forces within the physical structure. As a result of mental dilation, that is, increase in volume and mass of the psychic body, the mind acquires more and more potentiality for multilateral activities.
ZH_TEXT: 心理擴張的運作力量有三。分別是：一、物質力量，來自於物質的衝擊；二、心理力量，來自於心理層面的衝擊；三、靈性力量，來自於對至上的渴望。由於這三種力量的作用，造成心理的擴張。此擴張並非只是膨脹，而是體積與質量的擴展。擴張的程度取決於與終極目標的距離，亦即只要距離縮短，擴展就增加。 質量的增加乃是由於在物質結構內，各交戰力量間的衝擊愈益頻繁所致。由於心理擴張的緣故，亦即心靈在體積與質量上的增加，使其擁有更多的潛能從事各種活動。
CITATION_EN: Shrii Shrii Ánandamúrti | 28 May 1959 | 02 Pratisaiṋcara and Manah | Idea and Ideology
CITATION_ZH: Shrii Shrii Ánandamúrti | 1959年5月28日 | 02 宇宙向心運動與心靈 | 印心與悟道，P.15

EN_TEXT: According to the urge of pratisaiṋcara the unit mind goes on dilating because of the ever-increasing reflected density of the Macrocosmic Nucleus. Here the microcosm acts as a mirror and the reflected consciousness is just like the reflection of the rays of the sun, in that, while being reflected, He also associates Himself with the plate. The association inculcates the sameness of the quality and so the associative reflection of the Nucleus – Puruśottama – will develop in the unit mind the broadness of His Cosmic Self and the final culmination of the march of this unitary self, or microcosm.
ZH_TEXT: 由於宇宙向心運動的影響，個體心靈因為大宇宙核心的反映密度增加而持續地擴張。在此，個體小宇宙如同鏡子，而反映出的意識恰如陽光的反射，當祂被反映時，也將其自身與反映板連結。此種連結將使兩者愈來愈一致，所以與核心意識的連結會在個體心靈中產生宇宙大我的無限性，同時幫助單一自我或個體小宇宙達成前進之目的。
CITATION_EN: Shrii Shrii Ánandamúrti | 28 May 1959 | Pratisaiṋcara and Manah | Idea and Ideology

EN_TEXT: One will have to detach the mind from worldly propensities while meditating upon Iishvara (God). First the mind will have to be withdrawn from the limited “I” feeling, and focused at a point. Then one will take the thought of the Macrocosm around that point with the help of the ideation of the mantra prescribed according to one's own saḿskára (mental potentiality). He is the subtlest Entity; therefore He can be realized only through feeling and by no other means.
ZH_TEXT: 一個人在冥想上主時、必須讓心靈擺脫世俗的習性；首先，必須從有限的我覺中將心靈收攝，並定於一點；然後藉由梵咒理念作用之助，觀想大宇宙環繞該點，而此梵咒是依照每個人的業力(saḿskára)所定。祂是最精細的本體，因此，除經由覺知外，別無他法能了知祂。
CITATION_EN: Shrii Shrii Ánandamúrti | 28 May 1959 | 12 Psycho-Spiritual Practices of Iishvara Prańidhána | Yoga Sádhaná
CITATION_ZH: Shrii Shrii Ánandamúrti | 1959年5月28日 | 10 心住至上──心智導向靈性的鍛鍊 | 瑜伽修持科學觀，P.129

EN_TEXT: It is desirable to practise various lessons of sádhaná alone, in a lonely place, but Iishvara prańidhána can be practised both individually as well as collectively. In collective Iishvara prańidhána the combined mental efforts work together, and so give rise to the expression of the higher signs in a very short time. Therefore, like all other aspects of sádhaná, Iishvara prańidhána should positively be practised alone, in a lonely place; but in addition, do not miss the opportunity of collective Iishvara prańidhána whenever some of you conveniently meet together. The indomitable mental force aroused as a result of collective Iishvara prańidhána will help you solve any problem, great or small, on this earth. It is for this reason that you should always be zealous to attend weekly dharmacakra regularly.
ZH_TEXT: 一個人最好單獨在寂靜的地方練習靜坐的每一課，但「心住至上」的修持單獨或集體皆可行。在集體修持「心住至上」時，由於心靈集體努力的結合，可在短時間內將心靈提升至較高的境界。如同靈性修持的其他方面，「心住至上」當然也應該在無人之處獨自練習；此外，也不要錯過任何幾個人聚在一起從事「心住至上」修持的機會。在一起修持「心住至上」時所產生的堅強心靈力量，可幫助你解決任何大大小小的問題。因此，你應熱誠而有規律地參加每週的法性聚會(dharmacakra)。

EN_TEXT: What is the best auto-suggestion, on what you are to do? You are to use your incantation, always use your Iśt́a mantra. That is the best auto-suggestion. “Auto” means – what? “Auto” means “self”. “Autonomy” means “self-government”. “Automatic” – “done by self”.
ZH_TEXT: 什麼是最佳的自我暗示，你應該怎麼做呢？你必須持誦你的梵咒，永遠持念你的生命理念目標梵咒(Iśt́a mantra)，此為最佳的自我暗示。自我暗示意指什麼？自我暗示意指由自身自我管理、自我完成。
CITATION_EN: Shrii Shrii Ánandamúrti | 28 May 1959 | Psycho-Spiritual Practices of Iishvara Prańidhána | Yoga Sádhaná

EN_TEXT: What is the best outer-suggestion? When you are in good company, from that good company there comes outer-suggestion. Here you are getting outer-suggestion. This outer-suggestion strengthens the vitality of auto-suggestion. So outer-suggestion is a necessity, it is indispensable for a manʼs spiritual progress. This outer-suggestion is called satsauṋga in Sanskrit.
ZH_TEXT: 什麼是最佳的外在暗示？當你身處於一個良好的團體中，從那個團體裡，你得到外在的暗示。這種外在的暗示可以強化生命自我的暗示，對於一個人的靈性進步是不可或缺的。這種外在暗示在梵文裡叫作「與善為伍」(satsauṋga)。

EN_TEXT: Now, what is good and bad? What is sat and what is asat? The physical, mental, or spiritual action that helps you, or your association in developing your spiritual life that lessens the distance between you and your Lord, is “good”. And your physical, psychic, or spiritual actions that increase the distance between you and your Lord is “bad”.
ZH_TEXT: 什麼是善，什麼是惡？什麼是「真理」sat?什麼是「虛妄」(asat)?在身、心、靈各層面對你有益的行為，或是能夠幫助你靈性生命進展的友伴，那些能夠減少你和上主之間距離的事物都是好的。而那些會在身、心、靈各方面增加你和上主之間距離的事物就是不好的。
CITATION_EN: Shrii Shrii Ánandamúrti | 28 May 1959 | 12 Psycho-Spiritual Practices of Iishvara Prańidhána | Yoga Sádhaná

EN_TEXT: The physical structure of an animal is less complex than that of a human being, because the human mind is also more complex than that of the animal. The number of glands in a human body is more than that in an animal structure, in an animal body. Now, the first phase of the process is physico-psychic – that is, withdrawing the mind from different physical objects and bringing it to a particular point, and directing that point towards the realm of the mind. And next is a phase of withdrawing the mind from different mental objects, from different mental pabula, and directing it towards the Supreme Subjectivity.
ZH_TEXT: 動物的身體沒有人類身體那麼複雜，因為人類的心靈也比動物心靈複雜許多。人體內的腺體數目比動物的還多。心靈集中的第一個階段是由身體導向心智，亦即將心靈從各種物質客體中收攝回來，並導向於某一特定點，而此點直指心靈。下一個階段則是將心靈從各式心靈客體、從不同的心靈食糧中再收攝，並將它導向於至上的主體。

EN_TEXT: In the worship of Brahma there is a method by which every worldly duty can be performed easily and perfectly. For ideation on Brahma a person does not have to become a hermit in the forest. Only go on behaving rightly and properly with every manifestation of Brahma in this universe – remove or rectify the mental disease of criminals and reform their characters, cure the sick of their sickness, and arrange for their medicines and their diet. Just remember only this: that you have to behave properly and reasonably with every entity of this world. Pay special attention to the word “properly”. By “proper behaviour”, I mean that in which there is neither anger nor jealousy, neither attraction nor aversion...
ZH_TEXT: 在至上的禮拜中，有一種方法可以更容易及完善的完成世俗的責任。你無需退隱山林以心懷至上，只要在至上意識的所有展現裡，繼續保持適時而正確的行為，去除或導正犯罪的心理疾病、改變習性、治療疾病、適當的醫藥和飲食。只要牢記：你對這個宇宙的萬事萬物，都必須採取合理合宜的舉措。特別注意「合宜」這個字眼，我所謂合宜正確的舉止行為就是指既不憤怒、嫉妒，亦不執著或厭惡。
IT_TEXT: Nell’adorazione di Brahma esiste un metodo grazie al quale ogni dovere mondano può essere svolto facilmente e perfettamente. Per mantenere l’ideazione su Brahma una persona non deve necessariamente diventare un eremita nella foresta. È sufficiente continuare a comportarsi in modo giusto e appropriato con ogni manifestazione di Brahma presente in questo universo: eliminare o correggere la malattia mentale dei criminali e riformarne il carattere, curare gli ammalati dalle loro malattie e provvedere alle loro medicine e alla loro alimentazione. Ricordate soltanto questo: dovete comportarvi in modo appropriato e ragionevole con ogni entità di questo mondo. Prestate particolare attenzione alla parola «appropriato». Per «comportamento appropriato» intendo un comportamento nel quale non vi siano né rabbia né gelosia, né attrazione né avversione...
CITATION_EN: Shrii Shrii Ánandamúrti | 28 May 1959, Patna | 15 Pratyáhára Sádhaná | Yoga Sádhaná
CITATION_ZH: Shrii Shrii Ánandamúrti | 1959年5月28日於Patna | 13 感官回收之靈性修持 | 瑜伽修持科學觀，P.178

EN_TEXT: Unless the shabda or the collection of shabdas, when meditated upon, leads to the path of liberation, it cannot be called a mantra. Every mantra is thus sonic or vibrational and is vibrating simultaneously in the Cosmic system and in the unit body. When, with the help of a mantra, a person finally establishes the parallelism of the unit ectoplasmic vibration with the Cosmic vibration, that person gets mantra siddhi.
ZH_TEXT: 除非靜坐時所冥想之某一音聲或某組音，合能帶你走向解脫之道，否則它不能被稱為「梵咒」。所以每一個梵咒都是音聲或波動，同時會在大宇宙系統與個體中產生波動。當人藉著梵咒之助，建立起個體心靈波動與大宇宙心靈波動間的平行關係時，此人即達到持誦梵咒的成就(Mantra siddhi)。
CITATION_EN: Shrii Shrii Ánandamúrti | 28 May 1967 DMC, Allahabad | 04 Mantra Caetanya | Subháśita Saḿgraha Part 10
CITATION_ZH: Shrii Shrii Ánandamúrti | 1967年5月28日於Allahabad大法會 | 04 梵咒之覺醒 | 靈性科學集成 卷10，P.57~58

EN_TEXT: What is mantra caetanya, or the awakening of a mantra? Mantra caetanya is the condition where, with the help of a particular shabda, a person establishes parallelism between his or her external physical vibration and his or her internal ectoplasmic vibration, and then raises this to the spiritual level. And the culmination of this process in the achievement of the final spiritual goal is called mantra siddhi. The same shabda without being made “live” or awakened in the above process is meaningless; it acquires force and meaning when it becomes “live” in the aforesaid manner. The parallelism between the internal ectoplasmic vibration and the external Cosmic vibration can only be established when one has complete control over oneʼs own ectoplasmic vibration.
ZH_TEXT: 何謂「梵咒之覺醒」(mantra caetanya)?梵咒之覺醒是指該人經由某一特殊音聲之助，而建立起外在肉體波動與內在心靈波動間的平行關係，並進而將此提升至靈性層次的一種狀態。在達到最終靈性目標的過程中，其極致頂點就稱為持誦梵咒的成就。同樣的音聲在上述過程中若未經喚醒或使其具有生命力，也是沒有意義的；只有透過上述方式讓該音聲變得「有生命」時，它才具有力量和意義。唯有當人能完全控制自己心靈波動時，才能建立內在心靈波動與外在大宇宙心靈波動之間的平行關係。
CITATION_EN: 28 May 1967 DMC, Allahabad | Mantra Caetanya | Subháśita Saḿgraha Part 10
CITATION_ZH: 1967年5月28日於阿拉哈巴德 | 梵咒之覺醒 | 靈性科學集成卷10，P.58

EN_TEXT: Service to humanity with a view to serve Parama Puruśa and with the same attachment which one feels towards oneself and Parama Puruśa is an essential prerequisite for progress in sádhaná. This will establish the equilibrium and parallelism of the individual rhythms with the rhythms of the external physicalities.
ZH_TEXT: 以服務至上意識的心來服務人類，並對人類懷著一種像對待自己以及至上意識相同的感情，是促成靈修進步的一個主要先決條件。此將建立起個人波動與外在物質界波動間均衡與平行的關係。
CITATION_EN: Shrii Shrii Ánandamúrti | 28 May 1967 DMC, Allahabad | 04 Mantra Caetanya | Subháśita Saḿgraha Part 10
CITATION_ZH: Shrii Shrii Ánandamúrti | 1967年5月28日於Allahabad大法會 | 04 梵咒之覺醒 | 靈性科學集成 卷10，P.61

EN_TEXT: There are several essential factors to bring about mantra caetanya. The first is that the mantra should suit the saḿskára of the individual concerned. And the second is that the individual should feel a fraternal emotion for and attachment to the external world. This sentimental contact with the external world is a must. If someone is under the impression that “I am doing sádhaná for the sake of personal liberation and I have nothing to do with the world,” and thus denies his or her contact with external physicality, although the personʼs physical body is very much in this world, the person is cheating himself and indulging in selfishness.
ZH_TEXT: 有幾個重要的因素可以導致梵咒的覺醒。第一、梵咒應符合個人的因果業力；第二、個人對於外在世界應懷著一種如兄弟般的情誼和愛，與外在世界有此種情感的聯繫是必要的。如果有人覺得「我是為了個人的解脫而從事靈修，與這個世界一點關係也沒有」，因而拒絕與外在物質世界接觸，則雖然此人的肉體尚存活在這世界上，但其實他是在欺騙自己，不過是放任自己於自私自利之中。
CITATION_EN: Shrii Shrii Ánandamúrti | 28 May 1967 DMC, Allahabad | 04 Mantra Caetanya | Subháśita Saḿgraha Part 10
CITATION_ZH: Shrii Shrii Ánandamúrti | 1967年5月28日於Allahabad大法會 | 04 梵咒之覺醒 | 靈性科學集成 卷10，P.61

EN_TEXT: When a person will awaken caetanya in a mantra, that is, when he or she will do purashcarańa, he or she will move from negativity to positivity, from human parábindu to human sahasrára.
ZH_TEXT: 當一個人喚醒梵咒中的意識力量，亦即當經由梵咒的敲擊和梵咒的覺醒，庫拉孔達里尼從海底輪朝頂輪提升時，他將從負性走向正性，從音聲的起點(parábindu)走向人類的極致頂點(sahasrára)。
CITATION_EN: Shrii Shrii Ánandamúrti | 28 May 1967 DMC, Allahabad | 04 Mantra Caetanya | Subháśita Saḿgraha Part 10
CITATION_ZH: Shrii Shrii Ánandamúrti | 1967年5月28日於Allahabad大法會 | 04 梵咒之覺醒 | 靈性科學集成 卷10，P.64~65

EN_TEXT: As bliss is infinite pleasure alone. Sádhaná, then, is what wise people have to do. And in sádhaná, the first thing to be done is to use mantra caetanya.
ZH_TEXT: 因為喜悅是唯一無限的快樂。所以靈性修持是聰明人必須做的事，而其首要之務就是運用「梵咒的覺醒」。
CITATION_EN: Shrii Shrii Ánandamúti | 28 May 1967 DMC, Allahabad | Shravańa, Manana and Nididhyásana | Yoga Sádhaná

EN_TEXT: Going home is a simple task. It requires no scholarship, no knowledge, no intellectual [[faculty]] – no long and tedious lecturing. The scriptures tell us to remember three points in order to return home. They are shravańa [hearing about the Supreme], manana [ideating on the Supreme] and nididhyásana [meditating on the Supreme with an unbroken flow of mind].
ZH_TEXT: 回家是一件簡單的工作，它不需要學問，不需要知識，不需要智力──不需要冗長而乏味的說教。經典告訴我們為了回家必須記住三要點：諦聽有關至上(shravana)、心中持念觀想至上(manana)以及以不中斷的心靈波流冥想至上(nidi-dhyásana)。

EN_TEXT: And when His progeny sing Bábá nám kevalam openly, He sings Bábá nám kevalam secretly. Because the Progenitor is the nearest and dearest one for the progeny, hence the progeny also is the nearest and dearest one for the Supreme Progenitor. Both are bábá to each other and one another.
ZH_TEXT: 當祂的孩子公開唱頌著至上之愛無所不在(Bábá Náma Kevalam)時，祂也秘密的唱頌著至上之愛無所不在。因為對孩子而言，至上之父是最親近、最摯愛之人。所以對至上之父而言，孩子也是他所最親近、最摯愛的人。他們都是彼此最親愛的巴巴(bábá)。
CITATION_EN: Shrii Shrii Ánandamúrti | 28 May 1979 evening, Stockholm | 26 An Expression Is Never Alone | Ánanda Vacanámrtam Part 12

EN_TEXT: Utilize each and every moment of your life in doing something good, in thinking something good. When you are not physically doing something good, then mentally do something good. And the best mental work, the best mental engagement, is kiirtaniiyah sadá harih – “Do the kiirtana of Parama Puruśa.”
ZH_TEXT: 你應該充分利用生命做一些有意義的事或思考一些好事。當身體沒有在做時，那麼心靈就來做。心靈最好的工作是──唱頌至上之主的聖名(kiirtaniiyah sadá harih)。

EN_TEXT: The particular nature of expression through dance and through kiirtana which brings the inner self outward, that is, gives proper expression to the inner self – that particular nature of dance, together with kiirtana, is called Kaośikii. Kośa means “inner self”, and thatʼs why this dance has immense value in the psychic and spiritual strata of human life.
ZH_TEXT: 透過舞蹈和「至上聖名的唱頌」最能適切地將人類的內在真我展現出來──那種特別的舞蹈與「至上聖名唱頌」結合的結果，就稱之為「高士基」舞(Kaośikii)。Kośa意為「內在自我」，因此這種舞蹈對於人類生命在心智與靈性層面皆具有非凡的價值。
CITATION_EN: Shrii Shrii Ánandamúrti | 30 May 1979 morning, Valencia | 27 The Value of Dance | Ánanda Vacanámrtam Part 12
CITATION_ZH: Shrii Shrii Ánandamúrti | 1979年5月30日晨於Valencia | 27 靈性舞蹈的價值 | 喜悅甘露集卷6，P.152

EN_TEXT: Human life is an ideological flow – man moves towards spirituality, and for an animal there is no spirituality – only eating, drinking, sleeping and dying. Human life is an ideological flow, and there lies the fundamental difference between man and animal. So what should a man do? A man should decide at an early stage of his life what he is to do, what his mission in life is. The sooner it is done, the better it is, because you will get more chance, you will get ample scope to do, to materialize, to translate this goal into the actional flow... Saḿkalpa means “firm determination”. “I must do it. I must be successful in my mission. I must adhere to the principles of my life.” This firm determination is...samyak saḿkalpa.
ZH_TEXT: 人類的生命是一種理念的波流，人朝向靈性前進；但動物則沒有此種靈性──牠們的生命只有吃、喝、睡和死亡。人類的生命是理念的波流，這是人和動物間最根本的差異。所以一個人應該做什麼呢？一個人應及早決定他這一輩子要做什麼，他生命的使命是什麼。決定得越早越好，因為你將獲得更多的機會，更游刃有餘去做、去實現、將目標化為行動的波流。…… Sámkalpa意為「堅定的決心」、「我必須做，必須完成我生命的使命，必須堅守生命的原則。」這種堅定的決心就是「正思惟」(Samyak Sámkalpa)。
IT_TEXT: La vita umana è un flusso ideologico: l’essere umano si orienta verso la spiritualità, mentre per l’animale non vi è alcuna dimensione interiore – soltanto mangiare, bere, dormire e morire. La vita umana è un flusso ideologico, e qui risiede la differenza fondamentale tra l’essere umano e l’animale. Cosa dovrebbe fare, dunque, un essere umano? Fin dalle prime fasi della vita dovrebbe decidere che cosa intende fare, quale possa essere la sua missione esistenziale. Prima lo fa, meglio è, perché così avrà più possibilità, avrà ampio margine per compiere, realizzare, tradurre questo obiettivo nel flusso dell’azione. Saḿkalpa significa “ferma determinazione”: «Devo farlo. Devo avere successo nella mia missione. Devo aderire ai principi della mia vita.» Questa ferma determinazione è samyak saḿkalpa.
CITATION_EN: Shrii Shrii Ánandamúrti | 30 May 1979 evening, Valencia | 28 Lord Buddhaʼs Cardinal Principles | Ánanda Vacanámrtam Part 12
CITATION_ZH: Shrii Shrii Ánandamúrti | 1979年5月30日傍晚於Valencia | 28 佛陀的八正道 | 喜悅甘露集 卷6，P.162

EN_TEXT: Then the sixth one is samyak karmánta. Suppose you have started a particular work. Now you must not leave that work until that work is properly finished, till there is a happy finishing. Finishing should be done properly. This is called karmánta.
ZH_TEXT: 第六項是「正業」(Samyak Karmánta)。假定你開始做某個工作，在那工作適當完成前或有一個恰當的結束前，你都不應該放下工作離開。要有一個適當的結束，此謂之「完美的結束」(Karmánta)。

EN_TEXT: Now samyak smrti is remembering whatever is congenial to the spirit of never-ending human progress, and other items you may forget. Suppose a man unnecessarily wounded your sentiment. If you remember it you will be suffering from internal pain, mental agony. Try to forget it. It is better to forget it. If you want peace, you should forget it. But suppose you have learned something good. You should retain it. Those items coming within the second scope, that is, the scope of retention, are samyak smrti. And the best thing that you must always try to retain within the scope of your smrti, within the periphery of your smrti, is the name of Parama Puruśa, is the idea of Parama Puruśa. You must not forget it even for a single moment. When you are established in such a faculty, that is, when you never forget the name of Parama Puruśa, it is called dhruvásmrti.
ZH_TEXT: 「正念」就是記住與人類永無止境進步精神一致的任何事物，而其他的事物你可以忘記。假定有一個人傷了你的心，如果你一直記得這件事，那麼你的內在將承受無比的痛苦，心裡會有難過的煎熬。試著忘了它吧！你最好能夠將此事遺忘，如果你想要有平靜的心靈，你應該將它忘記。但如果你是學到了某些有益的好東西，那麼你應該努力將它保留住。那些來自精細範疇的事物，亦即記憶中的進步事物，就是「正念」。你必須永遠把最好的事物留在你的記憶裡，那就是至上意識的名字、至上意識的理念，你甚至不可須臾將祂忘記。 當你能夠立足於此種能力，亦即當你永遠都不會將至上意識之名忘懷時，就稱為「永恆的記憶」(dhruvásmrti)。

EN_TEXT: The correctness of perception depends upon a good many factors. The objects transmitting tanmátras must be in healthy condition. The gateways of the organs must be healthy, and also the reflecting tanmátras should be defectless. The afferent and efferent nerves and the citta should be sufficiently strong and active, and the last but not least factor is that the ego (ahaḿtattva) should be ready to receive them. Any defect or slackness of any of the above factors results in incorrect perception and hence in incorrect conception.
ZH_TEXT: 知覺的正確性有賴於許多因素：傳遞微波元素的對象必須處於正常的情況下、器官的入口必須健康，而反射的微波元素亦須毫無缺陷；輸入、傳出神經以及心靈質亦應強壯及活躍，最後但同樣重要的因素則是我執(ahaḿtattva)要準備好接收它們。只要上述任一因素有缺陷或鬆散都會導致不正確的覺知，因而造成錯誤的概念。
IT_TEXT: L’esattezza della percezione dipende da molti fattori. Gli oggetti che trasmettono i tanmātra devono essere in condizioni adeguate. Le porte degli organi di senso devono essere sane, e anche i tanmātra riflessi devono essere privi di difetti. I nervi afferenti ed efferenti e il citta devono essere sufficientemente forti e attivi, e, ultimo ma non meno importante, l’ego (ahaḿtattva) deve essere pronto a riceverli. Qualsiasi difetto o debolezza in uno qualsiasi di questi fattori determina una percezione errata e, di conseguenza, una concezione errata.

EN_TEXT: By a process of correct sádhaná, the sádhaka will feel that there is one causal mind in the universe. There is no causal difference between the microcosm and the Macrocosm. Similarly, by the subtleness of projection, subtle and crude portions of the unit mind can connect themselves with the subtle and crude portions of the Cosmic Mind. The way to achieve this subtleness of projection is the process of yogic sádhaná.
ZH_TEXT: 靈修者以正確的靈修方法將可感受到宇宙中存在一個致因心靈，在個體小宇宙及大宇宙心靈之間並無致因的差別。同樣地，藉著精細的投射，個體心靈的精細及粗鈍部分，能夠與大宇宙心靈的精細及粗鈍部分連結；達到這種投射的精細方法就是瑜伽修行(yogic sádhana)。
IT_TEXT: Attraverso un processo di corretto sadhana, il sādhaka giungerà a percepire che esiste un’unica mente causale nell’universo. Non vi è alcuna differenza causale tra il microcosmo e il Macrocosmo. Analogamente, grazie alla raffinatezza della proiezione mentale, le parti sottili e grossolane della mente individuale possono connettersi con le parti sottili e grossolane della Mente Cosmica. Il modo per raggiungere questa sottigliezza della proiezione è il processo del sadhana yogico.»

EN_TEXT: By its very nature, if the mind is to possess objectivity it must also have a witnessing entity. The witnessing entity is the summum bonum of the mind. Philosophy has given different names to the witnessing entity according to the differences in the nature of the objective mind.
ZH_TEXT: 心靈的特性為：如果它擁有客體，就一定會有目證體。此目證體是心靈的至高境界。哲學上依照客體心靈的性質，給予此目證體不同的名稱。
IT_TEXT: Per sua stessa natura, se la mente deve possedere oggettività, deve avere anche un’entità testimone. L’entità testimone è il summum bonum, il principio supremo della mente. La filosofia ha dato nomi diversi all’entità testimone a seconda delle differenze nella natura della mente oggettiva.

ZH_TEXT: 人藉由其行動、知識和虔誠讓自己的存在變得有價值，此方為真正的修持。一個人的存在越是融入於至上意識，他就變得越有價值。

EN_TEXT: As long as devotion is not there oneʼs heart is like a desert and when the devotion is attained, an oasis in the desert advents. You have not to be afraid of anything when devotion is with you. Nothing is to be afraid of when Parama Puruśa is with you.
ZH_TEXT: 人若無虔誠，其心將如沙漠般荒蕪，而有了虔誠，沙漠即會出現綠洲。有虔誠為伴，你當無所恐懼。當至上意識與你同在時，你何懼之有？

EN_TEXT: Nothing is to be afraid of when Parama Puruśa is with you. When devotion is there, Parama Puruśa is there. And when He is there fear none. In no case you have to be disturbed. You must remember that devotion is a unique creation of Parama Puruśa. And for getting this, learning, intellect, money etc. are not all needed. Ask and you get the cheapest but the most invaluable.
ZH_TEXT: 當至上意識與你同在時，你何懼之有？虔誠存在之處，至上意識就在那裡。當祂在那裡，你就沒有什麼好怕的！在任何情況下，你皆不應為此而煩惱。你要記住，虔誠是至上意識一個殊勝的創造。要得到虔誠，學識、智力和錢財等全部都不需要。只要你要求，你即可得到這個最便宜，又最無價的珍寶。

ZH_TEXT: 虔誠是愛的化身。 努力讓自身在對至上的愛中達到生命的極致，亦即對至上之愛的化身就是虔誠。

EN_TEXT: Because of His grace, they will get energy or strength from Him, and with that strength they will move forward. Without His grace, no one can move even a single step forward. And for this people should always remember that by their own efforts they do not make any progress, rather it is due to the wish of Parama Puruśa that they make any progress at all. It is the duty of Parama Puruśa to help them to move forward. This 100% reliance on Parama Puruśa is called “Prapatti” in the scriptures. Sadhakas should always maintain the spirit of “Prapatti” and they will never develop any sort of pride in their minds. “Whatever takes place in the universe and whatever qualities I possess is all due to His grace. He is the Lord of everything; He is the machine-man, and I am simply a machine.”
ZH_TEXT: 因為有祂的恩典，他才能從祂那裡得到力量，有了那個力量，他方才能夠前進。沒有祂的恩典，任何人一步也無法前進。為此，人們必須永遠記住，他們無法靠自己的努力而前進，任何進步都是憑藉著至上意識的意願。幫助人們前進是至上意識的責任，這種對至上意識百分之百的信賴，在經典上稱為「完全的臣服」(Prapatti)。修行者永遠都要有這種「完全臣服」的精神，心中不能有一絲一毫的傲慢。「宇宙間所發生的一切，我所擁有的特質，都是祂的恩典。祂是萬事萬物之主，祂是機器的操作者，而我不過只是機器。」
IT_TEXT: Per Sua grazia, gli esseri umani ricevono energia e forza da Lui, e con quella forza procedono nel cammino. Senza la Sua grazia nessun essere umano può avanzare anche di un solo passo. Per questo si dovrebbe sempre ricordare che non è grazie ai propri sforzi che avviene il progresso; se vi è progresso, esso avviene solo per la volontà di Parama Puruśa. Aiutare gli esseri a procedere è un dovere di Parama Puruśa. Questa totale fiducia in Parama Puruśa è chiamata “Prapatti” nelle scritture. I sādhaka dovrebbero mantenere sempre lo spirito della Prapatti, e così non sorgerà in loro alcuna forma di orgoglio. «Qualunque cosa accada nell’universo e qualunque qualità io possieda è dovuta unicamente alla Sua grazia. Egli è il Signore di tutto; Egli è Colui che muove ogni cosa, e io sono soltanto uno strumento.»

EN_TEXT: What is bhajana? You know, in the process of ideation there are several varieties. One of those varieties is bhajana. When the sádhaka employs all his or her sensory and motor organs in serving his or her object of ideation, that is called bhajana. Devotees sing the name of their Lord, and their ears hear that kiirtana, that bhajana; that is, all their indriyas, all their sensory and motor organs, are engaged in serving the Lord. That particular type of ideation is called bhajana.
ZH_TEXT: 何謂「虔誠之歌」(bhajana)?你們知道，在理念作用的過程中，有許多不同的類型，其中一種就是「虔誠之歌」。靈性的修持者運用其所有的感覺和運動器官為其理念作用的目標而服務，就稱為「虔誠之歌」。虔誠者唱頌著上主的聖名，他們的耳朵聆聽著上主聖名之唱頌以及虔誠的歌曲，也就是說他們所有的器官（包括所有的感覺和運動器官）都致力於對上主的服務。這種特別的理念作用型態，即稱之為「虔誠之歌」。

ZH_TEXT: 靈性修行者來到他對至上意識的虔誠心被完全喚醒的階段，即使受到生命風暴悲慘地攻擊，他也絲毫不受影響，就算心靈痛苦至極，他也不在乎，而把這種痛苦當成來自於至上意識的祝福。他從痛苦中得到喜悅。修行者達到這個階段稱為「業力種子燒盡」的階段。

EN_TEXT: And just to concentrate your mind during your occult practice, you must dance and sing kiirtana, because kiirtana is the best purifying agent. It purifies the mind, and its meaning is also very good. Its meaning is, “O Father, I am to take your name and your name only.” Bábá means “the nearest and dearest one”.
ZH_TEXT: 在從事靈性鍛鍊時，只要將心靈集中。你一定要配合靈性舞蹈唱頌至上的聖名(Kiirtana)，因為它是最好的淨化工具。它能淨化你的心靈，其意義也極為殊勝，即「哦，至上的父親啊！我接受您的名字，只接受你的名字。」Bábá意為「最親近和最親愛的」。

EN_TEXT: It is enough if we only think that the Subject is watching each action we are doing. By ideating that the Supreme Subjectivity is watching everything, we are thinking of Him as well, and this idea itself becomes objectivated. The Supreme Subject does not become objectivated, but the thought of the Supreme Subjectivity does. Ultimately, the best way to meditate on Parama Puruśa, or remember Him, is to bear in mind that, in actions big or small, significant or insignificant, in wakeful state or in sleep, in dream or in reality, the Supreme Subjectivity is maintaining a constant and close watch on me. Thereby the subjectivity as such does not come within your objectivated mind, but the ideation of the Supreme Subjectivity becomes objectivated. When this ideation becomes clear, stable and permanent, then one fine morning you will see that you have become one with the Supreme Subjectivity. And this is the final stage of the faculty of knowledge.
ZH_TEXT: 只要我們隨時想起主體正注視著我們的每一個行動就夠了。藉由觀想至上主體正注視每件事，我們也同時想著祂，而此觀念本身已被客體化。至上主體不會變為客體化，而是對至上主體的心念本身變成客體。最後，觀想或記住至上意識的最佳方法就是心裡隨時記住「不論在大或小，在重要或無足輕重的行動中，在清醒或在睡眠中，在夢中或在現實裡，至上主體都一直且親近的注視著我。」如此主體本身不會來到你客體化的心中，但對至上主體的持念或觀想將變成客體化。當此理念作用變得清晰、穩定、永恆時，那麼在一個美好的早晨，你將發現自己已和至上主體合而為一，而這就是知識能力的最後階段。

EN_TEXT: When one wants to get peace, what is one to do? One is to convert oneʼs small objectivity into infinite objectivity; and that is the only way to get peace. There is no alternative. Just simply preaching the gospels of peace will not give you any peace. You are to convert yourself from small into big. There is no alternative.
ZH_TEXT: 當一個人想要獲得平靜，他應該怎麼做呢？他應該將小我轉化成為無限的大我；這是唯一的方法，你別無選擇。光只在嘴巴上宣揚和平的福音，是無法獲得和平的。你必須轉化自己，將小我變成大我，你別無選擇。

EN_TEXT: It is possible for human beings to feel Parama Puruśa with their intuition and not with their intellect. Parama Puruśa is something that can be touched by your intuition and not by your intellect. In Vedic language, intuition is called bodhi and intellect is called buddhi. The Supreme is beyond the range of your buddhi. It is within the range of your bodhi.
ZH_TEXT: 人類唯有透過靈性直覺才能感受到至上意識，若想以人類的智力來接觸到祂是不可能的。你只能以靈性直覺而非智力來碰觸到祂的存在。在吠陀的語言中，靈性直覺稱為Bodhi，而智力為Buddhi。至上之境超越智力的範疇，它是在你靈性直覺的範疇裡。

EN_TEXT: A time comes in the life of a human being when one frantically searches for peace and longs for the realization of Iishvara tattva [the principle of Iishvara] or His closeness, by spiritually elevating oneʼs own sense of being an individual entity. The nature of this realization of closeness varies from person to person according to the differences in people and their saḿskáras. In some cases, again, after some progress, an ardent desire grows for further progress. However, at the root of every desire or longing (eśańá), there lies the story of a journey. To undertake a journey one needs a guide, one who will give the right direction and simultaneously illuminate the way (with a torch, before oneʼs eyes). So, when the desire grows for attaining peace, when there is an intense longing for supreme peace (paramá prashánti), one is brought before the Guru by the force of Shuddhámáyá or Pará Prakrti or Viśńumáyá [all meaning the absolute illusory force of Prakrti, or primordial Prakrti]. This awakening of desire, this special kind of longing is called samvit [revelation]. This sudden awakening brings one to the shelter of the Guru and puts one in touch with the Guru.
ZH_TEXT: 當一個人於靈性上提升個體的生命，他狂熱地追求心靈的平靜，並且極度渴望了悟至上的真諦(Iishvara tattva)或者非常想要與至上親近。每個人根據其因果業力，與至上親近之了悟的性質也有所不同。有的時候，一個人在有了一些進步後，會升起想要再進步的強烈渴望。 然而，在每一種渴望(eśańa)的背後都有一段旅程的故事。每一個人在踏上一段旅程之時，都需要有人指引，需要一個能夠引導他朝向正確方向前進，並且為他照亮路途的人。所以，當心靈產生想要獲得平靜，當一個人極度渴望得到永恆的平靜(paramá prashánti)時，宇宙的力量(shuddhá máyá/pará prakrti/viśńu máyá)將會把他帶至古魯面前。這種渴望就是一種「覺醒」(sambita)。這種突然的覺醒將一個人帶至古魯的聖壇前……並讓人與古魯聯繫上。

EN_TEXT: Suppose the Sadguru is saying something, and a deaf or dumb man wants to hear it, but cannot. If he concentrates the mind on barábhaya mudrá, there will be the direct effect of positive microvita on the auricular or other nerve cells and also on the controlling cells, and it may be that all of a sudden he may get back the power of hearing. One should look towards these two mudrás and not to anything else. Microvita are radiated through these two mudrás. This is the inner secret.
ZH_TEXT: 假定完美古魯正在開示，一個既聾又啞的人想要聆聽他的開示卻聽不見時，如果他們能夠集中心靈觀想古魯的「大無畏手印」(varábhaya mudrá)，則正性微生命將能對聽覺或其他神經細胞以及控制的細胞產生直接的作用，他可能在突然間恢復了聽力。所以，吾人應專注於這兩個手印，不該左顧右盼。正性微生命正透過這兩個手印發射出來。此為內在的奧秘。

EN_TEXT: The psychic potentialities of human beings are immense, but people do not utilize them because most of their valuable time is wasted in undesirable thoughts, in psychic extravaganza... This psychic extravaganza should be checked either by physical approach, or psychic approach, or by spirituo-psychic approach. People should have some control over their breathing, over their respiratory system, because the waves of respiration control the waves of thinking. Whenever you are doing something crude, your respiration becomes very active; and when you are thinking of something subtle, it becomes slow, extremely slow. And finally, when this respiration coincides, or becomes one, with oneʼs thought-waves, that stage is known as hat́ha yoga samádhi. That is, the physical exertions, the physical emanations, become one with the psychic emanations. So some degree of control over respiration is essential.
ZH_TEXT: 人類心智的潛能是巨大的，但是人們卻沒有使用它們，因為他們將寶貴的時間都花在無益的思想或妄想上。…… 這種妄想應透過身體、心理或靈性導向心理的方法加以控制。人們應控制他們的呼吸和他們的呼吸系統，因為呼吸的波動控制了思想的波動。只要你在做粗鈍的事情，你的呼吸變得很活躍；當你在思想某些精細的事物，呼吸就變得很緩慢、極為緩慢。最後，當呼吸和思想波流合一時，此一階段稱為「哈達瑜伽三摩地」(hat́ha yoga samádhi)。亦即身體上的努力、身體上的放射和心智上的放射合而為一。所以對於呼吸有一定程度的控制是必要的。
IT_TEXT: Le potenzialità psichiche degli esseri umani sono immense, ma le persone non le utilizzano perché gran parte del loro tempo prezioso viene sprecato in pensieri indesiderabili, in una dissipazione psichica… Questa dissipazione psichica dovrebbe essere controllata attraverso un approccio fisico, oppure psichico, oppure psico-spirituale. Le persone dovrebbero avere un certo controllo sul proprio respiro, sul proprio sistema respiratorio, perché le onde della respirazione controllano le onde del pensiero. Ogni volta che si compie qualcosa di grossolano, la respirazione diventa molto attiva; e quando si pensa a qualcosa di sottile, essa rallenta, diventa estremamente lenta. E infine, quando questa respirazione coincide, o diventa una cosa sola, con le onde del pensiero, quello stato è conosciuto come haṭha yoga samādhi. Vale a dire: gli sforzi fisici, le emanazioni fisiche, diventano una cosa sola con le emanazioni psichiche. Perciò un certo grado di controllo della respirazione è essenziale.

EN_TEXT: I have already said that the scope of rationality and rationalization should be increased more and more, and for this, unnecessary waves should be removed from the plane of physicality. From the psychic sphere also, unnecessary waves are to be removed. This will remove many burdens from the mind. “I must not bother about petty things, because that will waste my time” – people should remember this. This removal or rather withdrawal of unnecessary and undesirable thoughts emanated from the mind will help you in rationalizing the major portion of your mental faculty, so this must also be practised. The cult of spirituality is a cult of pinnacled order.
ZH_TEXT: 我曾經說過，理性和理性化的範圍應該愈來愈增加，為此我們應該將不必要的波動從物質層面去除。在心理層面也一樣，必須將不必要的波動去除，如此則許多負擔將從心中去除。「我一定不要為那些小事煩惱，因為這樣很浪費我的時間。」—人們應將此謹記在心。去除或是收攝心中所放射出來的不必要以及不好的思想，將會幫助你，使你心理能力的主要部分理性化，所以這也是要鍛鍊的。靈性的修持是達到極致的修持法門。

EN_TEXT: People get propensive propulsion from devotion or emotion. When the mind moves along a particular track or follows a particular discipline in a methodical way, this is called “devotion” or bhakti; but when it does not follow a particular method, when it moves haphazardly, swept away by whim, it is called “emotion”. This is the fundamental difference between devotion and emotion. You must know this clear-cut silver line of demarcation between devotion and emotion. Those who adhere to this cult of pinnacled order know that there must be a happy blending amongst intellectual-cum-intuitional faculty, actional faculty and devotional-cum-emotional faculty. None of these is unimportant, all are of equal importance, but the finality comes in devotion. That is, the final outcome or resultant of intellectual-cum-intuitional faculty and actional faculty is devotion, not emotion, and that is why the great sages of the past said, Bhaktir Bhagavato sevá bhaktih prema svarúpinii; Bhaktiránanda rupá ca bhakti bhaktasya jiivanam. [Bhakti (devotion) is service to God; bhakti is the form taken by divine love; bhakti is the embodiment of bliss; bhakti is the life of the devotee.]
ZH_TEXT: 人們從虔誠或情感中獲得心靈情緒傾向的驅策力。當心靈遵循一個特殊的道路或訓練而以有條理的方式行動時，稱為「虔誠」(bhakti);但若是他沒有遵循上述特殊方法，隨意而起，隨興而止，則稱為「情緒」(emotion)。這就是虔誠和情緒之間基本的不同。你們必須知道這兩者之間有著清楚的區別。 堅持達到極致修持法門之人，了解在智力兼直覺、行動以及虔誠兼情緒的能力之間，必須要有一個適當的調和。這三者之中沒有一個是不重要的，它們都同樣重要，但最終還需回到虔誠上，亦即智力兼直覺與行動能力的最終結果就是虔誠，不是情緒。是故往昔偉大的聖賢說道：Bhaktir Bhagavato sevá bhaktih prema svarúpinii; Bhaktiránanda rupá ca bhakti bhaktasya jiivanam. 「虔誠是對上主的服務；虔誠是神聖的愛；虔誠是喜悅的化身；虔誠是虔誠者的生命。」

EN_TEXT: Where the thought-waves or thought-movements are goaded by a single idea, and where the culminating point is also a singular entity – that is, where the attraction for other entities, for the crude world or the psychic world are all goaded unto the Supreme Self, towards Viśńu – this is the supreme status of devotion. Viśńu comes from the root-verb vish which means “to permeate”. The Entity which permeates everything, which is present in each and every expressed entity, in each and every emanation of this universe, is Viśńu.
ZH_TEXT: 當思想波動或思想活動為唯一的理念目標所驅策，且其極致的終點也是此唯一的本體時，也就是說，對其他實體、對粗鈍世界或心理世界的吸引力，若完全導向至上大我、導向無所不在的本體(Viśńu)──這便是虔誠最高的境界。Viśńu來自動詞的字根vish，其意為「充滿、瀰漫」。一個遍在萬有之中，存在於宇宙中一切實體及每一個展現的本體，就是「唯識努」(Viśńu)。

ZH_TEXT: 「心不離道」(Brahmacarya)並非指獨身生活，而是指個體心靈的心理波流融入大宇宙心靈的永恆波流。

EN_TEXT: If people think that they will make steady progress in the spiritual sphere even if the society goes to the dogs, they are mistaken. You who are genuine spiritualists should practise spiritual cult thinking that by doing so you will become effective in maintaining the universal balance. You must think, “I will personally move towards the Supreme Desideratum, and at the same time I will try to assist those who are suffering from despair, those steeped in blind superstition and those wallowing in poverty.” Our family is universal, our abode is also universal.
ZH_TEXT: 若有人認為：即使這個社會沈淪了，而他們仍可以在靈性層面上有穩定的成長，那他們就錯了。真正的靈修者應該想著：如是之修持，將會促進維持宇宙平衡。你們必須做如是想：「當我自己往至高無上的目標前進的同時，我將儘量幫助那些在絕望中受苦的人、那些沈浸在盲目迷信中的人，以及在貧困中翻滾的人。」因為，宇宙是我們的家庭，也是我們的住所。

EN_TEXT: The Means of Purifying the Five Kośas The paiṋcakośa shall have to be perfected, but how is it possible? They can be consummated only through the practice of Yama and Niyama. The annamaya kośa is perfected through asanas (physical postures). Yama and Niyama sádhaná perfects the kámamaya kośa. The manomaya kośa is perfected through pránáyáma. Through pratyáhára the atimánasa kośa is perfected. The vijiṋánmaya kośa is perfected through dhárańá, and the hirańmaya kośa through dhyána. Only dhyána samádhi gives access to the soul. Spiritual persons are those who are earnest in their efforts to perfect the paiṋcakośa. Human existence consists of the five kośas, and spiritual practice is eightfold. This spiritual practice is dharma. That which does not provide for the explanation of the paiṋcakośa is not dharma, but sectism. Aśt́áuṋga yoga was introduced for this particular kośa sádhaná.
ZH_TEXT: 淨化五個心靈層次的方法我們必須使心靈的五個層次完美，但是如何能做到呢？唯有藉由外在行為控制(Yama)和內在行為控制(Niyama)的修持，它們才能變得完美。身體層面的完美則是要透過瑜伽體位法；內外在行為控制的修持使粗鈍心靈層次完美；精細心靈層次是透過呼吸控制法的鍛鍊使其完美；經由感官回收的鍛鍊使超心靈層次得以完美；下意識心靈層次是透過集中的鍛鍊才得以完美；致因心靈則是透過禪定的鍛鍊使其完美。唯有禪定的三摩地才能使人進入靈魂裡。那些努力使五個心靈層次完美之人才是虔誠者。人的存在是由心靈的五個層次所構成，而靈性的修持則有八個層面。這個靈性的修持就是法性。那些對心靈的五個層次沒有詳盡解釋的鍛鍊，它不是法性而是宗派主義。八部功法瑜伽是用來作為此個別心靈層次修持之用的。
IT_TEXT: I mezzi per la purificazione dei cinque kośa I pañcakośa devono essere resi perfetti; ma come è possibile farlo? Essi possono essere portati a compimento solo attraverso la pratica di Yama e Niyama. L’annamaya kośa viene perfezionato mediante le āsana (le posture fisiche). Il sadhana di Yama e Niyama perfeziona il kāmamaya kośa. Il manomaya kośa viene perfezionato tramite il prāṇāyāma. Attraverso il pratyāhāra viene perfezionato l’atimanasa kośa. Il vijñānamaya kośa viene perfezionato mediante dhāraṇā, e l’hiraṇmaya kośa attraverso dhyāna. Solo il dhyāna-samādhi consente l’accesso all’Ātman. Sono spirituali quelle persone che si impegnano sinceramente nello sforzo di perfezionare i pañcakośa. L’esistenza umana è costituita dai cinque kośa, e la pratica spirituale è ottuplice. Questa pratica spirituale è dharma. Ciò che non prevede la spiegazione e il perfezionamento dei pañcakośa non è dharma, ma sectarismo. L’Aṣṭāṅga Yoga è stato introdotto proprio per questo sadhana dei kośa.

EN_TEXT: You human beings are fortunate that you do not have to live as stones or trees. The entire universe has the grace of Brahma, but human beings enjoy greater grace. They are endowed with the privilege of practising sádhaná. It is the special grace of Brahma to appear as Sadguru and teach spiritual practice to human beings. Is it not His special grace when Brahma attracts a person?
ZH_TEXT: 生而為人，你很幸運不必過著像石頭或是樹木般的生活。至上意識的恩典遍滿宇宙，但是人享受到更大的恩典，他們被賦予從事靈性修持的殊榮。至上意識顯現為完美的上師(Sadguru)教導人從事靈性的修持，這是祂特別的恩典。一個人受到至上意識的吸引，難道這不是祂特別的恩典嗎？

EN_TEXT: Even if your past life was depraved, from now on, from this very moment completely purge your mind of that memory. Let your life begin anew. Take to sádhaná from this very moment. Do not put it off until tomorrow, for tomorrowʼs sun may not rise on the horizon of your life.
ZH_TEXT: 即使你過去的生活是墮落的，從此刻起，徹底清除心靈的那段記憶，讓你的生命重生。從此刻起，開始你的靈性修持，別拖延到明天，因為明日的太陽可能無法在你生命的地平線上升起。

EN_TEXT: In the present environment many fissiparous tendencies are working to divide humanity into mutually-belligerent groups. Spirituality must inculcate sense in human psychology, and develop a natural affinity amongst this species of the creation. The approach of spirituality should be psychological and rational, and should offer a touching appeal to the deepest psychic sentiments of human beings.
ZH_TEXT: 在當前的環境中，充斥著許多分裂的傾向，使人類分成許多交戰的團體。靈性必須教化人心，並在眾生中發展出自然的親和力。靈性的方法應該符合人性及理性，且能深深觸動人內心深處之情感。

ZH_TEXT: 法性引領人們走向宇宙一家，並在個體心中注入宇宙理想主義。從法性觀點，宗教是團結人類的力量。此外，靈性提供個人及全人類精細而巨大的力量，這是其他力量無法比擬的。

EN_TEXT: When the unit mind is established in psycho-spiritual parallelism, it is called “idea”, while the psychic conception of psycho-spiritual parallelism is called “ideology”. When idea maintains adjustment with the glands and sub-glands, it is called “ideation”. But to effect psycho-spiritual parallelism, knowledge, action and devotion are required. In spiritual parlance, when the mental flow is directed towards the goal, that is, the Supreme Entity, it is called “concentration”.
ZH_TEXT: 當個體心靈與心智趨向靈性層面的波流平行時，即稱之為「印心」(idea);而對此心智趨向靈性層面平行狀態的心智概念就稱為「悟道」(ideology)。當個體心靈與心智趨向靈性的波流平行，且與腺體和次腺體維持調和時，就稱為「理念作用」(ideation)。但為了達到上述平行狀態，必須具備知識、行動和虔誠。以靈性的說法而言，當心靈波流導向生命目標──即至上本體，就稱為「集中」;但以形而上學來說，這是一種法性的概念。

EN_TEXT: Should do sitting in siddhásana [perfect posture] or any other convenient ásana [posture], on the same blanket, skin, seat or bed as they had used for sleeping, immediately after waking up and before doing any other work or before having any other thought – even before performing their morning duties or any other task. This will be a high category of Gurusakásha. If it cannot always be done immediately after sleep, it is essential to remember the Guru early in the morning after overcoming sleepiness. If this is done, they will meet with success or illumination in each and every subtle and spiritual task that they perform in the course of the whole day. It is said: Prátah shirasi shuklébje dvinetraḿ dvibhujaḿ gurum;  Varábhayakrtahastaḿ smarettaḿ námapúrvakam. [Early in the morning one should meditate on the Guru in Barábhaya mudrá with two hands and two eyes seated on a white lotus in Guru cakra, and remember Him by chanting His holy name (through a mantra).]
ZH_TEXT: 應該在每天早上一醒來，尚未做任何事情（甚至未進行梳洗、如廁等工作之前）或心中尚未生起任何其他念頭時，立刻以「完美坐姿」(Siddhásana)或任何其他方便的姿式，坐在其睡覺時所躺臥的毛毯、毛皮、座位或床舖上，於古魯輪觀想古魯。這是一種高層次的古魯庇護法(Gurusakásha)。如果不能經常在睡醒後立刻做上述觀想，那麼在早晨清醒後記住古魯是特別重要的。靈性修持者若能如此，那他們一整天所從事的每件精細與靈性的工作均將獲得光明與勝利。 Prátah shirasi shuklébje dvinetraḿ dvibhujaḿ gurum;  Varábhayakrtahastaḿ smarettaḿ námapúrvakam. 「人應在每天清晨於古魯輪，觀想古魯的雙手、雙眼，祂以圓滿大無畏手印坐在白色蓮花上。吾人並應透過梵咒持念祂的聖名以記住祂。」

EN_TEXT: Let all the various human scripts be studied and developed impartially, and let the result be utilized in the cause of aesthetic science. Then human beings will certainly achieve rapid progress; the conflict between states, between societies and between races will cease in no time. They must march ahead vigorously with firm steps, keeping a synthetic goal ever before them. Caraeveti, caraeveti – “March forward, march forward”. This should be the slogan of todayʼs humanity.
ZH_TEXT: 讓各種不同人類的典籍都能夠被研究且超然地發展，並且讓此結果應用在美學的目標上。那麼人類一定能夠快速的進步，而國與國、社會與社會及種族與種族之間的衝突也將立刻停止。人必須一直將結合的目標擺在眼前，並且以堅定的步伐，奮力向前邁進。「向前邁進，向前邁進！」這才是人類今天應該提出的口號。

EN_TEXT: At various times, we come across ideological conflicts among human beings. What does this ideological conflict really mean? Let human beings follow the path, the ideals, which appeal to them. If a particular theory or ideology is acceptable to some people, let them follow that ideology. Why should there be a conflict between people? Such conflicts should never occur. If anyone wants to drive a wedge into the one and indivisible human society on the basis of some ideology or theory, then this is nothing but a totally mischievous plan. Human beings can easily co-exist despite mere ideological differences... Different theories and doctrines with their numerous interpretations and connotations should be developed. No one should object to that, because intellectual clash and cohesion cause the human intellect to progress. Why should we keep all the doors of the human intellect closed? Let sufficient light and air enter the intellect for its overall enrichment.
ZH_TEXT: 在不同時代，人類彼此間常遭逢理念上的衝突。到底這種理念的衝突所指為何？讓人們各隨所好去追隨他們的理想吧。如果某些人接受某特定理論或觀念，就讓他們去追隨他們的喜好，為什麼之間要有衝突呢？不應該有衝突才是，任何人想要強行將某種理論或觀念置入這不可分的人類整體，就是一種蓄意的破壞計劃，雖然彼此間理念的不同，但人類是相當容易可以互相接納並存的。…… 各種理論和教義以及其闡釋皆應充分發展，沒有人應反對，因為各種心智的摩擦衝擊才能造成人類智力的進步。我們為什麼要關閉人類智力的大門呢？迎進足夠的光線和空氣來豐富智力吧！

ZH_TEXT: 我們在此世上最主要的職責是什麼？就是要盡可能務實的從事不同的活動。有無數的工作，但是人類的能力有其限度。因此在許多的活動裡，你一定要尋求其他人的合作。

EN_TEXT: Unless and until you have developed implicit faith and sincere love for that Supreme Father, you will not become one with Him, you will be bound by this Máyá. Now, when do people begin to feel that they should love the world? When they free themselves from evil, from egotistic sentiments.
ZH_TEXT: 除非你對至上之父有絕對的信心和真誠的愛，否則你無法與祂合而為一，你一定會受制於宇宙力量。何時人們才會感覺到他們應該要愛這個世界？當他們擺脫了邪惡、擺脫了自我感時。
IT_TEXT: Finché non avrete sviluppato una fede assoluta e un amore sincero per quel Padre Supremo, non diventerete uno con Lui; resterete legati da questa Māyā. E quando gli esseri umani iniziano a sentire che dovrebbero amare il mondo? Quando si liberano dal male, dai sentimenti egoistici.

EN_TEXT: One is to get Him, to come in contact with the Divine Father, through jiṋána, karma and bhakti. What is jiṋána? Jiṋána is spiritual knowledge, not mundane knowledge. Mundane knowledge is distorted knowledge. It is not knowledge at all. Spiritual knowledge is the real knowledge. But what is spiritual knowledge? One must know what one is, what oneʼs goal is. This is the spiritual knowledge. Then comes karma. Karma means “action”. But if one knows what one is, what oneʼs desideratum is, then one will have to move towards oneʼs goal. One will have to do something practical and move towards oneʼs goal. This movement, this practical approach, this actional approach, is called karma. And then when, after karma, one comes near to Him, one will be united or unified with Him. This process of unification is devotion, bhakti.
ZH_TEXT: 人必須透過知識、行動與虔誠來獲得祂，來與至上之父接觸。什麼是「知識」?知識是指靈性的知識，而非世俗之知識。世俗的知識是扭曲的知識，一點也不能稱為知識，靈性的知識才是真正的知識。那麼什麼又是靈性的知識呢？也就是人必須知道自己是什麼，自己的目標是什麼，這才是靈性的知識。接著談到「行動」，如果一個人知道自己是什麼，自己的目標又是什麼，那麼他是不是應該要向著他的目標前進，他必須要做些具體的努力，朝著他的目標前進。這種前進，所採取的實際方法，就稱為「行動」。當人有了行動之後，他就會與祂接近，他將會與祂合一或融入於祂。這種融合的過程就稱為虔誠。

EN_TEXT: To come in direct contact with the Supreme Father, you are to serve the universe as the ideal daughters and sons of the Supreme Father. You neednʼt be anxious. You must not have any worries and anxieties about your personal problems. Your problems are to be solved by the Supreme Father. You serve the children of the Supreme Father as the ideal daughters and ideal sons of that Father.
ZH_TEXT: 為了能與至上之父直接接觸，你必須做一個至上之父理想的孩子，服務這個宇宙。你無需擔憂，你不必為個人問題而煩惱、憂心忡忡。你的問題至上之父會幫你解決，你只要做祂理想的孩子服務祂其他的孩子即可。

EN_TEXT: The Supreme Cognitive Principle, which is the only knowable entity for all other beings, is the sole permanent entity. To attain something permanent, one must not run after the petty pleasures of the world. Rather, knowing that eternal Entity, that permanent Entity, to be the only goal of life, one has to propel all oneʼs mental propensities towards Him. One must not waste oneʼs potentialities mistaking the transitory for the eternal. All created objects are finite; sitting in the midst of the multitude of finite things, and with the help of a finite unit mind, it is impossible, either in theory or in practice, to think of the Infinite. When the mind becomes intoxicated with the thought of the Infinite, then the finite mind transcends its own limits and loses itself in a state of endless peace. This is the highest attainment.
ZH_TEXT: 至上認知法則──此唯一讓一切眾生可知的實體──是唯一永恆的實體。一個人若想要達到永恆之境，則絕對不可追逐世俗渺小的快樂，一個人若欲了知那永恆實體是生命的唯一目標，則必須將所有的心靈情緒傾向導向祂。不可浪費潛能，誤將短暫當成永恆。所有的創造物皆為有限之事物，想要以有限的心靈來觀想無限，是不可能的，不管在理論上或實際上都是如此。當心靈沉醉在觀想無限時，有限的心靈則超越了它原有的限制，而陶醉在無限寧靜祥和的境界裡，此乃最高之成就。

EN_TEXT: What are the causes of salvation? Átmajiṋána [self-knowledge] is the only requisite for the attainment of mokśa. (The knowledge that “I am Brahma” is also known as pańd́a, and one having this pańd́a is a pańd́ita.) Of the living creatures, only the human – one having a human body, human glands, etc. – can attain mokśa. If one does not take proper care to attain mokśa, then one is a foolish person, for one is not making proper utilization of oneʼs human potentialities.
ZH_TEXT: 如何方能達到解脫？自我了悟(Átmajiṋána)就是達到解脫的唯一途徑(「我即是至上意識」的了悟知識稱為「潘達」—pańd́a，擁有「潘達」的人就是「了悟者」—pańd́ita)。 在有生命的個體中，唯有擁有人類肉身、人類腺體的人類能夠達到解脫。如果不利用此肉身來達到解脫，就是最愚昧的人，因為他沒有善用他所特有的人類心靈習性。
IT_TEXT: Qual è il requisito per la liberazione? L’átmajiñána [conoscenza del Sé] è l’unico requisito per il conseguimento di mokṣa. (La conoscenza «Io sono Brahma» è detta anche paṇḍa, e chi possiede questo paṇḍa è un paṇḍita.) Tra tutti gli esseri viventi, solo l’essere umano – cioè colui che possiede un corpo umano, ghiandole umane, ecc. – può conseguire mokṣa. Se una persona non si impegna seriamente a conseguire mokṣa, allora è una persona sciocca perché non sta facendo un uso corretto delle proprie potenzialità umane.

EN_TEXT: Now I am leaving this country, and I am leaving you physically. I am always with you; I will always be with you. Physically I am leaving you, my sons and daughters, but I cannot forget you, and mentally I will always be with you. I want that all of you should be ideal human beings. All of you, let your existence be successful. I have got nothing more to say. Peace be with you. My sons and my daughters, I have one more thing to say. I do not belong to heaven. What I am – I am to express this truth in a single sentence: I am yours.
ZH_TEXT: 現在我即將離開這個國家，我的身體將與你們分離。但我永遠與你們同在，我會永遠與你們同在的。孩子們，雖然我的肉身離開你們，但是我無法將你們忘懷，我的心靈將永遠與你們同在。我衷心期盼各位都能成為完美的人。希望你們一個個都能成就自身，這是我所要說的話，再無贅言。願永恆的寧靜與你們同在！我的孩子們，最後還有一句話，就是：我不屬於天堂，那麼我是什麼，用一句話來表示此一真理，那就是：我是屬於你們的。

EN_TEXT: You should remember one thing. In the Sanskrit language, the verbs yuiṋj and yuj do not have identical meanings. Yuj means “to add”, while yuiṋj means “to unify, to become one without any difference”. [In the same way,] jiivátmá and Paramátmá become one. The jiivátmá no longer has any separate identity. It has merged itself in Paramátmá. Brahmavid brahmaeva bhavati – “One who knows Paramátmá becomes Paramátmá Himself.” He no longer has any separate existence. In the spiritual domain, yoga is used in this sense (in the sense of “unification” and not in the sense of “addition”).
ZH_TEXT: 你們應該記住一件事：在梵文裡，動詞字根yuiṋj和yuj的意思並不相同。Yuj意指「增加」，而yuiṋj意指「融合，變成不可分割的一體」。同樣的，個體意識與至上意識也是如此融合成一體，個體意識因而失去了其自身的存在，它融入於至上意識裡。Brahmavid brahmaeva bhavati──了悟至上意識者，即成為至上意識本身。他不再有個體的存在。在靈性的領域上，瑜伽指的是這個意思（即融合，非增加之意）。
IT_TEXT: Dovete ricordare che nella lingua sanscrita, i verbi yuiṋj e yuj non hanno lo stesso significato. Yuj significa «aggiungere», mentre yuiṋj significa «unificare, diventare uno senza alcuna differenza». Allo stesso modo, jiivátmá e Paramátmá diventano uno. Il jiivátmá non conserva più alcuna identità separata: si è fuso nel Paramátmá. Brahmavid brahmaeva bhavati – «Colui che conosce Paramátmá diventa Egli stesso Paramátmá.» Non rimane più alcuna esistenza separata. In ambito spirituale, la parola yoga è usata in questo senso (nel senso di «unificazione» e non nel senso di «aggiunta»).

EN_TEXT: People operate in the world within the confines of a limited circumference. Because of this, they cannot completely merge in Parama Puruśa. There is a bondage, a boundary, around the mind. So, a yogi has to expand his or her mind and remove the bondage. This bondage is the bondage of Máyá. One can become a yogi only when this bondage is removed. Only then will human mind and Cosmic Mind become one.
ZH_TEXT: 世上的人們都是在有限狀態的束縛下運作著，因為束縛纏繞著心靈，他們無法完全融入於至上意識裡。所以，一個瑜伽行者必須努力擴展他的心靈以去除這些束縛。此束縛即是宇宙力量的枷鎖。只有除去這枷鎖，個體的心靈與大宇宙心靈合一時，一個人方才可能成為真正的瑜伽行者。

EN_TEXT: There is a particular tune, a particular rhythm, a particular rága, a particular rágini, particular laya and a particular tála in the Paramarasa-samudra as per the vibration projected in the nucleus of the Paramarasa. One who gets one acquainted with these does not like visayarasa, and naturally leaving the Visayarasa, one goes into Paramarasa.
ZH_TEXT: 在至上神性波流的海洋裡，依照在至上神性波流核心的投射，每種波流都有其特殊的旋律、節奏、音階和方式。只要吾人熟悉這些，就不會再喜歡物質享樂的波流，自然而然會離開物質享樂的波流，而來到至上神性的波流裡。
IT_TEXT: Nell'oceano della Beatitudine Suprema (Paramarasa) esistono una particolare melodia, un particolare ritmo, un particolare raga, una particolare ragini, un particolare laya e un particolare tala, in accordo con le vibrazioni proiettate dal suo nucleo. Chi entra in sintonia con esse non trova più attraente il viśayarasa (il fascino e il piacere derivanti dagli oggetti e dalle esperienze del mondo materiale) e, abbandonandolo spontaneamente, entra nel Paramarasa.

EN_TEXT: What is it that is dearest to human beings? It is our considered opinion that the átmá [unit-consciousness] is a human beingʼs dearest object, and for the átmá, Paramátmá [Supreme consciousness] is the dearest object. So, the dearest object is Paramátmá. The mantra by which one attains Paramátmá or the Iśt́a is the Iśt́a mantra. People can get paritráńa [final liberation] simply through the Iśt́a mantra. Guru mantra is also like this. Guru mantra is that which reminds you at every step that you are a human being, for you it is not worth doing. This means that through the guru mantra, you always feel the presence of the Guru before you. This is the significance of the gurumantra. By now you must realize how casually the word mantra is used. Then, what should a person do? One has to place the Iśt́a mantra and guru mantra in a different category from/to other mantras, because other mantras bring tráńa, whereas Iśt́a mantra and guru mantra bring people paritráńa. While the use of other mantras brings temporary relief from suffering, the use of the Iśt́a mantra and guru mantra lead to permanent liberation, emancipation or salvation.
ZH_TEXT: 人類最親愛的東西是什麼？我們認為個體意識是人類最親愛的，而對個體意識而言，它最親愛的則是至上意識。因此，人最親愛的、最珍貴的就是至上意識。能讓人達到至上意識或生命目標的梵咒就是「生命目標梵咒」。人透過他的生命目標梵咒，就能達到究竟解脫。古魯梵咒也一樣，它時時刻刻提醒你，透過古魯梵咒，你會永遠感覺到古魯在你面前。這是古魯梵咒的意義。現在，想必你們已瞭解梵咒的使用了吧！那麼人又該怎麼做呢？人不能再將他的生命目標梵咒及古魯梵咒與一般梵咒等同視之。因為其他的梵咒帶來的是暫時的解脫，而個人生命目標梵咒與古魯梵咒為人帶來的是究竟解脫。使用一般的梵咒，你能短暫地擺脫痛苦，然而當你持念個人生命目標梵咒及古魯梵咒時，你將可獲得永恆的究竟解脫。
IT_TEXT: Che cosa è più caro agli esseri umani? Secondo noi, l’átmá [coscienza individuale] è l’oggetto più caro per l’essere umano, e per l’átmá, il Paramátmá [Coscienza Suprema] è l’oggetto più caro. Dunque, l’oggetto più caro è il Paramátmá. Il mantra attraverso cui si realizza il Paramátmá o l’Iśt́a è l’Iśt́a mantra. Le persone possono ottenere il paritráńa [liberazione finale] semplicemente attraverso l’Iśt́a mantra. Il guru mantra è simile. Il guru mantra è ciò che ti ricorda a ogni passo che sei un essere umano e che certe azioni non sono degne di te. Questo significa che attraverso il guru mantra si sente costantemente la presenza del Guru davanti a sé. Questo è il significato del guru mantra. A questo punto dovreste rendervi conto di quanto superficialmente venga usata la parola “mantra”. Allora, che cosa dovrebbe fare una persona? Deve collocare l’Iśt́a mantra e il guru mantra in una categoria distinta rispetto agli altri mantra, perché gli altri mantra portano tráńa, mentre l’Iśt́a mantra e il guru mantra portano paritráńa.Mentre l’uso degli altri mantra porta un sollievo temporaneo dalla sofferenza, l’uso dell’Iśt́a mantra e del guru mantra conduce alla liberazione permanente, all’emancipazione o alla salvezza.

EN_TEXT: Mortal human beings can attain liberation only if they channel all their psychic tendencies, all their thought-waves, towards the Supreme One, and then the dynamic flow of their minds, concentrated at a single point, becomes one with the Supreme Cognition, far beyond the scope of all bondages. The finite microcosm merges in the Macrocosm; the small “I” dissolves in the infinite vastness. In fact, this “I” never loses itself – the small “I” only becomes the great “I”. The Supreme Cognition completely absorbs the individual “I”, and this state of total surrender of the individual brings complete fulfilment. In that exalted state, one realizes that the millions of individual entities are all microscopic fractions of that oceanic Brahma, merely bubbles in that infinite sea. This is the state of realization of Brahmaeváham or Brahmásmi [“I am Brahma”]. Hence it is said that if mortal human beings can surrender their all to the Supreme Entity by means of sádhaná, then they can certainly attain liberation, even while in their physical bodies.
ZH_TEXT: 一般人唯有將其所有的心理情緒傾向、所有的思想波流導向唯一的至上才可能得到解脫，心靈生生不息的波流集中於一點，且與至上認知能力融合，那麼他才能超越所有的束縛。有限的小宇宙個體與大宇宙心靈合而為一，小「我」融入於浩瀚的無限中。事實上，這個「我」從未消失──只是由小「我」變成了大「我」。至上認知力將個體的「我」完全吸收，這種個體小「我」全然臣服的狀態，為個體帶來圓滿的實現，在那崇高之極致境界，他了悟到數以百萬計的小宇宙個體皆為彼海洋般至上意識之微小部分，僅僅只是浮現在無限廣大海洋的小泡沫。此即了悟「我即至上意識」(Brahmaeváham或Brahmásmi)的境界。因此才有言道：如果眾生能夠藉由靜坐修持向至上本體全然臣服，即使在活著之時，亦必可得到解脫。

EN_TEXT: Certainly the person whose hands and feet are tied and who cannot move at all, whose voice is totally silenced, whose feelings of the heart are suppressed, whose urges of life have no expression, who is physically behind bars, whose mind is caged by dogmas, whose soul is deprived of the blissful flow of nectar, whose path of progress has lost its way in a chasm, is indeed in bondage. The vigorous effort for emancipation from all bondages is termed sádhaná, and the motive that inspires such efforts is called liberation.
ZH_TEXT: 手、腳都被綁住無法移動、喉嚨無法發聲、內心情感被壓抑、生命渴望無法表達、身體被監禁、心靈被教條鎖住、靈魂被剝奪無法享受喜悅甘露波流以及在進步道上迷路落入深淵的人，都是被束縛的人。強力掙脫所有束縛得到自由的努力就稱為「靈性修持」，鼓舞人心努力掙脫所有束縛的動力就稱為「解脫」。

EN_TEXT: If a person prays, let me vanquish my enemy, it is to be remembered that the enemy is also the creation of Mahámáyá. What will the person get by invoking that Máyá as dviśo jahi? This is not the correct way. Then, what is the correct thing to do? The correct path is the middle way. That means, “I will advance towards my goal. I shall go ahead unperturbed by the hindrances and obstacles that come along the way. Parama Puruśa is with me. I fear no one. I know that such obstacles and dangers are small compared to the power of Parama Puruśa. When the omnipotent, supreme God is with me, whom shall I fear?” This is the middle way.
ZH_TEXT: 一個人要是祈禱希望宇宙力量助他打敗敵人，你們要記得，那個敵人對宇宙力量而言，也一樣是她的產物，你請求她給你打敗你敵人的力量，能成功嗎？這是不對的。要怎麼做方才正確呢？就是採取中道，也就是說：我會向著我的目標前進，不受途中各種阻礙干擾。至上意識與我同在，我一無所懼。我知道和至上意識的力量相較，我所面臨的阻礙和危險多麼微不足道。如果全知全能的至上意識與我同在，我要畏懼誰呢？這就是中道。

EN_TEXT: For the attainment of the ultimate goal and the realization of Parama Puruśa, the middle way is the ideal path. You should remember that noble work is never accomplished through flattery. One needs to have courage, competence and sincerity to do a noble work. Of course, you will emerge victorious. Never worry about success. You have come to this world for a noble mission. Keep on making efforts till you reach your goal. Eventually, you will attain your cherished goal and will be established in cosmic bliss for eternity.
ZH_TEXT: 要達到生命究竟的目標、要了悟至上意識，中道為最理想的道路。你們要記住的是：任何高尚的工作皆不可能透過奉承和懇求而可完成；要做高尚的工作，人必須具足勇氣、能力和誠心。如此，勝利必然可期。你們不要擔心會不會成功，因為你們是為了做高尚工作而來此塵世，在未達目標前要持續努力，最後你們一定可以達到珍愛的目標，並且永恆立足於大宇宙喜悅之境。
IT_TEXT: Per il conseguimento della meta suprema e per la realizzazione di Parama Purusa, la via di mezzo è la via ideale. Dovete ricordare che un’opera nobile non viene mai realizzata mediante l’adulazione. Per compiere un’opera nobile sono necessari coraggio, capacità e sincerità. Naturalmente, uscirete vittoriosi. Non preoccupatevi mai del successo. Siete venuti in questo mondo per una nobile missione. Continuate a compiere ogni sforzo fino a quando non avrete raggiunto la vostra meta. Alla fine raggiungerete la meta desiderata e sarete stabiliti per l’eternità nella beatitudine cosmica.

EN_TEXT: Human existence is an ideological flow. If any entityʼs existence goes against its ideological flow, it harms itself. Under those circumstances, people would rather commit suicide than sacrifice their ideology. You might read in history that in the case of ideological conflicts, millions of people left their countries and migrated to other lands. Millions of people leave their countries even today and, if the occasion arises, will do so in future, unless we build and ideal human society.
ZH_TEXT: 人類的存在是一種理念的波流，個體的存在若違反此一理念波流，會傷及自身。在那種情況下，人寧可自殺也不會去犧牲他們的理念。你或許曾於歷史中讀過，數百萬的人由於理念的衝突而離鄉背井移居他地，即使在今日也有數百萬人民離開自己的家園，除非我們能建立起一個有理念的人類社會，否則若情況再度發生，那麼將來這種事仍會重演。

EN_TEXT: Tadsthiti: Human beings have the tendency to merge in Parama Puruśa, for He is the only Supreme desideratum of all unit beings. Thus we find that the essential characteristics of Bhágavata Dharma are expansion, flow and service and the final goal is ensconcement in Parama Puruśa.
ZH_TEXT: 安住於至上(tadsthiti):人類想要融入於至上意識，因為祂是萬有個體唯一的終極目標。由此我們知道至上法性最重要的特性就是擴展、波流、服務以及最後的目標──安住於至上意識之中。

EN_TEXT: There is a basic difference between eśańá [longing] and icchá [desire]. Icchá means “desire” or “intention”, whereas eśańá or “longing” presupposes an active endeavour to fulfil that desire. In each and every living being there is the innate desire for happiness, and there is an active effort to fulfil that desire as well. In their search for happiness, human beings discovered that the entire property of this universe will never be able to satisfy their psychic hunger. With unsatiated hearts they kept on repeating, “My hunger is not yet satisfied, my thirst is yet unquenched.” Thus in the process of this constant search for happiness, one finally attains that Entity who is the most beloved of all and that entity is oneʼs iśt́a. With the acquisition of money, people still feel that they have nothing; in spite of possessing a huge amount of money they often beat their chests in despair. So it is not money they seek – what they truly desire is peace, not happiness. But it is only rarely that people attain peace in life. Iśt́a means Parama Puruśa but why is He called Iśt́a? The answer is that by attaining Parama Puruśa one no longer has any unsatiated hunger or unquenched thirst. He is so vast that the human mind can never fully grasp Him. And if there is no emptiness in the mind, how can anyone feel hunger or thirst?
ZH_TEXT: Eśańá（渴望）和icchá（慾望）基本上是不同的。Icchá意為「慾望」或「意向」;而eśańá則含有積極努力實現此慾望之意。每一個眾生與生俱有追求快樂的慾望，也積極努力實現這個渴望。在追尋的過程中，人類發現宇宙間所有的東西都不能滿足他們心靈的飢渴，因為心靈尚未得到滿足，所以一再吶喊著：「我還未滿足、還未滿足。」 在此永恆的追尋之中，終於達到他們最親愛的那個本體，此本體即吾人之理念目標。人獲得金錢後，仍然覺得一無所有，即使擁有大量的金錢，他們還是經常感到失望，所以金錢並非他們所要追求的，他們真正想要的是平靜，而不是快樂；可是生命中能獲得這種平靜的人屈指可數。 理念目標就是「至上意識」，為什麼至上意識是理念目標呢？原因就在於：當一個人獲得至上意識後，他的渴望全都滿足了；祂如此浩瀚，人類心靈永遠無法將祂完全捕捉；如果人的心靈不再空虛，他怎麼還會感到飢渴呢？
IT_TEXT: Esiste una differenza fondamentale tra eśanā [anelito] e icchā [desiderio]. Icchā significa “desiderio” o “intenzione”, mentre eśanā, cioè “anelito”, presuppone uno sforzo attivo per realizzare quel desiderio. In ogni essere vivente esiste un desiderio innato di felicità, e vi è anche uno sforzo attivo per soddisfarlo. Nella loro ricerca della felicità, gli esseri umani hanno scoperto che l’intero patrimonio di questo universo non sarà mai in grado di soddisfare la loro fame psichica. Con il cuore insoddisfatto continuano a ripetere: «La mia fame non è ancora saziata, la mia sete non è ancora placata». Così, nel corso di questa continua ricerca della felicità, si giunge infine a quell’Entità che è la più amata di tutte, e tale Entità è il proprio Iśt́a. Con l’acquisizione del denaro, le persone continuano comunque a sentirsi prive di qualcosa; pur possedendo grandi ricchezze, spesso si battono il petto nella disperazione. Dunque non è il denaro ciò che cercano: ciò che realmente desiderano è la pace, non la felicità. Ma è raro che le persone raggiungano la pace nella vita. Iśt́a significa Parama Puruśa, ma perché Egli è chiamato Iśt́a? La risposta è che, una volta realizzato Parama Puruśa, non rimane più alcuna fame insoddisfatta né sete inappagata. Egli è così vasto che la mente umana non può mai comprenderlo pienamente. E se nella mente non vi è alcun vuoto, come potrebbe qualcuno provare fame o sete?

EN_TEXT: There are two meaning for the word iśt́a: first, the one whose realization fills the mind, thus removing all psychic dissatisfactions; and secondly, the most beloved of all entities. When the mind attains its most coveted object, it becomes filled.
ZH_TEXT: 理念目標iśt́a這個字有兩種意義：第一指因了悟而使心靈充盈，從而消除所有心智上的不滿；第二指的是為所有個體所最親愛的實體。當心靈獲得它所渴望的目標後，它就得到了滿足。

EN_TEXT: Where there is dharma there is Iśt́a; the two are inseparably connected, and thus those who follow dharma are sure to follow Iśt́a also. Dharma cannot exist where there is no love for God. There are some people who say, “We do practice yoga but we are atheists.” This is impossible. Those who speak thus are not true yogis. Where there is dharma there is bound to be Iśt́a, and Iśt́a means Parama Puruśa. He is the soul of all souls, the greater “I” of all microcosms. In each and every human being, two “Iʼs” are hidden – the smaller “I” and the greater “I”. The small “I” is the various microcosms such as Ram, Shyam, Tom, Dick, Harry, etc.; but for all the greater “I” is one – Parama Puruśa. All the conflicts and struggles among the microcosms are all centered around their small “Iʼs”.
ZH_TEXT: 有法性之處，就有理念目標，兩者是密不可分的。因此，遵循法性之人必定也會遵循理念目標。法性無法存在於對至上沒有愛之處。有些人說：「我們鍛鍊瑜伽修持，但我們是無神論者。」這是不可能的。說這話的人必定不是真正的瑜伽行者。有法性之處，一定有理念目標，而理念目標即意指至上意識。他是靈魂之靈魂，所有個體小宇宙的大我。每個人都有兩個「我」，一個小我，一個大我：小我是每個個體，如羅摩、夏姆、湯姆、迪克、亨利等，然而所有人的大我都是一樣的，就是至上意識。個體小宇宙間的摩擦衝突都是因為這個小我所致。

EN_TEXT: Human beings are no doubt very ordinary and weak creatures, but if they connect themselves with Parama Puruśa then they no longer remain helpless, they become one with Him. If they constantly ideate on Him, if they always sing His glories and become engrossed in His ideation then they no longer remain ordinary mortals. Then they will achieve success in whatever task they undertake. But that success, that victory does not belong to them – it belongs to dharma, to Iśt́a.
ZH_TEXT: 人類誠然非常平凡和脆弱，但如果他們能與至上意識連結，他們就不再無助了，而會與至上意識合而為一。如果他們一直觀想持念祂，經常唱頌祂的榮光，且融入在祂的理念作用裡，他們就不再是凡夫俗子了，無論他們做什麼，都必定會成功。但這成功和勝利不是屬於他們的，而是屬於法性和理念目標的。

ZH_TEXT: Sakala jagate more kare vidhi bhakti; Vidhi bhaktye Vrajabháva páite náhi shakti. 「整個世界皆以形式的虔誠來禮拜我，然而事實上，拘泥外在形式虔誠的人永遠無法達到至上喜悅的虔誠波流境界，也就是說，他們將無法一心融入至上意識並獲得喜悅。」

EN_TEXT: In subtle philosophical analysis it can be said that all perception and assimilation is done with the help of shakti (force). Hence the Witnessing Entity of this entire creation is nothing but Citi Shakti (Cognitive Force or Cognitive Faculty). Puruśa is called Citi Shakti for two reasons: He is pure Consciousness and He is omni-telepathic. Citi Shakti has five qualities: shuddhá (absolutely pure), anantá (infinite), aparińámii (unchangeable), apratisaḿkramá (non-extroversive), and darshita viśayá (witness of the reflected object).
ZH_TEXT: 以精細的哲學分析來說，所有的感知以及吸收都可說是透過宇宙力量(shakti)之助而完成的。因此，見證宇宙萬有者即是宇宙認知力量或稱為至上認知力(Citi Shakti)。宇宙意識被稱為至上認知力之原因有二：其一，祂是純意識，而且是全然的精神感應實體。至上認知力有五個特質：絕對純淨(shuddhá)、無限(anantá)、永恆不變(aparińámii)、其外無物(apratisaḿkramá)、見證一切(darshita viśayá)。

ZH_TEXT: 一個有智慧的人視此世界的每一事物皆是那唯一無所不在的至上意識(Viśńu)的顯現，所以當他們見到任何事物在名、相上的改變也不會感到痛苦或快樂。無所不在的至上意識對他們而言，仍是無所不在的至上意識，他們不會失去任何東西。

ZH_TEXT: 虔誠者請記住上主的聖名，否則你的一切努力都將化為烏有。在任何情況下，在所有的活動中都要緊緊的抓住祂的聖名。

EN_TEXT: The world is a changing phenomenon. Therefore, it is unwise to be attached to any object in this ever-changing world. The name and form of objects undergo changes with the change in time and place. The child changes into a youth, the youth into an old person, and the old person into a dead person. Wise people take every object of the world as the expression of one and single Viśńu and are not be affected by pain or pleasure when they witness changes in the name and form of any particular object. Viśńu to them remains Viśńu and they lose nothing.
ZH_TEXT: 這個世界變化不居，因此，執著此無常世界的任何事物都是不智的。名稱與形象也是隨著時、空的變遷而改變，孩童成長為青年，青年漸趨老朽，老朽又轉變為死亡。一個有智慧的人視此世界的每一事物皆是那唯一無所不在之至上意識(Viśńu)的顯現，所以當他們見到任何事物在名、相上的改變也不會感到痛苦或快樂。無所不在的至上意識對他們而言，仍是無所不在的至上意識，他們並沒有失去任何東西。

EN_TEXT: When there is fear or feeling of crude propensities in the mind, there cannot be pure Anurakti or Bhakti. Devotion generated through fear is no Bhakti at all, rather it is but a lamentable state of mental crudeness. Some pray to the Lord for fear of hell and some for fear of torture and retribution in the next life. They hunger for emancipation from these fears. This betrays a lack of knowledge of the truth and you should not give encouragement to this inferiority complex. Those who accept or know the Lord as their own self have no reason to entertain any fear of Him. This fearless movement towards the Lord is termed Love.
ZH_TEXT: 心中懷有恐懼或粗鈍習性的覺受，就不可能有純粹的虔誠，由於恐懼而產生的虔誠根本不是虔誠，那只是粗鈍心靈可悲的狀態。有些人害怕下地獄，有些人擔心來世受折磨或受報應而向上主祈禱，他們渴望從這些恐懼中得到解脫。這只是顯示出他缺乏對真理的認知，我們不應該鼓勵這種自卑感。凡是接受或認識上主如同他們自己者，本身沒有理由害怕祂，此種無懼的朝向上主的行動即名之為愛。

They also love the finite, since it is also a portion of the Universal. They perceive worldly pleasures as divine bliss varied by time, place and person. They keep their mind-stuff absorbed in the eternal currents of the divine flow. Such devoted aspirants are the only true enjoyers or rasika and their object of enjoyment is the Supreme Brahma.
ZH_TEXT: 真正的虔誠者愛這個世界、這個社會及周遭的一切，因為他們體會到在宇宙力量所有巧妙的顯現裡，都充滿了宇宙一體的精神。他們也愛有限的事物，因為它們也是大宇宙的一部分。他們感受世俗的快樂如同受時、空、人物變化下的神性喜悅。他們將其心靈波質融匯在永恆的神性波流中，此種虔誠的修行者才是真正的享樂者，他們享受的目標即是至上意識。

ZH_TEXT: 只有了知至上瓊漿玉液的人才是真正的享受者。假如以卑鄙自私的動機來看待神性喜悅，那麼它就會變成毒藥。

ZH_TEXT: 虔誠的修行者應將他們的一切臣服於所禮敬的目標。萬物皆備於心，因此，如果心靈本身臣服於至上意識，則一切自然會臣服在祂的足下。

EN_TEXT: Wise people take every object of the world as the expression of Viśńu alone, and are not affected by pain or pleasure when they witness changes in the name and form of any particular object. Viśńu to them remains Viśńu, and they lose nothing.
ZH_TEXT: 一個有智慧的人視此世界的每一事物皆是那唯一無所不在的至上意識(Viśńus)的顯現，所以當他們見到任何事物在名、相上的改變也不會感到痛苦或快樂。無所不在的至上意識對他們而言，仍是無所不在的至上意識，他們並沒有失去任何東西。

EN_TEXT: The highest attainment of bhakti is the attainment of the Supreme, but in the mind-stuff of the devotees of vaedhii bhakti a desire for the pleasures derived from objects is greater than the desire for supreme bliss. Just as a mother diverts a crying child by offering a toy, so too the devotees of vaedhii bhakti are as if deluded by toys. The mother is obliged to disengage herself from other jobs and embrace the child who discards the toy. The devotees of kevalá bhakti are shrewd like those children.
ZH_TEXT: 虔誠的最高成就，就是達到至上意識，但是拘泥外在形式之虔誠者的心靈中，對來自物質上逸樂的渴望比對至上喜悅的渴望還要強烈。就好比母親拿玩具來哄哭泣的小孩，此種的虔誠者有如為玩具所哄騙的小孩。如果小孩將玩具扔掉，則母親就不得不放下工作，親自把孩子抱在懷裡。絕對虔誠之虔誠者就像這些被抱入懷中的孩子一樣。

EN_TEXT: We cannot consider Shiva or Cosmic Consciousness as being the resultant attribute of energy (Shakti); for although this great Shiva is difficult to discern in matter, where He is lying dormant, when He awakens with all His prowess, all His spatial, temporal and personal bondages of energy (Shakti) are broken and absorbed in that Consciousness.
ZH_TEXT: 我們不能將至上意識視為能量的集合，當偉大的意識沈睡時，我們很難在物質裡察覺到；一旦甦醒之後，祂便以非凡的神奇力量擺脫時空的限制、去除所有力量的束縛，並且與至上意識合而為一。

EN_TEXT: If there was no witness-ship of the Supreme Spirit then Time, Nature, Destiny, Will, [[Accident]], the world, or any of the activities of Prakrti that we can think of could not have existed at all, and so the cycle of action and reaction could not have evolved. It is on account of the witness-ship of the collective consciousness that the collective mind, as the action-performing agent, allots to the microcosm pleasure or pain as the reaction to past actions (bhogapavarga). Requittals of actions of any variety are perceived by the mind alone, not by the body, for the subtle waves of action and reaction cannot be received by the body, but only by the mind, and because of this capability the mind has the capacity of comprehension and cognition, which the body has not.
ZH_TEXT: 如果沒有至上靈魂的見證，那麼所有我們想得到的時間、自然、命運、意圖、事故、災禍、世界，或是任何造化勢能的行為，都將無法存在，也不會產生作用和反作用的循環作用。宇宙意識見證所有一切，祂就像是一個表演活動的經紀人，祂根據過去行為(bhogapavarga)的反作用力，將歡樂與痛苦分配給個體。各式各樣行動的果報都是由心靈而不是身體所感知的，因為作用力與反作用力的精細波流無法被身體所接收，他們只能經由心靈感知，也正因為如此，心靈方才具有理解及認知的能力，這些都是身體所不具備的能力。
IT_TEXT: Se non esistesse la funzione di testimonianza dello Spirito Supremo, allora non potrebbero esistere né il Tempo, né la Natura, né il Destino, né la Volontà, né il Caso, né il mondo stesso, né alcuna delle attività della Prakrti che possiamo concepire. Di conseguenza, nemmeno il ciclo di azione e reazione avrebbe potuto svilupparsi. È proprio grazie a questa funzione di testimonianza della Coscienza collettiva che la mente collettiva – in quanto agente che compie le azioni – distribuisce al microcosmo le conseguenze delle azioni sotto forma di piacere o dolore. Queste esperienze di piacere e dolore vengono percepite dalla mente, non dal corpo; ed è per questo che la mente possiede la capacità di comprendere e conoscere, mentre il corpo, da solo, non ne è capace.

It is the father of all eyes; to it all objects will remain the same.
ZH_TEXT: 儘管至上意識是所有心靈的至上指導者，是所有人類心靈板最至高無上、最燦爛光明的反射者，如果你的心靈板有缺陷，且由於你的心理缺陷而導致祂無法在你心中完美呈現……它始終都是那麼的純淨。它是所有眼睛之父，對它而言，萬事萬物始終如一。

EN_TEXT: The knowers of Brahma say that He remains with the unit entities, just as the shadow remains with the sunʼs ray. One who is carefully introspective by dint of sádhaná (intuitional practice) certainly attains Him, and attaining that eternal sea of bliss, enjoys everlasting happiness. Eating a rossogolla, a delicious sweet, you become happy; but no matter how great a stock of rossogollas you have, some day it will be exhausted, wonʼt it? To attain lasting happiness from rossogollas, you need an unlimited number of them, but this is not possible, for nothing in this evolved world is limitless. Only He is unlimited, so it is only by attaining Him that unlimited happiness can be attained.
ZH_TEXT: 至上的知曉者說，祂永遠與個體同在，就像影子必然跟隨著陽光一樣。一個透過靈修的力量不斷自我反省的人必然能夠了悟祂，也必然能夠到達喜悅之海，享受永恆的喜悅。當你嚐著可口的甜點「拉薩勾拉」(rossogolla)，你覺得很快樂；但無論你擁有多少「拉薩勾拉」，總有吃完的一天，不是嗎？想要從甜點身上獲得源源不絕的快樂，你必須擁有無限多的甜點，但這是不可能的，因為這個世界上的每一樣東西都是有限的。只有祂是無限的，因此唯有了悟祂，才能達到永恆的喜悅。

According to the extent of this introversion people will realize more and more deeply the vastness of their goal as compared to transitory nature of physical entities.
ZH_TEXT: 為了將至上的召喚傳到吾人心中，人們必須以無比的甜美及虔誠，將每個身、心的表現慢慢地、逐漸地引導至內在的生命。根據此內向性的程度，人們對其生命無限的目標，相較於身體的短暫性存在，將有更深入的瞭解。

EN_TEXT: In the attraction of the Great lies the secret of greater well-being. You will have to rush towards the fundamental Source of the entire creation. You will have to merge your individual stance in the Absolute Stance of the Supreme Transcendental Entity. You will have to advance at a speed greater than that of ordinary microcosms in the Cosmic Cycle.
ZH_TEXT: 在至上的吸引中存在著更大福祉的秘密。你必須奔向所有創造之本源，你必須將自身融入於至上本體的絕對之境，你必須比宇宙循環圈中之其他小宇宙個體，以更快的速度前進。

EN_TEXT: All entities must advance along the path of progress. This evolution will lead to the expansion of the psychic arena and, ultimately, liberation. This struggle for liberation is the struggle against those forces which attempt to thwart oneʼs psychic expansion. These are oneʼs enemies. Through meditation and contemplation one must surrender oneself at the altar of the Almighty, merging oneʼs finite identity into the Infinite. Only by surrendering oneʼs mind to the vast Macrocosm and becoming one with the Supreme Consciousness can one attain final salvation. The struggle for salvation is the struggle against those forces which strive to prevent oneʼs total self surrender to the Supreme. Never retreat. Keep advancing, and you will certainly attain the highest fulfilment of your existence.
ZH_TEXT: 所有的實體皆須循進步之道前進，此進化將導致心智領域的擴展，最後達到解脫。為解脫所作的奮鬥是與妨礙心智擴展之阻力對抗，這些阻力是敵人。一個人必須透過深沉的靜坐，將自身誠服於至上的聖壇前，必須將有限的個體融入於無限的本體中。唯有將個體心靈向浩瀚的大宇宙誠服，並且與至上意識合而為一，方能達到最後的解脫境界。為達究竟解脫之奮戰就是對抗那些阻止你向至上誠服的力量。 千萬別退縮！繼續前行，你必將達到存在最高圓滿的境界！
IT_TEXT: Tutte le entità devono avanzare lungo il sentiero del progresso. Questa evoluzione porterà all'espansione della sfera psichica e, infine, alla liberazione. Questa lotta per la liberazione è la lotta contro quelle forze che cercano di ostacolare l'espansione della propria mente. Queste sono i veri nemici. Attraverso la meditazione e la contemplazione, si deve offrire sè stessi sull'altare dell'Onnipotente, fondendo la propria identità finita nell'Infinito. Solo consegnando la propria mente al vasto Macrocosmo e diventando una cosa sola con la Coscienza Suprema si può raggiungere la salvezza finale. La lotta per la salvezza è la lotta contro quelle forze che cercano di impedire il totale abbandono di sé al Supremo. Non ritiratevi mai. Continuate ad avanzare e certamente raggiungerete il più alto compimento della vostra esistenza.
