EN_TEXT: When one accepts something as absolute after due logical deliberation one develops shraddhá (veneration) in the mind. One who has no respect for the goal can never attain success. Shrat satyam tasmin dhiiyate iti shraddhá. “Shraddhá is the pursuit of Supreme Truth.” The expansion of citta is also called shraddhá. One should have immense, respect for that object which causes the citta to expand. Samádhi is the state of maximum expansion of citta, and thus shraddhá is the first stage in the attainment of samádhi.
ZH_TEXT: 當一個人經過理性思考後，接受某對象為絕對唯一的存在時，他即在心中發展了一種虔敬(shraddhá)的情感。一個對目標不懷敬意的人是不可能成功的。「Shrat satyam tasmin dhiiyate iti shraddhá.」意即：「虔敬就是對至上真理的追求。」一個人應該對能讓心靈質擴展的目標懷有無與倫比的尊敬。三摩地是心靈質擴展的極致境界，因此這種無與倫比的虔敬(shraddhá)就是達到三摩地境界的第一個階段。

EN_TEXT: A spiritual aspirant who wants to attain samádhi needs to develop vaerágya (spirit of renunciation) and abhyása (continued practice). Remember, samádhi is neither pravrtti múlaka nor nivrtti múlaka. Vaerágya is the absence of attachment, not repulsion. In order to deal with objects properly one should never become subservient to them, but should ascribe Brahmahood to them by cultivating the repeated practice of cosmic ideation or Brahma Bhávana. What is abhyása? Tatra sthitao yatnoʼbhyásah. Abhyása is the creation of a particular continuous psychic vibration. It is the most essential factor in the spiritual sphere. The continuous endeavour to maintain the state of equilibrium of citta leads to the attainment of samádhi. When one is attracted by an object one runs after it, and when one feels repulsion for an object, one runs away from it. A person who is fond of wine often thinks of wine, whereas a person who detests wine prevents his or her mind from thinking about wine. Unless attraction and repulsion are both transcended, the mind can never attain a state of equilibrium or samádhi. Mental equilibrium only becomes possible when one makes a constant endeavour to attain psychic balance.
ZH_TEXT: 一個想達到三摩地的靈性修持者必須發展的是不執著(vaerágya)的精神以及有恆的鍛鍊(abhyása)。謹記於心：三摩地既非外在導向行為(pavrtti múlaka)亦非內在導向行為(nivrtti múlaka)。不執著(Vaerágya)不是憎惡排斥。為了正確的對待萬事萬物，一個人不應受役於它們，而應精進不懈地從事視宇宙萬有皆是至上意識所化現(Brahma Bhávana)的修持鍛鍊。 什麼是努力有恆的鍛鍊(abhyása)?Tatra sthitao yatno’bhyásah，意即持續創造某一特定的心智波流。在靈性的領域中這是最重要的因素。持續努力讓心靈質維持在平衡的狀態，能夠引導一個人達到三摩地的境界。人受某物吸引則追逐之，當對某物厭惡時則遠離之。好酒之人心念不忘酒，然而討厭酒的人就會阻止心靈想到酒。除非超越喜歡和厭惡，否則心靈永遠不會達到平衡或三摩地之境。一個人只有不斷努力讓心智取得平衡，才能達到心靈的平靜。
IT_TEXT: Un aspirante spirituale che desidera raggiungere il samādhi deve sviluppare vairāgya (spirito di rinuncia) e abhyāsa (pratica costante). Ricordate che il samādhi non è né pravṛtti-mūlaka né nivṛtti-mūlaka. Vairāgya è assenza di attaccamento, non repulsione. Per rapportarsi correttamente agli oggetti, non si dovrebbe mai diventare loro subordinati; al contrario, si dovrebbe attribuire loro la natura di Brahma coltivando la pratica ripetuta dell’ideazione cosmica, o Brahma Bhāvanā. Che cos’è abhyāsa? Tatra sthitau yatno’bhyāsaḥ. Abhyāsa è la creazione di una particolare vibrazione psichica continua. È il fattore più essenziale nella sfera spirituale. Lo sforzo continuo di mantenere lo stato di equilibrio della citta conduce al raggiungimento del samādhi. Quando una persona è attratta da un oggetto, corre verso di esso; quando prova repulsione per un oggetto, se ne allontana. Una persona che ama il vino pensa spesso al vino, mentre una persona che lo detesta impedisce alla propria mente di pensare al vino. Finché attrazione e repulsione non vengono entrambe trascese, la mente non può mai raggiungere uno stato di equilibrio o di samādhi. L’equilibrio mentale diventa possibile soltanto quando si compie uno sforzo costante per conseguire l’equilibrio psichico.

EN_TEXT: A spiritual aspirant who wants to attain samádhi needs to develop vaerágya [the spirit of renunciation] and abhyása [continued practice]. Remember, samádhi is neither pravrttimúlaka nor nivrttimúlaka. Vaerágya is the absence of attachment, not repulsion. In order to deal with objects properly one should never become subservient to them, but should ascribe Brahma-hood to them by cultivating the repeated practice of Cosmic ideation or Brahma bhávana. What is abhyása? Tatra sthitao yatnóbhyásah. Abhyása is the creation of a particular continuous psychic vibration. It is the most essential factor in the spiritual sphere. The continuous endeavour to maintain the state of equilibrium of the citta leads to the attainment of samádhi.

EN_TEXT: What is omniscience? The knowledge regarding the past, present and future is called omniscience. The seed of omniscience lies in every human being, but the degree of its expression varies from person to person. In some the seed is ripe, in others it is unripe. Samprajiṋáta samádhi causes the seed to ripen. In permanent savikalpa the seed assumes vast proportions. In that state oneʼs object no longer remains within the limited periphery of the unit mind, but becomes as vast as the Macrocosm. Oneʼs potentiality becomes immeasurable. By virtue of sádhaná the ungerminated seed ripens and assumes unlimited proportions. Thus elevated sádhakas do not need to acquire knowledge from external sources. The bliss of knowledge spontaneously manifests itself in them due to Macrocosmic grace. Tatra nirátishayaḿ sarvajiṋátva biijaḿ. “The seed of omniscience is manifested in them.”
ZH_TEXT: 什麼是全知？了知過去、現在、未來一切者謂之「全知」。全知的種子含藏在每一個人的內在，只是它表達的程度因人而異。某些人的種子已成熟，而某些人的尚未成熟。有餘依三摩地讓種子成熟，永恆的有餘依境界，種子變得極為巨大，此時一個人的目標不再存在於有限的個體心靈中，而是變得像大宇宙心靈般廣闊。一個人的潛能變得無窮，藉由靈性修持使得其未萌芽的種子成熟，並變得無限大。因此，一個心靈提升的靈修者不須要從外在來源獲得知識，由於大宇宙心靈的恩典，了悟的喜悅自動地於內在顯現出來。Tatra nirátishayaḿ sarvajiṋátva biijaḿ──全知的種子於其內在展現出來。

EN_TEXT: The practice of Ananda Marga has been formulated to enable spiritual aspirants to search for the Supreme within their minds. Thus you must seek, and if you seek you shall find.
ZH_TEXT: 阿南達瑪迦的鍛鍊就是讓修行者往內心深處去尋找至上意識。因此，你要向內尋求，只要你往內去找，必會發現。

EN_TEXT: In the spiritual world, the most important thing is sharańágati - taking shelter in the Supreme Entity. How can you deal with an Entity who knows all about you? What you can only do is to totally surrender to Him.
ZH_TEXT: 在靈性的世界裏，最重要的是「要以至上意識為庇護」(sharańágati)。你如何與一個了知你一切的實體相處呢？你能做的只有全然的臣服。

EN_TEXT: The Supreme Consciousness has given human beings eyes in front so that they can look ahead, not behind. You need not waste your time unnecessarily worrying about your past mistakes: you must move ahead, and while moving forward, you will have to come within His shelter. This sharańágati or taking shelter in Him, is the most important aspect of dharma.
ZH_TEXT: 至上意識將人的眼睛置於前面，就是要人們向前看。你不要浪費時間為過去的罪業憂心忡忡，你必須向前看，必須來到祂的庇護下。這種「以至上意識為庇護」(sharańágati)才是法性最重要的面向。
CITATION_EN: 9 July 1979 DMC, Ludhiana | The Secret of Dharma Lies Hidden in the Mind, Subháśita Saḿgraha Part 12

EN_TEXT: What is your relationship to Parama Puruśa? Whatever thoughts may come to your mind, take His name and cry. Parama Puruśa understands what you need and will make provisions accordingly. Human intelligence is very limited, so very inadequate. What is the point of misusing your intelligence? Surrender (sharańágati) is the most ideal way.
ZH_TEXT: 你和至上意識的關係是什麼？不管什麼樣的念頭來到你的心中，你儘管持念祂的名並向祂泣訴。至上意識知道你的需要，祂會為你安排一切。人類的聰明才智不足，極為有限，又為什麼要誤用智力呢？所以最好的方法就是臣服。

EN_TEXT: Out of this Macrocosmic ectoplasm, the infinite takes its expression, and out of this Macrocosmic expression which is called citta – the micropsychic structures have emerged. Puruśa is the hub or the nucleus of the ultimate cause of creation, and thus he controls the Macrocosmic ectoplasmic scope. Although Puruśa Himself does not do all the phenomenal activities in the physical world, he gets them all performed by Prakrti. Because He is located in the Macrocosmic Nucleus, he is radiating all the vibrations directly.
ZH_TEXT: 無限就從此大宇宙心靈之中取得表達，心靈質就是從大宇宙心靈的表達中演化而來，個體小宇宙的結構於焉出現。宇宙意識是創造終極肇因的核心，因此，大宇宙心靈全部的領域皆為祂所控制。 雖然宇宙意識本身並未在此物質世界直接從事任何活動，但祂讓至上運作法則完成所有的事。祂位於大宇宙心靈的核心，直接放射出所有波動。
IT_TEXT: Da questo ectoplasma cosmico l’Infinito trova la propria espressione; e da questa espressione macrocosmica, chiamata citta, sono emerse tutte le strutture psichiche individuali. Puruṣa è il perno, il nucleo della causa ultima della creazione e, proprio per questo, governa l’intero ambito dell’ectoplasma cosmico. Sebbene Puruṣa non compia direttamente tutte le attività fenomeniche del mondo fisico, Egli le fa realizzare da Prakṛti. Poiché risiede nel Nucleo Cosmico, irradia direttamente tutte le vibrazioni.
CITATION_EN: Shrii Shrii Ánandamúrti | 12 July 1979 DMC, Jaipur | 07 Puruśa | Subháśita Saḿgraha Part 12
CITATION_ZH: Shrii Shrii Ánandamúrti | 1979年7月12日於Jaipur大法會 | 07 宇宙意識 | 靈性科學集成 卷12，P.71

EN_TEXT: All objects and actions emanate vibrations, which are perceived by the human mind, which then forms an idea about those objects or actions. The difference between the Macrocosm and the microcosms is that the microcosms are under spatial bondage, whereas the Macrocosm is free from all bondages. Thus it is quite justifiable to use the epithet sahasrapát (“thousand-footed”) to describe Parama Puruśa.
ZH_TEXT: 所有的物體和行動都散發出波動，這些波動皆為心靈所感知，而形成對這些物體和行動的觀念。大宇宙心靈和個體小宇宙的差別，就在於個體小宇宙受空間的束縛，而大宇宙心靈不受這些束縛。因此，描述至上意識為擁有無數隻腳是非常有道理的。

EN_TEXT: For the proper interpretation of yoga, two fundamental entities are necessary – the bhakta and Bhagaván. A yogi can never remain without his Lord. All the propensities, psychic propensities, of a yogi must not be suspended; rather all his propensities must be goaded unto the Lord. So here there is no question of suspension, but the question of proper diversion.
ZH_TEXT: 為了闡明「瑜伽」真正的含義，必須要有兩個基本實體──一個是虔誠者，一個是上主薄伽梵。瑜伽行者不能沒有其上主而存在，瑜伽行者並不需停止他的心靈習性，而應將他的心靈習性導向上主，所以在此是否停止心靈習性也就不會是問題了，問題在於是否有正確的導向。

EN_TEXT: When due to yoga this finite aspirant comes in contact with that infinite Iśt́a, he acquires infinite strength, he acquires infinite psycho-spiritual stamina, he becomes victorious in all the arenas of his existence.
ZH_TEXT: 在從事瑜伽的鍛鍊時，此有限的實體與無限的生命理念目標接觸後，就會獲得無限的力量，就會在他的心理趨向靈性的層面獲得無限的動力，因而造就他在生命存在的領域中得到勝利。

EN_TEXT: It is said that because of this Cosmic flow of love and compassion for the entire creation, Parama Puruśa is rasa personified, that is, “flow personified”. The eternal flow personified is rasa. Rasah vae sah –– “He is flow personified.” And thatʼs why we say that His movement of love and compassion for all created beings is the rasasyamúlam, the rasaságara, and every living entity, every animate and inanimate entity, is dancing according to the flow of that rasa, according to the vibrational expression of that rasa. And it is the rásaliilá of Bhagaván.
ZH_TEXT: 有言道，由於整個宇宙是充滿愛和慈悲的波流，所以至上意識又稱為波流化身，祂就是永恆波流的化身(Rasah Vae Sah)。這也就是為什麼說祂為眾生所創造的這齣愛和慈悲的戲碼是一齣永恆波流的宇宙大戲(Rasaságara)。每一個有生命、無生命個體，每一個眾生都依照該波流而舞動著，這就是至上意識的波流遊戲。
CITATION_EN: Shrii Shrii Ánandamúrti | 15 July 1979 DMC, Ernakulam | 08 The Spirit of Yoga | Subháśita Saḿgraha Part 12

EN_TEXT: What is dharma? Dhriyate dharma ityáhuh sa eva paramaḿprabhuh – The wont, the controlling qualifications or attributions that an entity must possess, are dharma. Dharma controls all the expressions of human life; that which controls all the expressions of life, all the expressions of entitative waves, is dharma. And for the proper movement of entitative flows, the proper movement of entitative expressions, there must be a parallelism with incantative expression. The existential movement must get its stamina from the incantative existence. And there cannot be any incantative stamina or incantative vitality if there is no object, no intra-psychic goal, that is, if there is no Iśt́a.
ZH_TEXT: 法性是什麼？一個實體所必須具備的至上控制特質就是法性(Dhriyate dharma ityáhuh sa eva paramaḿprabhuh)。法性控制了人類生命所有的展現，它控制了個體波流的所有表達。個體的波流或個體的表達若欲適當的前進必須與梵咒作用的波流平行一致。個體存在的行動必須從梵咒的存在中獲得能量，如果心中沒有目標，沒有內在的目標，也就是缺乏生命理念的目標(Iśt́a)，就不會有梵咒作用的能量或梵咒作用的存在。

EN_TEXT: When due to yoga this finite aspirant comes in contact with that infinite Iśt́a, he acquires infinite strength, he acquires infinite psycho-spiritual stamina, he becomes victorious in all the arenas of his existence. So wise people, yogis, should realize clearly and definitely that their entitative existence along with the incantative flow, is to move forward towards the Supreme goal, which is their Iśt́a. And the yogi should know the Iśt́a; the yogi should use a singular name for the Iśt́a and not two names or three names. Wherever the Iśt́a is in singularity in name and form and idea and ideation, and also in ideology, success is sure, success is fully assured.
ZH_TEXT: 如果你鍛鍊瑜伽，那麼你那有限的生命將得以接觸到無限的理念目標而臻至無限，你將獲得無限的靈性能量，而在各領域的存在中獲得勝利。所以，明智者，真正的瑜伽行者應清楚、明白地了悟到他們個體的存在，伴隨著理念目標所賦予的個體力量，都將朝著至上目標而前進。真正的瑜伽修持者唯一應知道的就是他的理念目標，而不是其他東西。當你的理念目標是你唯一呼喚的名字、是唯一的形象和概念，是你理念作用和心中持念唯一的實體時，成功就是必然的，保證可以獲得成功。

EN_TEXT: You are spiritual aspirants, hence you are yogis, and you should know that the only interpretation of yoga is Saḿyogo yoga ityukto jiivátma-Paramátmanah. All other explanations are baseless. And you should also remember that your movement towards your Iśt́a is your yogic practice, and your unification with your Iśt́a is your yogic goal, is the final desideratum of all the flows of all your psychic propensities. The question of suspension of psychic propensities does not arise.
ZH_TEXT: 你們都是靈性的修持者，都是瑜伽的行者，你們都應該知道瑜伽唯一的解釋就是「個體意識與至上意識的合一」，所有其他的解釋都沒有根據，而且你們要記住，你們的行動是朝向你們生命理念的目標，你唯一要做的就是精進鍛鍊，與你們的理念目標合一是你唯一的目標，這是所有心靈情緒傾向波流最後的目標。不會有心靈情緒傾向作用停止的問題出現。

EN_TEXT: The Singular Entity has manifested Himself in the form of the ten directions. He has been born in the past as the offspring of different living beings, and will continue to be so born in the future. He inheres in every object and is the witnessing counterpart of those objects.
ZH_TEXT: 唯一的至上本體在六方四隅展現祂自己。過去祂以眾生之子孫誕生，未來也會繼續如此。祂隱身於每一個體之中，祂是這些個體相對應的目證本體。

EN_TEXT: If He wishes you to attain Him, you can get Him here and now. What He sees is your aspiration for Him. Remember that at every step of your life He is testing you to see whether or not you have been able to arouse love for Him in your mind. He is testing you as to whether you want Him or want worldly objects.
ZH_TEXT: 如果祂想讓你了悟祂，你當下就能得到祂。祂看重的是你對祂的渴望。你要記住，祂會在生命的每一步都試探你，看看你心中是否已喚起對祂的愛。祂會考驗你，看你要的是祂還是世俗的物質。
IT_TEXT: Se Parama Puruṣa desidera che tu Lo realizzi, può accadere qui e ora. Ciò che guarda è il tuo anelito verso di Lui. Ricorda: a ogni passo della tua vita, Egli verifica se nel tuo cuore è sorto l’amore per il Supremo, se desideri veramente Lui, oppure gli oggetti del mondo.
CITATION_EN: Shrii Shrii Ánandamúrti | 18 July 1967 DMC, Delhi | 04 Niiti and Dharma | Subháśita Saḿgraha Part 21
CITATION_ZH: Shrii Shrii Ánandamúrti | 1967年7月18日於德里大法會 | 10 導向靈性進步的行為與法性 | 靈性科學集成 卷14，P.125

EN_TEXT: Either in the world or in the wilderness one will not necessarily be free. If Paramátman does not want you to know Him, then you will not be able to attain Him in either place; whereas if He wishes you to attain Him, you can get Him here and now. What He sees is your aspiration for Him. Remember that at every step of your life He is testing you to see whether or not you have been able to arouse love for Him in your mind. He is testing you as to whether you want Him or want worldly objects.
ZH_TEXT: 無論你是在世俗，還是在荒野，你都不見得沒有束縛。如果至上意識不想讓你了悟祂，無論你在哪裡，你都無法得到祂；反之，如果祂想讓你了悟祂，你當下就能得到祂。祂看重的是你對祂的渴望。你要記住，祂會在生命的每一步都試探你，看看你心中是否已喚起對祂的愛。祂會考驗你，看你要的是祂還是世俗的物質。

CITATION_ZH: Shrii Shrii Ánandamúrti | 1967年7月18日於德里大法會 | 19 道德與法性 | 完美生命的實踐，P.153~154

EN_TEXT: The real service is the service that you render to others for their spiritual upliftment, and that is known as viprocita sevá. But other services such as shúdrocita sevá [physical service], vaeshyocita sevá [economic service] and kśatriyocita sevá [martial service] help you in rendering viprocita sevá to others. When someone is dying of some ailment you cannot preach spiritual gospels to the person, rather you should help that person with medicines and physical services. Then when the person gets well you should teach something spiritual to him or her. Then the person will have been permanently benefited. Hence, Kuru puńyamahorátram.
ZH_TEXT: 真正的服務是你所提供的服務能讓他人的靈性獲得提升，此稱為viprocita sevá（知識型的服務）。但其他的服務，如勞力服務(shúdrocitasevá)、經濟上的服務(vaeshyocita sevá)和武力上的服務(kśatriyocitasevá)都是為了最後提供知識上的服務以提升他人的靈性。當有人快要病死時，你不能對他宣講靈性上的大道理，而應以醫藥等物質上的服務來幫助他，當他病好了，你才能告訴他一些靈性之事。這樣對這個人而言，才是永恆的受益。這就是「日夜行善」。

EN_TEXT: Wherever there is bondage of sentient, mutative or static principle, it cannot be non-attributional.
ZH_TEXT: 只要有悅性、變性或惰性任何一個法則的束縛，它都不可能是無屬性的。

EN_TEXT: The Supreme Entity always call anybody and everybody, “oh human beings, oh painstaking human beings, donʼt be afraid, donʼt be disheartened, I am for you, oh human beings, please come, you please come, I am for you.”
ZH_TEXT: 至上本體永遠呼喚著每一個人：「哦，人哪！受苦受難的人哪！不要害怕！不要沮喪！我為你們而來，哦！人哪！來吧！來到我的面前，我是為你們而來的！」
CITATION_EN: Shrii Shrii Ánandamúrti | 18th July 1979 DMC, Vishakhapatnam | 09 Trio in Spiritual Progress | Subháśita Saḿgraha Part 12

EN_TEXT: Even those ordinary human beings who take shelter in Parama Puruśaʼs all-pervading kindness and compassion, are sure to attain the supreme excellence of spiritual grandeur; nobody has any reason to be disheartened. The Supreme Entity always call anybody and everybody, “oh human beings, oh painstaking human beings, donʼt be afraid, donʼt be disheartened, I am for you, oh human beings, please come, you please come, I am for you.”
ZH_TEXT: 即使是平凡之人，如果能以無比慈悲之至上意識為庇護，則必定可以達到卓越的靈性輝煌之境，所有人都不應感到沮喪。至上本體永遠呼喚著每一個人：「哦，人哪！受苦受難的人哪！不要害怕！不要沮喪！我為你們而來，哦，人哪！來吧！來到我的面前，我是為你們而來的！」

CITATION_ZH: Shrii Shrii Ánandamúrti | 1979年7月18日於Vishakhapatnam大法會 | 09 靈性進步的三個方法 | 靈性科學集成卷12，P.99

EN_TEXT: This binding force, this dangerous binding force with her dexterous hand created the serpentine noose. It is very difficult for ordinary human beings to free themselves from this serpentine noose, but people must not be disheartened or discouraged I am here to help you. Why am I here? These binding forces, these degenerating agencies are under me; they have to obey me. So although you may be an ordinary human being, if you take shelter in me I am to help you. This insurmountable Máyá wonʼt remain insurmountable.
ZH_TEXT: 這束縛的力量，這危險的束縛力量，以其靈巧的手創造了各種如毒蛇般的圈套，一般人想要擺脫這些圈套是非常困難的，但你們千萬不要灰心喪志，因為有我在這裡幫助你們。為什麼我會在這裡呢？因為這些束縛力量、這些墮落的作用都是屬於我的，它們必須聽從我。所以，雖然你們是凡夫俗子，如果你們能以我為庇護，我一定會幫助你們的。這難以超越的宇宙力量將不再難以超越。

The Supreme Entity always call anybody and everybody, “oh human beings, oh painstaking human beings, donʼt be afraid, donʼt be disheartened, I am for you, oh human beings, please come, you please come, I am for you.”

EN_TEXT: When spiritual aspirants become one with their Iśt́a, they no longer remain as insignificant people; in that case their finite happiness is transformed into infinite happiness. Then with their limited strength they become able to perform gigantic tasks.
ZH_TEXT: 當靈性渴望者與其生命理念目標合一時，他們就不再是個渺小微不足道的人，此時他們有限的快樂轉化為無限的喜悅，那麼即使他們力量很小，也能夠完成偉大的工作。
CITATION_EN: 20 July 1979 DMC, Bhuvaneshwar | The Dharma and Iśt́a of a Yogi, Yoga Sádhaná
CITATION_ZH: 1979年7月20日於Bhuvaneshwar大法會 | 瑜伽的精神，瑜伽修持科學觀，P.16

EN_TEXT: Human beings have come onto this earth only to follow Bhágavata dharma, and not for any other purpose. You have many tasks to perform: whatever you do, you should always feel that all your actions are part of Bhágavata dharma. Wherever you are, you must do something to remove the poverty and distress of the people in that area, to ameliorate their socio-economic condition. But even while discharging your duties thus, you should always remember that whatever you are doing is not a mundane duty, it is an inseparable part of your Bhágavata dharma.
ZH_TEXT: 人類不為其他原因，而是為遵循至上法性才來到這個世界。你們有許多工作要做：不管你做什麼，你都應該時時感覺到你所做的一切都是至上法性的一部分。不論你在哪裡，你都必須為當地的人解除他們的困苦和煩惱，改善他們的社會經濟狀況。但即使當你在履行你該盡的義務時，你也應該記得你所做的一切是至上法性不可分割的一部分，而非世俗的責任。
CITATION_EN: 20 July 1979 DMC, Bhuvaneshwar | The Dharma and Iśt́a of a Yogi, Yoga Sádhaná
CITATION_ZH: 1979年7月20日於布旺納希瓦 | 瑜伽的精神，瑜伽修持科學觀，P.17

EN_TEXT: 20 July 1979 DMC, Bhuvaneshwar Ádarsha and Iśt́a, Subháśita Saḿgraha Part 12
ZH_TEXT: 理念目標指的就是人類可以與祂建立起愛和情感的那位具人格的上主，他們可以向祂傾訴他們的快樂和痛苦，並向祂臣服和以祂為最安全的庇護。
CITATION_ZH: 1979年7月20日於Bhuvaneshwar大法會 | 理念與理念目標，靈性科學集成卷12，P.108

EN_TEXT: When human beings do not move towards that state, what happens? I have just said that movement is the law of the universe. It is a providential decree that movement is a must for all: caraeveti, caraeveti – “proceed on, proceed on.” Naturally human beings must keep on moving ceaselessly; but supposing one does not have a goal, then oneʼs movement will be like that of a rudderless ship sailing on stormy sea. If you keep rowing a boat without a fixed goal all your labour will go in vain, your time will be wasted, and you will also run the risk of being caught in a whirlpool. Therefore human beings must always have an ádarsha, an ideology before them.
ZH_TEXT: 如果人類不朝向「理念」的狀態前進，那麼會怎麼樣？我剛才說了，行動是宇宙的定律，眾生都必須移動，這是上主的誡命。「前進吧！前進吧！(caraeveti, caraeveti)」人類本自必須不斷地繼續移動。然而如果一個人沒有目標，那麼他的行動會像什麼呢？就會如同一艘沒有舵的船航行在驚濤駭浪之中。當你在划船卻沒有固定的目標，不但會白費力氣，浪費時間，而且也可能被捲入漩渦中。因此，人類永遠必須要有一個「理念」(ádarsha)在前。
CITATION_EN: Shrii Shrii Ánandamúrti | 20 July 1979 DMC, Bhuvaneshwar | 10 Ádarsha and Iśt́a | Subháśita Saḿgraha Part 12
CITATION_ZH: Shrii Shrii Ánandamúrti | 1979年7月20日於Bhuvaneshwar大法會 | 10 理念與理念目標 | 靈性科學集成 卷12，P.102

EN_TEXT: In the play of abstract imagination people may derive some temporary satisfaction, but not lasting peace. The God of philosophy cannot provide complete fulfilment to peopleʼs deep internal urges: they want One to whom they can open their hearts. Such an entity is oneʼs iśt́a.
ZH_TEXT: 在抽象的想像裡，人們或許可以得到暫時的滿足，但無法獲得永恆的平靜。哲學上的上主無法完全滿足人類內在深處的渴望，人類想要一個能讓他們敞開心扉的實體，這實體就是他們的「理念目標」(iśt́a)。
CITATION_EN: Shrii Shrii Ánandamúrti | 20 July 1979 DMC, Bhuvaneshwar | 10 Ádarsha and Iśt́a | Subháśita Saḿgraha Part 12
CITATION_ZH: Shrii Shrii Ánandamúrti | 1979年7月20日於Bhuvaneshwar大法會 | 10 理念與理念目標 | 靈性科學集成 卷12，P.104

EN_TEXT: Service is quite different: it is always unilateral. You give something to Parama Puruśa without asking for anything in exchange. When you offer everything unto Parama Puruśa, what else can He ask for? Moreover, who will ask? When you have offered everything to Parama Puruśa, then you have become one with Parama Puruśa, what else can He ask for? Moreover, who will ask? When you have offered everything to Parama Puruśa, then you have become one with Parama Puruśa, and obviously there cannot be anything left to ask for.
ZH_TEXT: 服務並非交易，它永遠都是單向的付出。你給至上意識東西，但卻不求回報。當你已奉獻出一切給至上意識時，祂還能向你要求什麼呢？再者，祂能要求誰呢？當你已獻上所有給至上意識時，當你已與至上意識合一時，祂還能要求什麼呢？因為很明顯的，已經沒有任何東西可以讓祂要了。
CITATION_EN: Shrii Shrii Ánandamúrti | 20 July 1979 DMC, Bhuvaneshwar | 10 Ádarsha and Iśt́a | Subháśita Saḿgraha Part 12

Wherever you are, you must do something to remove the poverty and distress of the people in that area, to ameliorate their socio-economic condition. But even while discharging your duties thus, you should always remember that whatever you are doing is not a mundane duty it is an inseparable part of your Bhágavata dharma.
ZH_TEXT: 人類只為遵循至上法性而來此塵世，沒有其他的目的了。你有許多工作要完成，不管你做什麼，你都應該覺得所作所為是至上法性的一部分。不管你在哪裡，你都必須做一些事為當地人民去除貧窮和困苦，改善他們的社會經濟處境。但是即使你是在履行你的職責，你也應該永遠記著，你所做的一切不是平凡、世俗的工作，而是至上法性不可分割的一部分。

EN_TEXT: By spiritual cult, spiritual sádhaná, you may bring about certain changes in your nervous system, nerve cells and nerve fibres, control the secretions of the hormones from different glands and sub-glands, and become elevated. By this process of elevation a person becomes superhuman and goes beyond the periphery of the common human psychology. Otherwise, the general rule is there. Here lies the necessity of spiritual practice. Without spiritual practice there cannot be such a change.
ZH_TEXT: 藉著靈性法門、靈性的修持，你能為神經系統、神經細胞及神經纖維帶來改變，並控制不同的腺體和次腺體荷爾蒙的分泌，進而達到提升。在提升的過程中，一個凡人成了超人，他超越了一般人心智所能及的範圍。否則必定受制於一般的法則。這就是靈性鍛鍊的必要，缺乏靈性的修持就不會帶來此種改變。
IT_TEXT: Attraverso una disciplina spirituale, attraverso il sadhana, è possibile produrre cambiamenti nel sistema nervoso, nelle cellule e nelle fibre nervose, regolare le secrezioni ormonali delle diverse ghiandole e sotto-ghiandole, e così elevarsi interiormente. Mediante questo processo di elevazione, una persona diventa super-umana, andando oltre i confini della psicologia umana ordinaria; in caso contrario, resta soggetta ai suoi automatismi. Qui sta la necessità della pratica spirituale: senza pratica spirituale, un tale cambiamento non può avvenire.
CITATION_EN: Shrii Shrii Ánandamúrti | 20 July 1990, Kolkata | 26 The Human Body Is a Biological Machine | Yoga Psychology
CITATION_ZH: Shrii Shrii Ánandamúrti | 1990年7月20日於加爾各答 | 26 人的身體是一部生物機器 | 生命科學觀：瑜伽心理學，P.272

EN_TEXT: You should revive all these subtler expressions of humanity. You should remember that human life is not like a flower, it is like a collection of so many flowers, and that collection of so many flowers is the charm of human life. Human life is not like a flower; it is like a beautiful garden of so many flowers. Let all those flowers develop, and let the final movement of all those expressions of charm and fascination be goaded unto Parama Puruśa. Whatever I do, whatever we do, whatever we will be doing, just to please the supreme charmer, just to please the supreme source, just to please the Supreme Progenitor – there cannot be any other aim of human life.
ZH_TEXT: 你們應該復興所有這些人類精細的表達。你們當記住人類的生命不像是一朵花，而是各式各樣花朵的集合，這些繽紛綻放的花朵正是人類生命迷人之處。人類生命不像是一朵花，是許多花朵盛開的美麗花園。讓花朵爭奇鬥艷，讓所有這些迷人和絢麗的展現最終都導向至上意識。任何我所做之事，任何我們所做之事，任何我們將做之事，都是為了取悅這位至上的魔術師，都是為了讓至上之父高興。人類生命除此之外，再沒有其他目的了。
IT_TEXT: Dovreste far rivivere tutte queste espressioni più sottili dell’umanità. Dovreste ricordare che la vita umana non è come un fiore: è come una raccolta di molti fiori, e quella raccolta di molti fiori è il fascino della vita umana. La vita umana non è come un singolo fiore; è come un bellissimo giardino di molti fiori. Lasciate che tutti quei fiori si sviluppino, e che il movimento finale di tutte quelle espressioni di fascino e di bellezza sia spinto verso Parama Puruśa. Qualunque cosa io faccia, qualunque cosa noi facciamo, qualunque cosa faremo, tutto deve essere fatto per compiacere il Supremo Incantatore, per compiacere la Fonte Suprema, per compiacere il Supremo Progenitore. Non può esserci nessun altro scopo della vita umana.
CITATION_EN: Shrii Shrii Ánandamúrti | 21 July 1980 morning, Vellore | 20 Aesthetics and Mysticism | Ánanda Vacanámrtam Part 34
CITATION_ZH: Shrii Shrii Ánandamúrti | 1980年7月21日早晨於Vellore | 20 美學與神秘學 | 喜悅甘露集 卷11

EN_TEXT: Beyond the periphery of material mobility, there is the world of aesthetics; and above it, beyond it, there is the world of mystics. The world of mystics and the world of aesthetics are for human beings. And each and every human being should get a proper chance, should get adequate chance, to move into those worlds.
ZH_TEXT: 超越物質波動的範疇，存在著美學的世界；而在美學之上，超越美學的範疇，則是神秘學的領域。這兩個世界都是為了人類而備，所以每一個人都應該得到適當、足夠的機會以進入這些世界。
CITATION_EN: Shrii Shrii Ánandamúti | 21 July 1980 morning, Vellore | Aesthetics and Mysticism, Ánanda Vacanámrtam Part 34
CITATION_ZH: Shrii Shrii Ánandamúti | 1980年7月21日晨於Vellore | 美學與神秘學，喜悅甘露集卷11，P.127

EN_TEXT: To the Supreme One, who is the central figure of all existence, of all ideas of the universe, one should offer only oneʼs soul. One should offer oneʼs most favourite object – the quintessence of oneʼs existence. And while offering one should say, Nivedayámi cátmánaḿ tvaḿ gatih Parameshvarah [“O Supreme Lord, I offer myself to You – You are the culmination of the journey of my life”]. The sádhaná to assimilate the ideation of Parama Puruśa by surrendering oneʼs “I” feeling unto Him, is the sádhaná of self-knowledge, and one can attain salvation only by this type of sádhaná. No one can escape the consequences of his or her actions by resorting to falsehood. This applies not only to the mundane sphere, it applies in the psychic world as well. This is the essence of countless words.
ZH_TEXT: 對於萬有存在之中心、宇宙一切之觀念所在的至上本體而言，一個人應該向祂獻上他的靈魂。他應該獻上他最喜愛的東西──亦即他的存在。而且在獻上之時他應該向至上意識說：「Nivedayámi cátmánaḿ tvaḿ gatih Parameshvarah」──哦，至上之主啊！我向您獻上我自己──您是我生命旅程的極致。 一個人透過將「我覺」臣服於祂而融入於至上意識的理念中，即是自我了悟的靈性修持。一個人唯有藉由此種修持方能達到解脫之境。 無人可憑藉不實之謬誤而擺脫行為業力的束縛。世俗層面如此，心智層面亦然。這是無盡話語的精髓！

EN_TEXT: In the universe, under no circumstances was anyone alone, is anyone alone, or will anyone be alone... The sky of the external world is glittering with His light and the sky of the inner world is also gleaming with His effulgence.
ZH_TEXT: 在此宇宙中，無論何種狀態都沒有人會是孤單的，過去沒有、現在沒有，將來也不會有。…… 外在世界的天空閃耀著祂的光芒，而內在世界的天空也因祂的光輝而明亮燦爛。
IT_TEXT: Nell’universo, nessuno è mai stato solo, nessuno è solo e nessuno lo sarà mai… Il cielo del mondo esterno brilla della Sua luce e il cielo del mondo interiore risplende ugualmente della Sua radiosa presenza.

ZH_TEXT: 人無需走遍天涯去找祂，因祂就藏身在你存在感的寶盒中。當你向內尋求時，驀然發現祂就在那裡。 忘記內在世界最明亮的珍寶，耗費功夫尋求光源於外在世界—真是浪費光陰！希瓦問何以有人要以此方式浪費寶貴的時間呢？為何有人要丟棄自己手中的食物而沿門托缽去行乞呢？祂的建議是：「向內在世界前進……走向更深……更深的內在吧！」

EN_TEXT: One need not run about in the world to find Him who is contained within the jewel-case of oneʼs existential feeling. One can easily attain Him if only one searches within.
ZH_TEXT: 人無需走遍天涯去找祂，因祂就藏身在你存在感的寶盒中。當你向內尋求時，驀然發現祂就在那裡。

EN_TEXT: Not only the gods are fond of the fragrance of flowers; devotees also want to string garlands for their beloved Iśt́a with the fragrant flowers of the devotion of their hearts. If a flower has no fragrance, it has no value for a devotee. One should remember that the fragrance of a flower and the tender sweetness of a devotional heart together make a perfect combination. What does the perfume of the flower represent? The worldly activity which a devotee does with a heart filled with love is the perfume of the flower, and the overflowing devotion for oneʼs Iśt́a is the tender sweetness in the devoteeʼs heart. With these two together, the devotee makes a garland.
ZH_TEXT: 不只諸神喜歡花朵的芬芳，虔誠者也想向他們親愛的上主(Iśt́a)獻上以他們虔誠的心靈所編織成的芬芳花環。如果花朵沒有芬芳的香氣，對虔誠者而言，一點價值也不具有。各位要牢記於心，花朵的芬芳和虔誠心靈的甜美溫柔兩者形成絕妙的結合。花朵的芬芳代表什麼呢？虔誠者以誠摯的愛所從事的世俗活動就是花朵的芬芳；而對上主所洋溢的無比虔誠就是虔誠者心靈的甜美溫柔。虔誠者以此二者編織成獻給上主的花環。
IT_TEXT: Non solo gli dèi amano il profumo dei fiori; anche i devoti desiderano intrecciare ghirlande per il loro amato Iṣṭa con i fiori fragranti della devozione del loro cuore. Se un fiore non ha profumo, non ha alcun valore per un devoto. È bene ricordare che il profumo del fiore e la dolcezza tenera di un cuore devoto, quando si incontrano, diventano una sola fragranza perfetta. Che cosa rappresenta il profumo del fiore? L’attività nel mondo che un devoto compie con il cuore colmo d’amore è il profumo del fiore, e la devozione traboccante verso il proprio Iṣṭa è la dolce tenerezza nel cuore del devoto. Unendo questi due elementi, il devoto confeziona la ghirlanda.

EN_TEXT: You have not to be afraid of any immoral or evil force of the world. Fearfulness is not your wont, it is not your Dharma. Your duty is to march forward. You must move forward. You have always the support of Parama Puruśa.
ZH_TEXT: 你不要害怕任何不道德或邪惡的力量，你不應恐懼，恐懼不是你的習性，它不是你的法性。你的責任是前進，你必須向前邁進。你永遠會有至上意識的支持。
CITATION_EN: 3 August 1978 DMC, Patna | Live without Fear, Subháśita Saḿgraha Part 19

EN_TEXT: Humans sometimes feel weak. And when do they feel weak? They feel weak when they isolate themselves from the Supreme Father, drift away from Him. But the moment they again realize Him they begin to realize that they are not low, they are not mean, they are the sons of the Supreme Father, they are the daughters of the Supreme Father, instantly they receive strength. Always remember: Karḿadhyakśah. You work with His power, you have no power. Hence you must not think as to whether you will be able to do this work, whether this work is possible for you. You will certainly be able to do it if there is the grace of the Supreme Father. Why should you not be able to do it? You will surely be able to do it. While doing work you are always in His sight. He is always seeing you, you are not alone, you are never alone. In no circumstances are you alone.
ZH_TEXT: 人類有時候會感到脆弱，他們何時覺得脆弱呢？就是當他們孤立自己，遠離至上之父時。然而當他們再度了悟祂時，就會知道自己並不低劣，而是至上之父的子女，一領悟及這個道理，他們馬上就得到了力量。你要永遠記得祂是「所有行動的控制主」(Karḿadhyakśah)。你沒有自己的力量，而是用祂的力量在工作。因此，你千萬不可猶豫自己是否能勝任此工作，或擔心自己能不能做這個工作。如果有至上之父的恩典，你當然能勝任。為什麼會不行呢？當你在工作時，祂永遠觀照著你、看著你，你絕對不是孤單的，無論在任何情況下，你永遠也不會是孤立無助的。
IT_TEXT: A volte gli esseri umani si sentono deboli. E quando accade? Quando si separano dal Padre Supremo, quando si allontanano da Lui. Ma nel momento in cui Lo riconoscono di nuovo, iniziano a rendersi conto di non essere inferiori, di non essere miseri: sono figli e figlie del Padre Supremo, e immediatamente ricevono forza. Ricordate sempre: Karmádhyakṣa. Voi agite con la Sua forza, non avete una forza vostra. Non dovete quindi chiedervi se sarete capaci di svolgere un lavoro, se quel lavoro è possibile per voi. Se c’è la grazia del Padre Supremo, sarete certamente in grado di farlo. Perché non dovreste riuscirci? Ci riuscirete sicuramente. Mentre lavorate, siete sempre sotto il Suo sguardo. Egli vi osserva costantemente. Non siete soli, non lo siete mai. In nessuna circostanza siete soli.

EN_TEXT: According to mental desire, there are acoustic roots, there are sounds. When you want to fight against these human weaknesses – each and every man has got certain weaknesses – one is always moving after name, one is always moving after fame, one after money, always money. So many weaknesses. Now, when one wants to fight against these internal and external enemies – you have got enemies in your mind, you have got enemies outside your mind. There are so many depraving forces, they are all enemies. When you want to fight against the mind, a particular flow is created in your mind, a particular flow. And the acoustic root of that flow is hummm. [Makes fighting gesture.] Hummm – fight – see – hummm. Hummm sound is created. The hummm sound is the acoustic root of fight.
ZH_TEXT: 心理上的欲望，有其音根和聲音。每個人都有弱點，人總是追逐名位、追逐財富；人有許許多多的弱點，在你心靈的內在和外在有許多的敵人，人想要對抗內在和外在的敵人。有許多墮落的力量，它們都是你的敵人，當你想要與心靈對抗，在你心中就產生了一個特殊的波流，這波流的音根就是吽(Hum)（巴巴做了一戰鬥的手勢），吽(Hum)聲音產生後，它就是戰鬥的音根。
IT_TEXT: Secondo il desiderio mentale, esistono specifiche radici acustiche, cioè suoni corrispondenti ai diversi flussi della mente. Quando una persona decide di combattere le proprie debolezze – che sono presenti in ogni essere umano, come l’attaccamento al nome, alla fama o al denaro – si attiva un processo interiore di opposizione. Queste debolezze costituiscono veri e propri nemici, sia interni, nella mente, sia esterni, sotto forma di influenze degradanti. Nel momento in cui si intraprende una lotta contro tali forze, nella mente si genera un flusso specifico, una particolare corrente psichica orientata al contrasto. A questo flusso corrisponde una precisa radice acustica: il suono hummm. Questo suono rappresenta, nella sua forma più essenziale, l’atto del combattere. Il suono hummm è dunque l’espressione acustica fondamentale della lotta interiore.

EN_TEXT: Those who run after Sambhúti or the glamour of creation and those who are obsessed by the fear of Asambhúti or the possibility of is destruction are both racing towards the world of darkness. A Sádhaka should look upon both Sambhúti and Asambhúti, i.e. creation and destruction, equitably and with equanimity. Scientists who are wholly and solely dedicated to the worship of Sambhúti and hermits who live in constant fear of destruction are both on the wrong path: they are not on the path of salvation. Only the person who uses judgement and accepts both of them attains immortality.
ZH_TEXT: 迷戀至上外顯幻化世界的美或害怕祂的傾頹毀滅都是在往黑暗世界疾行，一個靈修者應對創造與毀滅等同視之。科學家完全獻身於這個外顯的造化世界，遁世者活在毀滅的持續恐懼中，此二者都是偏頗的道路，皆非解脫之道，唯有在正確判斷下接受兩者的人才能達到最終的不朽。
IT_TEXT: Coloro che inseguono Sambhūti, cioè lo splendore della creazione, e coloro che sono ossessionati dalla paura di Asambhūti, ossia dalla possibilità della sua distruzione, corrono entrambi verso il mondo dell’oscurità. Un sādhaka dovrebbe considerare sia Sambhūti sia Asambhūti – cioè creazione e distruzione – in modo equilibrato e con equanimità. Gli scienziati che sono interamente e unicamente dediti al culto di Sambhūti e gli eremiti che vivono nel timore costante della distruzione sono entrambi sulla via sbagliata: non sono sul sentiero della liberazione. Solo colui che usa il discernimento e accetta entrambi raggiunge l’immortalità.

EN_TEXT: When a person progresses from the crude to the subtle as a result of his Sádhaná, all the bondages gradually start disappearing by themselves, and when a strong desire awakens in the mind to attain that pure consciousness within, the Hirańyamaya Kośa also gets destroyed. In each of the five different stages of mind i.e. (1) Kámamaya Kośa (Crude or Conscious mind), (2) Manomaya Kośa (Subtle or Sub-conscious mind, (3) Atimánas Kośa (Supra-mental mind), (4) Vijiṋánamaya Kośa (Subliminal mind), (5) Hirańyamaya Kośa (Subtle-Cosmic Mind) – (the last three are collectively called causal or astral or unconscious mind) some sort of finite object directly or indirectly remains, and this object becomes the cause of bondage – “Mana eva mauśya nám kárańam bandha mokśayo”. In other words the unit attains salvation only when she/he empties her/his mind of all objects. Just as an iron sword can perform acts of cruelty or merely cut the rope tethering and animal, similarly, according to its objective tendencies, the mind can also be the cause of both bondage and liberation.
ZH_TEXT: 一個人經由靈性修持之助，得以從粗鈍向精細前進，所有的束縛亦隨之漸次消失，最後當心中湧現誓願成就至上的強烈渴望時，連最後的一層──致因心靈也將被擊碎。心靈的五個層次──意識心靈、潛意識心靈、超心靈、下意識心靈、致因心靈（後三者合稱為無意識心靈或致因心靈），在每一層次直接或間接都存在著有限的個體，這些東西就成為束縛之因──「Mana eva mauśya nám kárańam bandha mokśayo」一個人唯有清空他心靈內所有的一切時，才能得到解脫。就像一把劍，可以是殺人的工具，也可以只是用來切斷拴住動物的繩索；同樣的，一個人的心靈可以依其目標的不同，成為束縛或解脫之源。
IT_TEXT: Quando, grazie al sadhana, una persona progredisce dal livello più grossolano a quello più sottile, tutti i vincoli iniziano gradualmente a dissolversi spontaneamente. E quando nella mente si risveglia un intenso desiderio di realizzare quella pura coscienza interiore, anche l'Hiraṇyamaya Kośa viene distrutto. In ciascuno dei cinque livelli della mente, cioè Kāmamaya Kośa (mente grossolana o cosciente), Manomaya Kośa (mente sottile o subconscia), Atimānas Kośa (mente sovramentale), Vijñānamaya Kośa (mente subliminale), Hiraṇyamaya Kośa (Mente Cosmica sottile), — gli ultimi tre livelli vengono collettivamente chiamati mente causale, astrale o inconscia — permane sempre, direttamente o indirettamente, qualche oggetto finito; ed è proprio questo oggetto a diventare la causa della schiavitù. Per questo si afferma: «La mente è la causa sia della schiavitù sia della liberazione dell'essere umano.» (Mana eva manuṣyāṇāṁ kāraṇaṁ bandha-mokṣayoḥ.) In altre parole, l'essere individuale raggiunge la liberazione soltanto quando svuota completamente la mente da ogni oggetto. Così come una spada di ferro può essere usata per compiere atti crudeli oppure semplicemente per tagliare la corda che tiene legato un animale, allo stesso modo la mente, a seconda della direzione verso cui è orientata, può diventare causa sia di schiavitù sia di liberazione.

EN_TEXT: No worldly happiness is limitless. Dedicate yourself completely to the blissful ocean of the Supreme Soul. Then alone will you realize what happiness really is. This path to attain happiness, this Sádhaná of self-surrender I call absolute devotion. Carry on performing your worldly duties with sincerity, and at the same time think about the pure self within you. Then alone will your Sádhaná be justified. The constant thought of your pure inner Self will certainly one day establish you in your original source, and this is the ultimate aim of Sádhaná. The Soul is by nature characteristically pure. The mind gets tied to Saḿskáras (potential reactions) due to its actions, and that is why the unit becomes the slave of life and death. When all the Saḿskáras are destroyed through spiritual Sádhaná and mental purification, one goes beyond life and death to the eternal region of immortality, where there is no difference between the soul and His Supreme Soul. Amen!
ZH_TEXT: 世界上沒有任何快樂是永恆的，完全獻身於至上意識的喜悅之洋，那麼你將明白真正的快樂為何。我把達到永恆快樂、自我誠服的靈性修持這條道路稱為絕對的虔誠。誠摯地盡你世俗該盡的責任，並時時一心繫念內在無染真我，你當可印證你的靈性修持。你內在自性的專精一念必將證入本源，這即是你靈性修持的最終目標。至上靈魂本自清淨無染。心靈因受到業力之縛而在生死海中流轉，當所有的業力經由靈性修持燃燒殆盡，心靈得以淨化之時，一個人將超越生死安住於永恆不朽之境，於彼再無個體靈魂與至上靈魂之別！阿門！
IT_TEXT: Nessuna felicità mondana è illimitata. Dedica completamente te stesso all'oceano di beatitudine dell'Anima Suprema. Solo allora comprenderai che cosa sia realmente la felicità. Questo sentiero per raggiungere la felicità, questo sadhana di abbandono al Supremo, io lo chiamo devozione assoluta. Continua a svolgere con sincerità i tuoi doveri nel mondo e, allo stesso tempo, mantieni il pensiero rivolto al Sé puro che dimora dentro di te. Solo così il tuo sadhana sarà veramente giustificato. Il pensiero costante del tuo Sé interiore puro ti condurrà certamente, un giorno, a stabilirti nella tua sorgente originaria, ed è proprio questo lo scopo ultimo del sadhana. L'Anima è per sua natura intrinsecamente pura. La mente si lega ai saḿskára (reazioni potenziali) a causa delle proprie azioni, ed è per questo che l'essere individuale diventa schiavo della vita e della morte. Quando tutti i saḿskára vengono distrutti attraverso il sadhana spirituale e la purificazione della mente, si va oltre la vita e la morte e si raggiunge l'eterno regno dell'immortalità, dove non esiste più alcuna differenza tra l'anima individuale e l'Anima Suprema. Amen!

EN_TEXT: Each of the spheres, namely, atimánas, vijiṋánamaya and hirańmaya, is respectively one beyond the other. Satya is beyond even the last. When one is established in Satya, only then can one become the knower of the past, present and future and ultimately of truth itself. For such a person there is no disharmony anywhere.
ZH_TEXT: 超心靈、下意識心靈和致因心靈一個比一個更超越，至上真理則連致因心靈也超越了。只有當一個人立足於至上真理之境時，他才能知曉過去、現在和未來及最終之真理。對他而言任何地方都沒有不和諧之處。

EN_TEXT: In the jiiva there are two types of “I” feeling – one is its mind created by Máyá, and the other is its knowledge-filled state – the reflected expression of Paramátmá Himself – that is, its (the jiivaʼs) jiivátmá. The jiivátman is the real “I” feeling of the jiiva, or unit soul.
ZH_TEXT: 在個體生命裡，有兩種類型的「我覺」──一個是由宇宙力量所創造出來的心靈，另外則是一種全知的狀態──它是至上意識的反映，也就是個體的意識，個體意識是個體生命真正的「我覺」。

EN_TEXT: Thus one must continue with sádhaná ceaselessly with a view to gradually establishing harmony and equilibrium in the kośas one after another. The moment the indistinct sensibility of the hirańmaya kośa (subtle causal mind) is free of the least vestige of impurity, the sádhaka shines with the dazzling radiance of the Satyaloka. That is an auspicious moment for a sádhaka as it is unification between Átman and Paramátman.
ZH_TEXT: 為了要建立起每個心靈層次間的協調與寧靜，人必須持續不斷的從事靈性的修持。一旦精細的致因心靈的朦朧感覺全然純淨時，修行者綻放出真理世界耀眼的光輝。個體意識與至上意識合而為一時，這是修行者最幸運的時刻。

ZH_TEXT: 人們可能僅因受精細藝術的陶冶而得到類似或些微的快樂，但他們無法完全將自身立足於神性喜悅之境，因此以至上意識為目標的靈性修持是必須的。

EN_TEXT: When the mental propensities reach the stage of cessation through sádhaná all the desires of the heart, whether original or consequential, disappear. The reactive momenta (saḿskára dhara) of those who have reached this stage, even once, no matter what course their reactive momenta take, have only one [ passion (Rati) left in them and that is, Brahma-rati or passion for the union with Brahma. Love alone remains as the Praeti (the only longing). ] At that stage sádhakas attain deathlessness right in this mortal world. They see nothing but Brahma. For the eyes of those in whom a singular longing for union with Brahma has awakened (Brahma praeti) this mundane world appears as the Brahma Loka, the Abode of Brahma – everything is He, everything is He.
ZH_TEXT: 當心靈情緒傾向透過靈性修持到達如如不動不起作用的階段，心中不論是原發性或是因為因果業力而來的欲望都消失了。達到此境界之人，不論他們所取得的因果業力為何，此時最多只會存留一種因果業力──那就是與至上意識合而為一的渴望。只有「愛」為唯一的渴望。在此境界，修行者於無常的塵世即達到永恆不朽。他們所見惟有至上意識。與至上意識合而為一的渴望已於心中覺醒之人。此塵世在眼中即顯現為至上真理之境──一切都是祂，一切都是祂。
IT_TEXT: Quando, attraverso il sadhana, le tendenze della mente arrivano a quietarsi completamente, tutti i desideri del cuore – sia originari sia derivati – si dissolvono. I momenti reattivi (saḿskāra-dhārā) di coloro che hanno raggiunto anche una sola volta questo stato, qualunque direzione essi prendano, conservano ormai un’unica passione (rati): la Brahma-rati, la passione per l’unione con Brahma. Solo l’amore rimane come praeti, l’unico anelito. In quello stadio i sādhaka conseguono l’immortalità già in questo mondo mortale. Non vedono altro che Brahma. Agli occhi di coloro nei quali si è risvegliato un anelito unico verso l’unione con Brahma (Brahma-praeti), questo mondo ordinario appare come Brahma-loka, la Dimora di Brahma: tutto è Lui, tutto è Lui.

EN_TEXT: Every unit mind can function freely in the realm of imagination... Thus in the sphere of imagination every microcosm enjoys independence, the power of a king. But one can only imagine according to the capacity of the mind. One may have unlimited freedom, but one does not have unlimited capacity. The closer one comes to the Supreme Consciousness in the introversive flow of the Cosmic Imagination (pratisaiṋcara), the more oneʼs mental capacity increases, and the more oneʼs spirit of independence is expressed. When one finally becomes established in Supreme Consciousness, one realizes that the Supreme Entity has limitless psychic power and freedom of expression.
ZH_TEXT: 每個個體心靈皆可在其想像的領域內自由運作。……因此，在想像的領域裡，每個小宇宙個體均享有如國王之權力般的獨立自主。但是人只能依其心智能力來想像。人可有無限的自由，但卻沒有無限的能力。當一個人在宇宙向心運動波流中愈接近至上意識時，他的心智能力就愈增強，其獨立自主的精神就更為展現。當他最後立足於至上意識時，他即了悟到至上本體具有無限的心智力量和表達自由。
IT_TEXT: Ogni mente individuale può muoversi liberamente nel regno dell’immaginazione. In questo ambito, ogni microcosmo possiede un’indipendenza totale. Tuttavia, ciò che una mente può immaginare dipende dalla sua capacità interiore. La libertà può essere illimitata, ma la capacità non lo è. Essa cresce nella misura in cui la mente si avvicina alla Coscienza Suprema, nel flusso introversivo dell’Immaginazione Cosmica (pratisaiñcara). Quanto più la mente si espande, tanto più si manifesta il suo autentico spirito di indipendenza. Quando infine la mente si stabilisce nella Coscienza Suprema, si realizza che l’Entità Suprema sola possiede un potere psichico e una libertà di espressione senza limiti.

EN_TEXT: Intelligent people realize Parama Puruśa deep in their unit souls, after surrendering themselves at His divine altar. Only by becoming one with Him does one attain the infinite and the eternal. To merge in Him, the path of self-surrender is the only path.
ZH_TEXT: 明智者將自身臣服在祂的聖壇時，了悟到至上意識就在他們個體靈魂的深處，只有與祂合一，才能達到無限和永恆。要融入於祂，自我臣服是唯一的道路。

EN_TEXT: Say, creed. We say there are so many creeds. “We are serving the human society irrespective of creed.” We say like this. But can there be more than one creed? What is the human creed? To move towards the Supreme Entity, move towards the Supreme Source, the perennial source of bliss. It is the only creed. Knowingly or unknowingly, we are all moving towards – what? We are all seekers of – what? We want – what? We want bliss. We want peace. So for the entire human society the creed is – what? How many? One. We are all knowingly or unknowingly moving towards Him; so human society cannot have more than one creed.
ZH_TEXT: 說到「信仰」,「信仰」有千千萬萬種，人們會說：「我們為全人類服務，不問任何信仰。」但是難道人們能有多種不同的信仰嗎？人類的信仰是什麼？人類的信仰只有一種，就是朝向至上本體前進，朝向至上的本源、永恆的喜悅之源前進。這才是人類唯一的信仰。我們在有意無意間皆朝著什麼而前進呢？我們都在尋找什麼呢？我們渴望的是什麼呢？就是喜悅，我們渴望得到平靜。所以對整體人類社會來說，其信仰應是什麼？有多少種呢？就只有唯一的一種。我們都在有意無意間朝向祂而前進，所以人類的社會不可能會有超過一種以上的信仰。
IT_TEXT: Diciamo spesso: credo. E diciamo che esistono tanti credi. Diciamo persino: «Serviamo la società umana indipendentemente dal credo». Ma fermiamoci un attimo. Può davvero esistere più di un credo? Qual è, in fondo, il credo umano? Muoversi verso l’Entità Suprema. Muoversi verso la Sorgente Suprema, la fonte perenne della beatitudine. Questo è il credo. L’unico. Che ne siamo consapevoli o no, tutti stiamo andando in quella direzione. Tutti cerchiamo qualcosa. Cerchiamo che cosa? Che cosa vogliamo davvero? Vogliamo la beatitudine. Vogliamo la pace. Allora, per l’intera società umana, qual è il credo? Quanti credi possono esserci? Uno solo. Consapevolmente o inconsapevolmente, tutti ci stiamo muovendo verso di Lui. Per questo la società umana non può avere più di un credo.

ZH_TEXT: 我們向人問候的方式是什麼？我們會說「Namaskára」，意即「我向你內在的至上意識致敬」。你們要牢記於心：「我把心中所有的善念都集中於眉心這一點(trikut́i)。」

EN_TEXT: A person requires a strong determination – “I must move. I must move.” And then do it. There must not be any negative thought in the mind. “Will it be possible for me to do?” – such a question must not arise in the mind, and whenever there is such a question, it means you will not be successful in your mission. Your thinking should always be positive: “Yes, I must be successful.” There must not be any question regarding your success.
ZH_TEXT: 人類需要堅強的決心──一定要有「我要前進」、「我要前進」的決心方可。有了這種決心，你才會採取行動。心靈中不可存有任何負面的想法，如「這可能嗎？我做得到嗎？」不要有這種念頭升起。一旦你的心中出現類似的想法，你生命的使命將難以成功。所以你的思想必須時時保持正面：「是的，我一定要成功。」對於生命的成功這件事你毫不懷疑。

EN_TEXT: The beginning point of prapattiváda is “I am, Thou art, and Thou art mine.” The culminating point of prapattiváda is “Thou art, O my Lord, Thou art.” In the absence of “I am,” prapattiváda cannot begin; that is why the presence of “I am” is essential for prapattiváda in the beginning; but in the end only “Tvamasi, Tvaḿ Hi, Tvaḿ Hi” (Thou art – Thou, Thou.)
ZH_TEXT: 完全臣服論的起點是「我存在，您存在，您是我的」;而它的極致頂點是「您存在。哦，我的主啊！只有您存在。」 沒有「我」時，「完全臣服」無法開始；這就是為何「我存在」對於「完全臣服」的論點在開始時很重要的原因；但是在最後，卻只有「您存在」，只有「您」、只有「您」。

EN_TEXT: The second important factor is samyak saḿkalpa. Samyak means “proper”. Saḿkalpa means “determination”. Here, samyak saḿkalpa means “proper and firm determination”. “I will do it, I must do it.” This firm determination is the secret of success in each and every human life. Where there is no firm determination, one will never be successful in any arena of human life or human thought. “I must do it! I must come in contact with the Supreme Entity! I must be one with Parama Puruśa!” These are the firm determinations. So Lord Buddha said that this is the second important factor, second important principle, that a spiritual aspirant must adhere to.
ZH_TEXT: 第二個要項是山亞‧山卡帕(samyak saḿkalpa)。山亞(Samyak)意指適當的；山卡帕(Saḿkalpa)意指決心。山亞‧山卡帕(samyak saḿkalpa)意指適切而堅定的決心。「我要做，我一定要做！」這種堅定的決心是每個人生成功的秘訣。若無堅定的決心，在人類生命的任何領域中絕對無法成功。「我必須做，我必須與至上本體(Supreme Entity)合而為一！我一定要和至上意識 (Parama Puruśa)合而為一。」這就是堅定的決心。所以佛陀說這是第二個要點，一個靈性渴望者必須嚴格遵守這第二個重要的原則。

ZH_TEXT: 最好的人，他們是什麼樣的人？他們的原則是：「當我開始做一件事，我必須以美好的、妥善的和卓越的方式來完成它。」佛陀說，當你開始做一件事時，你必須盡善盡美地完成它。

And behind that expressed world, behind that final form of the expressed world, there lies coverted the Supreme Consciousness, the Átman. So the Átman is the best tiirtha. And the Átman is the supreme tiirtha. Rather the Átmán is the only tiirtha.

EN_TEXT: Each and every man has an “I” feeling; each and every man feels that “I exist”. This feeling of “I exist” is the final form of expressed world. And behind that expressed world, behind that final form of the expressed world, there lies coverted the Supreme Consciousness, the Átman. So the Átman is the best tiirtha. And the Átman is the supreme tiirtha. Rather the Átmán is the only tiirtha. You are all spiritual aspirants. You should remember that your movement is not from subtle to crude, but from crude to subtle. But you must not neglect this crude world, because your existence is being nourished by this crude world. Thatʼs why you should pay proper respect to the crude world also. Thatʼs why I say, ours is a subjective approach through objective adjustment. You should remember this fact.
ZH_TEXT: 每個人都有「我存在」的感覺。此「我存在」的感受是此大千世界最後形態的背後潛存著至上意識──自性。所以自性(Átman)是最佳的聖地。自性是至上的聖地，也是唯一的聖地。 你們都是靈性的追求者，你們應該記住，你們的行動不是從精細到粗鈍，而是從粗鈍到精細。你們也不應忽視此粗鈍的世界，因為你們的存在是受此粗鈍世界的養育。所以你們也應適當的尊重此粗鈍的物質世界。所以我說我們的方法是經由客體的調適而從事主體的接近。

EN_TEXT: Each and every man – whatever his status of life, whatever his psychic or spiritual status – each and every human being wants success in life. Whenever you are doing something, success is not in your hands. Success comes as a reaction. When the original action is good, the reaction is also good, and that reaction is the success. For a spiritual man, for a spiritual aspirant, for a good soul who renders service to the Society, the service itself is the prize. He wants no other prize, no other success.
ZH_TEXT: 每個人不論他的身份地位如何，不論他的心智或靈性狀態如何，都希望在生命中得到成功。不論何時你做何事，成功並不操之在你。成功來自行為的果報。若最初的行為是好的，它的反作用結果也是好的，則此反作用結果即是成功。對於靈性之士、靈性的渴望者以及善良的人，當他服務社會時，服務本身就是獎賞。他不要求其他的獎賞，也不要求其他的成功。
CITATION_EN: Shrii Shrii Ánandamúrti | 17 August 1979, Taipei | 03 Seven Secrets | Bábá in Taiwan
CITATION_ZH: Shrii Shrii Ánandamúrti | 1979年8月17日於台北 | 03 成功的秘訣 | 巴巴在台灣，P.18

EN_TEXT: Devotion is the only secret in spiritual movement, and the incantative outer-suggestion and auto-suggestion can help you in psychic movement. A neat and clean life based on morality can help you in your entitative flow, and there must be a happy blending, or parallelism amongst entitative waves, incantative waves, and spiritual waves.
ZH_TEXT: 在靈性的活動中，虔誠是唯一的秘密，梵咒的外在暗示和自我暗示能在心智的活動中幫助你，植基於道德的純淨生活能在你個體的波流裡幫助你。而個體的波流，梵咒的波流和靈性的波流，此三者必須有一快樂的融合或平行。
CITATION_EN: Shrii Shrii Ánandamúrti | 17 August 1979 DMC, Taipei | 04 Man and His Ideological Desideratum | Bábá in Taiwan
CITATION_ZH: Shrii Shrii Ánandamúrti | 1979年8月17日於台北大法會 | 04 人及其理念的目標 | 巴巴在台灣，P.32~33

EN_TEXT: What is spiritual flow? For spiritual flow, you need not go through so many books and so many scriptures. You need not do anything else; only all your propensities should be suspended and brought to a particular point, a particular gland and goaded unto the Parama Puruśa. When you love the Parama Puruśa with all your propensities good and bad, then that collective flow of your mind is devotion. By dint of oneʼs devotion, one can attain the Supreme Stance. One gets the Parama Puruśa.
ZH_TEXT: 靈性的波流是什麼？為了達到靈性的波流，你不必皓首窮經，你只需暫停你所有的心靈情緒傾向作用，將其置於特定的一點，特定的腺體，然後導向至上意識。此外你不須做任何其他的事。當你以所有好的與不好的心靈情緒傾向作用去愛至上意識識時，則你心靈的集體波流就是虔誠。藉由虔誠，吾人才能達到至上之境，得到至上意識。
CITATION_EN: Shrii Shrii Ánandamúrti | 17 August 1979 DMC, Taipei | 04 Man and His Ideological Desideratum | Bábá in Taiwan
CITATION_ZH: Shrii Shrii Ánandamúrti | 1979年8月17日於台北大法會 | 04 人及其理念的目標 | 巴巴在台灣，P.32

EN_TEXT: For progress in entitative flow, one is to lead a pure life, a moralistic life, a life based on moral principles. Do not do anything bad. What is bad? Bad is that which depraves human existence. Follow a strict code of morality. Live a pure life, a neat and clean life. Be strict in 16 Points. What will happen? Your entitative flow will get purified and will be in parallelism with your psychic wave.
ZH_TEXT: 為了個體波流的進步，吾人必須過著純淨、有道德的生活，一種以道德原則為基礎的生活。不要做壞事。什麼是壞事？促使人類生命墮落之事就是壞事。遵守嚴格的道德規範，過著純淨的生活，過著整齊有序和潔淨的生活。嚴守十六點原則。那麼結果將會如何？你個體的波流會得到淨化，而與你心智的波流保持平行一致。
CITATION_EN: Shrii Shrii Ánandamúti | 17 August 1979 DMC, Taipei | Man and His Ideological Desideratum | Subháśita Saḿgraha Part 12
CITATION_ZH: Shrii Shrii Ánandamúti | 1979年8月17日於台北大法會 | 人及其理念目標，靈性科學集成卷12，P.116

EN_TEXT: For maintaining parallelism between psychic waves and spiritual waves, what are you to do? You are to follow the auto-suggestion and outer-suggestion of incantations. What is outer-suggestion? If you are in the company of good people, that company – their discourses and talks will influence your mind, and your mind will be purified. The curvatures will be less and the flow will be straightened. This is outer-suggestion through incantations. Now, what is auto-suggestion through incantations? It is doing meditation and japa (mantra repetition) as per the instruction of the Ácárya. This is auto-suggestion. These incantative auto-suggestions and outer-suggestions will purify your mind, and the mind will be in the position to maintain proper parallelism with your spiritual flow. What is spiritual flow? For spiritual flow, you need not go through so many books and so many scriptures. You need not do anything else; only all your propensities should be suspended and brought to a particular point, a particular gland and goaded unto the Parama Puruśa. When you love the Parama Puruśa with all your propensities good and bad, then that collective flow of your mind is devotion. By dint of oneʼs devotion, one can attain the Supreme Stance. One gets the Parama Puruśa.
ZH_TEXT: 你該怎麼做，才能維持心智波流與靈性波流的平行呢？你必須遵循梵咒的自我暗示和外在暗示。什麼是外在暗示？如果你與善人為伍，這些朋友們的話語會影響你的心靈，你的心靈將得以淨化。你的波流曲度會因此減少而成為直線。這就是經由持咒的外在暗示。那什麼是經由持咒的自我暗示？就是遵照阿闍黎的指示，從事靜坐和不斷的持念梵咒(japa)，此即為自我暗示。持咒自我暗示和外在暗示會淨化你的心靈，心靈才能維繫與靈性波流間的平行。 靈性波流是什麼？你不必皓首窮經，只要收攝所有的心靈情緒傾向作用於特定的一點、特定的腺體，並將它導向至上意識，除此之外，你什麼也不必做。當你傾盡所有好的、壞的心靈情緒傾向去愛至上意識時，則你心靈的集體波流就是虔誠。藉由虔誠，吾人才可達到至上之境，獲得至上意識。
IT_TEXT: Per mantenere il parallelismo tra le onde psichiche e le onde spirituali, che cosa si deve fare? Occorre seguire l’auto-suggestione e la suggestione esterna attraverso i mantra. Che cosa si intende per suggestione esterna? Se si è in compagnia di persone buone, quella compagnia – i loro discorsi e le loro conversazioni – influenzerà la mente e la mente verrà purificata. Le deviazioni della mente si ridurranno e il suo flusso diventerà più lineare. Questa è la suggestione esterna attraverso le incantazioni. Ora, che cos’è l’auto-suggestione attraverso i mantra? Consiste nel praticare la meditazione e il japa (ripetizione del mantra) secondo le istruzioni dell’Ácárya. Questa è l’auto-suggestione. Queste auto-suggestioni e le suggestioni esterne generate dai mantra purificheranno la mente e, di conseguenza, questa sarà in grado di mantenere il giusto parallelismo con il flusso spirituale. Che cos’è il flusso spirituale? Per il flusso spirituale non è necessario passare attraverso molti libri e molte scritture. Non occorre fare altro: tutte le proprie propensioni devono essere sospese, raccolte in un punto particolare, in una specifica ghiandola, e indirizzate verso Parama Puruśa. Quando si ama Parama Puruśa con tutte le proprie propensioni, buone e cattive, allora quel flusso collettivo della mente diventa devozione. In virtù della propria devozione si può raggiungere la Suprema Realizzazione. Si ottiene Parama Puruśa.

EN_TEXT: No man is unimportant. No man is insignificant. Everyone is a VIP. All of you were born of noble family, the noblest family, because Parama Puruśa is your father. You are not an insignificant person.
ZH_TEXT: 沒有人是不重要的，沒有人是微不足道的。每個人都是重要的人物。你們都是誕生於高貴的家庭，是在最高貴的家庭中出生的，因為至上意識是你們的父親，你們不是微不足道的人。
CITATION_EN: 17 August 1979 DMC, Taipei  | Man and His Ideological Desideratum, Subháśita Saḿgraha Part 12
CITATION_ZH: 1979年8月17日於台北大法會 | 人及其理念目標，靈性科學集成卷12，P.119

EN_TEXT: The interpretation of Ananda Marga, is Saḿyogoyogo ityukto jiivátmá Paramátmanah – “The unification of unit consciousness, jiivátmá, with the Supreme Consciousness, that is, Paramátmá, is yoga.” When the unit entity, the unit consciousness, becomes one with the Cosmic Consciousness, that becoming one, that unification, is yoga. And in that unification, the unit consciousness loses its identity. When the river comes in contact with the sea, it no longer remains the river. It becomes one with the sea, it becomes the sea.
ZH_TEXT: 阿南達瑪迦的說法是：Saḿyogoyogo ityukto jiivátmá Paramátmanah 「個體意識(jiivátmá)與至上意識(Paramátmá)的合而為一即是瑜伽。」當個體意識與至上意識合而為一時，這種合而為一、這種融合就是瑜伽。在那樣的融合當中，個體意識早已不存在了。猶如河流注入大海，河流即不再是河流，它與大海合而為一，它成為大海。
CITATION_EN: Shrii Shrii Ánandamúrti | 18 August 1979, Taipei | 05 The Three Species of Human Being | Bábá in Taiwan
CITATION_ZH: Shrii Shrii Ánandamúrti | 1979年8月18日於台北 | 05 三種人 | 巴巴在台灣，P.38

EN_TEXT: Those who are established in viirácára they are to elevate themselves to the standard of deva. That is, they are to be gods in human structure. And what is the meaning of “god” here? Here “god” means, with a small “g”, not capital “G”; “g” – “o” – “d”, whose feminine term is “goddess”. And for big “God” with a capital “G”, there is no feminine term: “God” is a common gender.
ZH_TEXT: 那些已經立足於勇敢之路境界的人，必須將自身提升到神(Deva)的水準，那是以人的形體存在的神。此處的神(god)意義為何？這裡用的是小寫的英文字母g，而不是一個大寫的G，這個詞的陰性是goddess（女神）。一個大寫的G所指的上帝(God)一詞是沒有陰性形式的，它是一個通性的詞。
CITATION_EN: Shrii Shrii Ánandamúrti | 18 August 1979, Taipei | 05 The Three Species of Human Being | Bábá in Taiwan
CITATION_ZH: Shrii Shrii Ánandamúrti | 1979年8月18日於台北 | 05 三種人 | 巴巴在台灣，P.40

EN_TEXT: Those who do not practise sádhaná – unknowingly they are moving away from Him. That is, their radius, the radius between that entity and Parama Puruśa, increases, but they cannot go beyond the Cosmological Order. Not to meditate on Him, not to do His work, means increasing the length of the radius, going away from the nucleus of the Universe – this much, but they will have to remain within the Cosmological Order. Now, those who meditate on Him, those who are on the path of sádhaná, their radius, the radius between that spiritual aspirant and the Cosmic Nucleus, Parama Puruśa, goes on decreasing and decreasing.
ZH_TEXT: 那些未能從事靈修的人──他們在無意間逐漸偏離了祂。他們和至上意識之間的半徑距離逐漸擴大，但是他們仍然無法超越這運作的法則。不去想祂、不去做祂的工作意味著你和他之間的半徑距離將會愈來愈長，你將會逐漸遠離宇宙的核心。但是一切事物仍然維持在宇宙法則運作的範圍之內。 那些想著祂、那些行走在靈修道路上的人，他們和宇宙核心的距離，也就是靈性渴望者和至上意識之間的半徑距離將會逐漸縮小。
CITATION_EN: Shrii Shrii Ánandamúrti | 20 August 1979, Taichung, Taiwan | 06 The Nucleus of the Universe | Bábá in Taiwan
CITATION_ZH: Shrii Shrii Ánandamúrti | 1979年8月20日於台中 | 06 宇宙的核心 | 巴巴在台灣，P.44~45

EN_TEXT: You should always remember that you are the children of Parama Puruśa, and it is your birthright to be one with Him. It is your birthright to sit upon His lap. And nobody can debar you from this birthright. So, why unknowingly, why unconsciously? Knowingly and consciously, all should move towards Him and be one with Him. And this is the path of humanity, and this is the main factor that differentiates an animal from a man.
ZH_TEXT: 你們應該永遠記得你們是至上意識的孩子，與祂合而為一是你們與生俱來的權利。坐在祂的膝上是你們與生俱來的權利。沒有人能夠剝奪你們這項天賦的權利。這就是為什麼說，無論自覺或不自覺，無論在有意或無意中，你們都應該朝祂前進並且與祂合一。這是人類的正道，也是人類與動物的最大差別。
CITATION_EN: Shrii Shrii Ánandamúrti | 20 August 1979, Taichung, Taiwan | 06 The Nucleus of the Universe | Bábá in Taiwan
CITATION_ZH: Shrii Shrii Ánandamúrti | 1979年8月20日於台中 | 06 宇宙的核心 | 巴巴在台灣，P.46

EN_TEXT: In human life also, where a man does not want to do anything, indirectly or unknowingly or unconsciously he is going against the very spirit of the universe. Because the spirit of the universe is to move. In Sanskrit, this universe is called jagat. Jagat means “move” – the entity whose characteristic, whose wont, is to move. Here everything moves.
ZH_TEXT: 在人類生命中，當一個人什麼事也不想做的時候，無論是出於自覺或不自覺，他已違反了宇宙真正的精神。因為宇宙的精神是不停向前邁進的。在梵文裡，宇宙被稱為Jagat。Jagat意指此實體的本然特質是不停向前邁進的。
CITATION_EN: Shrii Shrii Ánandamúrti | 21 August 1979, Kaohsiung | 07 Kiirtana and Dance / The Psychic Order | Bábá in Taiwan
CITATION_ZH: Shrii Shrii Ánandamúrti | 1979年8月21日於高雄 | 07 循環圈 | 巴巴在台灣，P.51

EN_TEXT: What a mystery! It is a great mystery, that whatever you perceive or whatever you conceive – everything is within you, nothing without you. And that is why in Sanskrit it is said... Entire universe will be within you in minature form. You will see the psychic projection of the material world. Thatʼs why I say, the human entity is more a psychic one than physical. Your existence is more important in the psychic world than in the physical world. But, in DMC, I said you must maintain parallelism amongst your – what? Entitative waves, incantative waves, and spiritual waves.
ZH_TEXT: 這是多麼奇妙的事情啊！一切你所接收到的或想像的事物，全部都是在你的內心裡，沒有任何事物是外在的。所以說，在梵文中曾經說到整個宇宙都是以縮影的方式存在你的內心裡。你所看到的事物，事實上是物質世界的心智投射。這也是為什麼我說人類的本質是於心智上更勝於物質的層面。你們的存在，主要是在心智層面裡，而非在物質的領域中。在大法會中，我說過你們必須保持個體的波流，梵咒的波流，和靈性的波流三者之間的平衡。
IT_TEXT: Che mistero! È un grande mistero: qualunque cosa tu percepisca o qualunque cosa tu concepisca, tutto è dentro di te, nulla è fuori di te. Per questo in sanscrito si dice: Traelokye yāni bhūtāni tāni sarvāṇi dehataḥ — qualunque cosa esista nell’universo esiste anche nella tua piccola struttura. L’intero universo sarà dentro di te in forma miniaturizzata. Vedrai la proiezione psichica del mondo materiale. Ecco perché dico che l’essere umano è più una realtà psichica che fisica. La tua esistenza è più importante nel mondo psichico che in quello fisico. Tuttavia, al DMC ho detto che è necessario mantenere il parallelismo tra le tue onde entitative, le onde dell’incantazione e le onde spirituali.
CITATION_EN: Shrii Shrii Ánandamúrti | 24 August 1979, Taipei | 09 The Two Human Approaches | Bábá in Taiwan
CITATION_ZH: Shrii Shrii Ánandamúrti | 1979年8月24日於台北 | 09 人類的兩種探求 | 巴巴在台灣，P.64~65

EN_TEXT: But the true devotees say, “Oh Parama Puruśa, there are so many good devotees, and I am an ordinary devotee, worst devotee. But O Lord, those who are your big devotees, they have done one thing. They have stolen Your mind." Because Parama Puruśa loves His devotees very much, His mind has been stolen by His devotees – what? His devotees have stolen His mind. Because He loves His devotees very much. Now Parama Puruśaʼ – His mind has been stolen by His devotees, so He has got one shortage, one want – what? Mind. His mind has been taken by His devotees. So, ”O Lord, your big, big devotees have stolen your mind, so You have got one want. You have lost your mind. Do one thing, O Lord, take my mind. Let there be no want in You. I offer my mind to You. Accept it.” So, the devotees are very intelligent, they are more intelligent than intellectuals, more intelligent than those who are engaged in actional faculties.
ZH_TEXT: 所以，真正的虔誠者會說：「哦！至上意識啊！世界上有這麼多的虔誠者，我只是其中最普通、最差勁的一個。但，上主啊！那些偉大的虔誠者做了一件事情啊！他們偷走了你的心。」由於至上意識非常愛祂的虔誠者，因此祂的心被祂的虔誠者偷走了。現在，至上意識的心被祂的虔誠者偷走，祂缺少了一樣東西，那就是祂的心。因為祂的心已經被祂的虔誠者所偷走。「哦！主啊！你的虔誠者偷走了你的心，因此你缺了一樣東西，你失掉了心。主啊！做一件事吧！把我的心拿去吧！讓你不再有所缺乏。我把心給你，使你不再有所缺乏，請祢收下吧！」 所以說，虔誠者是非常聰明的，他們比知識份子更聰明，也比專注於行動的人更聰明。
IT_TEXT: I veri devoti dicono: «O Parama Puruśa, ci sono così tanti bravi devoti e io sono solo un devoto qualunque, il peggiore. Ma, Signore, quei tuoi grandi devoti Ti hanno rubato la mente». Poiché Parama Puruśa ama profondamente i Suoi devoti, la Sua mente è stata “rubata” da loro — che cosa? I devoti Gli hanno sottratto la mente. Perché Lui li ama immensamente. E allora, poiché la mente di Parama Puruśa è stata portata via dai Suoi devoti, Egli si ritrova con una mancanza, una carenza: quale? La mente. La Sua mente è stata presa dai devoti. Perciò il devoto dice: «O Signore, i Tuoi grandi devoti Ti hanno preso la mente, così ora Ti manca qualcosa: hai perduto la Tua mente. Allora, Signore, prendi la mia. Che in Te non ci sia più alcuna carenza. Io Ti offro la mia mente: accettala». Così i devoti sono molto intelligenti: più intelligenti degli intellettuali, più intelligenti di coloro che sono impegnati nelle attività dell’azione.
CITATION_EN: Shrii Shrii Ánandamúrti | 24 August 1979, Taipei | 09 The Two Human Approaches | Bábá in Taiwan
CITATION_ZH: Shrii Shrii Ánandamúrti | 1979年8月24日於台北 | 09 人類的兩種探求 | 巴巴在台灣，P.70~71

EN_TEXT: How is one to move along that path? How is oneʼs existence to be pinnacled? Human existence is trifarious – physical, mental, and spiritual, but the stages or layers are four in number – physical, psychic, psycho-spiritual, and spiritual. In Sanskrit those physical entities with which, we say, human existence is closely coordinated is called káma. You cannot do without these things – food, clothing, education, medical treatment. These things are essential for human life. They come within the grasp of káma, the lowest layer. Those that think that this world is nothing, or those who say that a good man should keep no connection with the world are in Foolʼs Paradise. Yet you should remember that these things should not be the goal of your life. So many times I have said, yours should be subjective approach with objective adjustment. For your development in this crudest, physical layer, you should build up a strong society. You should see that everyone gets enough food, clothing, housing, medical treatment, education, you should see to it. It is your social duty.
ZH_TEXT: 一個人要如何走在虔誠之路上呢？一個人的存在要如何達到極致之境呢？人類的存在，有三個層面──身體的、心智的和靈性的。但其階段或層次有四個──身體的、心理的、心理趨向靈性的，以及靈性的。 在梵文中，那些有關身體的，與人類存在息息相關之事物統稱為卡瑪(Káma)。你無法忽略食物、衣服、教育和醫療這類事物對於人類存在之必要性。他們皆隸屬於卡瑪範疇，都是在最基本需求的層次之內。至於那些成天說著這個世界是虛幻不實的，或者說一個好人不應涉入此紅塵俗世之中的人，他們其實都是活在幻想中。但是你應該永遠記住這些事物不是你生命中的目標。我已經說過許多次了，你的生命應該是朝主體前進，但必須做好客體的調適。 為了使你們能在這個粗鈍的物質世界發展，你們應建立起一個堅強的社會。你們應滿足所有人在食、衣、住、醫療和教育方面的需求，這是你們的社會責任。
IT_TEXT: Come si procede lungo il cammino? Come può l’esistenza unificata e orientata al vertice? L’esistenza umana è triplice – fisica, mentale e spirituale – ma le fasi o gli strati sono quattro: fisico, psichico, psico-spirituale e spirituale. In sanscrito, l’insieme degli elementi fisici con cui, possiamo dire, l’esistenza umana è strettamente coordinata è chiamato kāma. Non si può fare a meno di queste cose: cibo, vestiario, istruzione, cure mediche. Queste cose sono essenziali per la vita umana. Rientrano nell’ambito di kāma, lo strato più basso. Coloro che pensano che questo mondo non sia nulla, o che affermano che una persona buona non dovrebbe avere alcun legame con il mondo, vivono in un “paradiso degli stolti”. Tuttavia, dovete ricordare che queste cose non devono essere lo scopo della vostra vita. Molte volte ho detto che il vostro deve essere un approccio soggettivo con un adattamento oggettivo. Per il vostro sviluppo in questo strato più grossolano, quello fisico, dovete costruire una società forte. Dovete assicurarvi che tutti abbiano cibo sufficiente, vestiario, abitazione, cure mediche, istruzione; dovete occuparvene. Questo è il vostro dovere sociale.

EN_TEXT: Three factors are indispensable for microcosmic progress: physical clash, psychic clash and the attraction of the Great. Whenever there is clash or conflict within any structure, whether subtle or crude, it develops increasing subtlety. This applies to both psychic clash and physical clash. The spirit of sádhaná of a person experiencing the attraction of the Great is total surrender, or kevalá bhakti (one-pointed devotion).
ZH_TEXT: 小宇宙個體的進步和三個要素息息相關──身體層面的摩擦衝擊、心智層面的衝擊和至上的吸引力。 不論精細或粗鈍的結構體，一旦遭逢衝擊，其結果都是變得更為精細。這在身體層面及心智層面皆適用。 在至上吸引力中，完全的臣服或絕對的虔誠(kevalá bhakti)是靈性修持的精神所在。

EN_TEXT: It should be remembered that both the materialists and the idealists are sádhakas, the only difference between them being their goal. A subtle analysis will reveal that both categories harm society. In order to advance, human beings will have to maintain a balance between the two, and will have to keep the idea of the Supreme fixed before them as their goal in the midst of physical [and psychic] clashes.
ZH_TEXT: 「理想主義者」和「唯物主義者」都是靈性修持者，唯一不同的是他們的目標。仔細分析下可發現兩者對於社會皆有害。人類必須在維持兩者的平衡下前進，他們必須在重重身體層面的摩擦衝擊中緊盯住至上理念以為其目標。
IT_TEXT: Va ricordato che tanto i materialisti quanto gli idealisti sono sadhaka; l’unica differenza tra loro consiste nella meta che perseguono. Un’analisi sottile rivelerà che entrambe le categorie arrecano danno alla società. Per progredire, gli esseri umani dovranno mantenere un equilibrio tra le due e, nel mezzo dei conflitti fisici [e psichici], dovranno mantenere saldamente davanti a sé l’idea del Supremo come propria meta.

EN_TEXT: Devotion plays a positive role in the process of clash. Had there been no factor to maintain the balance among all the objects created within the Macrocosmic Mind, the entire structure of the universe would have fallen apart. For the sake of harmony and balance within the universe, there is a mutual attraction among all the objects; each microcosm attracts the other microcosms. All finite microcosms – the innumerable manifestations of the Supreme Entity – are entitled to that universal love with which It has bound each microcosm to Itself, entitled to the wave of that universal love, in which Its divine ocean of bliss is perennially flowing. Attraction is the innate characteristic of microcosms. When this attraction is for finite objects, it is called káma [“physical longing”], and when it surges towards the Cosmic Entity, it is called prema [“divine love”]. Of course, káma is nothing but a limited form of prema. When microcosms rush towards Parama Puruśa [Supreme Consciousness] attracted by the irresistible force of divine love, it is termed “devotion”. Since clash drives the microcosms towards subtlety, it follows that clash must be the sustainer of devotion.
ZH_TEXT: 虔誠在摩擦衝擊的過程中扮演著重要的角色。大宇宙心靈所創造之各種物體間，如果缺乏一種可資維繫平衡的因素，那麼整體宇宙的結構將分崩離析。為了維繫整體宇宙的和諧和平衡，各種物體間必須要有一種彼此的吸引力：即個體小宇宙相互間的吸引。祂對其無盡展現之所有有限的個體小宇宙，都給予其深深的宇宙之愛，以此讓個體小宇宙和祂緊緊相繫，並使其徜徉在神性喜悅的海洋中。吸引力為個體小宇宙內在本自具有之特質，如果此種吸引力導向於有限之物的追求，則稱為「物質慾望」(káma);當它湧向至上本體時，就稱為「宇宙之愛」(Prema)。當然，物質慾望也只不過是宇宙之愛的有限形相。當小宇宙個體以此無可抗拒的宇宙之愛奔向至上意識時，即名之為「虔誠」。既然摩擦衝擊驅使個體小宇宙朝向精細，那麼摩擦衝擊必定是虔誠的支柱。

EN_TEXT: That is not to say that one should avoid physical and psychic clashes. On the contrary, one should encourage them, but without losing sight of the Macrocosmic goal.  When one’s mind becomes more subtle and expanded, it is no longer assailed by petty thoughts. The mind-atoms (atoms of ectoplasm) will be powdered down, and in the fire of sádhaná those powdered-down atoms will become ensconced in non-duality. So physical and psychic clash achieve their highest fulfilment in the attraction of the Great. Without this divine attraction, life loses its charm.
ZH_TEXT: 應鼓勵物質或心智層面的摩擦衝擊，但不要忘了至上目標。當一個人的心靈變得精細且擴展時，它不再受瑣碎念頭之干擾，心靈質將被粉碎，在靈性修持的熱力中被融化，將安住在無屬性至上本體之境。在至上的吸引力中，身體層面和心智層面的衝擊獲得了最圓滿的成果。沒有此等神性的吸引力，生命將失去它迷人的魅力。

EN_TEXT: When the goal of one’s ideation is Paramátman [the totality of all unit consciousnesses], one progresses in an absolute sense. As one’s psychic object is subtle and expansive, one’s psychic body also becomes subtle and expansive and finally becomes one with the Macrocosm. It was assumed that during the period of psychic clash in the phase of pratisaiṋcara, microcosms progress due to the resultant Vidyá force (a negative twenty in our example). But as a result of Cosmic ideation, can the speed of the microcosms’ progress exceed that pratisaiṋcara speed? Yes, it can. This is known as the attraction of the Great.
ZH_TEXT: 當一個人理念作用的目標是至上意識時，他即能獲得完全的進步。由於其心智目標是精細且擴展的，他的心智體也會隨之變成精細和擴展，最後與大宇宙合而為一。在宇宙向心運動的過程中經歷心智摩擦的衝擊，則個體小宇宙必可因這二十分的向心力量之助而前進。但個體小宇宙前進的速度會因大宇宙理念之作用而超越宇宙向心運動嗎？的確沒錯，這就是所謂的「至上吸引力」。

EN_TEXT: In the final stage the devotee feels that, “I love Him, not to get any pleasure for myself. I love Him, because I want my love to give Him pleasure.” That is purely unilateral, not reciprocal. Where there is the idea of reciprocity, it is not devotion, it is an ordinary commercial transaction – give some money, get some article. Here the devotee wants to give everything to the Supreme Entity and wants nothing in return. I love you, not for myself. I love you because I want my love to give you pleasure. So, in that last, final stage, the devoteeʼs only wish is to give Him pleasure.
ZH_TEXT: 在最後的階段，虔誠者感覺到「我愛衪，不是為了使自己得到任何快樂。我愛衪，因為我希望我的愛為衪帶來快樂。」這純粹是單方面的，而非互惠的。如果有要求回報的念頭，則不是虔誠，而只是一般的商業交易──使用金錢，以得到某件東西。在此，虔誠者要將一切給予至上本體而不求任何回報。我愛你，不是為了我自己，我愛你，是因為我希望我的愛為你帶來快樂。所以，在最終的階段裡，虔誠者唯一的願望是為衪帶來快樂。

EN_TEXT: The kaeshik propensity is more manifest in women than in men. There is a greater degree of sentimentality in women. Consequently, women can perform extraordinary feats that men cannot. Had these potentialities been harnessed for constructive activities, there would have been many benefits for the world, but as this aspect of womenʼs psychology is not known, society could not utilize their potential fully.
ZH_TEXT: 這種豐富情感極致表達(kaeshik)的習性在女性身上較為明顯。女性的情感非常豐富，所以她們可以做出男性所無法完成的非凡成就。如果能夠善用此習性於建設性的活動上，將對世界產生多重助益。但因為女性這方面的心理潛能尚未為人所知曉，故社會亦未能十足善用她們這方面的潛能。

EN_TEXT: What is then the most precious thing in human life? It is devotion. If one has gotten devotion, one has gotten everything, and nothing remains unrealized. Devotees have to serve the Lord. Now, what is the true service? To serve His creation is the real service. In common practice, we see that the parents are pleased when their sons or daughters are served. Similarly, the simplest and easiest way to please Me is to serve humanity. Forget whatever you were in the past, or whatever you did in the past, and from this auspicious moment on dedicate yourself to the service of humanity.
ZH_TEXT: 人類生命中最寶貴的東西？就是虔誠。倘若一個人得到虔誠，他將得到一切，沒有不能被實現的東西。虔誠者必須服務上主。 何謂真正的服務？真正的服務就是服務祂所創造的萬有。因為當自己的子女被服務時父母都會很快樂。同樣的，取悅於「我」最單純最容易的方式就是為人類服務。忘掉你過去的一切或你過去之所作所為，從現在這神聖的一刻開始，將自己獻身為人類服務！

EN_TEXT: Brahma is beyond the scope of words and mind and yet even that verbally and mentally incomprehensible Brahma is attainable by effort. You have got to touch Him with your innermost heart of hearts, got to hold him with your intuition, got to attain him by merging your soul in the Supreme Soul. His body is not a quinquelemental, finite entity that you can see with your eyes. He is indeed subtler than the subtle, vaster than the vast. To see Him you have got to use the lens of knowledge, moving aside the blinding obstructions or bondage of Avidyá or the forces of microcosmic distraction.
ZH_TEXT: 至上意識超越語言、心智，但如此超越的至上意識卻可經由努力而達到。你必須用最深最深的心來感動祂，你必須用直覺的力量來緊緊把握住祂，必須融入祂以達到祂。祂的「體」不是你可以用肉眼看到由五大原素構成的有限實體。祂比精細還精細、比廣大還廣大。要能得見祂，唯有透過真知，擺脫無明的束縛力量才行。

EN_TEXT: To attain Him, the flow of the microcosmic mind should be directed towards Him alone. Those for whom Puruśa is the only object of constant ideation, the be-all and end-all of life, unfold their cognitive faculty by degrees, thus acquiring the strength to overpower the static bondages and become established in the spiritual stance.
ZH_TEXT: 只有將小宇宙的心靈波流導向祂才能夠得到祂。對「宇宙意識」是他們唯一持念目標、是生命中最要緊之事、且逐步開展其認知能力者而言，他們將獲得克服惰性束縛的力量，而立足於靈性之境。
IT_TEXT: Per raggiungerLo, il flusso della mente microcosmica dovrebbe essere diretto esclusivamente verso di Lui. Coloro per i quali Puruṣa è l’unico oggetto di costante ideazione, l’unico scopo e significato della vita, sviluppano gradualmente la propria facoltà cognitiva; acquisiscono così la forza necessaria per superare i vincoli statici e stabilirsi saldamente nella dimensione spirituale.

EN_TEXT: To turn this academic love into universal love one must colour the molecules and atoms of this dusty earth with oneʼs love. This is not possible for an ordinary follower of the cult of knowledge. Such people can be very pedantic, but unless certain effective ways are adopted to become one with the Supreme Entity, this knowledge will become barren. Sádhakas know that to become one with Him they will have to remain absorbed in constant ideation on Him, and then only will He appear in their hearts in His most attractive form.
ZH_TEXT: 要想把理論上的愛轉化成為真正宇宙之愛，一個人必須用他真正的愛將此灰濛濛的塵世中之每一分子、每一原子都著上漂亮的色彩。此乃一般追求知識法門者所無法做到的，因為他們皆好賣弄學問，但除非你能採取一種與至上本體合一的有效方法，否則這知識是不會帶來任何結果的。靈性修持者深知，若想與祂合一，他們必須不斷持念祂，唯有如此，祂才會以最迷人的形象來到他們的心靈深處。

EN_TEXT: He is spotless, actionless, without distortion, calm and tranquil, unaffected by external stimuli, unblemished. He is the bridge connecting the microcosm to immortality. Through constant ideation on Him, the seeds of oneʼs accumulated saḿskáras become burnt.
ZH_TEXT: 祂純淨無瑕、寂然不動、永恆不變、不受外在刺激的影響、完美無缺。祂是連接小宇宙個體走向永恆的橋樑。透過不斷持念祂，將燒盡累世曠劫的業力種子。

ZH_TEXT: 人類的苦難皆源自其不完美的思想念頭。透過持念、觀想這偉大的本體，一個人才可能自苦難中永遠地解脫出來。
