EN_TEXT: However much people might pursue the cult of knowledge and action, the science of Brahma should be taught only to those who possess parábhakti. This parábhakti should be directed towards both Brahma and the guru. One should remember that there is only one Guru. The actual Guru is not the physical body of a guru but the Entity who works through the physical body. Hence, Paramátmá alone is the Guru. Through parábhakti, one can easily transcend oneʼs “I” feeling and attain the non-attributional stance. Those who possess parábhakti or kevalá bhakti are free from mahima jiṋána [the notion that God is too perfect to be attained by a mere mortal]. Hence, the attainment of emancipation is possible only through parábhakti. Spiritual aspirants with developed parábhakti can proclaim that the universe is all Brahma; Brahma alone is the Supreme desideratum of all microcosms.
ZH_TEXT: 不管人們多麼追求知識和行動法門，至上意識靈性直覺科學仍應只教給具有絕對虔誠的人。這種絕對的虔誠應被同時導向至上意識和古魯。你應記住，古魯只有一個。真正的古魯不是古魯的肉身，而是透過這個肉身運作的至上本體。因此唯有至上本體是古魯。透過絕對的虔誠，一個人可以輕易地超越他的我覺而達到無屬性至上本體的境界。有的人認為完美的上帝非一般凡人所能企及(mahimá jinána)，但具有絕對虔誠的人不再受到此種觀念的束縛。因此唯有透過絕對的虔誠，一個人才有可能得到解脫。具有絕對虔誠的靈性渴望者可以宣稱這個宇宙就是至上意識，唯有至上意識是所有個體小宇宙的最高目標。
IT_TEXT: Per quanto le persone possano dedicarsi al culto della conoscenza e dell’azione, la scienza di Brahma dovrebbe essere insegnata soltanto a coloro che possiedono parábhakti. Questa parábhakti deve essere rivolta sia a Brahma sia al Guru. Si deve ricordare che il Guru è uno solo. Il vero Guru non è il corpo fisico di un maestro, bensì l’Entità che opera attraverso quel corpo fisico. Pertanto, soltanto Paramátmá è il Guru. Mediante parábhakti si può facilmente oltrepassare il sentimento dell’“io” e stabilirsi in uno stato di coscienza in cui non ci si identifica più con attributi, ruoli o qualità limitanti. Coloro che possiedono parábhakti o kevalá bhakti sono liberi da mahima jiñána [l’idea che Dio sia troppo perfetto per poter essere raggiunto da un semplice mortale]. Per questo motivo la liberazione spirituale può essere raggiunta solo mediante parábhakti. Gli aspiranti spirituali che hanno sviluppato parábhakti in modo maturo possono proclamare che l’universo è interamente Brahma; Brahma soltanto è la meta suprema di tutti i microcosmi.

EN_TEXT: Through knowledge, one should ascertain the best path and the proper direction to take, and then advance along it with ceaseless efforts. This path of movement is the path towards the supreme attainment (Paramártha). By knowing and understanding the path as well as the goal of life, and acting accordingly, one will unify oneself with the Supreme Desideratum in the end. Total merger with the Cosmic Desideratum becomes a reality through absolute sincerity.
ZH_TEXT: 一個人透過知識，當確認何者為正確的方向以及最好的道路，並以不懈的努力沿此道前行。此行進的道路乃朝向至上成就(Paramaŕtha)的道路。知曉並熟悉這條道路以及生命的目標，且依此前行，最後將與至上目標合而為一，與至上目標完全融合因透過絕對的真誠而實現。
IT_TEXT: Attraverso la conoscenza si deve riconoscere il sentiero giusto e avanzare nella direzione corretta con sforzo costante. Questo movimento conduce alla realizzazione suprema (Paramārtha). Quando il cammino e lo scopo della vita sono chiari e l’azione è coerente con essi, l’essere umano si unisce al Supremo Desiderato. La fusione con il Desiderato Cosmico diventa allora una realtà, resa possibile da una sincerità assoluta.

EN_TEXT: Those who dismiss the world as illusory, do injustice to their individual prowess, and become very cynical. This negative approach leads the human society astray, partially or fully. Seeing how deeply you love your children a Máyávádin [a proponent of the doctrine of illusion] will say, “Be careful, you are about to fall in the snare of attachment. Remember this relative world is just an illusory prison.” To such a negative statement, a genuine Ananda Margi will say with robust optimism: “Of course I will love my children with all my heart, and through sádhaná, expand this love to its greatest or unlimited extent. Let this love which was confined to one child be extended to all children. By taking the hearts of all parents within oneʼs own heart one realizes that every child is worthy of this love.” This sort of awareness is possible only through real knowledge – the knowledge of truth.
ZH_TEXT: 那些認為世界是幻象而棄世絕塵的人變得非常悲觀，他們並未善用他們英勇的才能。此種負性的追求讓人類社會完全或部分偏離了正道。看見你如此深愛著你的小孩時，認為世界是幻象的擁護者(máyávádin)會說：「小心哪！你即將落入執著的陷阱裡啊！你要記得這個相對的世界僅僅只是一個幻象的監獄啊！」面對這樣負性的言論，一個真正堅強的阿南達瑪琪將以健康樂觀的態度對他說：「我當然會全心愛我的小孩，同時我也會透過我的靈性修持將此愛擴展至最大、無限之境。幼吾幼以及人之幼，感受天下父母心的人，將明白天底下所有的小孩都該擁有這樣的愛。」此等覺醒唯有透過真正的知識才能達到。

EN_TEXT: Through theoretical knowledge one can only understand what one should or should not do in sádhaná, and nothing more. To turn this academic love into universal love one must colour the molecules and atoms of this dusty earth with oneʼs love.
ZH_TEXT: 理論上的知識只能讓你瞭解在靈性修持上何者是該做的，而何者是不該做的，僅僅如此而已。要想把理論上的愛轉化成為真正宇宙之愛，一個人必須用他真正的愛將此灰濛濛的塵世中之每一分子、每一原子都著上漂亮的色彩。

EN_TEXT: Who is the propounder of intuitional science? Is he a particular muni [sage] or rśi? No, Brahma is the Propounder who expresses His ideas through the vocal cords of different sages. No individual human being deserves the credit for human excellence. It is due to His grace alone that the intuitional science was revealed.
ZH_TEXT: 是誰創立了靈性直覺科學？是某一聖者？抑或是一個聰明的知識分子呢？都不是，而是至上意識才是靈性直覺科學的創立者。至上意識透過不同的聖人表達出祂的理念。人類的優越不能歸功於任何個人，唯有祂的恩典，才有靈性直覺科學的出現。
IT_TEXT: Chi è l’autore della scienza intuitiva? È forse un particolare muni [saggio] o ṛṣi? No, è Brahma l’Autore: Egli esprime le Sue idee attraverso le corde vocali di diversi saggi. Nessun essere umano individuale merita il merito dell’eccellenza umana. È soltanto per la Sua grazia che la scienza intuitiva è stata rivelata.

EN_TEXT: There are two broad categories of love or devotion: Prema and parábhakti. Prema (love for the Supreme) occurs when there is a strong attraction for the Supreme Entity (as opposed to káma, which is love for relative objects). Even though the “I” feeling greatly expands as one strives to seek shelter in Parama Puruśa, the existential “I” feeling does not altogether disappear. So through prema one can attain mukti [liberation]. But to attain mokśa [salvation], parábhakti, exclusive devotion to Parama Puruśa, is required.
ZH_TEXT: 愛或虔誠有兩大類：一種是神性之愛(prema)，一種是絕對的虔誠(parábhakti)。對至上本體有強烈的吸引時就產生神性之愛，和世俗的情愛(Káma)相反，世俗的情愛是對相對事物的渴望。儘管一個人努力尋求至上意識的庇護，他的我覺將極度擴展，但這存在的我覺仍未完全消失，所以透過神性之愛，他能得到自在解脫(mukti);然而若想得到究竟解脫，則絕對的虔誠，意即對至上意識完全的虔誠是必須的。
IT_TEXT: Esistono due grandi categorie di amore o devozione: prema e parábhakti. Prema (amore per il Supremo) si manifesta quando vi è una forte attrazione verso l’Entità Suprema (a differenza di káma, che è amore per gli oggetti relativi). Anche se il senso dell’“io” si espande enormemente mentre si cerca rifugio in Parama Puruśa, il senso esistenziale dell’“io” non scompare del tutto. Così, attraverso prema si può conseguire la mukti [liberazione]. Ma per raggiungere mokśa [salvezza], è necessaria parábhakti, la devozione esclusiva verso Parama Puruśa.

EN_TEXT: One attains the stage of devatá, then what one thinks, one says; and what one says, one does. There is no difference amongst thinking, saying, and doing. And that is the best stage of human structure or human existence.
ZH_TEXT: 一個人達到神的階段時，他所說的就是他所想的；他所做的就是他所說的。其思想、言語與行動之間並無差別。此為人類結構或人類生存的最佳階段。

EN_TEXT: In devotion there is no scope for being puffed up with vanity. Because in devotion finally you want to surrender yourself. You want, finally you want – “O Lord, I love You just to give you pleasure. And, O Lord, I donʼt want You, You just take me as Yours.”
ZH_TEXT: 在虔誠之中不會產生虛榮的自大感，因為有了虔誠最後你必然想要將自身臣服，你最終所希望的一定是：「哦，主啊！我愛您只為了使您快樂。主啊，我不是要得到您，請您讓我屬於您。」

ZH_TEXT: 一輪滿月高掛，幾朵白雲遮去部分月亮，一顆彗星劃過天空。 一隻白色的仙鶴飛過天際。 一名穿著輕薄橘色洋裝的長髮女子在月光下的蓮花池畔散步。

EN_TEXT: Now, everything that is known to the Macro-psychic Entity is within Its infinite structure, within Its infinite framework. Everything is within, nothing without. Everything is His internal mental projection, intra-psychic projection. That is why He knows everything and will always know everything. And for individuals, for micropsychic entities or microcosms, almost everything is external. There lies the imperfection. And what is the spiritual practice of a spiritual aspirant? His is a movement, a never-ending movement, from imperfection towards perfection, from electronic imperfection towards nuclear perfection.
ZH_TEXT: 大宇宙心智本體所知道的一切都在祂無限的結構裡，都在祂無限的架構裡。一切是內在的，沒有任何事物是外在的。一切都是祂內在精神的投射、內在心理的投射。這就是為何祂知道一切而且將永遠知道一切。而對於個人來說，對於小宇宙心智個體或小宇宙個體而言，幾乎一切都是外在的，這裡存在著不完美。那麼一個靈性渴望者的靈性修持是什麼？他的靈性修持是一種前進，一種永無休止的前進，從不完美走向完美的核心。

EN_TEXT: What is their goal? They have to go back to Parama Puruśa, from where they came. So He is the starting point, He is the dwelling point, and He is the culminating point of all creatures. So there lies an eternal tie of fraternity among human beings, among the living world. You are all spiritual aspirants. You are all devotees. You are all going to be one with the Creator. You should remember this inherent tie of humanistic fraternity. Try to help others with all your might, try to help others as much as you can, because it is the desire of Providence that humanity should march onward with maximum cooperation, with maximum cooperative cooperation. And, if you move along the path of righteousness with the spirit of Universal Fraternity, victory is yours. The blessing of Parama Puruśa will always be with you.
ZH_TEXT: 什麼是他們的目標？他們必須回到他們所從來之處──至上意識那裡。所以，祂是起點，是源頭，也是萬有一切極致之終點。因此，人類和其他生物間存在著與生俱有的兄弟情誼。你們全都是靈性的渴望者，你們都是虔誠者，你們都將與至上創造者合而為一。你們應該牢牢記住這種與生俱來的內在聯繫，盡你們所能去幫助他人吧！因為互相提攜共同前進乃上主之心願。如果大家都能以宇宙之愛的情誼在正確的道上前行，那麼勝利必定屬於你們。至上意識的祝福也必定永遠與各位同在。

EN_TEXT: Now, there is a common wont in each and every human mind, and that wont differentiates a man, a human being, from animals, people from plants. What is that difference? That spiritual wont is called human dharma. What is it? It wants to expand; and second, they want to become one with the Cosmic. Third thing, it wants to do something noble, and the fourth thing was peace, supreme peace, undisturbed peace. These are the four special qualifications of human beings. Collectively, you may say, it is the human mode.
ZH_TEXT: 人類的心靈都有共通的渴望，這種渴望使得人與動物、植物有所區分。那是什麼呢？那種靈性的渴望就是「人類的法性」。何謂「法性」?人類想要擴展，而且想要與大宇宙本體合而為一，同時他們也想要做一些崇高的事以及獲得平靜——無限的祥和寧靜。以上四項是人類特有的特質，總而言之，這些就是人之所以為人的特性。

EN_TEXT: In quest of this Infinite, man first came in contact with the aesthetic science. Aesthetic science does not always mean to get something pleasant or to come in contact with something [pleasant]; it may be something troublesome, something embarrassing – it may or may not always be pleasant. Aesthetic science is that which one can express in a subtler way, from subtle to subtler, and when it reaches the subtlest point, that point is the pinnacle of human glory. Now, it is the duty of artists to express in a nice way, a lucid way, and place the same before the world. Anybody and everybody cannot do it. But enjoying this aesthetic bliss or aesthetic charm is within the capacity of each and every human being.
ZH_TEXT: 在尋求無限時，人們首先接觸到美學。美學並非總是意味著獲得快樂的東西，它也可能意味著得到惱人的或令人難堪的東西，所以美學不一定是快樂的，而是一種能以較精細方式表達的科學。從精細到更精細，在達到最精細的這一點時，就是人類光輝的極致。現在，藝術家的責任就是以優美而清晰的方式來表達他們的作品，將其展現在世人面前。這不是每個人都做得到的，但以美的品味或美的眼光來欣賞東西，則是在每個人的能力範圍之內。

EN_TEXT: When one unit thinks that “I am a drop of water”, it is a drop of water. And when it thinks that “I am not a drop of water, I am the ocean”, it is the ocean. Similarly, when the unit ensconces itself in the Supreme Excellence it becomes Supreme, it becomes one with the Lord. And when it becomes one with the Lord no obstacle can defeat him.
ZH_TEXT: 當一個人認為「我是個小水滴」時，他就只是一個小水滴；但要是他認為「我不是一個小水滴，而是大海洋」時，他就會是海洋。同樣的，當個體將自身安住在至上之境，他就成了至上意識，與上主合而為一。當他與上主合而為一時，再無阻礙可以擊敗他。

EN_TEXT: And the fourth one is the spiritual stage, the stage of spirituality. What is the stage of spirituality? Each and every entity, in physical world, psychic world, and in the world of Dharma, is a metamorphosed form of the Supreme Consciousness. And when everything is a metamorphosed form of the Supreme Entity then one will feel, one is to feel, that everything of this universe is spiritual, nothing is physical or psychic. Everything there is, is the dance of the Cosmic Cognition. And when one realizes this Supreme Truth, this all-pervading standard of veracity, one gets complete composure, one enjoys the supreme bliss. This is the only way to attain salvation. This is the only way to attain liberation of a permanent nature. There is no other alternative. So you should remember, your life should start from the point of devotion, culminate in the point of devotion. Devotion is the order, [[devotion is the principle,]] and devotion is the policy for each and every spiritual aspirant and it is the principle for all intellectual and spiritual-minded people.
ZH_TEXT: 第四階段是純粹靈性的階段。這是什麼樣的階段呢？物質世界、心理世界和法性世界的萬事萬物、每個實體都是至上意識變化的形象，當萬有事物都是至上本體變化而來的形象時，我們當然就會感覺到宇宙間的一切全部都是靈性的，不是物質的，也不是心理的。宇宙萬有都是至上認知力之舞動。 當吾人了悟到此一至上真理時，他就會得到完全的平靜，他會享受到至上的喜悅。這是獲得解脫的唯一途徑。這是得到究竟之境的唯一道路，別無他途可循。故你要牢記，你的生命應始於虔誠並終於虔誠。虔誠即是一切，它是每個靈性修行者、智者和靈性追求者必須遵守之法則。

ZH_TEXT: 當人開始朝向至上本體前進，開始尋求至上喜悅時，首先會接觸到靈性。由於靈性就是與無限接觸，也就是說，有限與無限的接觸，此即稱為「瑜伽」(yoga)。

EN_TEXT: In devotion there is no scope for being puffed up with vanity. Because in devotion finally you want to surrender yourself. You want, finally you want – “O Lord, I love You just to give you pleasure. And, O Lord, I donʼt want You, You just take me as Yours.” One must follow the path of the yogi, and one must accept that Universal Entity as oneʼs supreme goal. There is no alternative. As the universal “I” is the Supreme Creator, Supreme Generator, everything in this universe is His progeny, and He is the progenitor. He is the Supreme Father. You have a family relation with that Supreme Entity, and not a relationship of external formality. He is yours, and you should also remember that nothing is external for Him. Everything is within, nothing is without. So you have been created by Him and you are in Him, and, because He is your supreme goal, finally you will be with Him, you will be one with Him. For this you require no special education, no knowledge of philosophy, and no other external attributions. Supreme love for the Supreme Universal Entity will make you one with Him.
ZH_TEXT: 在虔誠之中不會產生虛榮的自大感，因為有了虔誠，最後你必然想要將自身臣服，你最終所希望的一定是：「哦，主啊！我愛您只為了使您快樂。主啊，我不是要得到您，請您讓我屬於您。」人唯有遵循瑜伽行者的道路，接受至上本體為其生命之至上目標，此外別無他途可循。此宇宙之大我乃至上的創造者、至上的生產者，宇宙間的萬有事物都是祂的子孫；祂是始祖，是至上之父。你與至上本體並非任何外在形式的關係，而是有著家庭親情般的聯繫，祂是你的。你也應該牢記在心：沒有任何事物存在祂之外，所有一切都在祂的內在。所以你既然是祂的創造，你也是在祂的內在，因為祂是你的目標，所以你最終會融入於祂，與祂合而為一。為此，你不需要受過特別的教育，也不需要有什麼哲學知識，任何外在的條件都不必要，只要你心中有對至上本體的愛，必然可以與祂合而為一。
IT_TEXT: Nella devozione non c’è spazio per gonfiarsi di vanità. Perché nella devozione, alla fine, ciò che si desidera è abbandonarsi completamente. Si arriva a dire: «O Signore, Ti amo solo per darti gioia. E, o Signore, non voglio Te: prendi me come Tuo». Si deve seguire il cammino dello yogi e si deve accettare quell’Entità Universale come proprio scopo supremo. Non c’è alternativa. Poiché l’“Io” universale è il Creatore Supremo, il Generatore Supremo, tutto in questo universo è la Sua progenie ed Egli ne è il Progenitore. Egli è il Padre Supremo. Tu hai una relazione familiare con quell’Entità Suprema, non un rapporto di formalità esteriore. Egli è tuo, e dovresti anche ricordare che nulla è esterno per Lui. Tutto è interno, nulla è esterno. Così tu sei stato creato da Lui e sei in Lui e, poiché Egli è il tuo scopo supremo, alla fine sarai con Lui, sarai uno con Lui. Per questo non è necessaria alcuna educazione speciale, né conoscenza filosofica, né altri attributi esterni. L’amore supremo per l’Entità Suprema Universale ti renderà uno con Lui.

EN_TEXT: Humans come to this earth for a very short span. And within this short span they are to do so many duties. When the span is short, not a moment should be wasted. And it is desirable that they know their goal and the path from the very beginning of their life. One must not wait for old age. That is, one should know the correct path, one should know the correct destination or desideratum, from an early stage of oneʼs life. But what is the goal, and what is the path? – that is the question. So many books, so many scriptures, say so many things: “Do this.” “Do that.” So what should one do? A common person fails to understand what to do and what not to do. There are so many social codes – what to do and what not do. There are so many dos and so many donʼts. Spiritual aspirants fail to know what to do. The great men who reached the goal say, “Donʼt be misguided by so many books and so many theories and so many dogmas. Be guided by the established yogis.” Who is a yogi? And what is yoga? There are so many definitions by so many scholars. But the accepted principle regarding yoga is Saḿyoga yoga ityukto jiivátma Paramátmanah.
ZH_TEXT: 何謂人生之目標？人類生而為人，在世間的停留不過短短一瞬；然而在這極短的時光裡，卻肩負著無數的責任與使命。既然時間如此短暫，片刻也不應浪費。因此，人生最理想的，是能在一開始──在生命尚年輕之時──就明白自己的方向與道路。不必等到白髮蒼蒼，才開始尋找真理。人應在早年便知：何為正確之路？何為最終之目的？然而──目標是什麼？道路又是什麼？這正是人生的疑問。 世間經典繁多，教義紛紜──「應該這樣做」、「不該那樣做」，各執一詞。普通人因此困惑：究竟何者為是？何者為非？社會亦立下種種規範，滿是「該做」與「不該做」。而修行者，在這眾聲紛擾之中，往往迷失方向。然那些已達終極目標的聖者告訴我們：「莫為書本與理論所惑，莫被教條與辯說所迷。應讓自己的心，跟隨真正已達合一境界的瑜伽士之路。」 何謂瑜伽？何謂瑜伽士？歷代學者給出無數定義，然真正的原理在於：Saḿyoga yoga ityukto jiivátmá Paramátmanah.──「瑜伽，乃個體意識(Jiivátman)與宇宙意識(Paramátman)之合一。」

EN_TEXT: The Supreme Entity, Parama Puruśa, is omniscient. He not only sees what you do, He also sees what you think, what you are contemplating, what the thought-waves of your mind are. Then He is omniscient, and you are His object. He sees what you do. He is the subject, you are the object. Then how can the mind know Him? … What is the secret? It is that whatever you are doing, whatever you are thinking, you should always remember that that action of yours, those thoughts of yours, are being witnessed by Him. If you remember this, He remains the subject and you remain the object.
ZH_TEXT: 至上本體是全知的，祂不僅觀照你所做的一切，祂也觀照你的每一個念頭，你所想的一切，你心靈的思想波流是什麼。祂是全知的，所以你是祂的客體，祂看著你的所做所為，祂是你的主體，你是祂的客體。那麼我們的心靈如何能知道祂呢？……其秘訣為何？就是不管你做什麼、想什麼，你都應該永遠記得你所有的行動、所有的思維，都在祂的觀照下，都為祂所見證。如果你能記得這項事實，祂就永遠是主體而你是祂的客體。

EN_TEXT: If there is a man and a kingdom is attached to him – kingdom is something attributional – we will say that that man X is a king because that attribution of kingdom has been attached to him. He is a king. We will call another man who has got big clubs in his hand, a wrestler. He will be known as a wrestler because of the attribution of those clubs. But, if we take away that attribution of the kingdom from Mr. X and that attribution of clubs from Mr. Y, X will become Y. Similarly, if Para becomes something non-attributional, and jiiva also becomes non-attributional, they will become Parama Shiva, both will become Parama Shiva. What is spiritual practice? To wipe out these attributional bondages is sádhaná. This is spiritual practice.
ZH_TEXT: 若有一個王國屬於一個人──王國是某種具有屬性的東西──我們將說某甲是個國王，因為一個王國的權能已經歸屬於他。他是一位國王。我們稱呼一個手握棍棒者為格鬥者。但是如果從某甲取走王國的權能，從某乙取走棒棍，則某甲將變成某乙。同樣地，倘若至上意識變成某種沒有屬性的東西，而且個體的生命也變成無屬性者，那麼它們將變成至上的意識，兩者都將變成至上意識。何謂靈性的修持？靈性的修持為消除這些屬性的束縛。這就是靈性的修持。

EN_TEXT: Particular expression of vidyá shakti is called saḿvit shakti. Conscience, when it is roused all of a sudden, is called saḿvit. “I should do something, I should do something.” As soon as it comes in contact with saḿvit shakti, in the next moment you feel, “I should do something practical. Theory wonʼt help me; I should do something concrete, I should do something practical.” And when this desire to do something practical is created in the mind, this created force is called hládinii shakti or Rádhiká shakti. With the help of this Rádhiká shakti one can move towards that Cosmological Nave.
ZH_TEXT: 宇宙向心力量的這種表達稱為「覺醒的力量」(aḿvit shakti)。當良知突然被喚醒稱為「靈性的覺醒」(saḿvit)。心靈一旦與此力量接觸時，它就會覺得「我應該有實際的作為，光是理論幫不了我的，我應從事一些實際的行為。」當心靈產生這種念頭時，它所產生的力量就是一種「提升的力量」(hládinii shakti，或稱為rádhiká shakti)。在提升力量的幫助下，吾人始得以朝向宇宙核心前進。
CITATION_EN: Shrii Shrii Ánandamúrti | November 1966, Ernakulam | 03 Rádhiká Shakti | Ánanda Vacanámrtam Part 23
CITATION_ZH: Shrii Shrii Ánandamúrti | 1966年11月於Ernakulam | 10 提升的力量 | 喜悅甘露集 卷7，P.72

EN_TEXT: There is spiritual potentiality in all people. Some people have harnessed it, and these people are able to help other people to arouse it. Some people will arouse it if they are in the company of those who have already awakened it; this is the importance of satsauṋga [good company]. Your duty is to awaken yourself and help others to awaken.
ZH_TEXT: 所有的人內在本自俱足靈性的潛能；有些人已然善加利用此潛能，所以他們能夠幫助他人喚醒他們的潛能；有些人則因與善為伍而獲得提升，進而喚醒這種潛能，這就是善知識的重要。你的責任就是要喚醒自己的潛能，並幫助別人也喚醒他們的潛能。
CITATION_EN: Shrii Shrii Ánandamúrti | October 1969, Ranchi | 14 No One Is Negligible  | Ánanda Vacanámrtam Part 31
CITATION_ZH: Shrii Shrii Ánandamúrti | 1968年10月於Ranchi | 14 沒有人是微不足道的 | 喜悅甘露集卷9，P.101

EN_TEXT: The nature of a human is to think of the so-called sweet memories of the past. People think more of the past and less of the future. But the sádhaka [spiritual aspirant] thinks of the Lord who is the [Terminus]. When he or she starts thinking of the Terminus of life, the very goal of life, the past with all its glory becomes pale. The ordinary person is one who thinks of the past and also of the future. The medium person is one who thinks only of the future. But the siddha [perfect] person is one who thinks neither of the past nor of the future. He or she thinks only of the Lord.
ZH_TEXT: 沈湎於過去甜蜜的回憶是人類的特性。人們總是眷戀過去較多，而較少放眼未來。但是對一個靈性修持者而言，他念念不忘的應該是上主，這是他生命的目標。當一個人開始一心想念其生命目標時，無論多輝煌的過去都會變得暗淡無光。 想著過去也想著未來的人是最普通的一般人，中等的人則只放眼未來；而一個完美的人(siddha)既不眷戀過去亦不放眼未來，他想的只有上主。
CITATION_EN: Shrii Shrii Ánandamúrti | October 1969, Ranchi | 14 No One Is Negligible | Ánanda Vacanámrtam Part 31
CITATION_ZH: Shrii Shrii Ánandamúrti | 1968年10月於Ranchi | 14 沒有人是微不足道的 | 喜悅甘露集 卷9，P.102

EN_TEXT: The ordinary person is one who thinks of the past and also of the future. The medium person is one who thinks only of the future. But the siddha (perfect) person is one who thinks neither of the past nor of the future. He or she thinks only of the Lord.
ZH_TEXT: 想著過去也想著未來的人是最普通的一般人，中等的人則只放眼未來；而一個完美的人(siddha)既不眷戀過去亦不放眼未來，他想的只有上主。

EN_TEXT: No one is negligible, no one is unimportant. The Lord can do anything and everything through these machines. Be a perfect machine.
ZH_TEXT: 沒有人是可忽略的，沒有人是不重要的，上主可以經由這些機器來做任一件事。成為完美的機器吧！
CITATION_EN: Shrii Shrii Ánandamúrti | October 1969, Ranchi | No One Is Negligible, Ánanda Vacanámrtam Part 31
CITATION_ZH: Shrii Shrii Ánandamúrti | 1969年10月於Ranchi | No One Is Negligible, Ánanda Vacanámrtam Part 31 | 2024年6月20日12:37 Gopal黃國豐譯

EN_TEXT: Human existence is a completely mental structure which is according to the psychic momenta due to saḿskáras [mental reactive momenta]. In this world everything is cinmaya [composed of consciousness], nothing is mrnmaya [composed of matter (literally, “earth”)]. According to the way the Lord controls oneʼs mind, so the person gets his or her physical body. Whatever you have got is good for you. Parama Puruśa is never to be guided by your reason, by your logic, and your justifications. You are to be guided by His whims.
ZH_TEXT: 人類的存在是純然的心智結構，此一心智結構乃依個人因果業力所產生的心靈動力而來。這世上的所有一切都由意識所組成(cinmaya)，沒有任何東西是純粹的物質(mrnmaya)。上主依此方式控制了人的心靈，而人因此而得到他的肉身。任何你所擁有的都是對你有益的。至上意識從來不被你的推理、邏輯或判斷所操控，而是你受祂的思想所引導。
CITATION_EN: Shrii Shrii Ánandamúrti | October 1969, Ranchi | 14 No One Is Negligible | Ánanda Vacanámrtam Part 31
CITATION_ZH: Shrii Shrii Ánandamúrti | 1968年10月於Ranchi | 14 沒有人是微不足道的 | 喜悅甘露集 卷9，P.104

EN_TEXT: The ideal course of life is neither left-oriented nor right-oriented. This kind of life will be conspicuous by the absence of strife, mayhem or horror of the leftists and of toleration of injustices by the rightists in their loose, careless and sloppy life. It is this ideal course that will usher in a life worth yearning for a super-human existence, divinely exquisite and shining brightly on the banner of gold. Álgá tare bol ut́he ná t́ánle cheŕe komal t́ár. [In a loose string, the melody remains mute If pulled, the delicate string is torn apart.] This is what has been referred to by Buddha as the middle path or majjhimá mágga.
ZH_TEXT: 理想的生命型態既不偏左亦不偏右。沒有左派分子的恐怖暴行，沒有右派分子因散漫、慵懶的生活態度而隱忍不公。如此方才是開創了一個渴望超越人類存在價值的新生命，神聖、精細並閃耀著金色旗幟的燦爛光芒。 Álgá tare bol ut́he ná t́ánle cheŕe komal t́ár. 「弦太鬆彈不成調，太緊則易斷。」 這就是佛陀所謂的「中道」(majjhimá mágga)。
CITATION_EN: Shrii Shrii Ánandamúrti | 5 October 1986, Kolkata | 33 Invention of Various Musical Instruments | Saḿgiita: Song, Dance and Instrumental Music
CITATION_ZH: Shrii Shrii Ánandamúrti | 1986年10月5日於加爾各答 | 4-4 各種樂器的發明 | 音樂與靈性修持，P.196~197

EN_TEXT: We must always remember this thing: When a group of good people – that group may be of a thousand, that group may be of a million, that group may also be of many billions – but when that group comes, it comes to do something concrete. And that group is known as Hariparimańd́ala gośt́hi, because that group moves around [makes a circle round] the Cosmic ideology. So you have come here to form a strong, well-knit Hariparimańd́ala for the coming generation.
ZH_TEXT: 我們一定要記住一件事：當一群人，或許是數千人，或許是數百萬人或數十億人聚集在一起，他們來到同一處為的是具體做一些有建設性的事，這樣圍繞著上主而行動的一群人稱為「哈里帕里曼陀羅」(Hariparimańd́ala gośt́hi)，因為這群人圍繞著宇宙的理念而旋轉運行。因此，你們是為了開啟後來世代的福祉，而來到這個世界以形成堅強的「哈里帕里曼陀羅」。
CITATION_EN: 6 October 1979, Kolkata | Devotees Moving around the Cosmic Nucleus, Ánanda Vacanámrtam Part 15
CITATION_ZH: 1979年10月6日於加爾各答 | 圍繞著宇宙核心前進的虔誠者，喜悅甘露集卷9，P.71

EN_TEXT: In this manifested Universe, where there are multitudes of finite objects can we start a life based on Brahma? The answer is that you adopt Madhuvidyá. Instead of seeing the finite and superficial objects as finite look upon them as the finite expressions of the Infinite or the permanent. Then the attraction for Preya and love for Shreya shall all fuse into one.
ZH_TEXT: 在此具有眾多有限事物的大千世界裡，我們是否可以開始一個以至上意識為基礎的生命？答案是你可以採取宇宙的科學(Madhuvidyá)的方式，不要視有限或表面的東西為有限的，反之要視他們為無限之有限的展現，如此對有限事物的執著和對最終目標的熱愛都將合而為一。
CITATION_EN: Áshvinii Púrńimá 1955 DMC, Calcutta | The Base of Life, Subháśita Saḿgraha Part 1
CITATION_ZH: 1955年10月7日Áshvinii滿月日於加爾各答大法會 | 生命的根基，靈性科學集成卷1，P.108

EN_TEXT: O Human beings, in that state, no finite object can colour your mind. You will be beyond all colours or Varńátiita. Then you will be able to give proper treatment to any finite being that you may come in contact with. Give proper treatment to the expression of Brahma in the shape of your father by serving him and paying attention to his comforts. Give proper treatment to the expression of Brahma in the shape of the earth by cultivating it and increasing its fertility. If you give such proper treatment to the different objects, they will not be able to degrade your mind. This is called true Vaerágya.
ZH_TEXT: 哦！人啊！在那個境界裡，沒有有限的事物會為你的心靈著上顏色，你會超越一切的顏色。如此你就能適當地對待任何你所接觸的有限物體，適當的去對待以你父親形象顯現的至上意識，為他服務，並關心他的舒適。適當地對待以土地顯現的至上意識，藉著耕地使它更為肥沃。如果你以此種適當的方式對待不同的事物，則你的心靈就不會退化或墮落。這才是真正的不執著。
IT_TEXT: O esseri umani, quando raggiungete questo stato nessun oggetto finito può più colorare la vostra mente. Diventate allora varńátiita, al di là di ogni colore, di ogni condizionamento. In quel momento sarete in grado di rapportarvi correttamente a ogni essere finito con cui entrerete in contatto. Trattate nel modo giusto l'espressione di Brahma che si manifesta nella forma di vostro padre, servendolo e prendendovi cura del suo benessere. Trattate nel modo giusto l'espressione di Brahma che si manifesta nella forma della terra, coltivandola e accrescendone la fertilità. Se saprete rapportarvi così alle diverse manifestazioni della vita, esse non avranno più il potere di degradare o limitare la vostra mente. Questo è il vero vaerágya.
CITATION_EN: Shrii Shrii Ánandamúrti | Áshvinii Púrńimá 1955 DMC, Calcutta | 09 The Base of Life | Subháśita Saḿgraha Part 1
CITATION_ZH: Shrii Shrii Ánandamúrti | 1955年10月7日Áshvinii滿月日於Calcutta大法會 | 08 生命的根基 | 靈性科學集成 卷1，P.109

EN_TEXT: The practice whereby we develop detachment from finite objects, i.e. the discipline whereby the mind is not influenced by the attractions of worldly objects is Vaerágya Sádhaná. The true Cosmic Entity is only revealed to people with this Vaerágya. This Cosmic Entity alone is the basic shelter of the human beings. It is a strong foundation which shall not, at any time forsake them leaving him forlorn.
ZH_TEXT: 藉以發展對有限事物不執著的鍛鍊，也就是使心靈不受世俗事物吸引影響的鍛鍊，即是不執著的靈性修持。只有不執著之人方能見到宇宙意識的實相，宇宙意識是人類根本的庇護所，它是一個堅強的基礎，無論何時皆不可拋棄它。
CITATION_EN: Áshvinii Púrńimá 1955 DMC, Calcutta | The Base of Life, Subháśita Saḿgraha Part 1
CITATION_ZH: 1955年10月7日Áshvinii滿月日於加爾各答大法會 | 生命的根基，靈性科學集成卷一，P.110

EN_TEXT: Within so many subtle and still subtler structures, the Creator of the universe expresses Himself in so many forms. By knowing Him, knowing that Shiva, who is beyond the universe also, human beings can attain absolute peace. Within this vast universe, the Creator, the One without beginning or end, expresses Himself in so many forms. By knowing that Deva, who is beyond the universe also, human beings become free from all fetters.
ZH_TEXT: 宇宙的造物主存在於許多精細又精細的結構裡，祂以許多形象來展現自身。藉著了悟祂，了悟這個超越宇宙的宇宙意識，人類能夠獲得絕對的寧靜。 宇宙的造物主存在於此浩瀚的宇宙裡，祂無始無終，以許多形象來展現自身，藉由了悟此一超越宇宙的大神，人類可從所有束縛之中獲得解脫。
CITATION_EN: Shrii Shrii Ánandamúrti | 7 October 1979, Kolkata | 10 The Omnipotent and Omnipresent Consciousness | Ánanda Vacanámrtam Part 31
CITATION_ZH: Shrii Shrii Ánandamúrti | 1979年10月7日於加爾各答 | 10 全知全能、無所不在的至上意識 | 喜悅甘露集 卷9，P.73

EN_TEXT: One can attain peace by knowing Him alone. But how to restore peace? By fighting all the forces which are a detriment to peace.
ZH_TEXT: 人只能藉由了悟祂而得到最終的平靜。人如何方可恢復平靜的狀態呢？藉由與各種阻礙平靜的力量抗爭到底。
CITATION_EN: Shrii Shrii Ánandamúrti | 7 October 1979, Kolkata | 10 The Omnipotent and Omnipresent Consciousness | Ánanda Vacanámrtam Part 31
CITATION_ZH: Shrii Shrii Ánandamúrti | 1979年10月7日於加爾各答 | 10 全知全能、無所不在的至上意識 | 喜悅甘露集 卷9，P.80

EN_TEXT: Before doing anything you should think carefully, because the action is in your hand, but not the result – that is in the hand of Prakrti [Cosmic Operative Principle]. Náráyańa neither performs the action nor administers the results. He simply gives Prakrti the opportunity to work within Her own limited sphere; Prakrti does Her duty accordingly. She does not aim to satisfy either your mind or the mind of anyone else. She only aims to please the mind of Náráyańa. Whatever work Náráyańa has given Her the right to do, that is what She does. She has no right to do more than that.
ZH_TEXT: 三思而後行，因為行為操之於你，但行為的果報，你無能為力。行為的果報操之於宇宙造化勢能之手，上主既沒有從事行為，亦不負責其結果。祂只是全權交給宇宙運作的法則，讓她在有限的範圍中盡她的職責，她也善盡職責。她不必取悅任何人的心靈，只要讓上主高興即可。上主賦予她權利去做的事，她盡心盡力一一完成，她也只能做到這樣，除此之外，她也沒有其他權利。
IT_TEXT: Prima di compiere qualsiasi azione, dovreste riflettere con grande attenzione, perché l’azione è nelle vostre mani, ma non il risultato: quello è nelle mani di Prakrti [il Principio Operativo Cosmico]. Náráyana non compie l’azione né amministra i risultati. Egli si limita a concedere a Prakrti l’opportunità di operare entro il proprio ambito limitato, e Prakrti svolge di conseguenza il Suo dovere. Prakrti non mira a soddisfare la vostra mente né la mente di nessun altro. Mira unicamente a compiacere la mente di Náráyana. Qualunque lavoro Náráyana Le abbia conferito il diritto di svolgere, è quello che Ella svolge. Non ha il diritto di fare più di questo.
CITATION_EN: Shrii Shrii Ánandamúrti | 9 October 1979 evening, Kolkata | 04 “You Have the Right to Action Only” | Ananda Marga Karma Yoga in a Nutshell
CITATION_ZH: Shrii Shrii Ánandamúrti | 1979年10月9日傍晚於加爾各答 | 04 你只有行動的權利 | 行動瑜伽的智慧，P.66~67

EN_TEXT: The demarcation between right and wrong, sin and piety, dos and donʼts, exists only for those who are not true devotees. True devotees can think only of Parama Puruśa – their every action is to please Parama Puruśa.
ZH_TEXT: 對與錯、罪與虔敬、做與莫做等，只有對非虔誠者而言才有分別。真正的虔誠者心中只有至上意識──他們的每一個行動都是為了取悅至上意識。
CITATION_EN: 10 October 1971 evening, Patna | The True Devotee, Ánanda Vacanámrtam Part 30
CITATION_ZH: 1971年10月10日傍晚於Patna | 真正的虔誠者，喜悅甘露集卷8，P.171

EN_TEXT: When a spiritual aspirant contacts Parama Puruśa and asks Him, “O Lord, who am I, who am I?” – when this eternal question is placed before Him, His reply is, Tattvamasi, “Thou art That,” that is, “Thou art the Supreme Entity.”
ZH_TEXT: 當一個靈性的渴望者接觸到至上意識而開始質疑「我是誰？我到底是誰？」時，面對著永恆謎團的他回應道：「Tattvamasi」（你是那個），意思就是說：「你就是至上本體」。
CITATION_EN: 10 October 1978, Patna | Guru Prańáma | Ánanda Vacanámrtam Part 3
CITATION_ZH: 1978年10月10日於巴特那 | 對上師之禮敬，喜悅甘露集卷二， P.49

EN_TEXT: The followers of karma yoga perform only those deeds which lead them to spirituality. While following the path of karma it is experienced that there is some distortion in life and that is rejected and a correct path is again adopted. Again while moving, it is found that there is still some impurity, which is again rejected, and a still purer path is adopted. The march continues till the Supreme One is attained.
ZH_TEXT: 遵循行動瑜伽之人，只從事那些可以引領他們到達靈性的行為。在這條行動的道路上，生命中有時會產生某些扭曲，這些扭曲應被摒除而只採取正確的道路。再往前進的同時，又再次發現一些瑕疵出現，於是又再次將他們去除，而選擇更純淨之路前進。如此一路純淨再更純淨地前進，直到獲得至上本體。
CITATION_EN: Shrii Shrii Ánandamúrti | 10 October 1979, Kolkata | 05 Karma Is Brahma | Ananda Marga Karma Yoga in a Nutshell
CITATION_ZH: Shrii Shrii Ánandamúrti | 1979年10月10日於Kolkata | 05 行動乃至上意識 | 行動瑜伽的智慧，P.70

EN_TEXT: Everything is the expression of Parama Puruśa. Bearing this in mind, the devotees serve everyone and everything with integral outlook and move ahead on the path of devotion. The path of the devotees is straightforward, it is blissful right from the beginning. The worker works ceaselessly. While moving on the path, if you happen to discover that some actions, which are not pure by nature and do not bring joy unto you, you should outright reject them.
ZH_TEXT: 一切都是至上意識的顯現，虔誠者心懷此念，以一體的觀念服務萬有眾生，並沿著虔誠之道前進。虔誠者的道路是一條筆直的道路，自始至終充滿了喜悅。行動道上之人行動不懈。當沿著此道前進時，一旦發現某些行為已失去原本純淨的本質，且無法為你帶來喜悅時，你應當機立斷，即刻全部去除。
CITATION_EN: Shrii Shrii Ánandamúrti | 10 October 1979, Kolkata | 05 Karma Is Brahma | Ananda Marga Karma Yoga in a Nutshell
CITATION_ZH: Shrii Shrii Ánandamúrti | 1979年10月10日於Kolkata | 05行動乃至上意識，行動瑜伽的智慧，P.71

EN_TEXT: Spiritual practice makes the mind calm and quiet, and maintains the nerves in a state of equipoise; and thus spiritual practice increases longevity. Those Vaishnavites who are vegetarians, who regularly sing spiritual songs, do meditation, perform virtuous deeds and think pure thoughts, live longer than ninety years. Now, one may say that some people like Vivekananda did not live long; but the cause of their early death was excessive labour... I want you all to live long – but you must live glorious lives, not like those of earthworms. Your lives should be bustling with activity.
ZH_TEXT: 靈性的修持使心靈寧靜、安詳，並且維持神經在一種平衡的狀態。因此，靈性的修持增長了壽命，那些懷氏那瓦法門的修持者(Vaishnavites)都是素食者，他們經常唱頌靈性歌曲、靜坐、從事高尚的行為，念頭純淨，壽命都超過九十歲。 但是可能有人會說，有些人像威維卡難陀並沒有很長命，造成這些人英年早逝的原因是操勞過度。…… 我要你們都能活得長命──但是你們必須過著榮耀的一生，而非像蚯蚓一般。你們應將生命投身於各類的行動中。
IT_TEXT: La pratica spirituale rende la mente calma e tranquilla e mantiene i nervi in uno stato di equilibrio; per questo la pratica spirituale aumenta la longevità. Quelle persone dedite a una vita spirituale (vaisnava), che seguono una dieta vegetariana, cantano regolarmente canti spirituali, meditano, compiono azioni virtuose e coltivano pensieri puri, vivono oltre i novant’anni.  Ora, qualcuno potrebbe obiettare che persone come Vivekananda non vissero a lungo; ma la causa della loro morte prematura fu il lavoro eccessivo. Io voglio che tutti voi viviate a lungo – ma dovete vivere vite gloriose, non come quelle dei lombrichi. Le vostre vite devono essere vibranti di attività.

EN_TEXT: Those who initiate in Vaedikácára [Vaedikii diikśá] are also gurus. So what is the Sadguru? The word Sat means “that which undergoes no change”. In modern Sanskrit, sat means “good” and asat means “bad”, but in Vaedika Saḿskrta, sat means “that which undergoes no change”. Násadásiinno sadásiittadániiḿ násiidrajo no vyomá paro yat; Kimávariivah kuha kasya sharmannambhah kimásiidagahanaḿ gabhiiram. Sat. Now, the entity by whose grace one comes in contact with Sat (Sat, the Non-Changeable Entity, that is, the non-changeable stance, the non-changeable nuclear entity around which so many electrons move) – that entity, or rather, that framework through which Parama Puruśa is working or Táraka Brahma is functioning, is the Sadguru. Sadguruḿ taḿ namámi – “I do my namah before you, at your altar.”
ZH_TEXT: 給予知識啟蒙的人也是古魯。那麼何謂Sadguru（完美上師）呢？Sat這個字意指「不會改變者」，在現代的梵文裡，Sat意為「好的」，而asat意為「不好的」。但是在吠陀的梵文裡，Sat意指「不會改變的」。 Násadásiinno sadásiittadániiḿ násiidrajo no vyomá paro yat; Kimávariivah kuha kasya sharmannambhah kimásiidagahanaḿ gabhiiram。由於此實體的恩典，吾人與不變的本體(Sat)接觸，(sat──不變的本體、是永不變易之境、許多電子圍繞此不變的核心本體運行)，此至上意識或解脫眾生的至上意識藉以作用的實體，就是永恆的古魯(Sadguru)──完美上師。Sadguruḿ tvaḿnamámi,「在你的聖壇上，於您的面前我向您頂禮致敬。」

EN_TEXT: People may say that there is a gulf of difference between subjectivity (internal feelings) and objectivity (external expressions). Why, then, are such contradictory adjectives used about the devotees? The reason is that the unit beings are both individually and collectively associated with Brahmánanda (Cosmic Bliss). That is why in the state of devotional bliss there is no difference between subjectivity and objectivity. In the case of ánanda both these terms are used.
ZH_TEXT: 或許有人會說在主體（內在的感受）和客體（外在的表現）之間有很大的歧異，那麼為何此種矛盾的形容詞用在有關虔誠者的身上？原因是：不論在個體和集體上，個體的生命都與宇宙的喜悅結合在一起。所以在虔誠的喜悅境界裡，在主體和客體間是沒有分別的，這兩個名稱都被使用。
IT_TEXT: Si potrebbe dire che esista un’enorme differenza tra soggettività (sentimenti interiori) e oggettività (espressioni esteriori). Perché, allora, vengono usati aggettivi così contraddittori a proposito dei devoti? La ragione è che gli esseri individuali sono, sia individualmente sia collettivamente, associati a Brahmánanda (Beatitudine Cosmica). Per questo, nello stato di beatitudine devozionale, non vi è alcuna differenza tra soggettività e oggettività. Nel caso di ánanda, entrambi questi termini vengono utilizzati.

EN_TEXT: Bhaktih bhaktasya jiivanam. What is life? It is the expression of vital energy. Because of this expression, the inferential vibrations [sound, touch, form, taste, smell] of the world get scope for reflection. That is why this life means life [in] that reflecting entity. For devotees, devotion alone is life, the expression of their vital energy. Where there is no devotion, when the devotion gets exhausted, the throbbing of their lives also stops. That is why devotees cannot even think of surviving without devotion, devotion is the very expression of their life.

EN_TEXT: What is love? That which makes mind soft and so strong and strenuous as it may keep itself in a balanced state even in the condition of pain, and creates perpetually a pleasant feeling within, is called love. Devotion is identical with love. They are invariably related with each other. The moment devotion is aroused, love for God comes.
ZH_TEXT: 何謂「愛」? 讓心靈溫柔敦厚並且堅定不移，即使在痛苦的狀態也能永遠保持著平衡，而於內在滋生出永恆的喜悅情懷，這就是「愛」。虔誠和愛是一樣的，彼此不可分割。虔誠心一旦被喚起，至上之愛即降臨。

EN_TEXT: What about action? Human beings have come to the world for work, work has got to be done. Regarding that, Rohit’s father said, “When a person’s face becomes sweaty due to constant labour, the beauty of the face of that person is unprecedented. Since that is perspiration due to hard labour, its beauty is flawless and unparalleled. Even Indra, the king of gods, sees it – where the face is beautified with perspiration out of hard labour, the king of gods, Indra aspires to befriend such a person and move with that person. So Devarája Indra becomes a friend to such an industrious person. Hence Rohit, go ahead, go ahead, dońt́ sit like a crude object devoid of lustre. You are a well-read person no doubt, but don’t sit like an inanimate object –Caraeveti, caraeveti – ‘Move ahead, move ahead’.”
ZH_TEXT: 那麼行動之道呢？人類為了做些事而來到這世界，必須將該做的事完成。先前洛西塔的父親說：「當一個人因勤奮勞動而臉上透出汗珠時，此人之臉龐所散發出來的美麗光芒是前所未有的。因為那閃耀的汗珠是辛苦的結晶，所以它的美是完美無瑕、無與倫比的。即使是眾神之神的因陀羅也渴望和他交朋友。看到因辛苦勞動而流汗的美麗臉龐，眾神之神因羅陀立刻與此勤奮之人做朋友。因此，洛西塔呀！行動吧！前進吧！不要像毫無活力的粗鈍物質般呆坐不動！你的確學富五車，但是千萬不要像個無生命之物般死氣沉沉，前進吧！前進吧(Caraeveti, Caraeveti)!」

EN_TEXT: As long as a person is asleep, drowned in the darkness of ignorance, one remains seized by the static force, one’s fate also remains sleeping. That period in the life of a human being is known as Kali Yuga [Iron Age]. Afterwards, when conscience dawns on oneself, and one starts thinking that one has to wake up and start working, from that very moment onward comes the age of Dvápara Yuga [Bronze Age] in one’s life. In individual life “Dvápara Yuga” begins when one’s sleep is broken, and he sits up thinking that one has got to begin to work. When one stands up and starts moving ahead, Tretá Yuga begins in one’s life. When a person actually starts moving ahead, then from that moment onwards, Satya Yuga commences. Krta Yuga [“era when action has been done”] means Satya Yuga. Hence Rohit’s father advised Rohit to move ahead.
ZH_TEXT: 當一個人沉睡，落入無明的黑暗時，他即受制於惰性力量的束縛中，他的命運也跟著沈睡。那個階段被稱為生命的卡力年代──「鐵的時代」(Kaliyuga);之後當他的意識覺醒，開始有了應該覺醒的思維並即刻行動時，即來到生命德瓦帕拉──「銅的時代」(Dvápara)。在個人生命中，德瓦帕拉──「銅的時代」意謂著他已從睡夢中醒來，並認真思考自己該起身而行了。而後當一個人已起身並開始往前走時，其生命垂塔年代──「銀的時代」(Tretá yuga)就展開了。 當一個人真正邁步向前的那一刻開始，他生命真理的「黃金時代」就來臨了。「行動的時代」(Krta Yuga)意即真理的「黃金時代」(Satya Yuga)。 因此洛西塔的父親苦口婆心勸告洛西塔要邁步前進。

EN_TEXT: Serving the world is serving Parama Puruśa. The world is created out of Parama Puruśa, so render service as much as you can. Parama Puruśa will be satisfied. Therefore, one who is a true devotee, one who follows the real path of devotion, will serve humanity to the maximum extent, and together with this, whatever else s/he will do – singing, dancing, doing kiirtana – he/she will think that Parama Puruśa remains in everything, seeing everything. Hence Parama Puruśa also wants that He should remain in the midst of His devotees, He should listen to their stories of pain and pleasure and watch their singing and dancing.
ZH_TEXT: 服務至上意識就是去服務這個世界。這世界是祂的創造，故盡你所能地付出更多吧！至上意識會非常高興的。 一個真正的虔誠者，一個遵循虔誠之道的人，會盡最大努力去服務眾生，除此之外，他還需做什麼呢？他應配合靈性舞蹈唱頌「至上聖名」(kiirtana)。他認為至上意識無所不在，祂應該在萬事萬物之中，觀照著萬有一切，所以至上意識也會希望他與其他的虔誠者為伍，他應該聆聽、分享其他人的快樂和痛苦，應該和他們一起唱歌和跳舞。

EN_TEXT: The meaning of the word bábá is “dear”. As Parama Puruśa is the beloved of all, so all are beloved for Parama Puruśa. So when Parama Puruśa is “Bábá” for units, for Parama Puruśa the units are also bábá. This is because the relationship is that of love, in which there is no scope for superior or inferior, higher or lower – all are equal. Whether the devotee is greater or God is greater, each is bábá for the other. Why wait for the decision of the fight?
ZH_TEXT: Bábá的意思是「親愛的」。由於至上意識為眾生所鍾愛，因此，對個體而言，至上意識是他們的bábá;而對於至上意識而言，個體是祂的bábá。這是因為他們之間的關係是「愛」的連結，沒有高低優劣之別，都是平等的。不論虔誠者比較偉大還是上帝比較偉大，彼此都是彼此的bábá。何必管他們的戰鬥誰輸誰贏呢？

EN_TEXT: Suppose that some time you go to a particular house which people say is haunted... Due to terror, due to pre-imposed terror, a personʼs mind gets concentrated. Due to fear the mind gets concentrated, and due to concentration, what happens? A certain portion of the personʼs own ectoplasmic stuff goes to help a detached mind in creating a body, an ectoplasmic body. So you see your own creation; the creation has been made out of your own ectoplasmic stuff. But that detached mind was also there. It was not a ghost. And those Brahmapisháca, or several kinds of “ghosts”, are all of your creation. Your ectoplasmic stuff is transferred to that detached mind due to your mental concentration, temporary concentration.
ZH_TEXT: 假若有時你去一間謠傳鬧鬼的屋子，由於恐懼以及原有的恐怖印象，使得心靈集中，因為集中之故，你心靈波質的某個部分，幫助了那個游離心靈創造出一個心靈波體，也就是說，你看到了自己心靈波質的創造物。那個游離的心靈的確也存在那裡，但它不是鬼，各式各樣的鬼都是你自己創造出來的，是因為你精神暫時的集中，使得你的心靈波質轉化到那個游離的心靈上。

EN_TEXT: Remove that burden, be light, and march on. Bhagaván [Lord] Buddha said the same thing when he asked his disciples to jettison the burden that is in the boat. Desire is, therefore, not enough. One needs to perform some tangible action. That action is called intuitional practice – spiritual cult. This cult is also called Tantra. It is not enough to read books, scriptures – one will have to be practical, will have to do something in practical life.
ZH_TEXT: 將罪業的重擔消除，輕鬆上路吧！上主佛陀也是這麼說的，他要弟子們快快將船上的重擔丟棄以減輕負載。因此，僅只是渴望走上靈性的道路是不夠的，吾人必須採取具體的行動，這行動就是從事靈性直覺的鍛鍊—靈修法門，也稱為「密宗修持」。光只是閱讀靈性書籍、經典是不夠的，吾人必須在日常的生活上予以實踐。

EN_TEXT: Now, what does one enjoy by dint of sádhaná? When one withdraws oneʼs mind from oneʼs psychic objectivity, then one becomes free. Similarly, when the Cosmic Entity withdraws Himself from His objectivity, He becomes nirguńa. Similarly, when the jiivas [units] withdraw their minds from their own worlds, they also become nirguńa. They become one with Nirguńa Brahma. Thatʼs why it has been said, Brahmavid Brahmaeva bhavati [“One who realizes Brahma becomes Brahma”]. And that is your sádhaná.
ZH_TEXT: 一個人經由靈性修持能獲得什麼？當該人的心靈從各種心靈客體中收攝回來，他就獲得了自由，得到解脫。同樣的，當宇宙本體將自身從祂的客體中收攝回來，祂就成了無屬性至上本體。同理，當個體從他們各自的世界將心靈收攝回來，他們也會成就自身為無屬性至上本體，他們將與無屬性至上本體合而為一。所以說：「了悟至上意識者將成就自身為至上意識。」這就是你的靈性修持。

EN_TEXT: One becomes established in bhakti through Bhágavata sevá, by serving Bhagaván. So what should be the spirit of a devotee? What should be the spirit of the unit? Átmamokśárthaḿ jagat hitáya ca. “One will meditate on the Supreme to become one with the Supreme, and at the same time, to purify oneʼs mind, one is to render selfless service to human society.” Without rendering selfless service to society, one cannot come in close proximity to the Supreme. And without practising meditation, one cannot render selfless service to the society. So one should remember that oneʼs motto in life is Átmamokśárthaḿ jagat hitáya ca.
ZH_TEXT: 人透過對至上的服務(Bhágavata sevá)將可立足於虔誠之境。虔誠者的精神應該是什麼？一個人的精神應該是什麼？應該是「了悟自我和服務社會」 (Átmamokśárthaḿ jagat hitáya ca)──「他應該靜坐觀想持念至上意識以與至上意識合而為一，同時，他應該為人類社會從事無私的服務，以淨化他的心靈。」沒有為社會從事無私的服務，無法與至上意識有親密的接觸；沒有靜坐的鍛鍊修持，無法為社會付出無私的服務。所以「了悟自我，服務社會」應該是一個人的人生座右銘。
IT_TEXT: Ci si stabilisce saldamente nella bhakti attraverso il Bhāgavata sevā, servendo Bhagavān. Quale dovrebbe essere, dunque, lo spirito di un devoto? Quale dovrebbe essere lo spirito dell’essere individuale? Ātmamokṣārthaṁ jagat hitāya ca: «Si mediterà sul Supremo per diventare uno con il Supremo e, nello stesso tempo, per purificare la propria mente, si offrirà un servizio disinteressato alla società umana». Senza prestare un servizio disinteressato alla società, non ci si può avvicinare intimamente al Supremo. E senza praticare la meditazione, non si può offrire alla società un servizio veramente disinteressato. Bisogna quindi ricordare che il motto della propria vita è: Ātmamokṣārthaṁ jagat hitāya ca — per la liberazione del sé e per il bene del mondo.

As they have no previous experience of divine life, they lack courage to move along that path, but once they do gather courage to move forward, they realize the greatness of that path of eternal bliss.
ZH_TEXT: 人類並不害怕走一條已知的道路，但對於未知道路的旅程卻總是遲疑與畏懼。神性生命的道路對於人們來說是未知的，因為他們過去沒有神性生命的經驗。他們缺乏沿此道路前進的勇氣，但是一旦他們鼓足勇氣向前進時，他們將了解此永恆喜悅之道的偉大。

EN_TEXT: Actually, tiirtha means that stance from where if you go a step deeper, a step inner, you will be in the land of bliss, and if you go a step cruder you will be within the realm of crude materiality, the crude world. A man should always try to keep his mind, keep himself, in tiirtha. So as soon as he will sit in meditation, he will be in deep meditation; and as soon as he will start worldly work he will be starting worldly work. So tiirtha is something internal, not external.
ZH_TEXT: 事實上，聖地(tiirtha)意指一種境地，此處如果你往內在深處再走一步，你將置身喜悅之地；如果你往外在粗鈍再走一步，你就會回到粗鈍的物質世界。人應努力讓自己的心靈處在聖地中，如此，當你靜坐時便進入深層的靜坐；一旦你開始從事世俗工作，也可立即上手。所以，聖地在內，非外。

EN_TEXT: The first essentiality of Bhágavata Dharma is vistára. To quench this thirst for vistára, one is to do sádhaná regularly, and this sádhaná will expand the personʼs mental arena. In this way a day is sure to come when the personʼs mind will become one with the Cosmic Mind. This is called vistára.
ZH_TEXT: 至上法性的第一要素是擴展。為了滿足擴展的渴望，人必須規律地從事靜坐修持，此靜坐修持將擴展一個人的心智領域。如此終有一天該人的心靈會與大宇宙心靈合而為一。此稱之為「擴展」。
IT_TEXT: La prima essenzialità del Bhāgavata Dharma è vistāra (espansione). Per placare questa sete di vistāra, si deve praticare regolarmente il sādhana, e questo sādhana espanderà l’ambito mentale della persona. In questo modo è certo che giungerà il giorno in cui la mente della persona diventerà una cosa sola con la Mente Cosmica. Questo è chiamato vistāra.

EN_TEXT: In the Vedas it has been said, Rasa bae sah [“The Supreme Entity is the embodiment of the flow of bliss”]. What is His speciality? He is a flow, a rasa, and His devotees were able to dance according to the rhythm of that rasa. Devotees always dance, either physically or mentally, according to a certain rhythm, a certain chandá. So the devotees dance according to the rhythm of His flow. And Parama Puruśa, Krśńa – Ádishiva as the hub, as the Noumenal Subjectivity – is in the centre, and the devotees, all human beings of the entire universe, of Hariparimańd́ala, dance around Him according to those rhythms. In the centre or the hub Parama Puruśa exists, and His devotees are dancing around Him according to the rhythms of the waves emanated from His body. It is the rásaliilá of Parama Puruśa, it is the rásaliilá of Bhagaván Krśńa – the dancing in tune with the rasa, or Cosmic flow.
ZH_TEXT: 在吠陀經中有言道：「至上本體是喜悅波流的化身(Rasa baesah)」。其特質為何？祂是一股波流，祂的虔誠者會隨著祂波流的韻律而舞動。虔誠者永遠在舞動著，不管是他的身體還是心靈，會依照特定的節奏、韻律而舞動。虔誠者隨著祂波流之韻律而舞動著。做為核心，做為至上主體的至上意識──克里斯那──第一希瓦──祂在中心，所有在唱頌至上聖名的甜美情境(Hariparimańd́ala)中的虔誠者及宇宙中所有之人，依照祂的節奏而舞動。至上意識是此一核心，祂的虔誠者圍繞著祂，根據從祂放射出來的波流韻律而舞動。這是至上意識──薄伽梵克里斯那的波流遊戲(rásaliilá)，隨著宇宙波流的曲調而舞。

EN_TEXT: If human beings take the Cosmic ideation, they will also become one with the Cosmic Entity. Now the question is, how can human beings take the ideation of Parama Puruśa? Jiṋániis [scholars] will analyse, “Parama Puruśa is like this or like that.” Karmiis [those engaged in actions] will think that Parama Puruśa is a master of action. (Now, what relation do bhaktas have to jiṋána? A devotee will think, “I may be a virtuous person, I may be poor, I may be learned or foolish, but, O Lord, I belong only to You.”) And devotees think of the Lord just as people think of their nearest and dearest ones. They think, “Parama Puruśa is mine;” and in this process of constant ideation, their minds gradually expand. From this sort of closeness, a person ultimately becomes one with Paramátmá. Such a person of devotion is called a bhakta.
ZH_TEXT: 如果人類觀想著大宇宙心靈，那麼他們將與宇宙本體合一。 現在問題在於人們應如何持念、觀想至上意識？知識分子總是分析「至上意識是像這樣或像那樣」，而行動家則認為至上意識是一位行動的大師。那麼，虔誠者與知識分子之間的關係如何呢？一個虔誠者心裡會這麼想著：「我可能是位有德行的人，我可能貧窮，我可能博學多聞或愚蠢無知，但是，喔！上主，我只屬於您。」虔誠者想起上主的時候就像人們想起他們最接近、最親愛的人。他心想「至上意識是我所有」，而在此種不斷持念、觀想的過程中，他的心靈逐漸擴展。從這種親密關係裡，一個人最後將與至上意識合而為一。梵文稱如此虔誠的人為bhakta（虔誠者）。

EN_TEXT: He does not reside anywhere except where His ardent devotees are singing kiirtana. Philosophically, Parama Puruśa is omnipresent, but His nucleus remains at a particular place. That particular place, where the nucleus resides, is not Vaekuńt́ha. That particular place is where His ardent devotees are singing His glories in kiirtana.

EN_TEXT: How can one attain siddhi through the practice of yoga? The jiivátmá will take the ideation of Paramátmá, and then the former will become one with the latter. How is it possible for the microcosm to become Macrocosm? The Macrocosm, or Parama Puruśa, has one unique characteristic, and that characteristic is, whoever ideates on Him becomes one with Him. The very nature of the mind is to become as it thinks... As one thinks, so one becomes... If human beings take the Cosmic ideation, they will also become one with the Cosmic Entity.
ZH_TEXT: 人如何經由修持瑜伽而達到圓滿的成就？個體意識持念、觀想至上意識，則個體意識將與至上意識合一。個體小宇宙怎麼可能變成大宇宙呢？大宇宙，或稱至上意識，有一個唯一的特徵，那就是無論誰持念、觀想祂，就會與祂合一。心靈的本質就是變成它所想的對象。…… 「你怎麼想就怎麼變」。……如果人類觀想著大宇宙心靈，那麼他們將與宇宙本體合一。
IT_TEXT: Come si può ottenere la siddhi attraverso la pratica dello yoga? Il jīvātman assumerà l’ideazione di Paramātman, e allora il primo diventerà uno con il secondo. Com’è possibile che il microcosmo diventi Macrocosmo? Il Macrocosmo, o Parama Puruśa, ha una caratteristica unica, ed è questa: chiunque mediti su di Lui diventa uno con Lui. La natura stessa della mente è quella di diventare ciò che pensa… Come si pensa, così si diventa… Se gli esseri umani assumono l’ideazione Cosmica, diventeranno anch’essi uno con l’Entità Cosmica.

EN_TEXT: To know Him you are to throw yourself into the introversive flow of the Macrocosmic imagination and bring about a union between the Entity which imagines and the entity which is imagined. To know Brahma means to become Brahma. As He is not your mental object, you cannot see Him.
ZH_TEXT: 為了了悟祂，你必須將自身投入於大宇宙想像的內在波流，讓想像的實體和被想像的實體合一。了悟至上意識就是成為至上意識，因為祂不是你的心智客體，所以你無法看見祂。

EN_TEXT: He is such a remarkable entity that whoever comes near Him becomes as great as Him and is made His own. Not only does He draw all other entities into His lap, but He also makes them lose their individual identities in Him – they become absorbed in Him. Thatʼs why He is also called “Vipula”. And as Heʼs Vipula, He is also called “Brahma”. Had He not possessed the quality of making others as great as Himself, we would have called Him Brhat, but certainly not Brahma.
ZH_TEXT: 祂如此非比尋常，誰靠近祂，誰就變得跟祂一樣偉大，而且成為祂所有。祂不僅吸引所有其他個體到祂的膝上，而且也使他們在祂裡面不再保有個別的自己──他們融入於祂，所以祂被稱為「偉大」(Vipula)，因為偉大，所以也被稱為「至上意識」(Brahma)。要不是祂擁有使別人變得跟祂自己一樣偉大的性質，我們將稱呼祂「無限大」(Brhat)，而絕非「至上意識」(Brahma)。

EN_TEXT: Some people think that Parama Puruśa is far away and, showing no mercy, has left them deserted in a corner. They believe He thinks about everyone except themselves. To such people my reply is, “He thinks about everyone. If Heʼs not thinking about you, He must be thinking about not thinking about you. If He thinks that He will think about everyone except you, He is also thinking about you.” So it logically follows that He thinks about everyone, excluding none.
ZH_TEXT: 有的人認為至上意識遙不可及，毫無慈憫悲心，把他遺棄在角落裡，只想到除了他之外的每一個人。對有這樣想法的人，我只有一個回答；「祂想到每一個人。如果祂沒有想到你，那麼祂必定正在想著祂沒有想到你這件事；如果祂想著祂將想除你之外的每一個人，那麼表示祂也還是想著你。」他想著每一個人，無一例外。

EN_TEXT: Whatever humans do in consistence with the dictates of dharma will ensure their well-being, their victory, their prosperity. And whoever goes against these ingrained human characteristics, against these dharma-orientated characteristics, will be doomed to destruction. For human beings, ideation on Parama Puruśa is a dharmic injunction. By divine decree everyone has the right to live in the world with dignity. If anyone creates any obstacle against this dharma-oriented system, if they oppose it, they are bound to be destroyed.
ZH_TEXT: 人類的作為若能符合法性，則其福祉、勝利與繁榮是必然的，任何違反人類本自具有以法性為導向的特性，必將招致毀滅。對人類來說，心中持念至上意識是法性的誡命，由於神聖的天意，每個人有權利尊嚴地活在這個世界上，如果有人製造障礙來阻撓以法性為導向的運作規律，必毀滅無疑。

EN_TEXT: It is the duty of every person to perform dharma sádhaná. Human beings are marching along the path of aesthetic science. Parama Puruśa is described as “Truth, Consciousness and Beauty” (Satyam, Shivam, Sundaram). Human beings are fascinated by His grandeur, His non-attachment, and by His beauty too.
ZH_TEXT: 從事法性的靈性修持是每個人的責任。人類正沿著美學之道前進。至上意識被描述為「真理、意識以及美」(Satyam Shivam, Sundaram)，人類也為祂的莊嚴偉大、不執著以及美麗所著迷。

EN_TEXT: Why do we move towards the Subtlest Entity? The reason is, we want to experience joy or pleasure. The stage when we lose ourselves in ecstatic bliss, we merge in the Supreme Entity, is called supra-aesthetic science (atinandana vijiṋána). It is also known as sammohana vijiṋána, that is, as long as we are enjoying that ecstasy, we feel it is very charming. The sport (liilá) of Parama Puruśa is very beautiful. We are moving towards Him. We do not mind the obstructions. We will go on moving. The stage of movement is the stage of aesthetic science. The stage of merger, when we have lost ourselves in the Supreme, when we have no desire for anything else, is the stage of supra-aesthetic science (mohana vijiṋána).
ZH_TEXT: 為什麼我們會朝向最精細的本體前進呢？原因就在於我們想要體驗喜悅或快樂。一旦當我們達到忘我的喜悅之境時，就會融入於至上本體，此即為「超美學」(Atinandana Vijiṋána)，也稱為Sammohana Vijiṋána，亦即只要我們沉浸在此種喜悅中，我們就會覺得它魅力無窮。至上意識的遊戲是非常美麗的。我們一心朝向祂前進，不在乎任何阻礙，會一直向前進。這種前進的行動就是美學；而當我們忘懷自身融入至上本體，當我們已無任何其他的慾望時，這就稱為超美學(Mohan Vijiṋána)。

EN_TEXT: By taking the ideation of Paramátmá [Supreme Subjectivity], the human mind becomes as vast as Paramátmá Himself. It is the characteristic of the mind to take the form of the object of its ideation. It is one of the characteristics of Paramátmá also that whosoever takes His ideation becomes like Him. Everything, such as water, fire, oxygen, nitrogen, etc., has its own characteristic. So the characteristic of Parama Puruśa [Supreme Entity] is that whosoever takes His ideation, become as vast as Him by His Grace. Brhatvadá Brahma brḿhańatvád Brahma. The word Brahma means “very great.” Is He only great? No, He is great Himself, and can make others great; so He is called Brahma.
ZH_TEXT: 以至上意識為理念作用的目標，人類心靈就會變成如至上意識般浩瀚。這是心靈的特質，心靈會取得它理念作用的目標。這也是至上意識的特質之一，亦即任何人若以祂為理念作用的目標，就會變成和祂一樣。每個東西，例如水、火、氧、氮等等，它們都各有各的特性，所以至上意識的特性就是任何人若以祂為其理念作用的目標，則在祂的恩典下就會變得如祂一般偉大—Brhatvadá Brahma Brḿhańatvád Brahma,Brahma這個字意指非常偉大。祂僅僅只是偉大嗎？不，祂不但偉大，同時也能使其他人變得偉大，所以祂被稱為至上意識—Brahma。
IT_TEXT: Assumendo l’ideazione di Paramātmā [Soggettività Suprema], la mente umana diventa vasta quanto Paramātmā stesso. È caratteristica della mente assumere la forma dell’oggetto della propria ideazione. Ed è anche una delle caratteristiche di Paramātmā che chiunque assuma la Sua ideazione diventi come Lui. Ogni cosa – come l’acqua, il fuoco, l’ossigeno, l’azoto, ecc. – possiede una propria caratteristica. Così, la caratteristica di Parama Puruṣa [Entità Suprema] è che chiunque assuma la Sua ideazione diventa vasto quanto Lui, per Sua grazia. Bṛhatvād Brahma bṛṃhaṇatvād Brahma. La parola Brahma significa «molto grande». È soltanto grande? No, Egli è grande in sé e può rendere grandi gli altri; per questo è chiamato Brahma.

EN_TEXT: If one, after transforming mind into a point, without making it vast, merges it into Parama Puruśa, surrenders it to Parama Puruśa, then, in that case, individual mind does not exist. Then what happens? Mind merges with Parama Puruśa; there remains only Paramátma [Supreme Subjectivity] and not the mind. This is called nirvikalpa samádhi. In savikalpa samádhi the mind enjoys bliss because of its greatness. That bliss is called liilánanda [bliss of the divine play]. When the mind is given to Parama Puruśa, it is surrendered unto Him, in that condition the bliss or supra-mundane ecstasy is called nityánanda [eternal, transcendental bliss]. So devotion is essential to get nityánanda or liilánanda (the bliss of His sport or liilá).
ZH_TEXT: 如果一個人將心靈專注於一點，而非擴展讓它變得浩瀚無比，以致融入於至上意識，臣服於至上意識裡，在此情況下，個體的心靈已不復存在，那麼將發生什麼事呢？心靈會融入至上意識裡，彼時只有至上意識的存在，而沒有個體心靈的存在。此稱為「無餘依三摩地」。在有餘依三摩地的境界中，心靈因為無比擴展而享受喜悅，那種喜悅稱為「遊戲三昧」(Liilánanda);當心靈完全交付給至上意識，完全臣服於祂時，那種喜悅或超世俗的喜悅則稱為「永恆三昧」(Nityánanda)。所以虔誠對永恆三昧或遊戲三昧而言都是不可或缺的。

EN_TEXT: What is love? It is the expressed form of devotion. Only one who has love for Parama Puruśa can take His ideation. Love is the expressed form of devotion. When does this expressed form occur? When it has its root or seed, only then it can occur. When there is seed, only then it will sprout. That seed is devotion. So, only that one can make oneself great, only that one can take the correct ideation of Parama Puruśa, who has the seed of devotion within.
ZH_TEXT: 何謂愛？愛是虔誠的表達方式。唯有深愛至上意識的人，才可能觀想、持念祂，以祂為理念作用的目標。虔誠的表達就是愛，愛的表達於何時產生？於有種子或根的地方才會產生出來。有種子方才會發芽。那種子就是虔誠。所以只有努力成就自身偉大，只有正確觀想、持念至上意識者，其內在才會有虔誠的種子。

EN_TEXT: Parents love their child very much. Do they love for the sake of their child? No they love their child because they get pleasure for themselves. If their child turns into a vagabond, if he or she becomes cruel, then he or she does not utter even the parents’ names, then they do not get pleasure. A person likes everything of this world but not for the sake of these things. One loves the world, one lives with this world because one gets pleasure, that is why one loves it. You see, if one gets great trouble in this world even for a single moment one says, “O Yamarája (God of Death), where are you? Come on, now, I don’t want to live.” After that if one gets attracted towards this world after two or three minutes, one says, “No Yamarája, no, you don’t come now.” So this is the first phase of aesthetic science. After that what happens? By taking the ideation of Parama Puruśa, when the quantity of pleasure increases, a person loses the self first. What happens when he or she is lost? He or she feels “I take the ideation of Parama Puruśa not for my sake, not for me. I love Parama Puruśa so that he may get pleasure because of my love, I wish to give Him pleasure. I may or may not get it.” When this stage is attained, this is called rágátmiká bhakti. In this stage one feels, “I love Parama Puruśa, I do not care whether He loves me or lot, He likes me or not, but I like Him”. This is rágátmiká bhakti. When this rágátmiká bhakti is attained, in that stage one is also called gopa” as described in scriptures (shástras).
ZH_TEXT: 父母摯愛其子女，他們難道會因為是自己的小孩所以愛他們嗎？不是的，他們愛子女乃因他們從愛小孩之中得到快樂。如果他們的小孩變成懶惰鬼或變成冷酷無情之人，連父母之名都不稱呼，那麼當父母的就不會覺得快樂了。一個人喜愛這世間的東西並非因為喜愛而喜愛，一個人愛這世界，活在這世界，乃因為他從中獲得快樂，所以他才會愛這世界、活在這世界。你們看，如果一個人遇到天大的麻煩，即使短短一刻，他都會覺得：「哦，死神啊！你在哪裡？快現身來取走我的性命吧！我一刻都不想再活了！」兩、三分鐘之後，若他又被世間某物所吸引，他就又會說：「哦，死神啊！求求你現在別來！」這就是美學的第一個階段。 然後會發生什麼事呢？藉由對至上意識的理念作用，當喜悅的感受越來越強時，首先他會忘懷自身。而後又會怎麼樣呢？他會覺得：「我觀想、持念至上意識不是為了自己的緣故，不是為了我自己。我愛至上意識因為祂可以從我對祂的愛中得到快樂，不管我自己能不能得到快樂，但我想要讓祂得到快樂。」當達到這種境界時，就稱為「拉嘎密卡虔誠」(Rágátmiká Bhakti)。在此階段，一個人會感覺到「我不在乎至上意識是否愛我，但我愛祂。祂喜不喜歡我無所謂，然而我喜歡祂。」此即為「拉嘎密卡虔誠」。達到這種虔誠之境的人，在經典上也稱為「勾帕」(Gopa)。
IT_TEXT: I genitori amano moltissimo il proprio figlio. Ma lo amano davvero per il bene del figlio? No. Lo amano perché ne traggono piacere per sé stessi. Se il figlio diventa un vagabondo, se diventa crudele, se non pronuncia neppure il nome dei genitori, allora quel piacere non c’è più. L’essere umano apprezza le cose di questo mondo, ma non per il loro bene: le ama perché ne ricava piacere. Si ama il mondo e si vive nel mondo perché il mondo dà piacere — ed è per questo che lo si ama. Osservate: se anche solo per un attimo questo mondo diventa fonte di grande sofferenza, l’uomo esclama: «O Yamarāja, Dio della morte, dove sei? Vieni pure, non voglio più vivere». Ma se dopo due o tre minuti torna ad essere attratto dal mondo, subito dice: «No, Yamarāja, no… non venire ora». Questa è la prima fase della scienza estetica. Poi che cosa accade? Quando, prendendo come ideazione Parama Purusa, la quantità di piacere aumenta, l’individuo perde per prima cosa il proprio io. E che cosa succede quando l’io si perde? Si sente: «Io prendo come ideazione Parama Purusa non per me, non per il mio tornaconto. Io amo Parama Purusa affinché Egli possa ricevere piacere dal mio amore. Che io ne riceva o no, non è importante». Quando si raggiunge questo stadio, esso è chiamato rāgātmikā bhakti. In questa condizione si sente: «Io amo Parama Purusa; non mi importa se Egli mi ama molto o poco, se Gli piaccio o no. Io Lo amo». Questa è la rāgātmikā bhakti. E quando questa forma di devozione è raggiunta, colui che la vive viene chiamato anche gopa, così come è descritto nelle scritture (śāstra).

EN_TEXT: What happens when they are established in supra-aesthetic science (atinandan vijiṋána)? All their worldly music is finished. All the rágas and rágińiis and the art of dancing, whatever they be, they come to an end. In that condition, there remains only an ecstatic state (bhávibhora). The music of that state is called kiirtana. Therefore, it is the scriptural direction not to sing any song after kiirtana, because other music is within the scope of aesthetic science and kiirtana comes within the scope of mohana vijiṋána.
ZH_TEXT: 當他們立足於超美學(Ati Nandan Vijiṋána)之境時將會是如何呢？所有世俗音樂均皆止息，不管是什麼曲調以及舞蹈藝術等等，不論是什麼全部都終止了，在那個情況下，只有法喜充滿(Bhávibhora)，那時候的音樂稱為「對至上聖名的唱頌」(Kiirtana)。 因此，經典上指示我們在唱頌至上聖名之後不應再唱其他任何歌曲，因為其他的音樂皆屬美學領域之物，而至上聖名之唱頌則來自於超美學的範疇。
IT_TEXT: Che cosa accade quando si è stabiliti nella scienza supra-estetica (atinandana vijñāna)? tutta la musica legata all’esperienza estetica perde significato. Tutti i rāga e le rāginī, e l’arte della danza, qualunque esse siano, cessano. In quello stato rimane soltanto una condizione estatica (bhāvibhora). La musica di quello stato è chiamata kīrtana. Perciò, la tradizione spirituale raccomanda di non cantare alcun altro canto dopo il kīrtana, perché le altre forme musicali rientrano nell’ambito della scienza estetica, mentre il kīrtana appartiene alla sfera del mohana vijñāna.

EN_TEXT: Your every action should be with Parama Puruśa. Without Him, your actions are as nothing, no matter how great they may seem. Yet if you do even a little with Him, you will have done a lot. He is like the number one, your actions are like zeros. If you take the One (1) first and to that One perform your actions, it is like adding zeros to the 1.
ZH_TEXT: 你的每一個行動都應有至上意識，沒有祂，你的行動無論看起來多麼偉大，事實上一無是處。即使你只做了一點小事，但如果那個行動有祂，那麼這就是件大事。祂像數字一，你的行動像數字零，如果把一放在前頭，然後再行動，就好比在一之後加上許多零。

EN_TEXT: Your every action should be with Parama Puruśa. Without Him, your actions are as nothing, no matter how great they may seem. Yet if you do even a little with Him, you will have done a lot. He is like the number one, your actions are like zeros. If you take the One (1) first and to that One perform your actions, it is like adding zeros to the 1, it is like multiplying by ten with each action. But if that One is not there, your zeros are added to each other and the net result can only be zero. So go on multiplying; let not all be zero. You have taken a human form to realize Him, let not your life be wasted.
ZH_TEXT: 你的每一個行動都應有至上意識，沒有祂，你的行動無論看起來多麼偉大，事實上一無是處。即使你只做了一點小事，但如果那個行動有祂，那麼這就是件大事。祂像數字一，你的行動像數字零，如果把一放在前頭，然後再行動，就好比在一之後加上許多零，如此你每加一個行動，就如同乘以十。反之如果沒有將一放在前頭，你加再多的零，結果仍是零。 所以不要讓你的行動變成都是零，你應讓它不斷相乘。你已取得人的肉身來了悟祂，不要白白浪費了生命。
IT_TEXT: Ogni vostra azione dovrebbe essere compiuta con Parama Puruśa. Senza di Lui, le vostre azioni non valgono nulla, per quanto grandi possano sembrare. Ma se fate anche una sola cosa insieme a Lui, avrete già fatto moltissimo. Lui è come il numero uno; le vostre azioni sono come degli zeri. Se mettete l’Uno (Parama Puruśa) davanti a tutto e lasciate che sia Lui a compiere le vostre azioni, allora ogni cosa che fate è come aggiungere uno zero dopo l’uno: il valore cresce sempre, si moltiplica per dieci a ogni nuova azione. Ma se quell’Uno non c’è, i vostri zeri si sommano tra loro e il risultato non può che essere zero. Dunque continuate a “moltiplicare”: non lasciate che tutto sia zero. Avete preso una forma umana per realizzarlo: non permettete che la vostra vita venga sprecata.

EN_TEXT: In each and every human being there is a sense of existence in the innermost cavity of the mind. All the worldly clashes and struggles, all the subtle ideas and thoughts centre around this existential “I” feeling. “Because he has insulted me I seek revenge.” Everything centres around this “I” feeling. “I am good, but heʼs bad.” It is all the result of that small “I”. If the small “I” is good, the world is automatically good. The part of the mind in which the “I” resides is called “guhá”. Here “guhá” does not mean a mountain cave but that innermost cavity within the human mind where the seer “I” lies hidden. And this seeing or witnessing entity of the small “I” is the very root of dharma. Who lies hidden in that innermost cavity of the existential “I” feeling? Parama Puruśa, of course. All the entities of this world are sheltered in Him.
ZH_TEXT: 每個人心靈深處皆有一種「我存在著」的感覺。從一切世俗的衝突、掙扎到所有精細的思想觀念都圍繞著這個存在的「我覺」。「他侮辱我，我要報復」等等一切的一切都環繞著此「我覺」。「我是好人，他是壞人」，全都是那個「小我」作用的結果。假使每個「小我」都是好的，那麼世界自然都是好的。心靈中，「我」存在的那部分稱為guhá，在此，guhá非指山洞，而是意指人類心靈的最深處，即「見證之我」所隱藏之處。而此小我的「目證本體」是法性的根源。隱藏於存在的「我覺」中最深處者為誰？當然是至上意識。世上萬事萬物均以祂為庇護。

EN_TEXT: As everything is within His psychic body so He is the real Supreme Controller of everything. He is Consciousness – Bliss Absolute. All mental feelings are either pleasant or painful. When the mind remains associated with any object for a long time we call that state “happiness” and when it is repulsed by any absent (while is characteristically inimical) for long, we call such a state sorrow. When the mind is neither concerned with the feeling of happiness nor with that of sorrow, it ceases to exist. In such a state here remains only an objectless soul, when the soul revels in the happiness of the soul. That is why He is the self-same Consciousness – the Bliss Absolute – the ever-blissful Spirit.
ZH_TEXT: 一切事物都在祂的心智體內，所以祂是一切事物真正的至上控制者。祂是意識──純然的喜悅。所有心理上的感受不是快樂就是痛苦。當心靈長時間盤踞在某些東西上，我們稱此種狀態為快樂，當它長時間排拒某些事物（當它具有敵對不友好的特性時）我們稱這種狀態為悲傷。當心靈既無痛苦也無快樂的覺受，它就停止存在。這種狀態只剩下空無一物的靈魂，那時，靈魂沈浸在它的喜悅裡。這就是為何祂與意識──神性的喜悅──永恆喜悅的靈魂是同一的。

EN_TEXT: This endeavour to liberate the unit consciousness from the unit mind, the base of all relativities, is what is termed sádhaná. The propensity through which one expresses oneʼs psychic power depends in most cases (except in the case of original actions) on the influence of physical constitution, education and the environment. Hence, to maintain purity of the psychic propensities, the purity of the body, the reactive momenta and the environment is crucial.
ZH_TEXT: 個體心靈是所有相對因素產生的根基，將個體意識從個體心靈中解脫出來的努力，就是『靜坐修持』。表達個體心智情緒傾向的習性，絕大部分受到身體、教育以及環境的影響。因此，要維持心理習性的純淨，身體、業力和環境的淨化非常重要。

ZH_TEXT: 沒有人生來就是卑賤的，也沒有人生而為了悟的婆羅門。只有行為卑劣之人才是卑賤的。如果能在一切有限的事物中看見無限的本體，並循此而行，必成了悟之人，他們將立足於圓滿的知識裡。

EN_TEXT: That which removes human afflictions is called artha. As the pangs of hunger are removed by food, the means of procuring food is called artha. The pain of disease is alleviated by medicine, hence the means of procuring medicine is called artha. Artha, however, cannot bring permanent relief to pain and miseries. Hunger removed today will return tomorrow; a disease cured today may strike again tomorrow. Artha cannot guarantee permanent security or lasting happiness. But in Brahma, the Entity who liberates one from all mundane ailments and the cycle of rebirth, lies the total cessation of all afflictions, the freedom from all ailments. He is the only dependable panacea for microcosmic distortions and imperfections; there is none other than Him – Nányah panthá vidyate ayanáya.
ZH_TEXT: 能解除人類痛苦者謂之為『阿塔』(artha)。食物可以解除飢餓的痛苦，因此得到食物的方法就被稱為『阿塔』;藥物可以解除疾病的痛苦，所以同樣的，得到藥物的方法即是『阿塔』。然而『阿塔』不能為你的痛苦帶來永遠的解脫，今天你吃飽不餓了，明天飢餓仍將降臨；今天你痊癒了，明天可能又遭受相同疾病的攻擊。『阿塔』無法保證永恆的快樂和安全。但至上意識能夠解脫眾生於無邊的世俗苦難中，祂能夠讓你不再生死輪迴，因為祂能停止所有的苦難，讓你免於所有的病痛。祂是扭曲的小宇宙個體唯一可依賴的萬應靈藥，除祂之外別無其他實體(Nányah panthá vidyate ayanáya)。

EN_TEXT: Renunciation does not mean giving up everything and going into seclusion. It is not an escapist tendency. Fundamentally it means not to be influenced by any colour. It can be compared with certain fishes who live in the muddy depths of ponds and yet never get smeared with mud. This psychic attitude is called vaerágya. When is one established in such a psychic feeling? When one realizes that those objects whose colours have so far influenced you, are not at all permanent. Visible today, they will disappear tomorrow. One realizes, “If I allow them to influence my mind today, I will feel acute pain when they disappear in future. So, in no stage of my life should I allow the colours of those objects to influence my mind.”
ZH_TEXT: 不執著並非棄絕一切離群索居，不是遁世的傾向，基本上指的是：不為任何顏色所影響，有種居於水塘污泥而不為泥巴所染污的魚類差可比擬，此種心態稱為不執著。這種心理覺受何時產生呢？當人了悟到那些深深影響他的顏色客體是如此無常而非永恆，今天得見，明日或許消失，了悟到「如果今天讓這些東西來影響我的心靈，那麼將來它們消失時我必承受那種無比錐心之痛。所以，在生命中不論身處何境，我都不會讓那些顏色客體來影響我的心靈。」

EN_TEXT: The only way to progress is to take shelter in satya (supreme truth) – there is no other way. Nothing can be built on the weak foundation of falsehood. And the life of one who has resorted to falsehood, however learned or wealthy he or she might be, will definitely be fruitless. EN_TEXT: What should we ask from Parama Puruśa? Let us pray to Him that we never forget Him, that we always remain united with that Supreme Benevolence. Let Him arouse unwavering ideation in us. “Smrti” means “memory” or “recollection” and “dhruvásmrti” means “constant recollection” of Him. One should always remember one thing constantly: Parama Puruśa. This will result in the intellect being constantly full of benevolent thoughts, forever linked with the spirit of benevolence. This and this alone should be the one prayer of human beings.
ZH_TEXT: 我們應向至上意識要求什麼呢？讓我們向祂祈求永遠不會忘記祂，如此我們將永遠與至上的慈悲結合，祈請祂喚起我們堅定的理念。Smrti意指「記憶」或「回憶」，而dhruvásmrti意指「持續不斷憶念著祂」。人應永遠不斷地記得至上意識，這樣聰明才智將充滿源源不絕的慈悲心，才能永遠與至上慈悲大愛連結，此是人類唯一應祈求的。

EN_TEXT: Let us analyse the qualities that are present in both Parama Puruśa and His created entities. The Saḿskrta word Iishvara is derived from the root verb lish + suffix varac. The root verb iish means “to control.” Hence the word Iishvara literally means “controller”. In this universe each and every object whether big or small or middle has a controller. This rule applies universally to all objects, from the tiniest molecule to the universe. However, Parama Puruśa is the Supreme Controller, and His created microcosms are the controlled entities. In the mundane world, human beings can never control their own activities because human capacity is extremely limited. For instance, even a second before oneʼs death one cannot know of the impending death. But Iishvara, the Controlling Entity, has absolute power of control: there is none to oversee or supervise His activities. Just as the owners of a house can remove the tenant if they so desire, according to necessity they may issue a notice for the tenant to vacate the house. Of course the tenant may go to the court for help, but Iishvara, if He so desires, may snatch away this human body, whose true owner is not the human being but Iishvara Himself. Human beings can at the very most utilize their bodies; but if Iishvara takes away this body, human beings have nothing to say about it, for as they are controlled entities, they have no alternative but to surrender to the Supreme Controller Iishvara. Therefore it is logical that when Iishvara controls everything Himself, in that case His created microcosms have no freedom. Of course in the kingdom of Parama Puruśa, a certain amount of freedom is granted to the microcosm. For instance, if any human being sitting in the kingdom of the Lord criticizes Parama Puruśa, He does not become angry, nor does He admonish His critic. This much freedom is granted to the microcosms. But at the same time it should be remembered that the capacity, the strength of the microcosm to criticize Parama Puruśa comes from none other than Parama Puruśa Himself. The microcosms criticize Parama Puruśa with the energy allotted to them by Him. Now what sort of attitude should the microcosms adopt towards the Supreme Controller, Parama Puruśa?... The controlling power of Parama Puruśa is truly a unique force, a magic power. When an expert magician creates a living pigeon out of a clod of earth, the spectators become wonderstruck to see it. In reality that earth is not actually transformed into a pigeon, but the spectators seem to see with their eyes that the soil is being transformed into a living, flying pigeon. What is the secret behind this phenomenon? And who knows this secret, whether the clod of earth really became a pigeon at all? In fact this secret is known only to the magician and his inveterate followers and no one else. With a similar kind of magic power, Parama Puruśa has been continuing His creation. Now if anyone desires to know the inner secrets of that magic power, what should be done? The answer is to establish a relationship of love with the magician Himself. One will have to enlist oneself in the inner circle of His followers. Then the Controller of this universe, because of His intimate relationship with that person, will disclose the secret of His controlling power. So one can know the secret from Parama Puruśa only through the closest proximity to Him, and not through any struggle with Him.
ZH_TEXT: 讓我們來分析至上意識和祂的創造物間同時都存在的特質。Iishvara這個梵文字是由動詞字根lish加上字尾varac所組成。Iish意為「控制」，因此Iishvara在字面上指的就是「控制者」。在這世上的每一個大大小小的物體都有一個控制者，此一原則適用於一切物體，從最微小的原子以至最大的宇宙皆然。而至上意識是最高的控制者，祂所創造的萬有都是受到祂控制的實體。在此塵世，人類其實沒有控制自身活動的任何能力，因為他們的能力非常有限。比方說人在死前一秒可能都還不知道自己即將死亡。但至上的控制主擁有絕對的控制能力，沒有任何人可以監控祂。 就像房東，只要他想要，他可以隨時讓房客走人，若有需要，他可以通知房客搬家而空出房子。當然，房客或許會求助於法院，但對至上控制主而言，只要祂願意，祂可以隨時取走這個人的肉身，因為此一肉身真正的所有人是至上控制主，而非此一個人。人類頂多就只有善用這個肉身，但萬一至上控制主要取走它，人類是沒有置喙的餘地，因為他們是受控制的實體，他們別無選擇只能臣服於至上的控制主。 因此，當至上的控制主掌控一切時，祂的創造物，即個體小宇宙，是沒有自由可言的。當然在至上意識的國度裡，祂會惠予個體小宇宙些許自由。例如，有人坐在至上意識的國度裡，卻恣意批評至上意識，但祂不會因此而生氣，也不會抹除個體小宇宙對祂的批評。像這樣的自由，個體小宇宙是被允許的。但你要記得，個體小宇宙所擁有的批評能力和力量，也正是從祂而來。是祂給予個體小宇宙批評至上意識的能量。 那麼個體小宇宙對至上的控制主應該抱有什麼樣的態度？…… 至上意識的控制力量的確是不可思議的神奇力量。當專業的魔術師從土塊變出一隻活生生的鴿子時，觀眾個個目瞪口呆，直呼驚訝。事實上，並非真的是土塊變成了鴿子，而是觀眾的眼睛好像看見了這種情形。此一現象背後的秘密何在？誰知曉這個秘密？到底土塊有沒有真的變成了鴿子呢？這個秘密只有魔術師自己和參與演出的伙伴知道，其他人都不知道。 至上意識有類似的魔術技巧，祂以其神奇的力量繼續維持祂整個造化遊戲。如果有人想要知道其中的奧秘，他應該怎麼做呢？他應該與這位偉大的魔術師建立一種愛的聯結。他必須讓自己成為祂的伙伴，進入祂的伙伴圈內。那麼由於和宇宙的控制主有親密的關係，祂將讓該人知道祂控制的奧秘。所以，一個人唯有與至上意識保持親密的關係，才會知道祂的秘密，若與祂一直是鬥爭的關係，則無由得知。
IT_TEXT: Analizziamo le qualità che sono presenti sia in Parama Puruśa sia nelle entità da Lui create. La parola sanscrita Iishvara deriva dalla radice verbale iish + il suffisso varac. La radice verbale iish significa “controllare”. Perciò la parola Iishvara significa letteralmente “controllore”. In questo universo ogni singolo oggetto, grande, piccolo o medio, ha un controllore. Questa regola si applica universalmente a tutti gli oggetti, dalla più piccola molecola all’universo intero. Ma Parama Puruśa è il Controllore Supremo e i microcosmi da Lui creati sono le entità controllate. Nel mondo materiale gli esseri umani non possono mai controllare le proprie attività, perché la capacità umana è estremamente limitata. Per esempio, neppure un secondo prima della propria morte un individuo può sapere che sta per morire. Ma Iishvara, l’Entità che controlla, possiede un potere di controllo assoluto: non c’è nessuno che sovrintenda o supervisioni le Sue attività. Così come i proprietari di una casa possono decidere di mandar via l’inquilino — che comunque ha il diritto di rivolgersi al tribunale per chiedere aiuto — allo stesso modo Iishvara, se così desidera, può strappare via questo corpo umano, di cui è il vero proprietario. Ma, a differenza dell’inquilino, l’essere umano non ha alcun tribunale a cui appellarsi: in quanto entità controllata, non può far altro che arrendersi al Controllore Supremo. Di conseguenza, dal momento che tutto è controllato da Ishvara, i microcosmi da Lui creati non hanno libertà. Ma, nel regno di Parama Puruśa, al microcosmo è concessa una certa libertà. Per esempio, un essere umano che sta nel regno del Signore, può criticare Parama Puruśa, senza che questi si arrabbi né lo rimproveri. Questa misura di libertà è concessa ai microcosmi. Allo stesso tempo bisogna ricordarsi che la capacità, la forza del microcosmo di criticare Parama Puruśa proviene da Parama Puruśa stesso e non da altri. I microcosmi possono criticare Parama Puruśa con l’energia che Lui stesso concede. Ora, quale tipo di atteggiamento dovrebbero adottare i microcosmi verso il Controllore Supremo, Parama Puruśa? Il potere di controllo di Parama Puruśa è davvero una forza unica, un potere magico. Quando un mago esperto fa comparire un piccione vivo da un grumo di terra, gli spettatori restano stupefatti. Anche se si sa che c’è un trucco, agli occhi degli spettatori sembra che il mucchietto di terra si sia trasformato in un piccione vivo e capace di volare. Qual è il segreto dietro questo trucco? Chi conosce questo arcano? Il mucchietto di terra è davvero diventato un piccione? Ma queste risposte sono conosciute solo dal mago e dai suoi seguaci più intimi; da nessun altro. Con un potere magico simile, Parama Puruśa continua la Sua creazione. Chi volesse conoscere gli intimi segreti di quel magico potere cosa dovrebbe fare? La risposta consiste nello stabilire una relazione d’amore con il mago stesso. Bisogna entrare a far parte del suo intimo circolo di seguaci. Solo allora il Controllore di questo universo, grazie alla Sua relazione profonda con quella persona, rivelerà il segreto del Suo potere di controllo. Pertanto solo attraverso questa intima e profonda relazione con Lui - non certo lottando con Lui - è possibile conoscere  il Suo segreto.
