EN_TEXT: The highest kind of kevalá bhakti, the highest kind of non-attributional devotion. Here the devotee says, “I serve Him, I worship Him, because I want Him to get bliss from my devotion or service or worship. I donʼt want anything for myself. I want Him to enjoy the bliss.” This type of devotion is called rágátmiká bhakti, and the type of devotee having this sort of non-attributional devotion is called a gopa. There are people who have a mistaken idea that gopa means “cowherd”. Actually, Gopáyate yah sa gopah – in Sanskrit, the word gopáyate means to give pleasure – “A gopa is one who gives pleasure to Parama Puruśa, one whose very nature is to give pleasure to Parama Puruśa.”
ZH_TEXT: 最高境界的絕對虔誠(kevalá bhakti)。此處虔誠者會說：「我為祂服務，我禮敬祂，因為我想祂能從我的虔誠或服務中得到喜悅。我不為自己要求任何東西。我希望祂能享受喜悅。」這種虔誠稱為拉嘎密卡虔誠(rágátmiká bhakti)，具有這種絕對虔誠的虔誠者稱為「勾帕」(gopa)。 有些人有錯誤的觀念認為「勾帕」意指「牧牛者」。事實上，Gopáyate yah sa gopah──在梵文裡gopáyate這個字意指「給予快樂」──「勾帕」是一個將快樂給予至上意識的人；一個人想要「把快樂給予至上意識」，具有這種特質之人即稱為「勾帕」。

ZH_TEXT: 生命理念目標梵咒有其殊勝的音根節奏，每一個梵咒都有其特有的音根節奏，靈性修持者個體的波流韻律，必須時時與生命理念目標梵咒的音根節奏保持接觸，也就是說，修行之人應努力保持個體的波流與梵咒的波流一致，當他已立足於此時，即達到了有屬性之至上合一境界。

EN_TEXT: I will say something regarding the necessity of devotion (bhakti) in the path of spiritual cult. Everybody knows that jiṋána (knowledge), karma (action) and bhakti (devotion) are the three aides for progress along the path of spirituality. A jiṋánii (person of knowledge) reaches near the goal but yet a little distance remains in between. A karmii (person of action) reaches nearer the goal but even then a little gap remains. A bhakta (person of devotion) reaches right to the goal. The jiṋánii has to repent ultimately that he or she wasted a long life on dry discourses of knowledge and could not fulfil their mission. Karmiis too, repent likewise. They think that they worked and reached nearer to the goal but could not achieve the same. There is no repentance in the minds of the bhaktas, however, because their minds are always full of bliss. They neither feel exalted nor humiliated. There is nothing else in their minds except bliss, the unbroken flow of happiness (ánanda), and therefore they remain unaffected by pain and pleasure.
ZH_TEXT: 說到虔誠在靈性修持法門上的必要性，每個人都知道知識、行動與虔誠是靈性道路上進步的三個助力。知識份子藉由知識接近其目標，但他與目標之間仍有些許距離；行動家雖以行動與目標更接近，但與目標之間還是有些許隔閡；而虔誠者直接達到目標。知識份子終究要後悔自己浪費了漫長的生命在知識的枯燥說教上，卻無法完成使命；行動家也將同樣的悔恨，雖自己認為因行動而更接近目標，但仍舊不能達到目標；然而，在虔誠者的心中了無遺憾悔恨，因為他們總是喜悅洋溢，既不覺得尊貴優越，也不覺得自卑屈辱，心中除了永不間斷的喜悅波流外，沒有其他東西，絲毫不為痛苦與快樂所影響。
IT_TEXT: Dirò ora qualcosa sulla necessità della devozione (bhakti) nel cammino della pratica spirituale. Tutti sanno che jiṋána (conoscenza), karma (azione) e bhakti (devozione) sono i tre strumenti per progredire sul sentiero della spiritualità. Un jiṋánii (chi segue la via della conoscenza) giunge vicino alla meta, ma resta ancora una piccola distanza. Un karmii (chi segue la strada dell’azione) arriva ancora più vicino alla meta, ma anche in questo caso rimane un lieve scarto. Un bhakta (chi pratica la devozione), invece, giunge direttamente alla meta. Il jiṋánii, alla fine, deve pentirsi di aver sprecato una lunga vita in aridi discorsi di conoscenza senza riuscire a compiere la propria missione. Anche i karmiis si pentono allo stesso modo: pensano di aver lavorato e di essersi avvicinati alla meta, ma di non essere riusciti a raggiungerla. Nella mente dei bhaktas, invece, non c’è pentimento, perché la loro mente è sempre colma di beatitudine. Essi non si sentono né esaltati né umiliati. Nella loro mente non vi è altro che beatitudine, il flusso ininterrotto della felicità (ánanda), e per questo restano imperturbati di fronte al dolore e al piacere.

EN_TEXT: Devotees feel alike whether in heaven or in hell. In heaven they are with Viśńu, Náŕayańa, Parama Puruśa and are happy. If perchance they go to hell, the Cosmic Entity is also there. There is no place in this universe where He is not present. If they go to hell, Náráyańa cannot live alone in heaven. He will also have to be in hell to entertain His devotees. So if devotees go to hell they are also with Paramátmá and dance, sing and do kiirtana. Their minds remains full of bliss. They are completely apathetic and indifferent towards pleasure and pain, good name and bad name in the external world. Only the devotees can say that these carry no value. Those who are devoid of devotion, even if they work conscientiously, shall remain aloof from Parama Puruśa and ultimately they will have abhorrence for work. While doing hard penance the minds of such people will not be with Parama Puruśa. Instead, their minds will be thinking about the hardship faced during the penance.
ZH_TEXT: 虔誠者不論在天堂或地獄其感覺是相同的。他們在天堂裡與唯識努、那拉衍那、至上意識同處而覺得快樂，如果不巧他們下了地獄，那麼宇宙本體也在那兒。宇宙中沒有任何地方是沒有祂的，如果他們下了地獄，那拉衍那不能獨自住在天堂裡，祂也必須留在地獄來使其虔誠者快樂，所以如果虔誠者下了地獄，亦與至上意識同在，他們一起唱歌、跳舞，從事對上主聖名的唱頌，心靈中仍然充滿著喜悅，只有虔誠者能說外在世界的痛苦與快樂、美名與惡名毫無價值，因為他們完全無動於衷。缺乏虔誠的人，縱然老實地努力付出行動，仍將遠離至上意識，最後對所從事的行動產生厭惡之心。當他們在從事艱難的苦行時，他們的心靈並未與至上意識同在，反之卻只想著苦行時所面對的艱辛。
IT_TEXT: I devoti provano lo stesso sentimento sia in cielo sia all’inferno. In cielo sono con Viṣṇu, Nārāyaṇa, Parama Puruṣa e sono felici. Se per caso vanno all’inferno, anche lì è presente l’Entità Cosmica. Non esiste alcun luogo in questo universo in cui Egli non sia presente. Se i devoti vanno all’inferno, Nārāyaṇa non può restare da solo in cielo: anche Lui dovrà essere all’inferno per stare con i Suoi devoti. Così, se i devoti vanno all’inferno, sono comunque con Paramātmā e danzano, cantano e fanno kīrtana. Le loro menti restano colme di beatitudine. Essi sono completamente distaccati e indifferenti al piacere e al dolore, alla buona fama e alla cattiva fama nel mondo esterno. Solo i devoti possono dire che queste cose non hanno alcun valore. Coloro che sono privi di devozione, anche se lavorano coscienziosamente, rimarranno lontani da Parama Puruṣa e, alla fine, proveranno avversione per il lavoro. Durante una pratica particolarmente austera, la mente di tali persone non sarà con Parama Puruṣa; al contrario, sarà assorbita dalle difficoltà affrontate nel corso della pratica.

EN_TEXT: To serve Him with the purpose of making Him happy. The devotee feels happiness in His happiness. The greater devotees, however, think in a different way. EN_TEXT: Physical knowledge is like the leaf of a shala tree [a tall evergreen with large leaves] on which people take meals. As long as you have not eaten, there is a value in the leaf, but the moment you have finished your meal, the leaf goes into the dust bin to be licked by the street dogs. When you come to realize that this physical knowledge of yours is only worth licking by a dog, then devotion will arise in you. Then you will acquire true knowledge.
ZH_TEXT: 物質的知識好比盛食物的大葉子，在食物尚未食用前，這葉子還有些許用處，一旦你吃完了，這葉子就沒有價值，只有丟進垃圾堆給狗去舔了。當你明白你所得的這些物質知識只有被狗舔的價值時，你心中才會升起虔誠的情懷。那時你才可能獲得真正的知識。

EN_TEXT: Maintaining a balanced mind is one of the greatest virtues. There are no complexes in a balanced mind. One neither feels inferior nor superior to others; one never fears anybody nor ever gets perturbed. One maintains a mental balance.
ZH_TEXT: 保持心靈的平衡是最偉大的美德之一：平衡的心靈沒有任何情結，既不覺得比別人拙劣，也不覺得比他人優越；不畏懼任何人，也不會煩擾不安。一直保持著精神的平衡。

EN_TEXT: In the field of spirituality there cannot be any complex, but there are complexes due to social defects. It is our spiritual duty to rectify the social order. If we fail, there may not be good spiritualists. Even those who have the potentiality to become good spiritualists may not progress. They may be like a flower that dies before it blossoms. I cannot allow this to happen. For this reason the theory of Prout has been given so that every person can progress speedily in the field of spirituality without any complex.
ZH_TEXT: 在靈性的領域裡不可能有任何情結，但由於社會的不健全而產生了情結，因此，匡正社會的秩序是我們靈性上的責任。如果我們未盡職責，則可能無法造就好的靈修者，甚至有潛力成為好的靈修者的人也可能不會進步，像一朵尚未綻放就枯萎的花朵。 我不能允許此事發生。為此之故，我提出進步利用論(PROUT)的學說，以便每個人都能在靈性的領域裡快速進步而沒有任何情結。

EN_TEXT: It is futile to engage in non-cardinal prayers. The cardinal human principles are acceptable to all. They touch the Infinite with the finite or rather they have a close relationship or a close link with mysticism; which is the never-ending endeavour to find a link between the finite and the Infinite. So in the case of cardinal prayer to some extent it is acceptable, but non-cardinal prayer is a mere waste of time. To say, “Oh God, give me this or that” is meaningless because your actual requirements are better known to Him.
ZH_TEXT: 從事於一般的祈禱徒勞無益。基本的人類法則為所有人所接受，人們以「有限」去接觸「無限」，甚至永無休止的努力去發現「有限」與「無限」之間的連結，也就是說與神秘主義有親密的連結。因此就祈禱而言，在某種程度上是可以被接受的，然而一般的祈禱就只是徒然浪費時間而已，一個人祈求道：「哦！上帝，給我這個或那個」是無意義的，祂比你更了解你真正的需要。

EN_TEXT: Microcosmic advancement requires some urge and it gets its food from the Macrocosmic Cause. So peopleʼs request or prayers should be on that issue only. For example, “Oh Parama Puruśa, guide my intellect unto the path of bliss.” In our Savitr Rk, which is commonly known as Gáyatrii Mantra, the prayers are for the development of the intellect or rather for the proper movement of the intellect.
ZH_TEXT: 個體小宇宙的前進需要某些驅策，並且從大宇宙致因之母處獲得食糧，所以人們的請求或祈禱亦應以此為主，例如：「哦！至上意識，請引導我的智力走上喜悅之路。」在吠陀的詩句裡，通常稱之為嘎雅翠禱頌(Gáyatrii Mantra)，該祈禱是為了智力的發展，更確切地說是為了智力的適當行進。

ZH_TEXT: 我告訴過你們，祂比你們自己更加了解你們的需求，你們並不知道你們真正的需要為何，而祂了解。在夜柔吠陀中亦曾有如下的祈禱文：「請引導我的智力走上喜悅之路。」

ZH_TEXT: 解脫是指從各種束縛中得到自由。主要的法門有三：知識法門、行動法門和虔誠法門（編註：分別強調明辨、無私的行動以及虔誠心。）。

EN_TEXT: Now, when one is in closest contact with Parama Puruśa, one becomes Parama Puruśa. Brahmavid Brahmaeva bhavati [“The knower of Brahma will become Brahma”]. So under such circumstances mukti has got no meaning, no importance. And with the help of Parama Puruśa, it will be a very easy job for one to liberate oneself from the binding influence, from the binding faculties of Paramá Prakrti.
ZH_TEXT: 當一個人與至上意識最親近時，他變成了至上意識本身。「了悟至上意識者成就自身為至上意識」(Brahmavid Brahmaeva bhavati)。所以在這種情況下，解脫就不再有意義了，也不再重要了。在至上意識的幫助下，要從造化勢能的束縛力量解脫出來即輕而易舉。

EN_TEXT: All powers come from God; whether it is physical, mental or spiritual. He is the owner; He is the master. This energy is the power of the Lord. The Lord grants these powers to those who are engaged in working for the welfare of others and are performing benevolent deeds. You will not have to ask for powers. You should leave this to the Lord.
ZH_TEXT: 不論是身、心、靈哪一方面的力量，一切皆來自於上主。祂是力量的主人、力量的擁有者。我們所擁有的能量都是屬於上主的力量，那些認真為其他人福祉而工作、從事善行之人，上主會將這些力量賜給他們。你們不必向祂要求，把一切交託給祂吧！

EN_TEXT: If you want to become powerful, you need not only ideology but also “Iśt́a”. Even for courage and efforts, you need the help of the Lord. You cannot say that it is not necessary to make more efforts because God will give according to oneʼs needs. This is correct, but we have to follow our ideology with effort and courage.
ZH_TEXT: 如果你想要變得強而有力，你不只要有理念，而且還要有「生命理念目標」(Iśt́a)。即使是勇氣和努力，你都需要有上主之助。你不可以藉口說上主會根據個人的需要給予力量就不更加努力。雖然說的確上主會根據個人的需要而給力量，但我們自己必須付出努力，並以十足的勇氣，來遵循我們的理念。

EN_TEXT: Devotees never complain because they know that the Lord is with them always protecting them. You should remember that if you always sing “Bábá Náma Kevalam” , you have a family relationship with Him. More than that, you have a relationship of Love with Him.
ZH_TEXT: 虔誠者知道上主永遠與他們同在，一直在旁保護著他們，所以他們從不抱怨。你們要牢牢記住，只要永遠唱頌著Bábá Náma Kevalam，你們跟祂會一直保有家人的關係。更重要的是，你與祂會是一種愛的聯繫。

ZH_TEXT: 上主是所有一切的主人。祂創造了宇宙間所有的財富。

ZH_TEXT: Iśt́a這個字有多重含義。其中一個意義是「目標的實現」。換言之，藉著觀想持念祂，心中所有的悲傷和歹念皆一掃而空。

EN_TEXT: You have encountered hundreds of thousands of people who are non-Sádhakas – they will have to live thousands of lives. Those who are Sádhakas will live in eternity after this life. Parama Puruśa will always be with you. That means, neither were you alone in the past nor will you be alone in the future. Always remember that you are not helpless. He who is guiding the stars of the skies, is with you, you are not alone. Under no circumstances should you ever be afraid. Never think that you are alone. Whatever has to happen, will happen, and the One who causes this happening is with you.
ZH_TEXT: 你們曾經遇見成千上萬沒有從事靈性修持的人們，他們將再出生千百次，而那些從事靈性修持者在這一世過後就可以活在永恆裡。至上意識永遠與你們同在，意思就是說過去你們不孤單，而將來你們也不會孤單，永遠要記得你們不是無助的，祂所引導著的星辰正與你們同在，你們不會孤立無援，所以不論在任何情況，你們都不應感到害怕，永遠不要認為自己是孤單的，該發生的事就會發生，而使得這一切發生的那個人正與你們同在。

EN_TEXT: If people are to know anything they should only know the One who never leaves them. What is to be gained from knowing those other things which will finally drift away and be lost? “Yah ágacchati sah gacchati”. That which comes also goes away. If today something painful has entered in your life, do not be perturbed. This is the nature of the world. “Yah ágacchati sah gacchati.” What has come, will go. The pain which has come to you today, will leave you after some time. Similarly, if pleasure comes to you, do not lose your control over it, do not be egoistic, since whatever has come must go. The pleasures that come will not remain. Once, Emperor Akbar asked Birbal, his courtier, to say something which would make a happy man sorrowful, and a sorrowful man happy. Birbal replied, “This day shall not remain.” Whatever comes in this world, goes away. He alone, who neither comes nor goes, lives with you eternally.
ZH_TEXT: 如果人們想要了解任何東西，應該只了解那唯一永遠不會離開他們的，去了解那些終將漂走而失落的東西又能得到什麼呢？Yah ágacchati sah gacchati——已來者終將離去。如果今天某件事在你們的生命中造成錐心泣血的痛，不要被干擾，這是這個世界的本質，Yah ágacchati sah gacchati——已來者終將離去。今日來到你們身上的痛苦，過一些時候將離你們而去。同樣的，如果快樂找上門來，也不要失去控制的力量，不要自大，因為不管什麼東西，已來的必將離去，快樂不會長留。 以前阿卡巴(Akbar)皇帝要求他的朝臣波伯(Birbal)說出一件能使快樂的人悲傷，使悲傷的人快樂的事情來，波伯回答說：「不會永遠保有這種日子的。」來到此世界的任何東西終將離去，只有祂，無來亦無去，永遠與你們同在。

EN_TEXT: Dhiiras understand well that behind all anityas lies the nitya, the Transcendental Entity beyond the scope of time, space, and person. So they never run after anityas. This keeps their mind in a balanced state.
ZH_TEXT: 那些將外向性行動轉向內在追尋之人，知道在所有無常事物的背後存在的是永恆。在超越時間、空間、人物因素之上的是此一超覺之本體。是故他們不會追逐於短暫、無常之事物，這使得他們的心一直都處在平衡的狀態。

EN_TEXT: Devotion means to merge all the rivulets of sentiment into one. The purpose of sádhaná is to arouse devotion. Remember always that all your efforts should be aimed at arousing devotion. Devotion aroused, nothing remains. If even the most degraded person succeeds in awakening the agryábuddhi, that person becomes able to realize Him. Donʼt be disheartened. Remove the mist of doubt and be fearless.
ZH_TEXT: 虔誠意指將所有的情感融合為一。靈性修持的目的即是喚起你的虔誠心，你要永遠記住，你所有的努力就是為了要喚起內心的虔誠。只要虔誠心被喚起，就夠了。即使最墮落的人如果能成功地喚醒他內在「無上的覺知」(agryábuddhi)，他也能夠了悟至上意識。切勿氣餒，要勇敢撥開疑惑的迷霧，應無所畏懼！

EN_TEXT: Proper knowledge means to know what is what, which is which, how to do and why to do. But this alone is not enough; you will have to act according to the knowledge you have acquired. And last but not least, you will have to arouse the sentiment of devotion within you.
ZH_TEXT: 正確的知識意指懂得分別明辨、知道如何去做以及為何要做的原因。但是僅只如此是不夠的，你還必須要根據你所獲得的正確知識採取行動。最後也是同樣重要的一點，就是你必須喚起你內在的虔誠情懷。

ZH_TEXT: 各種客體之間形象上的差異都是外在的，其內在本質是一樣的。聰明之人只會追求這唯一的「一」，而不會追逐其他許多。那唯一的本體只能透過正確的知識、行動和虔誠來獲得。

EN_TEXT: The ideation before surrendering to Paramátmá is “Nivedayámicátmanam tvaḿ gati Parameshvara.” When the entity is in bondage it is jiiva, and when it is liberated from the bondage it is Shiva.
ZH_TEXT: 臣服於至上意識就是了悟自性、己身即至上意識。當一實體處於束縛時，稱為個體生命(jiiva);當從束縛中解脫時，稱為至上意識(Shiva)。

EN_TEXT: Those people are great who harbour no biases and who behave rationally both with those who abuse them give them pain and with those who give them happiness. Such people donʼt harbour any feelings of enmity towards anybody and take no-one as their enemy. They remain the same in pleasure or pain whether they have a positive reputation or negative reputation. They are unaffected and unassailed in all circumstances of praise or criticism, pain or pleasure. They attach no importance whatsoever to any of these things. They are meaningless for such people.
ZH_TEXT: 不懷成見並以理性、平等對待曾經侮辱他們或讓他們痛苦、快樂的人才是偉大的。這種人對誰都不具敵意，不把任何人當成敵人看待，不論在快樂或痛苦中，不管聲名之好壞均保持著平衡的心境。不受讚美、批評、痛苦或快樂的影響，心性不為所動，遇到任何事情皆不執著。讚美、批評、痛苦或快樂這一切對他們來說都是毫無意義的。

EN_TEXT: Everybody wants success; but they do not know what the secrets of success are. So Párvatii asked Shiva, “O Lord, what are the secrets of success?” Shivaʼs reply was, Phaliśyatiiti vishvásah siddherprathama lakśańam; Dvitiiyaḿ shraddhayá yuktaḿ trtiiyaḿ gurupújanam. Caturtho samatábhávo paiṋcamendriyanigrahah; Śaśt́haiṋca pramitáháro saptamaḿ naeva vidyate. –Shiva Saḿhitá [There are seven requirements for success in any mission.] The first is firm determination: “I must succeed.” The second is reverence. The third is guru pújá, or constant remembrance of oneʼs spiritual master. The fourth is equanimity of mind. The fifth is control of the senses. The sixth is a balanced diet. The seventh There is no seventh requirement.
ZH_TEXT: 每一個人都想要成功，但是你們卻不知道要怎麼樣才會成功。所以帕瓦蒂問希瓦這個問題：「哦，主啊！什麼是成功的秘訣？」 希瓦的答覆如下：Phaliśyatiiti vishvásah siddherprathama lakśańam; Dvitiiyaḿ shraddhayá yuktaḿ trtiiyaḿ gurupújanam. Caturtho samatábhávo paiṋcamendriyanigrahah; Śaśt́haiṋca pramitáháro saptamaḿ naeva vidyate. –Shiva Saḿhitá 「任何使命要能獲致成功，有七個要素。第一是堅定的決心：我一定要成功。第二是對生命的目標懷有無比的崇敬之心。第三是對古魯的禮敬，或者是對靈性上師永誌不忘。第四是平衡的心靈。第五是感官的控制。第六是營養均衡的飲食。第七是沒有第七個要素。」

EN_TEXT: In the psychic world Parama Puruśa has infinite power. All longings and thoughts are reflected on His mental mirror. Any action one performs, any thought one is trying to materialize, is immediately reflected on the vast mental mirror. One cannot keep anything secret from Him. If a small piece of stone is thrown into the vast ocean it creates tiny ripples on its smooth surface. This event, although trivial, does not remain unknown to the ocean. Even the least vibration created within the unit mind is immediately known to the Macrocosmic Mind, for the unit mind is within the vast Macrocosmic Mind.
ZH_TEXT: 在心智的世界至上意識擁有無限的權力。所有的渴望和思想都反映在祂心智的明鏡中。一個人一言一行都反映在祂浩瀚的心智明鏡中，沒有人可以秘密地從事任何事而不讓祂知道。在廣大的湖中投下一顆小石頭會在平靜的湖面產生漣漪，即使極其微小，但是湖水仍然知道。所以即使個體小宇宙所製造出來的波動非常微小，大宇宙心靈仍然立刻得知，因為個體心靈是在廣大的大宇宙心靈之中。

EN_TEXT: Innumerable waves are constantly emerging from the ocean only to merge back into the ocean itself. This universe is like an ocean of waves of bliss. Parama Puruśa is the nucleus of all these countless rhythmic waves. Innumerable microcosms are constantly rotating around this nucleus, and will continue their orbits until they finally become one with Him. Every movement has a rhythm, and every rhythm has a sound. The countless waves of this vast universe also have their respective sounds. The devotees say that Parama Puruśa is an embodiment of love. They say that out of His infinite love for the microcosms He eternally plays His sweet flute, vibrating this vast universe with its divine sound. When spiritual aspirants attain a certain degree of spiritual progress, they are able to hear that divine sound. This divine sound is called oṋḿkára. All the sound waves of this universe have their source in Him. They emanate from the point of beginninglessness to the point of endlessness, and will continue to emanate eternally.
ZH_TEXT: 海中湧現無盡的波浪只為回到海洋本身。此宇宙正如同喜悅波流之海，至上意識是所有這些充滿節奏的無盡波流之核心，無數的個體小宇宙繞著此一核心運轉不息，並將持續運行直到與祂合一為止。 每一個行動都有其節奏韻律，而每一節奏韻律都有其音聲，這浩瀚宇宙的無盡波流也都各有其音聲。虔誠者說至上意識是愛的化身，他們說因為祂對個體小宇宙有著無限的愛，所以祂不斷吹奏其甜美之笛音，以此神聖的音聲撼動這廣大無垠的宇宙。當靈性修持者達到靈性進展的某種特定程度時，他們就聽得見此一神聖音聲。此神聖的音聲即稱為「唵聲」(oṋḿkára)。宇宙間所有的音聲皆源自於祂，自無始之始到無終之終永恆持續不斷地散發著。
IT_TEXT: Innumerevoli onde emergono continuamente dall’oceano solo per ritornare a fondersi nell’oceano stesso. Questo universo è come un oceano di onde di beatitudine. Parama Puruṣa è il nucleo di tutte queste innumerevoli onde ritmiche. Innumerevoli microcosmi ruotano costantemente attorno a questo nucleo, e continueranno le loro orbite finché alla fine non diverranno una cosa sola con Lui. Ogni movimento ha un ritmo, e ogni ritmo ha un suono. Anche le innumerevoli onde di questo vasto universo possiedono i loro rispettivi suoni. I devoti dicono che Parama Puruṣa è un’incarnazione dell’amore. Dicono che, per il Suo infinito amore verso i microcosmi, Egli suona eternamente il Suo dolce flauto, facendo vibrare questo vasto universo con il suo suono divino. Quando gli aspiranti spirituali raggiungono un certo grado di progresso spirituale, diventano capaci di udire quel suono divino. Questo suono divino è chiamato oḿkára. Tutte le onde sonore di questo universo hanno la loro origine in Lui. Esse emanano dal punto della non-origine fino al punto della non-fine, e continueranno a emanare eternamente.

EN_TEXT: Any action that leads to oneʼs physical, psychic and spiritual well-being is called punya or a virtuous deed; and any action which leads to oneʼs physical, psychic and spiritual degeneration is called pápa or sin.
ZH_TEXT: 任何會為個人帶來身、心、靈全面性福祉的行為稱為「善行」(punya);而相反的會導致身、心、靈墮落的行為即稱為「惡行」、「罪業」(pápa)。
IT_TEXT: Ogni azione che conduce al benessere fisico, psichico e spirituale di una persona è chiamata punya, ossia azione virtuosa. Ogni azione che conduce alla degenerazione fisica, psichica e spirituale è chiamata pápa, ossia peccato.

EN_TEXT: You are following the path of sádhaná. Always remember that you must establish yourself in pure devotion and not formal devotion. And to become established in pure devotion you must perform virtuous deeds, practise spiritual sádhaná regularly, render selfless service to the world, and wage a relentless fight against wrongs and injustice. There is no room for cowardice. May you be victorious.
ZH_TEXT: 你們在靈性修持的道上前進，永遠要記得將自身立足在純淨的虔誠上，而非形式上的虔誠。要立足於純淨的虔誠，吾人必須從事美德善行、規律地靈性修持鍛鍊、為這世界付出無私的服務，並且與邪惡不公奮戰到底。你們沒有膽小懦弱的餘地！期盼你們的勝利！

EN_TEXT: Prakrti exercises Her influence on the human mind in fourteen ways. Some of these bondages are related to the external world, and the rest are related to the internal world, to the psychic world. There are six enemies (śad́aripu): attachment (káma), anger (krodha), avarice (lobha), infatuation (moha), vanity (mada), and jealousy (mátsarya). And the bondages related to the external world are eight in number (Aśt́apásha): hatred, doubt, fear, shyness, hypocrisy, pride of lineage, pride of culture, and inflated ego: Ghrńá shauńká bhayam lajjá jugupsá ceti paiṋcamii Kulaḿ shiilaiṋca mánaḿca Aśt́apásháh Prakiirttitáh. Because of these bondages, the microcosms are called jiiva. The Entity who has no such bondages is called Shiva. One who has attained that Entity is said to have attained the culminating point of existence: Páshabaddho bhavejjiivah páshamukto bhavecchivah.
ZH_TEXT: 造化勢能以十四種方式來影響人類的心靈。其中一些與外在世界有關，另外一些則與內在心靈世界有關。如內在六大敵人(śad́aripu):執著、憤怒、貪婪、癡迷、傲慢和妒忌；與外在世界相關的束縛共有八項(Aśt́apásha)，它們是：憎恨、懷疑、恐懼、害羞、虛偽、家系門第的虛榮、文化的虛榮和自我優越感。 Ghrńá shauńká bhayam lajjá jugupsá ceti paiṋcamii Kulaḿ shiilaiṋca mánaḿca Aśt́apásháh Prakiirttitáh。由於這些束縛，所以小宇宙被稱為「個體生命」(jiiva)。大宇宙本體沒有這些束縛，所以是宇宙意識(Shiva)。達到至上本體的人即意味著該個體已達到其存在的極致(Páshabaddho bhavejjiivah páshamukto bhavecchivah)。

EN_TEXT: Each and every human being and each and every living microcosm is moving around the nucleus of creation: the difference between them is that human beings are moving consciously and the non-human creatures are moving unconsciously. Just as human beige have a certain advantage because of their independent minds they have a disadvantage also. The disadvantage is that if they do not move towards Parama Puruśa consciously, then their movement may be towards crude physicality, towards animality. And the advantage they enjoy because of their independent will is that if they so desire, they can move towards their Goal with greater momentum. To make the best use of this advantage is an act of wisdom on the part of human beings. Thus human beings, who have such developed minds, should properly utilize their mental potentialities and moving with accelerated speed, reach closer to Parama Puruśa.
ZH_TEXT: 每個人、每個生命個體都繞著創造的核心在移動：其不同在於，人類是有自覺意識地行動，而生物是沒有自覺意識地行動。人類擁有一個獨立自主的心靈，這是他們的優點，同時也是一個缺點，那就是如果他們不努力朝向至上意識自覺地前進，就會導向於粗鈍的物質、朝向獸性。但優點是，因為他們享有獨立的自主意志，所以只要他們願意，便可以更大的動力朝向至上目標邁進。善用此優點是人類智慧的表現。因此，具有開展心靈的人類應好好地善用他們的潛能，以加速度前進，更接近至上意識。
IT_TEXT: Gli esseri umani, proprio in virtù della loro mente indipendente, dispongono di un certo vantaggio, ma portano con sé anche un limite: se non si dirigono consapevolmente verso Parama Puruśa, il loro movimento può orientarsi verso la grossolanità materiale, verso l’animalità. Il vantaggio di cui dispongono, grazie al libero arbitrio, è che, se lo desiderano, possono avanzare verso la loro Meta con maggiore slancio. Saper fare il miglior uso di questo vantaggio è segno di saggezza da parte dell’essere umano. Pertanto, gli esseri umani, dotati di una mente così sviluppata, dovrebbero utilizzare correttamente le proprie potenzialità mentali e, procedendo con velocità accelerata, avvicinarsi sempre più a Parama Puruśa.

EN_TEXT: People according to their respective physical and psychic pabula, are provided in their next life with the requisite physical bodies. Those who want to eat and drink beyond all proportion may be provided with pigsʼ bodies; in that case, they can eat as much as they like. Those who are very angry by disposition may be provided with buffaloesʼ bodies, so they can be as angry as they like. And those who long for the close proximity to Parama Puruśa, will attain a developed human frame, a sentient human body.
ZH_TEXT: 人們根據各自物質和心理的資糧而獲得下一世相應的肉身。那些吃喝無度的人或許會得到豬的身體；這樣他們就可以盡情地吃喝。個性易怒之人可能會得到野牛的身體，這樣就可以讓他盡情地發怒。而那些渴望與至上意識親近的人，則會得到開展的人身，一個悅性的身體。

EN_TEXT: Along with spiritual discussions, people should discuss psychic subjects and science as well. With more development of science a biological change shall occur, and with this biological change progress in Sádhaná shall be faster. So you should always encourage science and never discourage it.
ZH_TEXT: 人們在從事靈性討論的同時，也應該討論以心理與科學為主的問題。科學更加發展，生理上的改變亦隨之產生，而生理的變化發生後，人類在靈性修持上的進步將更加快速，所以你們不但不該阻絕科學的發展，更應不斷鼓勵科學的進步。

EN_TEXT: We say that human life is an ideological flow. Life should have an ideal, and when the movement is towards that ideal, we call it human. Where there is no ideal, nor any movement towards an ideal, we cannot call a life human in spite of any human appearance it may have. So appearance is not the criterion for recognizing humans. In fact we find some persons having more bestiality than the beasts themselves. Beasts do not wage world war. They do not inflict injury on the innocent. So where there is no ideology one becomes worse than a beast. Hence human life is an ideological flow.
ZH_TEXT: 我們認為人類的生命乃為一理念的波流。生命應有理想，當一個人的行動是朝著生命的理想前進，那麼他就可被稱為是個「人」。然而儘管擁有人的樣貌，但是生命沒有理想，也沒有朝向理想前進的行動，這個人就不能被稱為是個「人」。所以形貌不是評斷一個人是否為「人」的標準。有時候我們發現某些人甚至比動物本身還更具獸性。野獸還不至引發世界大戰，也不會傷及無辜。所以在沒有理念之處，人比野獸更野蠻。因此人類的生命是一理念的波流。

EN_TEXT: The proper way to attain salvation is to ideate on Brahma. In the absence of deep love and longing for Parama Puruśa one cannot attain salvation. The first and foremost attribute for liberation or salvation is the irresistible urge for God-realization. Exclusive devotion to Parama Puruśa is all that is needed; no external ritual has anything to do with liberation or salvation.
ZH_TEXT: 要獲得解脫最正確的方法就是「以至上意識為持念觀想的目標」，缺乏對至上意識深深的愛和渴望，人是無法得到解脫的。 解脫的第一要件是對了悟至上有無法抑制的強烈渴望。我們唯一所需要的就是對至上意識專一的虔誠，任何外在的儀式和解脫無絲毫關係。

EN_TEXT: Fire lies hidden in firewood. To produce fire you have to rub two pieces of wood together to create friction. Similarly the Supreme Cognitive Faculty lies covert in you. If you create friction in your mind by adhering to truth and performing penance, the fire of meditation will ignite within. This will make it easier for you to realize the dormant Cognitive Faculty.
ZH_TEXT: 火含藏在木柴中，你必須用力摩擦兩塊木柴才能取火。相同的，至上認知能力隱藏在你的內在裡，如果你能固守真理並努力修行讓心靈產生摩擦衝擊，禪定的火焰將於內在燃起，這會使你更容易了悟那潛藏的至上認知力。
IT_TEXT: Il fuoco rimane nascosto nella legna. Per produrlo, bisogna sfregare tra loro due pezzi di legno, generando attrito. Allo stesso modo, la Facoltà Cognitiva Suprema rimane nascosta dentro di te. Se crei attrito nella mente aderendo alla verità e praticando la disciplina spirituale, il fuoco della meditazione si accenderà dentro di te. Ciò renderà più facile realizzare la Facoltà Cognitiva che dimora latente in te.

EN_TEXT: I deliberately used the word parábhakti because there is another type of devotion called aparábhakti. When people beseech the Lord to fulfil all their selfish desires, this is called aparábhakti. “Oh Lord, I am your devotee, help me to pass my examination… Oh Lord, my daughter has attained marriageable age – help me to find a worthy suitor… Let the bridegroom be ideal, let me not spend much on the wedding…” This type of showy devotion that simply asks for mundane objects, is no devotion at all, because it demands everything except Parama Puruśa. Such devotees never say, “Oh Lord, be mine… I want You and only You.” They always say, “I want this, I want that.” In fact this is no devotion at all. When one asks only for Parama Puruśa, this is the true devotion, parábhakti.
ZH_TEXT: 我特意使用「至上虔誠」(parábhakti)這個字，因為有另一種虔誠稱為世俗的虔誠(aparábhakti)。他們向上主要求滿足他們的私慾，他們說道：「哦，主啊！我是您的虔誠者，請幫助我通過這次考試……;哦，主啊！我的女兒已屆適婚年齡，請幫我找到一個合適、理想的新郎，婚禮不要讓我花太多錢……。」等等，這種表面的虔誠，只不過是為了要求世俗之物，根本不是虔誠，因為他們想要除了至上意識之外的所有一切。這種虔誠者永遠不會說：「哦，主啊！請您為我所有，我只想要得到您，我只要您！」他們只會要這個要那個，其實這毫無虔誠可言。當一個人所渴望的就只是至上意識時，才能說具有真正的虔誠──「至上虔誠」。

ZH_TEXT: 你應該在內在這樣想：你是純淨無瑕的了悟者，你是至上意識的孩子。你應該想著自己就像是一個新生兒，未受到塵埃和罪惡的污染。

EN_TEXT: These bondages are of three types: physical, psychic and spiritual. The first category comprises all those bondages which concern time, space and person in this quinquelemental world. There are also psychic bondages, the various types of mental limitations and afflictions that arise due to our saḿskáras; and finally, there are the spiritual bondages. Human beings, through the cultivation of knowledge, become convinced that their nearest and dearest one is Parama Puruśa, that He is the soul of their souls. Yet even after this understanding, when we do not actually attain him within the scope of our realsation, then this painful sense of separation is spiritual bondage. That which brings about the permanent cessation of these three types of bondages is called Paramártha, the Supreme Good.
ZH_TEXT: 束縛有身、心、靈三種類型。各種在時、空、人物因素限制下的五大原素世界之諸多束縛即屬於身體層面的束縛。 心理層面亦存在著束縛，因為業力也會使我們心中產生各種心靈的侷限和痛苦。最後還有靈性層面的束縛。人類透過知識培養，了知到與他們最親近和最親密的是至上意識，祂是他們靈魂的靈魂。 可是儘管了解，但我們沒有實際了悟這項真理，沒有真正達到祂，這種與祂分離的痛苦就是靈性層面的痛苦。能夠帶來永遠停止身、心、靈三層面痛苦的就稱為「永恆的解脫」(Paramártha)，它就是至上福祉。

EN_TEXT: Those reflected faces in the mirror are the unit consciousnesses, and the real face is Parama Puruśa. When this reflection is stopped, the unit consciousness will also cease to exist, and the existential “I”-feeling of the microcosm will also cease to exist. But how to do this? The task of all the images in the mirrors is to rush headlong and merge themselves in the Supreme Entity. That is, the devotees must channelize their minds towards Parama Puruśa and stop all reflections forever.
ZH_TEXT: 鏡子中反映的臉龐是個體意識，那張真正的臉才是至上意識。當此種反映一旦停止，個體意識也就不復存在，個體小宇宙的存在我覺也將不復存在。如何做到這樣呢？鏡中的影像必須不斷前進，將自身融入於至上的本體裡。也就是說，虔誠的修持者必須將他們的心靈導向至上意識，永遠停止所有的反映。

EN_TEXT: Whatever might be the obstacles, the devotee must move on like a flying bird. True spiritual aspirants will never be frightened by any circumstances, for they are born warriors, ready to move on amidst all struggles. They will smash all obstacles relentlessly. This is the creed of their lives.
ZH_TEXT: 虔誠者不論遭遇到什麼樣的困難，他們都應該像飛鳥般不斷地前進。靈性的修持者面對任何情況永遠都不會被嚇到，因為他們是天生的勇士，早已準備好要在奮鬥中勇往直前。他們會毫不留情地粉碎所有障礙，這是他們對生命的信念。

EN_TEXT: What He will ask you for, you will hesitate to give; for He will ask for nothing less than your whole existence. Those who are prepared to give their all, even though they may be the most degraded sinners, become the full responsibility of Parama Puruśa, because they have surrendered themselves completely to Him. They have not given away fifteen annas, keeping one anna for themselves (there are sixteen annas in one rupee). Hence it is the moral responsibility of Parama Puruśa to care for such people.
ZH_TEXT: 祂所要的東西，你卻遲遲猶豫不想給，因為祂要的是你整個存在。那些已準備好將一切交給祂的人，就算他們可能是最惡劣的壞人，也會是至上意識的責任，因為他們已經將自身完全向祂臣服。不會要給15塊安那，卻偷偷留1塊安那給自己(1盧比=16安那)。因此，照顧這些人是至上意識的道德責任。

EN_TEXT: Now we should remember two things here. Whatever you see, whatever you do, whatever you perceive or conceive in this world, both in the world of inferences and also in the arena of quinquelementality, comes from the Nucleus; everything comes from Parama Puruśa. But some of those physical entities and inferential values we receive through certain media, and some we receive directly. What we receive through some medium is known as “prápta vastu” and what we receive directly from the Nucleus of the universe, what we receive from the Parama Puruśa is called “ápta vastu”. Now in this realm of spirituality, whatever we receive, we receive directly from Him, and not through any medium, and that is why the secrets of his spirituality are known as “ápta vákyam” and not “prápta vákyam”. Prápta vákyas come through different media, through different physical media, and that is why they may vary, or undergo metamorphosis. After their metamorphosis, they may come within the scope of relativity and undergo distortion. That is why these prápta vákyas or prápta vastus are not infinite, and therefore can never be, must never be the desiderata of human beings. The only thing that an aspirant wants from Him is ápta vákya and this ápta vákya is guru vákya, and this guru vákya is the mantramúlaḿ. It is the rudimental faculty behind all mantras.
ZH_TEXT: 我們應該記住兩件事情：不論你看見或做了什麼，亦不論你於形而上的世界及五大原素架構的物質世界上認知或理解了什麼，這所有的一切均來自於至上核心，一切均來自於至上意識，只是有些物質實體和精神價值是經由某些媒介而得到，而有些則是直接得自至上；透過媒介而得到的稱為prápta vastu，而直接來自宇宙核心──至上意識的稱為ápta vastu。在靈性上不管我們得到什麼，都是直接得自於祂，而非經由任何媒介，那就是為何靈性的秘密被稱為至上的話語(ápta vákyam)──內在自性真知，而非透過媒介之世俗知識(prápta vákyam)的原因。世俗的知識經由不同的媒介，不同的物質媒介而來，因此可能變形，而在相對的範疇裡更加扭曲，因此這些世俗知識或世俗之物並非無限，故永遠不可能也必須永遠不可以成為人類的目標。靈性渴望者唯一渴望的即是來自於祂的至上話語，而至上話語即古魯的話語，古魯的話語即梵咒，這才是隱藏在所有梵咒背後的原動力。
IT_TEXT: Dobbiamo ricordare due aspetti fondamentali. Tutto ciò che vediamo, facciamo, percepiamo o concepiamo – sia nel mondo mentale sia nel campo dei cinque elementi – trae origine dal Nucleo Cosmico, da Parama Puruśa. Tuttavia ciò che riceviamo da questa Fonte non giunge sempre allo stesso modo: alcune realtà le riceviamo attraverso dei mezzi intermedi, altre invece provengono direttamente dal Nucleo Cosmico. Ciò che riceviamo tramite un mezzo è chiamato 'prápta vastu'; ciò che riceviamo direttamente dal Nucleo Cosmico è chiamato 'ápta vastu'. Nel campo della spiritualità ciò che riceviamo proviene direttamente da Lui, non attraverso intermediari. Per questo i segreti della spiritualità sono chiamati 'ápta vákya' e non 'prápta vákya'. I prápta vákya arrivano attraverso diversi mezzi e quindi possono cambiare, trasformarsi o deformarsi. Per questo non sono infiniti e non possono essere l’obiettivo ultimo dell’essere umano. L’unica cosa che l’aspirante spirituale desidera veramente è l’ápta vákya – la parola ricevuta direttamente. E questo ápta vákya è Guru Vákya; questo Guru Vákya è la radice del mantra, la facoltà fondamentale dietro tutti i mantra.

EN_TEXT: Each and every mantra has the support of an acoustic root: and when that acoustic root strikes at the root of the coiled serpentine, it is aroused. This is called mantrágháta. After that this roused coiled serpentine moves with the force, or the stamina, it gets from the mantra. It moves towards the supreme positivity, and this movement is called mantra caetanya.
ZH_TEXT: 每一梵咒皆有其音根，當該音根撞擊盤繞的靈蛇時，它就被喚醒了，此即稱mantrágháta（神性潛能）。而此被喚醒的靈蛇藉著梵咒的力量向前移動，向著至高的正性前進，此前進的過程即稱為mantra caetanya（梵咒的覺醒）。
CITATION_EN: 2 December 1978 Evening, Madras | Diikśá and Initiation, Ánanda Vacanámrtam Part 6
CITATION_ZH: 1978年12月2日傍晚於Madras | 靈性的啟蒙─Diikśá | 喜悅甘露集卷3，P.134

EN_TEXT: Now this process of freeing a person from the fetters of pápa is divided into two sub-phases: mantrágháta and mantra caetanya. Mantrágháta means, as I have already told you, that each and every mantra has the support of an acoustic root: and when that acoustic root strikes at the root of the coiled serpentine, it is aroused. This is called mantrágháta. After that this roused coiled serpentine moves with the force, or the stamina, it gets from the mantra. It moves towards the supreme positivity, and this movement is called mantra caetanya. With the help of this mantrágháta and mantra caetanya, a spiritual aspirant is freed from all the mundane bondages, bondages both on the physical and on the psychic plane.
ZH_TEXT: 使人從負性反作用力的桎梏中解脫之過程可分為兩個階段：以梵咒喚醒沈睡的神性潛能(mantrágháta)及梵咒的覺醒(mantra caetanya)。我曾說過，以梵咒喚醒沈睡的神性潛能的意思為：每一梵咒皆有其音根，當該音根撞擊盤繞的靈蛇時，它就被喚醒了，此即稱為mantrágháta。而此被喚醒的靈蛇藉著梵咒的力量向前移動，向著至高的正性前進，此前進的過程即稱為mantra caetanya。藉著以梵咒喚醒沈睡的神性潛能及梵咒的覺醒，靈修者得以從所有世俗的束縛，身體和心理層面的束縛中解脫。

EN_TEXT: Everything lies coverted within the self. The Supreme Entity is also within your "I" feeling. [He] is with you, but you do not know Him. That is, the Supreme Entity is with you, but You cannot see Him. You cannot realize Him. Why? Because you are covered by, you are surrounded by, Máyá, the cimmerian darkness of Máyá. This diikśá, Tántrikii diikśá, is just like a torch. And by focusing the torch, you see your route through the darkness. That is why the first sub-phase is diipanii – diipanii means “showing the torchlight”. But no such thing is there in the term “initiation”. Diikśá gives the aspirant the route, the way, or rather the path, of bliss. It shows the path of bliss. And to show the path of bliss, light is required; and that light is also supplied by diikśá. This light is diipanii.
ZH_TEXT: 每件事物均隱含在其自我之中。至上本體也是在你的「我覺」裡。「祂」與你同在，而你並不知道。亦即，至上本體與你同在，但是你無法看到祂、無法了悟祂，為什麼呢？因為你被宇宙幻網(Máyá)的漆黑所覆蓋籠罩。而密宗靈性的啟蒙就像一把火炬，藉著火炬之光，使你在黑暗中看到了道路。這就是第一階段稱為diipanii的原因──diipanii的意思為展現火炬之光。但在英文裡的啟蒙initiation這個字裡就沒有這樣的意義。 靈性啟蒙給予靈修者喜悅的道路，然而要有光源才能指引出喜悅之路！而此光源亦來自於靈性啟蒙，此光源即為diipanii。
IT_TEXT: L’Entità Suprema non è lontana dall’essere umano, ma rimane non realizzata. Tutto è coperto all’interno del sé. Anche l’Entità Suprema è all’interno del tuo sentimento dell’“io”. Egli è con te, ma tu non Lo conosci. Vale a dire: l’Entità Suprema è con te, ma tu non riesci a vederlo. Non riesci a realizzarlo. Perché? Perché sei coperto, sei circondato da māyā, dall’oscurità profonda di māyā. Questa diikśā, il processo di iniziazione tantrica, è proprio come una torcia. E, orientando la torcia, vedi il tuo percorso attraverso l’oscurità. Ecco perché la prima sottofase è dīpanī: dīpanī significa “mostrare la luce della torcia”. Ma nulla di tutto ciò è contenuto nel termine “iniziazione”. La diikśā offre all’aspirante il percorso, la via, o meglio il sentiero della beatitudine. Essa mostra il sentiero della beatitudine. E per mostrare il sentiero della beatitudine è necessaria la luce, e questa luce è anch’essa fornita dalla diikśā. Questa luce è dīpanī.

EN_TEXT: Human life, you know, is a measured one. Human beings come here for a very short span. If during this short span one tries to go through all the scriptures it will take more than one thousand years? And one is only here for approximately one hundred years. So, going along the path of jiṋána is a mere waste of existence. And karma is infinite and the human structure is a finite one, with limited stamina and limited capacity. So the path of bhakti is not only harmless, but the wisest one and is the approach of the most cunning people. So my advice to you all is to move along the path of bhakti. It is the best route.
ZH_TEXT: 你們知道，人類的生命非常有限，人們來到世上只是短暫停留，如果一個人想在這段短短的時間裡博覽所有的經典，恐將花上一千年的時間！而一個人在世上約莫百年光陰，所以選擇知識之路只是徒然浪費生命而已。而相對於行動的無限，人身是如此有限，精力與能力均處處受限。所以只有虔誠之路不僅無害，並且是最聰明的途徑，它是明智者的選擇。沿著虔誠之路前進吧！它是最佳之途徑。

EN_TEXT: To the karmii, god is neither personal nor impersonal, but maintains a link between the two. So in the life of a karmii the frustration is less than in that of a jiṋánii. But in the life of a bhakta, god is a personal one, his or her own Father, the Soul of oneʼs own soul. So one is linked with oneʼs own goal and this link with oneʼs personal god is maintained forever and never gets distorted. That is why everybody will have to admit the fact that “Mokśa kárańasamagryaḿ bhaktireva gariyasii.”
ZH_TEXT: 對於行動家而言，神既不是個人的，也不是非個人的，而是在兩者間保持著某種連結，所以行動家的生命裡，其挫折比知識分子來得少。然而在虔誠者的生命裡，神是屬於個人的，是他自己的父親，是自己靈魂的靈魂，所以一個人與自己的目標連結在一起，這種與個人之神之間的連繫會永遠存在且不會扭曲，因此每個人都必須承認虔誠是通往究竟解脫的最佳途徑這個事實。

EN_TEXT: It is the characteristic of the mind to remain attached to one object at a time. It cannot remain attached to one object for a long period of time, nor can it remain objectless. As the mind has to select an object to maintain its existence, it would be wise to select the biggest, the best, the most lasting, and the most loving object. Parama Puruśa is the only such object.
ZH_TEXT: 心靈一次只能有一個目標，這是它的特性，它既不能沒有目標，也無法長期維持在一個目標上。既然心靈一定要有一個目標以維持其存在，那麼選擇最偉大、最好、最持久且最親愛的目標將是最明智的。唯有至上意識是符合上述條件的最佳對象。

EN_TEXT: Whenever you think that you are knowing some thing, in that very moment you should also remember that you are known by Him. That is, whatever you are seeing, He knows. Nothing remains secret or coverted for Him. What you have done, He knows. What you have thought, He knows, and what you will think, He knows. “Paramaḿ parastád vidám devam bhuvaneshamiid́yam.” So, if you are to know anything, you should know Him. Know one, know all. He knows all. So if you are in love with Him, by His grace, you will also know all.
ZH_TEXT: 無論何時當你認為你了解某事時，就在那一刻你也應記得你是被祂所了解的，亦即，你所看到的任何東西祂都知道，沒有任何東西對祂而言是秘密的或是可以隱瞞的，你所做的事情祂都知道，你所想的，祂知道，而且你將想的，祂也知道。Paramaḿ parastád vidám devam bhuvaneshamiid́yam。 所以如果你想了解任何事情，你應該先了解祂。了解「一」就了解一切。祂了解一切。所以如果你愛祂，由於祂的恩典，你亦將了解一切。

EN_TEXT: The entity that vibrates the entire cosmos, that creates different expressions through different pulsations is a deva. Wherever there is movement there is creation. Wherever there is movement there are light waves, sound waves, and so many waves of inferences. And those expressions of inferences are devas, and Parama Puruśa is the controller of all those vibrations, all those manifestations, all those devas. Hence He is Mahádeva.
ZH_TEXT: 使整個宇宙振動，經由不同的脈動，而產生不同顯現的實體即為deva。任何有活動之處即有創造。任何有活動之處就有光波、音波以及許多微波元素的波動。那些微波元素的顯現為神(devas)，而至上意識為所有波動、所有顯現、所有神之主宰。因此祂是大神(Mahádeva)。

EN_TEXT: During meditation you should remember that the Supreme Entity looks on you, sees you as His object. He is not your object, you are His object. Do you follow? “Vidáma Devaḿ bhuvaneshamiid́yam” – that Deva, that Supreme Subjectivity, is to be adored by all, is to be loved by all, is to be accepted by all as the final culminating point of the different approaches of human life.
ZH_TEXT: 靜坐時，你應該記得至上本體注視著你，把你當成祂的客體看著你。祂不是你的客體，你才是祂的客體。你們了解我的意思嗎？Vidáma Devaḿ bhuvaneshamiid́yam──那個神，那個至上主體，是為一切人所禮敬的，是為一切人所摯愛的，是被所有的人做為生命中各種不同途徑的極致目標。

EN_TEXT: Life is a constant effort to restore an unstable equilibrium. Human beings endowed with enormous thinking power want to attain all-round development. To that end, along with the development of subtle thinking power, they will have to practice nivrttimúlaka sádhaná; they will have to strike a balance between the relative and subjective worlds. In the absence of such a balance, the process of thinking becomes disturbed again and again.
ZH_TEXT: 生命是持續恢復平衡的努力。具有無比思考能力的人類渴望得到全面性的開展，他們必須從事向內追尋的靈性修持以發展精細的思考能力和達到全面性的開展，必須在相對和絕對世界中獲得平衡。缺乏此種平衡，思想將不斷受到干擾。

When the perceiver, perceivable, and perception; or the knower, knowable, and knowledge become one; or when the deed and the “doable” become one with the doer; one attains non-dualistic self-knowledge, or becomes the embodiment of knowledge. Only this is real knowledge.
ZH_TEXT: 對一個了知全宇宙之境的人而言，所有的知識都是靈性直覺知識。當知者、知與可知者融合成為一體時，或者是當行為和行為者合一時，他即獲得非二元相對的自我了悟知識，或是他自身成為知識的具體化現。唯有這個才是真正的知識。

We take shelter in Him, who is the ship in the vast ocean of bhava (bundle of saḿskáras responsible for rebirth). You, the Supreme Lord, the one without shelter, are the Supreme Culminating Point of all the created beings in the universe.
ZH_TEXT: 我們只記得那個本體，我們持誦祂的聖名，我們向那全宇宙的見證者致敬，我們以祂為庇護，祂是保護我們通過無盡業力海洋的大船。至上之主啊！您無須任何庇護，您是宇宙萬有至高的終點。

EN_TEXT: Spiritual aspirants are called Brahma sádhaka… Although the Cognitive Principle is the object of ideation, a spiritual aspirant cannot keep himself away from, aloof from, worldly business, because his physical structure is a part of this quinquelemental world. He cannot remain away from this observable universe. His mental structure is also an expression of the Macropsychic conation. So he will have to come in contact with physicality. But while coming in contact with physicality, certainly for some time he will have to accept physical objects as his object of ideation; and if any physical object is taken as an object of ideation, what will happen? He will dart himself away from the nave of the universe. This darting away from the nave of the universe means negative introversion. A sádhaka, a spiritual aspirant, cannot do this. So while coming in contact with any object of this quinquelemental world, he will have to ascribe Brahma-hood to those objects. This ascription of Brahma-hood saves him from downfall.
ZH_TEXT: 修行者被稱為「宇宙本體的修行者」。……雖然宇宙認知力是其觀想持念的目標，修行者亦不可忽略或遠離世俗之事，因為他的身體仍然屬於五大原素世界，他無法離開這可見的世界。他的心理結構也是大宇宙心靈體的一種表達。所以他依然必須與物質世界接觸。在與此物質世界接觸的同時，他有時會以物質為目標，如果他選擇了物質為其觀想持念的目標，那麼會發生什麼事呢？他將遠離宇宙核心，此為反向心力。靈性修持者必不可如此。所以當與此五大原素的世界接觸時，他必須心懷宇宙本體，將一切歸之於宇宙本體，如此方才能夠使他免於墮落。

EN_TEXT: How should one take Cosmic ideation? Human beings make the mistake of mostly thinking about material objects (viśaya), subtle or crude. Parama Puruśa, to Whom you are an object, is your subject. How can you take Him as your object? To accept Parama Puruśa as your object means to surrender your microcosmic identity to His Macrocosmic identity. You must take yourself back to your original stance – an act of total surrender at the altar of Parama Puruśa.
ZH_TEXT: 該如何從事對宇宙理念的持念觀想呢？人類常犯一個錯誤就是多半都是想著精細或粗鈍的物質客體(viśaya)。對至上意識而言，你才是客體，而祂是你的主體。如何方能把祂當成你的目標呢？接受至上意識為你的目標意指將你個體小宇宙的存在臣服於祂。你必須將自身帶回你的源頭──此為完全臣服在至上意識的聖壇前。

EN_TEXT: What is this future? What should be the future? You should become one with Parama Puruśa by merging into Him. Then everything will be known and revealed to you. Unite with Him and enjoy the bliss of spiritual ambrosia. The meaning of unification with Parama Puruśa is to enjoy Parama Puruśa. What is the use of knowing the history of your previous births? Such knowledge will never help your spiritual advancement.
ZH_TEXT: 未來是什麼？未來應該如何呢？你應藉著融入祂而與至上意識合而為一，到那時候，每件事都會呈現在你面前，並為你所知。與祂合而為一並享受靈性佳餚的喜悅，與至上意識合一的意思就是享受至上意識。知道你生生世世的歷史又有何用呢？這樣的知識對你靈性的進步絕無助益。
IT_TEXT: Che cos'è questo futuro? Quale dovrebbe essere il futuro? Dovreste diventare una cosa sola con Parama Purusa, fondendovi in Lui. Allora tutto vi sarà conosciuto e rivelato. Unitevi a Lui e godete della beatitudine del nettare spirituale. Il significato dell'unione con Parama Purusa è godere di Parama Purusa. A che serve conoscere la storia delle vostre vite precedenti? Una tale conoscenza non aiuterà mai il vostro progresso spirituale.

ZH_TEXT: 我已介紹過「清晨五時晨光靜坐」(páiṋcajanya)的方法幫助你們從這個階段中獲得喜悅。在「早上五點鐘」從事靜坐，心靈自然而然充滿喜悅的波流，它無需任何外在的事物，只要一個人內在的自性。具足此一自性的每一個人皆能透過「清晨五時晨光靜坐」而達到了悟的境界，它將為你帶來成功，為人類生命帶來嶄新的精神。其生命將閃耀著至上意識的神性光輝。  願降生於此世界的你們在各方面都成功。我希望你們的存在發出閃耀的光芒，因活著的喜悅而無比燦爛。這就是為什麼我提出「清晨五時晨光靜坐」和「對大眾從事慈善布施」的原因，因為這會為你們的生命帶來至上的圓滿。不論是個體生命或集體生命，願你們在此地球的生命是圓滿成功的。

EN_TEXT: For a unit mind the wisest course of action is to ideate on the Supreme Entity, for by doing this it will become increasingly elevated. The nature of mind is to become as it thinks. Thus when a mind constantly ideates on the Supreme Entity, it gradually expands and eventually becomes one with the Cosmic Mind and it automatically becomes composed.
ZH_TEXT: 對個體心靈而言，最聰明的行動就是持念、觀想至上本體，因為這麼做將使得心靈快速地提升。心靈的特質就是它會變成它所想的，因此當心靈不斷持念、觀想至上本體時，它就會慢慢的擴展，最後與大宇宙心靈合一，自然也就達到平靜了。

EN_TEXT: "Salutations to the ancestors, salutations to the god-like rśis. The act of offering is Brahma; that which is offered is Brahma; the one to whom the offering is made is Brahma; and the person making the offering is Brahma. One will merge in Brahma after completing the duty assigned to him/her by Brahma."
ZH_TEXT: 「我向列祖列宗致敬，我向古聖先賢致敬；奉獻的舉動是至上意識，奉獻之物是至上意識；奉獻的對象是至上意識，奉獻的人也是至上意識；奉獻者的目標是至上意識，當完成世上工作後，他將與至上意識合而為一。」 你們應該知道這梵咒的意義，它與「至上圓滿法」最接近，亦即它將所有世上的工作都視為至上意識的顯現。

EN_TEXT: That is, when the jiivas come nearer to Parama Puruśa it of course causes immense bliss to Him – which is called liilánanda. But the volume of bliss of the jiiva is a billion times greater than what Parama Puruśa enjoys out of that liilánanda. That is why people should devote themselves to sádhaná. As long as one remains a sádhaka one enjoys and stays in liilánanda. And when he or she has become successful and merges with God, he or she stays in nityánanda. So one always gains never loses.
ZH_TEXT: 當個體更接近至上意識時，當然會帶給祂無比的喜悅，此稱之為「遊戲三昧的喜悅」，但是個體所得到的喜悅比起至上意識從遊戲中享受到的大了十億倍之多。所以，人們應投身於靈性修持，只要他還在靈修，他就享有並處於遊戲三昧的喜悅中，當他有所成就並融入於至上時，他便置身於永恆的喜悅裡。所以一個人永遠是贏家。

EN_TEXT: As religions are dependent upon various changing factors, they differ widely from one another. They criticize and mock each other, exaggerating the otherʼs defects and refusing to acknowledge the otherʼs positive qualities. As they have no eternal entity as their goal, they are influenced more by allegiance to their own sect than by any love for humanity... The entire universe is everyoneʼs homeland, and all the animate and inanimate entities are the various expressions of one and the same Supreme being.
ZH_TEXT: 由於宗教是建立在許多變動的因素上，所以彼此間的差異也相當大。他們互相批評和嘲笑，誇大對方的缺點，並拒絕承認其他教派好的特質。因為他們沒有以永恆的本體作為目標，故他們受到對教派忠誠的影響勝於對人類的愛。……所有一切生命體或非生命體都是來自同一且唯一的至上本體，是祂多采多姿的顯現。

EN_TEXT: The people of medieval times fought among the clans and communities, and the people of today are fighting over their isms. Just as religions did in the past, the isms are criticizing each other today, betraying their spirit of intolerance as they try to gag each otherʼs voices. It seems that they have no other goal than carping, criticizing, and slandering each other. They are befooling the ignorant masses by painting rosy pictures of service, peace and happiness. On the other hand they themselves are going far away from the path of selfless service and welfare. To emancipate the masses from the unhealthy influence of isms, there is no other way than universalism. Only universalism is free from the defects of any narrowisms because everything of this entire universe comes within its vast periphery.
ZH_TEXT: 中世紀的人在不同族群、部落間相互爭戰，而現在的人則為他們各自所擁護的主義而戰。如同過去宗教的作為，現在不同的主義間也互相批評並盡力箝制、打壓別人的言論，完全背離了寬容的精神。他們的目標似乎只是互揭瘡疤、批評和中傷。他們以服務、和平和快樂所畫出的明亮願景來欺瞞無知的大眾，在同時他們也讓自己愈來愈遠離無私服務和福祉的道路。要讓群眾自不健康的主義影響中脫離出來，除了推廣『宇宙一體』的觀念外，沒有別的方法。只有宇宙一體觀能避免所有狹隘主義的缺點，因為宇宙萬有都是來自於這無限的本體。

EN_TEXT: It is only with the help of átmánátma viveka that the human beings can emerge from the mire of the present century and move towards universalism with firm steps. By virtue of átmánátma viveka people can realize that Brahma is the Eternal Singular Entity, pure Consciousness.
ZH_TEXT: 只有藉助明辨何者為意識何者為非意識的能力，人類才能從現今世紀的泥沼中掙脫出來，並以堅定穩健的腳步朝向宇宙一體前進。具足此種分別明辨能力的人將了悟到至上本體是永恆唯一的純淨意識。

EN_TEXT: Everything in this universe is a metamorphosed form of Consciousness. This metamorphosis takes place due to the influence of the static principle. The creation of the world of forms by the static principle continues as a result of the changes in the flow of endless waves. Forms are the expressions of the formless due to the influence of the static Prakrti. So Consciousness, in the process of crudification, is turned into solid matter and takes the form of a perceptible object, relinquishing its original quality of witness-ship. That is, Consciousness (Átmabháva) becomes metamorphosed into non-consciousness (anátmabháva). From mind to solid matter there is the domination of non-consciousness and hence the existence of the three factors: knower, knowledge, and knowable.
ZH_TEXT: 宇宙中的萬事萬物都是意識的變形，這是由於受到惰性法則的影響，在此法則下所產生的有形世界是無盡波流不斷變化的結果。無形無相的本體受到造化勢能惰性法則的影響所展現出來的就是有形的世界。因此意識在粗鈍化的過程中，變成固體物質，取得可被感知的物體形象，失去了它原有見證的特質。也就是說意識(Átmabháva)變形成為非意識(anátmabháva)。自心靈以至固體物質，皆以非意識佔優勢，所以才有能知者、知與可知者三者的存在。

EN_TEXT: In the beginning, there was sound, and the sound was with God, and the sound was God. You know, amongst different expressions, the expression of sound is the subtlest, subtler even than light, and that is why the karńendriya, the ear, is treated as the subtlest organ. Now, these acoustic expressions are of two kinds: one is divine, or spiritual, acoustic expression, and the other is physical acoustic expression. The sound you hear is physical acoustic expression, and similarly there is spiritual acoustic expression in the divine realm, in the spiritual campus. But in the case of the Non-Attributional Entity, in the case of Nirguńa Brahma, there is no expression, because Nirguńa means “where there has been no expression”. But in the case of Saguńa [Saguńa Brahma, the Attributional Entity] and even starting from Puruśottama [the Nucleus Consciousness], there is expression. And that expression, till it reaches the physical sphere, is spiritual acoustic expression, spiritual sound.
ZH_TEXT: 太初有音，音與上帝同在，音就是上帝。你們知道，在所有的表達中，音聲的表達最為精細，比光波還精細，因此耳朵(karńendriya)被視為最精細的器官。音聲的表達有兩種：一種是神聖的或靈性的音聲表達；另一種是物質的音聲表達。你們耳朵所能聽見的音聲表達是物質界的音聲表達，同樣的在神性的領域裡存在著靈性的音聲表達。但是在無屬性至上本體(Nirguńa Brahma)的狀態，就沒有任何表達存在，因為無屬性(Nirguńa)意指「沒有任何表達展現之處」;但在俱屬性至上本體(Saguńa Brahma)裡，甚至是從至上核心意識(Puruśottama)而來正要開始之處，就有了表達，在未來到物質層面前的音聲表達，是為靈性的音聲展現，也就是靈性的音聲。
IT_TEXT: In principio era il suono, e il suono era con Dio, e il suono era Dio. Tra le diverse forme di espressione, quella del suono è la più sottile, più sottile persino della luce; ed è per questo che il karnendriya, l’organo dell’udito, è considerato il più sottile. Ora, queste espressioni acustiche sono di due tipi: una è l’espressione acustica divina, o spirituale, e l’altra è l’espressione acustica fisica. Il suono che percepite con i sensi è espressione acustica fisica; allo stesso modo esiste un’espressione acustica spirituale nel dominio divino, nel piano spirituale. Ma nel caso dell’Entità Non-Attributiva, nel caso di Nirguṇa Brahma, non vi è alcuna espressione, perché “nirguṇa” significa “dove non c’è stata alcuna manifestazione”. Nel caso di Saguṇa Brahma – l’Entità con attributi – e già a partire da Puruṣottama, la Coscienza Nucleare, invece, vi è espressione. E tale espressione, fino a quando non raggiunge la sfera fisica, è espressione acustica spirituale, suono spirituale.

EN_TEXT: Now, one may catch this physical sound according to the capacity of oneʼs acoustic organs, oneʼs ears. You cannot catch very short or very long sounds. Similarly, in the inner sphere there are several stages, several strata, several phases; and when the inner senses develop by dint of sádhaná, one will hear that divine sound, that inner sound. It is known as the sound of silence. The what? The sound of silence. And it is what is known as oṋḿkára in Sanskrit – prańava or oṋḿkára.
ZH_TEXT: 一個人根據其耳朵的聽力，或許能聽得見物質層面的聲波，但你們無法聽見極長或極短的聲波。同樣的，在內在的領域裡，也有許多階段、層面，當一個人透過靈性的修持將內在的感官能力發展時，他將聽見那神性的音聲，那內在的音聲。此音聲稱之為「寂靜之音」，就是梵文中所謂的「唵聲」(oṋḿkára或prańava)。

ZH_TEXT: 何謂頂輪(sahasrára cakra)?頂輪為意識(Átma)與至上意識(Paramátma)兩者所在之處，位於腦下垂體以上十指之處。被稱為安住於眉心輪十指之上的原因即在此。換言之，祂出現於腦下垂體以上十指之處──祂有祂自己的住所，祂存在於至上本體與意識的世界，沒有人是在祂之外的。

EN_TEXT: Whatever you are to do, you are to do for your own liberation – átmamokśárthaḿ. Then, jagaddhitáya ca – “for the hita of the jagat.” Hita includes all the four sevás – shúdrocita, kśatriyocita, vaeshyocita, and viprocita. But you should remember that viprocita sevá is of permanent nature. So a good person should follow this principle: that his or her life is for self-realization and the welfare of the universe: átmamokśárthaḿ and jagaddhitáya ca.
ZH_TEXT: 你的所作所為都應是為了自我的了悟(átmamokśárthaḿ)，以及為了世界的福祉(jagaddhitáya ca)。造福眾生的福祉包含四種類型的服務(shúdrocita勞動、kśatriyocita武士、vaeshyocita商人、viprocita智士)，然而你必須記住，其中以智力的服務最具永恆的特質，所以一個好人應該依此原則修持，也就是他的生命應該是為了自我的了悟，以及為了宇宙眾生的福祉。

EN_TEXT: After worldly death the disembodied soul will have to breathe in from the state of pause of the Cosmic-I to perpetuate its I-feeling, or course through the medium of a different body. That is why the unit mind should exhale with Cosmic ideation, for this leads to parallelism between the Macrocosmic waves and the microcosmic waves. At this stage there remains only one unbroken Cosmic flow which means liberation for the microcosm.
ZH_TEXT: 世俗肉身死亡後，離開的靈魂必須從宇宙大我的暫停狀態來行呼吸，或透過另一個肉身為媒介以維持其我覺。此即何以個體心靈呼氣時應懷有宇宙理念作用的原因，因為這麼做將可使個體小宇宙的波流與大宇宙波流平行，此時唯有一永恆不斷的宇宙波流存在，這也就是個體小宇宙的解脫。

EN_TEXT: The resultant flow created due to clash between the waves of the Cognitive Faculty, and those of the three principles of Prakrti, is called the spiritual flow. And the special resultant created in microcosms by this spiritual flow is called spiritual inspiration. Inspiration and the thought of universal welfare are inseparable. The spiritually inspired mind should apply its power on the material world so that matter can be used benevolently for human progress. Trees, stones and earth are not easily moved by spiritual inspiration; nor are people of static nature. The difference between human beings and inanimate objects is that the former possess minds. If crude people fail to imbibe spiritual vibrations, highly evolved sádhakas, using the powerful thought of human welfare, should create spiritual vibrations in their minds. This endeavour is called proper application of spiritual energy.
ZH_TEXT: 認知能力之波流間的摩擦衝擊而產生之波流，以及造化勢能三種法則所產生的波流，稱之為靈性波流。此靈性波流為個體小宇宙中所帶來的特殊結果就稱為「靈性鼓舞」。 靈性鼓舞與為眾生謀求福利是不可分的。受到靈性鼓舞的心靈應運用其力量於物質世界，如此物質方可有益於人類進步。樹木、石頭和泥土不容易受到靈性的鼓舞，惰性本質之人亦然。人類和無生命之物間最大的不同就是人類具有心靈。如果粗鈍之人不能接受靈性的波動，高度進化的靈修者應利用造福人類的強大慈悲胸懷，在他們心裡製造靈性的波動。此一努力稱為靈性能量的正確運用。

EN_TEXT: When the application of energy is internal it is called ádhyátmik saldhaná or spiritual practice. Spiritual practice is a constant process of purification of body and mind. It causes the physical and psychic waves to attain greater parallelism with the Cosmic wave.
ZH_TEXT: 內在能量的運用稱為「靈性鍛鍊」(ádhyátmik saldhaná)。靈性鍛鍊是一種持續潔淨身心的過程，它使身體和心智的波流到達一種與大宇宙波流平行的境界。

EN_TEXT: What is the meaning of mamatá? Mama + tá = mamatá. Mama means “mine” and thus mamatá is the inner idea of being mine, the feeling that something is my own. One does not think of anything as being oneʼs own except Parama Puruśa (Viśńu) This spiritual outlook can also be called “prema”. One who has thus taken Parama Puruśa as his or her own gets everything in Parama Puruśa and has a grip over the entire universe. Everything will eventually come under the control of such a devotee. To think that Parama Puruśa and nothing else is oneʼs own is therefore the cleverest thing to do. That is why it has been said “mamatá”: everything becomes full by His mamatá. Everyone will feel His closest proximity and receive the same treatment from Him as His nearest ones.
ZH_TEXT: 何謂瑪瑪塔(mamatá)?Mama tá=Mamatá。瑪瑪(Mama)意指「我的」，因此瑪瑪塔為內在認為某物是屬於自己的一種想法。一個人除了至上意識以外，不把任何東西認為是屬於自己的，這種靈性的見解也可以稱為神性之愛。一個像這樣將至上意識認為是屬於自己的人，將得到至上意識的一切，並且掌控整個宇宙。像這樣的虔誠者，一切事物最終將置於他的掌控中。因此，最聰明的作法是只把至上意識當成是自己的，那就是為何經典上說到瑪瑪塔的原因：在祂的瑪瑪塔裡，一切都變得圓滿，每個人都將感覺到祂是最親密的，並且從祂那裡得到祂視為親密之人的同等對待。

EN_TEXT: Devotees are capable of doing anything and everything. On the one hand they can endure immense torture, and on the other hand they can dance, sing and feast in joy. For them life is an abundance of blossoming flowers and sumptuous fruits. They derive bliss from every aspect of their lives.
ZH_TEXT: 虔誠者能夠做一切事，他們一方面能忍受巨大的磨難，而在另一方面又能快樂地唱歌、跳舞與享受。對於他們而言，生命充滿了盛開的花朵與鮮美的果實，他們的喜悅來自於生命的每一層面。

EN_TEXT: One does not think of anything as being oneʼs own except Parama Puruśa (Viśńu) This spiritual outlook can also be called “prema”. One who has thus taken Parama Puruśa as his or her own gets everything in Parama Puruśa and has a grip over the entire universe. Everything will eventually come under the control of such a devotee. To think that Parama Puruśa and nothing else is oneʼs own is therefore the cleverest thing to do. That is why it has been said “mamatá”: everything becomes full by His mamatá. Everyone will feel His closest proximity and receive the same treatment from Him as His nearest ones. He will take everybody on His lap, saying, “Donʼt worry. I have come to help you”. This is the second characteristic of Iishvaraprema.  Bháva sa eva sándrátma budhaeh premanigatyate. To look upon the world with an all-encompassing vision, seeing everything as an expression of Parama Puruśa is called prema by those who are wise.
ZH_TEXT: 一個人除了至上意識外，不把任何東西認為是屬於自己的，這種靈性的見解也可以稱為神性之愛。一個像這樣將至上意識認為是屬於自己的人，將得到至上意識的一切，並且掌控整個宇宙。像這樣的虔誠者，一切事物最終將置於他的掌控中。因此，最聰明的作法是只把至上意識當成是自己的，這就是mamatá。由於祂的神性之愛(mamatá)，一切都變得圓滿，每個人都感覺到祂是最親密的，並且也被祂視為最親密之人。祂會將每一個人置於祂的膝上並安慰道：「別擔心，我來幫助你了。」這是內在對上主之愛(Iishvaraprema)的第二個特徵。Bháva sa eva sándrátma budhaeh premanigatyate──以整體的眼光看世界，將每件事物看成是至上意識的顯現，那些有智慧的人稱此為神性之愛。

EN_TEXT: Who have attained Iishvaraprema, can never and will never exploit others. They will raise their voice against all sorts of tyranny, injustice and exploitation. Those who do not possess that kind of honest courage to oppose all wrongs are nothing but fakes – they are never genuine. Bhakti premasvarúpinii.  The actions of those absorbed in prema will reflect the true spirit of selfless benevolence.
ZH_TEXT: 內在對上主有真愛的人永不能也不會剝削其他人。他們將高聲疾呼，反對所有各種暴虐、不公與剝削。那些沒有誠實的勇氣對抗邪惡的人只是個冒牌貨—他們永遠不是真誠的。 Bhakti premasvarúpinii—那些專注於神性之愛的人，其行為將反映出無私、慈悲的真正精神。

EN_TEXT: There is another expression of bhakti which occurs when devotees realize that all beings are created from ánanda, exist in ánanda and return to ánanda. This realization causes a radical change in their outlook – no longer can they differentiate between rich and poor, highborn and low-born. They observe an ocean of ánanda flowing within and around all created beings. “Rasa vae sah” – all are flowing in the same rasa, the same ocean of bliss.
ZH_TEXT: 虔誠尚有另一種的表達，它發生於當虔誠者了悟到萬物創造於喜悅、存在於喜悅，並且最後回歸於喜悅之中。此了悟徹底改變了他們原有的想法，他們再也不會在貧富之間、高貴與低微的出生之間產生分別心。他們看到在其內在與萬有中有一喜悅之洋的流動。Rasa vae sah──一切在同一個波流(rasa)、同一個喜悅的海洋裡流動。

EN_TEXT: In the practice of yoga Sádhakas elevate Jaevii Shakti Kula Kuńd́alini (coiled serpentine) and merge it into Paramátmá. As the Kula Kuńd́alinii crosses various plexii the spiritual aspirant achieves Siddhis at the various stages of Yoga. The kula kuńd́alini can be raised only when the Sádhaka has a longing for Paramátman.
ZH_TEXT: 在瑜伽的鍛鍊裡，修行者提升其沉睡的生命潛能(Kula Kuńd́alini)融入至上意識。隨著沉睡的生命潛能穿越不同脈輪，靈性的修持者亦在瑜伽不同的階段裡得到各種成就(Siddhi)。只有當修行者對至上意識有強烈渴望時，生命沉睡的潛能才能被提升。

EN_TEXT: A Yogi depends on Bhakti in toto. Where there is no Bhakti the heart of a Yogi becomes like a barren desert. The heart of a Sadhaka is like soil, Iśtá Mantra the seed and Bhakti water. Where there are no cool showers of Bhakti there is no use sowing seed in a desert. So to be an ideal Yogi is the goal of everyone but one must remember that Bhakti has to be aroused.
ZH_TEXT: 瑜伽行者完全仰賴虔誠心，瑜伽行者的心中若無虔誠心，就會如沙漠般荒蕪。修行者的心就好比土壤，其生命目標梵咒(Iśtá Mantra)是種子，而虔誠則是水。沒有虔誠之水的澆灌，在沙漠中播種是徒勞無功的。所以成就自身為瑜伽行者的典範是每個人的目標，但一定要記得必須先喚起虔誠心。

EN_TEXT: One should always remember that one is serving Parama Puruśa and none other. Had Parama Puruśa not come in your contact in the form of living beings, you would not have an opportunity to serve Him. He comes to you as a sick person or as a beggar to solicit your assistance. Naturally you are more grateful than the person you serve because Parama Puruśa has given you the opportunity to serve Him. Thus everyone should render external service.
ZH_TEXT: 我們應永遠記住，我們服務的就是至上意識本身而非其他。至上意識如果未以眾生的形象來到你的跟前，你就不會有服務祂的良機。祂以病人或乞丐的形象來到你的跟前請求你的幫助，當然，你比受你服務的人更為愉悅，因為至上意識給你服務祂的機會。因此每人皆應從事外在的服務。

EN_TEXT: What could be more painful than spiritual bondage, which is the greatest obstacle in the path of human movement, and which leads human beings to forget their humanity and identify themselves with animality? Yet to fight against these obstacles and emerge victorious, and thereby to bring about human emancipation – all these tasks become easier if human beings take the shelter of Parama Puruśa.
ZH_TEXT: 有什麼比靈性束縛更令人痛苦的呢？它是人類前進道上最大的阻礙，它讓人們忘了自己的人性，而視自身為動物。然而，如果人類能以至上意識為庇護，則要與這些阻礙戰鬥，並獲得勝利為人類帶來解脫，這種種工作就會變得簡單多了。

EN_TEXT: One of the important expressions of negative microvita on human mind or human society is dogma. If you want to encourage positive microvita, encourage spirituality, you must fight dogma in different spheres and levels and arenas and strata of our society. This never-ending fight against dogma will help you a lot in establishing a society of spiritualistic order, maintaining a balance amongst the three layers of human existence, the physical, the psychic and the spiritual.(1) Wherever there is suppression, repression and oppression human beings are forced to follow the path of dogma. Communism preaches dogma, capitalism preaches dogma, and so-called religions based on the scriptures also preach dogma. Now is the time for the emergence for the third psychic force where there will be no more suppression, repression and oppression. Let the mind develop according to its longings; let the mind be free. Let there be a human society of coordination and cooperation.(2)
ZH_TEXT: 在人類心理或人類社會裡，負性微生元的一個重要的表現是「教條」。如果你們要促進正性微生元，促進靈修，你們必須要在社會的各個層面和教條作戰；與教條做無止盡的奮戰，將幫助你們建立一個靈性秩序的社會，並維持人類在物理、心理、靈性三個層面生存的平衡。(1) 只要有壓抑、壓制和壓迫的地方，人類便被迫要走上教條之路。共產主義宣揚教條，資本主義宣揚教條，而所謂以經典為基礎的宗教也宣揚教條。現在是第三種心理力量出現的時候了，在這種力量裡不會再有壓抑、壓制和壓迫。讓心靈依照其渴望來發展，讓心靈自由，讓我們人類的社會是一個協調與合作的社會。(2)
